title: $π^2$: Structure-Originated Reasoning Data Improves Long-Context Reasoning Ability of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: π2 turns Wikipedia tables into long-context QA with SQL/Python-agreed answers and back-translated reasoning traces for data-efficient SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: π2 将 Wikipedia 表格转成由 SQL 与 Python 双路径确认答案的长上下文问答，再反向生成推理轨迹用于高效 SFT。

title: A benchmark of expert-level academic questions to assess AI capabilities

one_line_summary.en: Humanity's Last Exam releases an expert-written frontier academic benchmark with closed-ended multimodal and text questions graded by reference answers.
one_line_summary.zh: Humanity's Last Exam 汇集全球专家编写的闭合式学术难题，用多选/短答参考答案评测 frontier model 的知识与推理边界。

title: A Comprehensive Survey of Process Reward Models: Data Generation, Model Construction, and Usage

one_line_summary.en: A 2026 ACL survey that traces process reward models from labeled reasoning data through construction to search and reinforcement-learning use.
one_line_summary.zh: 贯通过程数据生成、过程奖励模型构建与使用的 2026 年 ACL 综述。

title: A Narrowing Geometry in Contaminated Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: A mechanistic account links contaminated reasoning to geometric narrowing and tests an intervention that restores base-model consistency.
one_line_summary.zh: 从内部几何收缩解释污染推理，并用干预部分恢复与基础模型的一致性。

title: A Primer in Post-Training Reasoning Data: What We Know About How It Works

one_line_summary.en: This primer organizes more than 150 studies into a practical map of reasoning-data objects, utility signals, construction choices, and scaling limits.
one_line_summary.zh: 这篇 primer 把 150 多项研究整理为推理数据对象、效用信号、构造选择和规模边界的实用地图。

title: A Survey of Inductive Reasoning for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: An ACL 2026 survey that organizes inductive reasoning methods by post-training, exploration, data augmentation, and evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理大语言模型归纳推理的训练、探索、数据增强与评测方法。

title: A Survey of Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Progress and Challenges

one_line_summary.en: An ACL 2026 survey of retrieval tasks where finding evidence depends on an inferential connection, not only semantic similarity.
one_line_summary.zh: 梳理需要依靠隐含推断关系而非仅靠语义相似度的检索任务、基准与方法。

title: ABC-Bench: Benchmarking Agentic Backend Coding in Real-World Development

one_line_summary.en: ABC-Bench evaluates agents on 224 containerized backend-development tasks whose deployed services must pass end-to-end HTTP API tests.
one_line_summary.zh: ABC-Bench 将 224 个后端开发任务放入容器化服务环境，以部署后的真实 HTTP API 测试验证智能体的端到端实现。

title: ActiveDPO: Active Direct Preference Optimization for Sample-Efficient Alignment

one_line_summary.en: ActiveDPO uses the target policy's projected implicit-reward gradients to actively acquire diverse, high-uncertainty preference pairs for iterative DPO.
one_line_summary.zh: ActiveDPO 利用目标策略投影后的隐式奖励梯度，主动获取多样且高不确定性的偏好对，再进行迭代式 DPO 训练。

title: Adaptive Generate-Rank-Verify: Inference-Time Search with Costly Verification

one_line_summary.en: ADAP adaptively grows a candidate pool and verifies its top-ranked members, with a constant-factor cost guarantee under a monotone score-success assumption.
one_line_summary.zh: ADAP 根据廉价排序分数逐步扩大候选池，并只为高分候选支付昂贵验证成本，在单调假设下接近最优开销。

title: Adaptive Test-Time Compute Allocation for Reasoning LLMs via Constrained Policy Optimization

one_line_summary.en: A budget-allocation method that turns repeated responses into supervised compute-policy labels.
one_line_summary.zh: AdaCompute-LLM 为问题—预算组合收集 48 个响应，以受约束目标的拉格朗日标签训练分类器，从而按问题分配推理计算量。

title: Adaptive Test-Time Compute Allocation via Learned Heuristics over Categorical Structure

one_line_summary.en: The method saves verifier calls by gating invalid moves, ranking viable moves, and allocating a local verification budget at each reasoning state.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法通过筛除无效动作、排序可行动作并逐状态分配验证预算来节约验证调用。

title: Adaptive Test-Time Compute Allocation with Evolving In-Context Demonstrations

one_line_summary.en: The method reallocates later inference rounds to unresolved queries and conditions them on successful, semantically related test-time demonstrations.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法把后续推理轮次分配给未解决问题，并用语义相近的成功测试时示例改变其生成条件。

title: Adaptive Thinking: Large Language Models Know When to Think in Latent Space

one_line_summary.en: Adaptive Thinking: Large Language Models Know When to Think in Latent Space
one_line_summary.zh: 固定思考预算会在简单提示上浪费 token、在困难提示上投入不足，而查询复杂度与计算最优预算的关系并不清楚。

title: Advancing Block Diffusion Language Models for Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: The paper makes block-diffusion reasoning scale at test time by adapting denoising and using coarse exploration followed by fine-grained critique.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究让块扩散推理在测试时同时自适应控制去噪和推理块大小，以平衡探索、细化与速度。

title: AdverMCTS: Combating Pseudo-Correctness in Code Generation via Adversarial Monte Carlo Tree Search

one_line_summary.en: AdverMCTS co-evolves a Solver code-search tree and an Attacker test-search tree, retaining Arbiter-labeled counterexamples as a growing hard verifier at inference time.
one_line_summary.zh: AdverMCTS 让 Solver 代码树与 Attacker 测试树共同演化，并把同一主干模型的 Arbiter 标注反例存为逐题动态硬验证器；但 79.88% 测试有效率与 16.1% 误杀率表明，持久约束仍可能被错误标签污染。

title: Aegis: Automated Error Generation and Attribution for Multi-Agent Systems

one_line_summary.en: Aegis converts deterministic successful multi-agent runs into 9,533 evaluator-confirmed faulty trajectories with agent/error-mode labels, while mixed verifiers and selective failure retention bound reuse.
one_line_summary.zh: Aegis 将确定性成功的多智能体运行转化为 9,533 条经 mixed evaluator 确认失败的完整 episode，并附 agent/error-mode 归因；其选择性保留、分组策略未披露与未固定回放限制训练复用。

title: Agent Island: A Saturation- and Contamination-Resistant Benchmark from Multiagent Games

one_line_summary.en: Agent Island releases a frozen CC BY 4.0 manifest of 999 seven-agent social-strategy episodes and ranks winner outcomes with Bayesian Plackett-Luce, while its separate live leaderboard continues to drift.
one_line_summary.zh: Agent Island 发布了含 999 场七智能体社交策略 episode 的冻结 CC BY 4.0 manifest，并以 Bayesian Plackett-Luce 对胜者结果建模；独立的 live leaderboard 会持续漂移。

title: Agent-Diff: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise API Tasks via Code Execution with State-Diff-Based Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** Two hundred twenty-four enterprise API tasks scored automatically from database state differences before and after execution.
one_line_summary.zh: 224 个企业 API 任务用执行前后数据库状态差分自动判分。

title: Agent-X: Evaluating Deep Multimodal Reasoning in Vision-Centric Agentic Tasks

one_line_summary.en: Agent-X provides 828 human-reviewed multimodal tool-use tasks with stepwise traces and judges that score local decisions, full-chain reasoning, and final success separately.
one_line_summary.zh: Agent-X 提供 828 个经人工复核的多模态工具使用任务，以逐步轨迹分别评测局部决策、整链推理和最终成功。

title: AgentBeats: Agentifying Agent Assessment for Openness, Standardization, and Reproducibility

one_line_summary.en: AgentBeats turns a benchmark into an A2A/MCP judge agent that owns tasks, environments and scoring, and validates the interface through a 298-judge/467-subject field study plus standardized coding-agent episodes.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentBeats 将 benchmark 封装为掌管任务、环境与评分的 A2A/MCP judge agent，以统一评测 episode 的协议边界；但 arXiv v2 未绑定可重放轨迹、结果与实现清单。

title: AgentHER: Hindsight Experience Replay for LLM Agent Trajectory Relabeling

one_line_summary.en: AgentHER relabels recoverable failed WebArena and ToolBench episodes with LLM-synthesized hindsight goals and packages them as severity-weighted SFT, DPO, or ShareGPT records, while the public code and experiment release remain materially incomplete.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentHER 用 LLM 生成的后见目标重标可恢复的 WebArena 与 ToolBench 失败 episode，并封装为 severity-weighted SFT、DPO 或 ShareGPT 记录，但公开代码与实验发布仍存在关键缺口。

title: AgentProcessBench: Diagnosing Step-Level Process Quality in Tool-Using Agents

one_line_summary.en: AgentProcessBench supplies 1,000 tool-agent trajectories with 8,509 human ternary step labels for evaluating local process quality and first-error localization.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentProcessBench 提供 1,000 条工具智能体轨迹和 8,509 个人工三值步骤标签，用于评测局部过程质量与首错定位。

title: AgenTracer: Who Is Inducing Failure in the LLM Agentic Systems?

one_line_summary.en: AgenTracer turns successful and failed multi-agent episodes into decisive-agent/step labels through DeepSeek-R1-guided mutation or correction plus environment replay, but only a 127-row coding test subset of the reported 2,476 pairs is public and its license/replay contract is incomplete.
one_line_summary.zh: AgenTracer 通过 DeepSeek-R1 引导的纠错或故障注入与环境回放，把多智能体 episode 转成责任智能体/决定性步骤标签；但报告的 2,476 对数据中仅有 127 行 coding test 子集公开，许可与回放契约仍不完整。

title: AgentRx: Diagnosing AI Agent Failures from Execution Trajectories

one_line_summary.en: AgentRx provides 115 human-annotated failed executions with a critical step and cross-domain failure category, plus auditable constraint-based diagnosis.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentRx 为 115 条失败执行轨迹标注关键失败步骤和跨域失效类别，并提供可审计的约束式诊断记录。

title: AgentSim: A Platform for Verifiable Agent-Trace Simulation

one_line_summary.en: AgentSim releases grounded RAG-agent traces with stepwise decision labels, evidence, and provenance from an active validation pipeline.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 10 万余条带证据与决策标签的检索增强代理步骤，可训练 grounded 轨迹模型和过程奖励模型。

title: AgentSynth: Scalable Task Generation for Generalist Computer-Use Agents

one_line_summary.en: AgentSynth releases verified computer-use task sequences and trajectories whose difficulty scales by composing simple subtasks.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentSynth 将可解的简单子任务链式组合为难度可控的长程计算机使用任务，并公开相应执行轨迹。

title: Aligning Agents via Planning: A Benchmark for Trajectory-Level Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: Plan-RewardBench evaluates whether a judge can prefer safe, recoverable tool-use trajectories over closely confusable alternatives.
one_line_summary.zh: 1,171 个轨迹偏好比较、七个切分，覆盖规划、工具失效恢复、安全拒答与无关工具识别，适合长程奖励研究。

title: Alignment Data Map for Efficient Preference Data Selection and Diagnosis

one_line_summary.en: Alignment Data Map selects preference records by jointly measuring response quality and within-prompt variability, while exposing likely label mismatches.
one_line_summary.zh: Alignment Data Map 联合衡量回答质量与同题候选波动，选择更有效的偏好记录并暴露可能错标的样本。

title: AMO-Bench: Large Language Models Still Struggle in High School Math Competitions

one_line_summary.en: AMO-Bench uses high-school olympiad problems to expose persistent gaps in rigorous mathematical reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: 用高中奥数竞赛题揭示前沿模型在严谨数学推理上的持续短板。

title: An Execution-Verified Multi-Language Benchmark for Code Semantic Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: TraceEval evaluates code semantic reasoning by asking models to recover runtime call structure whose positive edges are witnessed by validation execution.
one_line_summary.zh: TraceEval 通过运行验证过的调用边，评测模型能否从源码恢复程序运行时调用结构。

title: An Imperfect Verifier is Good Enough: Learning with Noisy Rewards

one_line_summary.en: Local BibTeX seed for the 🪜 Process Supervision and Process Reward Models map; use it to inspect the paper's data object, verifier contract, and release metadata before promoting it.
one_line_summary.zh: 研究含噪验证器是否仍可支持有效学习，直接关系到 RLVR 中误判奖励会怎样影响策略更新。

title: ANCHOR: Branch-Point Data Generation for GUI Agents

one_line_summary.en: ANCHOR releases branch-point-expanded GUI trajectories with state-aware verification and step-level denoising.
one_line_summary.zh: ANCHOR 从已验证 GUI 演示中的分叉点扩展任务与轨迹，再用状态感知校验和步骤过滤生成面向局部决策的监督数据。

title: ARISE: An Adaptive Resolution-Aware Metric for Test-Time Scaling Evaluation in Large Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: ARISE evaluates test-time scaling by rewarding per-sample improvements and penalizing accuracy regressions that consume more tokens.
one_line_summary.zh: ARISE 以样本级正确性变化和词元成本评测测试时扩展，并惩罚越算越错的负向扩展。

title: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1

one_line_summary.en: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index aggregates multiple evaluations into a weighted model-quality score.
one_line_summary.zh: Artificial Analysis 智能指数把多个评测按权重合成为单一的模型质量分数。

title: Audio MultiChallenge: A Multi-Turn Evaluation of Spoken Dialogue Systems on Natural Human Interaction

one_line_summary.en: Audio MultiChallenge evaluates spoken dialogue systems on natural multi-turn interaction, including audio-native memory and voice editing.
one_line_summary.zh: 以自然人声中的记忆、约束保持、自洽与语音编辑检验端到端语音对话系统。

title: AutoL2S: Auto Long-Short Reasoning for Efficient Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A long-to-short reasoning-distillation recipe that attempts to retain correct concise traces.
one_line_summary.zh: AutoL2S 将长推理与短推理配对，保留正确且更短的答案，并以长度控制标记训练可在长短推理间切换的模型。

title: Autorubric: Unifying Rubric-based LLM Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: Autorubric unifies calibrated, rubric-based LLM evaluation with mixed criterion types, ensembles, and released benchmark artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: 统一二元、序数与名义 rubric 的校准、集成评审和可靠性度量，并发布 CHARM-100 等数据制品。

title: AutoSUIT Bench: Automated Security UnIt Test Benchmark for LLM Coding

one_line_summary.en: AutoSUIT Bench releases security-oriented unit-test suites spanning 232 CWE classes to jointly score functional and security behavior of generated code.
one_line_summary.zh: AutoSUIT Bench 自动构造覆盖 232 类 CWE 的安全单元测试套件，以编译和测试断言共同衡量代码功能与安全行为。

title: BarrierBench: Evaluating Large Language Models for Safety Verification in Dynamical Systems

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** One hundred dynamical-system barrier-certificate tasks strictly verify LLM-generated safety certificates with SMT.
one_line_summary.zh: 100 个动力系统 barrier certificate 任务，用 SMT 严格验证 LLM 生成安全证书。

title: Benchmark Test-Time Scaling of General LLM Agents

one_line_summary.en: General AgentBench evaluates sequential and parallel test-time scaling across general LLM agents and finds that extra trajectories help only when context use and trajectory verification remain reliable.
one_line_summary.zh: General AgentBench 在通用大语言模型智能体上评测顺序与并行两类测试时扩展，并发现额外轨迹只有在上下文利用和轨迹验证可靠时才会带来收益。

title: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Error Detection in Multimodal Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: PRMBench-V provides human-verified step-level error categories for auditing multimodal process reward models.
one_line_summary.zh: 以人工核验的九类局部错误，评估多模态过程奖励模型是否真正识别视觉推理失误。

title: Benchmarking LLM-as-a-Judge for Long-Form Output Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: Long-form judge benchmark emphasizing protocol-dependent reliability.
one_line_summary.zh: 以跨场景、跨协议基准检验 LLM 评审器对长文本输出的稳定性。

title: Benchmarking LLMs for Unit Test Generation from Real-World Functions
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology

one_line_summary.en: UnLeakedTestBench pairs 3,909 leakage-controlled real Python functions with a leaked counterpart and execution, coverage, and mutation metrics to separate test-generation generalization from memorization.
one_line_summary.zh: UnLeakedTestBench 以 3,909 个泄漏受控的真实 Python 函数及配对泄漏集，用执行、覆盖率和变异测试区分测试生成的泛化与记忆。

title: Best-of-Majority: Minimax-Optimal Strategy for Pass@k Inference Scaling

one_line_summary.en: Best-of-Majority gives a minimax-optimal, scaling-monotonic way to allocate sampled candidates under a Pass@k inference budget.
one_line_summary.zh: Best-of-Majority 在有限采样和提交预算下，以频率筛选结合奖励排序实现可随样本数稳定扩展的 pass@k 推理策略。

title: Beyond Final Answers: CRYSTAL Benchmark for Transparent Multimodal Reasoning Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: CRYSTAL supplies 6,372 quality-gated multimodal reference chains and order-sensitive metrics that expose correct answers reached through incomplete or disordered reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: CRYSTAL 提供 6,372 条经质量门控的多模态参考推理链，并以顺序敏感指标揭示“答对但推理缺失或失序”的情况。

title: Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: TrajFusion samples 16 math solutions, selects representative verifier-rejected errors using frequency and wrong-answer diversity, and fuses them with generic reflection prompts and one correct trace for standard SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: TrajFusion 从 16 条数学解答中选择代表性错误，将其与通用反思和一条正确轨迹融合为标准 SFT 目标；价值在构造配方，而非尚未发布的数据复用。

title: Beyond Theorem Proving: Formulation, Framework and Benchmark for Formal Problem-Solving

one_line_summary.en: FPS turns unknown-answer mathematics into replayable Lean state transitions, with RPE checking whether a completed formal answer is equivalent to the target.
one_line_summary.zh: FPS 将未知答案的数学求解建模为 Lean 中可重放的状态转移，并用 RPE 验证完成答案与目标的等价性。

title: Bridging Online and Offline RL: Contextual Bandit Learning for Multi-Turn Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: perturbed trajectory data for in-context reward-hacking analysis
one_line_summary.zh: 将多轮代码 RL 化为离线轨迹上的上下文 bandit 学习，并用扰动轨迹缓解错误反馈诱发的奖励投机。

title: BrowseComp-Plus: A Fair and Disentangled Evaluation Benchmark for Deep Search Agents

one_line_summary.en: A fixed-corpus BrowseComp derivative with 830 answerable queries, 100,195 web documents, human evidence/gold qrels, mixed answer/retrieval/citation grading, and four released frontier-agent trajectory archives.
one_line_summary.zh: BrowseComp-Plus 将 BrowseComp 筛为 830 个可核验证据的查询，并配套 100,195 篇固定网页语料、人类 evidence/gold qrels、混合评测器与四组部分发布的完整 agent 轨迹。

title: BrowseComp-V3: A Visual, Vertical, and Verifiable Benchmark for Multimodal Browsing Agents

one_line_summary.en: BrowseComp-V3 specifies visual, vertical, verifiable tasks for multimodal browsing agents.
one_line_summary.zh: BrowseComp-V3 定义面向多模态浏览智能体的视觉、垂直、可核验任务。

title: BrowseConf: Confidence-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Web Agents

one_line_summary.en: BrowseConf uses verbalized confidence to stop/retry web-agent rollouts.
one_line_summary.zh: BrowseConf 用模型自述的置信度决定网页智能体的采样何时停止、何时重试。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）

title: Can AI Agents Answer Your Data Questions? A Benchmark for Data Agents

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** Fifty-four realistic multi-database agent questions spanning 12 datasets, nine domains, and four DBMSes.
one_line_summary.zh: 54 个跨 12 数据集、9 领域、4 DBMS 的真实多数据库 agent 问题。

title: Can LLM-as-a-Judge Reliably Verify Rubrics in Agentic Scenarios?

one_line_summary.en: RuVerBench tests whether LLM judges can verify rubric compliance for long agentic reports and code against human labels.
one_line_summary.zh: 以 2,458 条长报告或代码输出、rubric 和人工满足性标签检验 Agent 场景 Judge 的可靠性。

title: CaTS: Calibrated Test-Time Scaling for Efficient LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: CaTS distills self-consistency confidence to allocate repeated-sampling budget and stop easy queries early.
one_line_summary.zh: CaTS 将自一致性得到的置信度蒸馏为可校准信号，用于在固定平均预算下动态停止或分配重复采样。

title: CATS: Conformalized Adaptive Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: CATS selects the least costly reasoning-effort level that satisfies a conformal bound on the probability of an incorrect answer.
one_line_summary.zh: CATS 在给定错误风险上限下，为每个问题自动选择成本最低的推理强度。

title: Chaining the Evidence: Robust Reinforcement Learning for Deep Search Agents with Citation-Aware Rubric Rewards

one_line_summary.en: CaRR turns deep-search answers into verifiable entity, citation, and evidence-chain rewards instead of a single outcome signal.
one_line_summary.zh: 将复杂检索问题拆成可验证单跳 rubric，并以实体、引用正确性和证据链完整度提供细粒度奖励。

title: Challenging the Boundaries of Reasoning: An Olympiad-Level Math Benchmark for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** Three hundred fifty bilingual olympiad problems unify numeric and Lean verification and release 582K+ trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: 350 道双语奥赛题统一数值答案和 Lean 两类验证，并开放 582K+ 轨迹。

title: Characterizing, Evaluating, and Optimizing Complex Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: The paper provides preference or reward feedback data for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: 该论文通过偏好数据刻画、评测并优化复杂推理能力。

title: ChartVerse: Scaling Chart Reasoning via Reliable Programmatic Synthesis from Scratch

one_line_summary.en: ChartVerse generates charts from executable programs and releases questions with both code solutions and long reasoning traces tied to known ground truth.
one_line_summary.zh: ChartVerse 从可执行制图程序出发，公开 180 万条带代码解法和长推理的可验证图表问答。

title: CHIMERA: Compact Synthetic Data for Generalizable LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** CHIMERA uses a hierarchical taxonomy and multi-model cross-validation to build about 9K compact reasoning examples across eight disciplines.
one_line_summary.zh: CHIMERA 用层级 taxonomy 和多模型交叉验证构造约 9K 条覆盖八学科的紧凑推理数据。

title: Chronos: Learning Temporal Dynamics of Reasoning Chains for Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: Chronos scores the temporal evolution of token confidence in sampled reasoning paths before weighted answer aggregation.
one_line_summary.zh: Chronos 在加权聚合前评估采样推理路径中词元置信度的时间演化。

title: Chunks as Arms: Multi-Armed Bandit-Guided Sampling for Long-Context LLM Preference Optimization

one_line_summary.en: LongMab uses bandit-guided context chunk rollouts to produce diverse, reward-ranked long-context response pairs for DPO.
one_line_summary.zh: LongMab 通过老虎机引导的上下文分块 rollout，为 DPO 生成多样且按奖励排序的长上下文回答对。

title: CL-bench: A Benchmark for Context Learning

one_line_summary.en: CL-bench tests context learning through 1,899 expert-rubriced tasks across 500 complex professional contexts.
one_line_summary.zh: CL-bench 以 500 个复杂专业上下文、1,899 项任务和 31,607 条专家 rubric，衡量模型是否能从上下文习得新知识。

title: Claim Verification in the Age of Large Language Models: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: An ACL 2026 survey of LLM claim-verification pipelines, including retrieval, prompting, fine-tuning, and English datasets.
one_line_summary.zh: 梳理基于大语言模型的声明核验流程、检索、提示、微调与英文数据集。

title: ClaimDB: A Fact Verification Benchmark over Large Structured Data

one_line_summary.en: ClaimDB turns large-database fact verification into executable reasoning with three-way evidence labels.
one_line_summary.zh: ClaimDB 以真实多表数据库和三类证据标签，测试模型能否用可执行程序完成大规模事实核验。

title: Claude Opus 4.6 System Card

one_line_summary.en: Claude Opus 4.6's system card partially discloses source categories, RLHF/RLAIF, prior-model reasoning-transcript initialization, a <0.01% reasoning workspace-reward error, and detailed safety/audit practice, but not the underlying data, reward, or reproducibility artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Claude Opus 4.6 的系统卡部分披露了来源类别、RLHF/RLAIF、先前模型 reasoning-transcript 初始化、小于 0.01% 的 reasoning workspace-reward 错误以及细致的安全/审计实践，但没有公开底层数据、奖励或可复现制品。

title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card

one_line_summary.en: The Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card reports broad proprietary training-source categories, deduplication/classification, post-training, reinforcement from AI feedback, and worker preference/safety roles, while record-level data, reward, and recipe details remain undisclosed.
one_line_summary.zh: 《Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card》披露了宽泛的专有训练数据类别、去重/分类、后训练、来自 AI 的强化反馈以及人工偏好和安全工作角色，但记录级数据、奖励契约和训练配方仍未公开。

title: ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?

one_line_summary.en: ClawBench evaluates web agents on everyday online tasks across live production websites.
one_line_summary.zh: ClawBench 在 144 个 live platforms 上评估 153 个日常在线任务，并用 final-submission interception 控制真实副作用。

title: Closing the Data Loop: Using OpenDataArena to Engineer Superior Training Datasets

one_line_summary.en: ODA closes the loop by ranking source corpora in OpenDataArena, then deduplicating and decontaminating the best-performing 500K-record mixture.
one_line_summary.zh: ODA 用公开数据竞技场的来源级反馈选择、去重和去污染约 50 万条通用后训练记录。

title: Code Generation by Differential Test Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: DiffCodeGen uses coverage-guided differential testing to select among diverse code candidates with almost no extra LLM-token cost beyond candidate generation.
one_line_summary.zh: DiffCodeGen 利用覆盖引导的差分测试从多样代码候选中选择结果，除候选生成外几乎不增加大语言模型词元成本。

title: CodeJudgeBench: Benchmarking LLM-as-a-Judge for Coding Tasks

one_line_summary.en: Coding judge benchmark covering generation, repair, and unit-test judgments and their order sensitivity.
one_line_summary.zh: 用 5,352 个经验证候选对系统测试代码 LLM 判别器，并暴露顺序和来源敏感性。

title: CodeRM-NT: Reward Model for Code RL without Unit Tests

one_line_summary.en: A code reward-model pipeline that judges execution traces and releases the associated code/data artifact.
one_line_summary.zh: CodeRM-NT 以 MCTS 生成的执行轨迹和 LLM judge 训练代码奖励模型，不依赖单元测试即可为代码 RL 提供反馈。

title: CodeScaler: Scaling Code LLM Training and Test-Time Inference via Execution-Free Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: CodeScaler releases 51,107 verified code preference pairs for training execution-free reward models that scale code training and test-time selection.
one_line_summary.zh: CodeScalerPair-51K 含 51,107 个经验证的代码候选偏好对，以无执行奖励模型支持代码推理训练与 test-time 选择。

title: CodeScout: An Effective Recipe for Reinforcement Learning of Code Search Agents
venue: ACM CAIS 2026 Workshop on Agentic Software Engineering (non-archival)

one_line_summary.en: Releases 54,845 full terminal-search RL rollouts for CodeScout-14B and CodeScout-4B, preserving grouped attempts, component localization rewards, and 8,281 zero-reward failures rather than publishing only successful trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: CodeScout 发布 54,845 条 CodeScout-14B 与 CodeScout-4B 的完整终端代码搜索 RL rollout，保留多次尝试、分层定位奖励和 8,281 条零奖励失败轨迹；但公开行数超过论文名义预算，部分分组不完整，且数据许可与精确重放谱系仍为 unknown。

title: CodeTracer: Towards Traceable Agent States

one_line_summary.en: CodeTraceBench releases code-agent traces with stage- and step-level failure labels for diagnosis and recovery.
one_line_summary.zh: CodeTraceBench 提供代码代理轨迹及阶段、步骤级失败标签，用于过程诊断、奖励建模与恢复策略。

title: COIG-P: A High-Quality and Large-Scale Chinese Preference Dataset for Alignment with Human Values

one_line_summary.en: COIG-P releases Chinese chosen/rejected pairs across six task domains, using multi-model generation and judging to make preference optimization resources available at million-pair scale.
one_line_summary.zh: COIG-P 发布覆盖六类任务的中文 chosen/rejected 对，通过多模型生成与评审提供百万级偏好优化资源。

title: Complex-IF and Beyond: Expert Rubrics for RLVR

one_line_summary.en: Complex-IF pairs difficult instructions with expert atomic rubrics to support both evaluation and rubric-reward RLVR.
one_line_summary.zh: 将约千条复杂指令与 10–40 个专家原子 rubric 结合，作为评测和 RLVR 的稠密奖励信号。

title: ComplexConstraints and Beyond: Expert Rubrics for RLVR

one_line_summary.en: ComplexConstraints shows expert atomic rubrics can train and evaluate complex instruction following.
one_line_summary.zh: ComplexConstraints 以专家原子化 rubric 为复杂指令跟随和 Agent 强化学习提供可解释奖励。

title: ComplexMCP: Evaluation of LLM Agents in Dynamic, Interdependent, and Large-Scale Tool Sandbox

one_line_summary.en: ComplexMCP pairs 47 manually curated tasks with seeded 315-tool environments, accepted gold tool trajectories, and final-state verification, while leaving full model rollouts and a paper-era release freeze unavailable.
one_line_summary.zh: ComplexMCP 将 47 个手工任务、15 个 MCP server 的 315 个工具、成功参考轨迹与状态差分 verifier 组合为可执行评测对象，但未发布完整模型 rollout、论文时期版本锁与独立 rights 声明。

title: Composition-Grounded Instruction Synthesis for Visual Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: COGS decomposes a few difficult visual questions into reusable perception and reasoning factors, then recomposes them with new images to synthesize QA data with factor-level process rewards.
one_line_summary.zh: COGS 将少量困难视觉问题分解为可复用的感知与推理因子，再与新图像重组，合成带因子级过程奖励的问答数据。

title: Composition-RL: Compose Your Verifiable Prompts for Reinforcement Learning of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** Composition-RL turns saturated easy verifiable prompts into 1.323M harder composed tasks that restore RL signal.
one_line_summary.zh: Composition-RL 将已饱和的可验证简单题组合成 132.3 万更难 prompt，继续提供 RL 信号。

title: CONGRAD: Conflicting Gradient Filtering for Multilingual Preference Alignment

one_line_summary.en: CONGRAD filters self-generated multilingual preference pairs by their alignment with a de-conflicted consensus gradient before DPO consumes them.
one_line_summary.zh: CONGRAD 在 DPO 使用自生成的多语言偏好回答对之前，依据其与去冲突共识梯度的一致程度进行筛选。

title: Continual Safety Alignment via Gradient-Based Sample Selection

one_line_summary.en: The paper preserves continual safety alignment by excluding high-gradient task records and training on moderate-gradient examples instead.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究通过排除高梯度任务记录、保留中等梯度样本，在持续微调中缓解安全对齐漂移。

title: Counsel: A Meta-Evaluation Dataset for Agentic Tasks

one_line_summary.en: Counsel meta-evaluates process-level agent critiques with human labels that separate correct locations, sound reasoning, and false alarms.
one_line_summary.zh: Counsel 用人工元评测标签区分 agent judge 批评的定位正确性、推理质量与误报，为过程批评器校准提供监督。

title: Credit-Budgeted ICPC-Style Coding: When Agents Must Pay for Every Decision

one_line_summary.en: Credit-Budgeted ICPC-Style Coding exposes ICPC-style coding with credit-budgeted evaluation as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作把带额度预算的 ICPC 风格编程评测做成可审计的评测面，让智能体为每一次决策付出成本。

title: CROWD SELECT: Synthetic Instruction Data Selection with Multi-LLM Wisdom

one_line_summary.en: CrowdSelect selects synthetic instruction pairs with complementary signals from multiple LLM responses and reward-model assessments.
one_line_summary.zh: CrowdSelect 利用多个语言模型回复和奖励模型评估提供的互补信号选择合成指令对。

title: CUA-Suite: Massive Human-annotated Video Demonstrations for Computer-Use Agents
venue: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Lifelong Agents: Learning, Aligning, Evolving

one_line_summary.en: CUA-Suite releases about 10,000 expert desktop videos with timestamped actions and dense UI links, preserving full interaction trajectories for computer-use training and process evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: CUA-Suite 发布约 1 万条专家桌面操作视频、时间戳动作和稠密 UI 链接，保留完整交互轨迹以支持计算机使用训练与过程评测。

title: Curing “Miracle Steps” in LLM Mathematical Reasoning with Rubric Rewards

one_line_summary.en: Rubric Rewards pairs mathematical problems with problem-specific scoring rubrics so a generative reward model can penalize trajectory-level logical shortcuts during RL.
one_line_summary.zh: 14.3K 数学题—rubric 样本，以问题级准则评估整条推理轨迹并作 RL 奖励，直接针对推理投机。

title: D3-Gym: Constructing Real-World Verifiable Environments for Data-Driven Discovery

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** 565 real scientific discovery tasks binding Docker, data, reference implementations, and automatic evaluators.
one_line_summary.zh: 565 个真实科学数据发现任务，绑定 Docker、输入数据、参考实现和自动 evaluator。

title: Data Selection for LLM Alignment Using Fine-Grained Preferences

one_line_summary.en: The method filters fine-grained preference records by cross-aspect consensus before standard DPO, retaining samples with the most negative preference divergence.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法先按跨维度偏好共识过滤细粒度偏好记录，再进行标准 DPO，保留偏好分歧最负的样本。

title: Data Selection for Multi-turn Dialogue Instruction Tuning

one_line_summary.en: MDS selects complete dialogue trajectories by combining user-intent coverage with entity-grounded and form-consistent structure.
one_line_summary.zh: MDS 以用户意图覆盖以及实体扎根、形式一致的结构选择完整对话轨迹。

title: Data-Efficient RLVR via Off-Policy Influence Guidance

one_line_summary.en: CROPI uses offline trajectories and projected gradient influence to refresh the 10-percent RLVR subset that receives each stage of GRPO training.
one_line_summary.zh: CROPI 用离线轨迹和投影梯度影响分数，持续更新每个阶段实际进入 GRPO 训练的 10% RLVR 提示。

title: daVinci-Env: Open SWE Environment Synthesis at Scale

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** daVinci-Env turns more than 12.8K repositories into 45,320 environments and collects 13K trajectories from about 9K of them.
one_line_summary.zh: daVinci-Env 将 12.8K+ 仓库转为 45,320 个环境，并从约 9K 环境采集 13K 轨迹。

title: DebugLM: Learning Traceable Training Data Provenance for LLMs

one_line_summary.en: DebugLM augments ordinary post-training records with dataset-level provenance and quarantine labels so a trained model can self-report a source tag or selectively refuse source-associated behavior.
one_line_summary.zh: DebugLM 用数据集级溯源与隔离标签增强 SFT/GRPO 记录，使模型能自报来源或针对来源选择性拒答。

title: DeepResearch Bench II: Diagnosing Deep Research Agents via Rubrics from Expert Report

one_line_summary.en: DeepResearch Bench II scores deep-research reports with 9,430 expert-grounded binary rubrics across retrieval, analysis, and presentation.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepResearch Bench II 用源自专家报告的 9,430 条二元准则诊断深度研究 Agent 的检索、分析与呈现。

title: DeepResearch-9K: A Challenging Benchmark Dataset of Deep-Research Agent

one_line_summary.en: DeepResearch-9K releases 9,000 difficulty-tiered web-research questions with teacher search traces, reasoning chains, and verifiable answers.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepResearch-9K 提供按搜索深度分级的 9,000 个深度研究问题、可验证答案及带推理链的多轮检索轨迹。

title: DeepVision-103K: A Visually Diverse, Broad-Coverage, and Verifiable Mathematical Dataset for Multimodal Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** DeepVision-103K provides about 103K visually diverse, decontaminated K–12 math problems with rule-verifiable final answers.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepVision-103K 提供约 10.3 万道视觉多样、去污染且最终答案可规则验证的 K–12 数学题。

title: DeFAb: A Verifiable Benchmark for Defeasible Abduction in Foundation Models

one_line_summary.en: DeFAb turns public knowledge bases into more than 372,000 defeasible-abduction tasks whose hypotheses are checked for derivation, conservativity, and minimality.
one_line_summary.zh: DeFAb 将公开知识库转化为 37 万余个可判定溯因任务，并以规则求解器检查假设的推导性、保守性与最小性。

title: Demystifying Multi-Agent Debate: The Role of Confidence and Diversity

one_line_summary.en: DMAD samples 10 candidates, selects five distinct answers, and trains five-turn homogeneous debate to express and use 0-10 confidence with correctness, calibration, engagement, and format rewards, while releasing code but not full traces.
one_line_summary.zh: DMAD 采样 10 个候选、挑出五个互异答案，训练五轮同质辩论来表达并使用 0 到 10 的置信度，奖励涵盖正确性、校准度、参与度与格式；开源了代码但未发布完整轨迹。

title: Detecting Data Contamination in LLMs via In-Context Learning

one_line_summary.en: CoDeC measures the change induced by in-context examples to identify memorized benchmark data.
one_line_summary.zh: 以同分布上下文是否降低 token 置信度，量化语言模型对候选数据集的污染风险。

title: Detecting Variant Contamination in LLMs via Variance of Generation Distribution

one_line_summary.en: Variance-based detector targets paraphrased and structurally transformed leakage.
one_line_summary.zh: 以生成分布方差检测释义与结构变体污染。

title: Difficulty-Based Preference Data Selection by DPO Implicit Reward Gap

one_line_summary.en: The method trains on preference pairs with the smallest DPO implicit reward gaps because those boundary cases provide the strongest learning signal.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法选择 DPO 隐式奖励差最小的偏好对，因为这些决策边界样本能提供最强的学习信号。

title: DiscoverLLM: From Executing Intents to Discovering Them

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: DiscoverLLM 将潜在意图逐步具体化作为奖励信号，提供多轮偏好记录用于对话式偏好优化。

title: Distilling Feedback into Memory-as-a-Tool

one_line_summary.en: Memory-as-a-Tool distils recurring rubric feedback into retrievable, updateable files to amortize refinement cost.
one_line_summary.zh: 将重复 rubric 批评蒸馏为 Agent 可检索、更新的文件记忆，以降低后续改写成本。

title: Distribution-Aligned Sequence Distillation for Superior Long-CoT Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Distribution-aligned sequence distillation selects and stages 435K teacher traces to reduce this mismatch before training a 4B reasoning student.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作按序列分布对齐和温度阶段筛选约 43.5 万条长推理轨迹，用于训练 4B 学生。

title: Do What You Say: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models via Runtime Reasoning-Action Alignment Verification

one_line_summary.en: SEAL simulates candidate actions and selects the sequence best aligned with the VLA's textual plan.
one_line_summary.zh: SEAL 先模拟候选动作，再选出与视觉语言动作模型文字计划最一致的动作序列。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）

title: Dockerless: Environment-Free Program Verifier for Coding Agents

one_line_summary.en: Dockerless replaces per-repository test execution during SWE-agent post-training with a golden-patch-conditioned verifier that asks 2-4 questions, gathers read-only repository evidence, and scores final patches for SFT filtering and GRPO.
one_line_summary.zh: Dockerless 以执行测试标签训练依赖 golden patch 的 Qwen3.5-9B agentic verifier，再用仓库证据评分从 16K 条环境精简 rollout 中筛出 4K 条用于 SFT，并为 GRPO 提供 dense reward。

title: DockSmith: Scaling Reliable Coding Environments via an Agentic Docker Builder

one_line_summary.en: DockSmith converts test-backed GitHub pull requests into success-filtered, execution-grounded Docker-building conversations for agent SFT and releases 39,719 per-agent chat fragments linked to 2,876 instances.
one_line_summary.zh: DockSmith 将通过 Docker 构建与测试验证的多智能体环境构造交互筛成 SFT 数据；公开发布的是关联 2,876 个实例的 39,719 个按智能体拆分的聊天片段，而非 39,719 条完整 episode。

title: Don’t Judge Code by Its Cover: On the Robustness of LLM-as-a-Judge for Code Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: Audits superficial-code and presentation biases in LLM code evaluators.
one_line_summary.zh: 审计代码 LLM 判别器对语义等价表层改写的偏差。

title: DOSE: Data Selection for Multi-Modal LLMs via Off-the-Shelf Models

one_line_summary.en: DOSE selects visual instruction data with off-the-shelf text-quality and image-text-alignment scores, then uses distribution-aware sampling to retain quality without collapsing coverage.
one_line_summary.zh: DOSE 使用现成模型衡量文本质量和图文对齐度，再以分布感知的抽样保留质量而不牺牲覆盖范围。

title: Dr. Post-Training: A Data Regularization Perspective on LLM Post-Training

one_line_summary.en: Dr. Post-Training uses general data as a feasible-set regularizer for target post-training updates.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法将通用训练数据视为目标后训练更新的可行方向约束，而非一次性筛选的样本池。

title: DRACO: a Cross-Domain Benchmark for Deep Research Accuracy, Completeness, and Objectivity

one_line_summary.en: DRACO scores real deep-research reports for accuracy, completeness, objectivity, and citation quality.
one_line_summary.zh: DRACO 用来自真实深度研究使用模式的任务及四维 rubric，审查报告的准确、完整、客观和引用质量。

title: Dual Consensus: Escaping from Spurious Majority in Unsupervised RLVR via Two-Stage Vote Mechanism

one_line_summary.en: Local BibTeX seed for the 🧯 Audit, Failure, Contamination, and Verifier Attacks map; use it to inspect the paper's data object, verifier contract, and release metadata before promoting it.
one_line_summary.zh: 用双阶段共识缓解无监督 RLVR 中多数错误答案带来的伪信号，适合审计投票机制的失效条件。

title: Dynamic Cheatsheet: Test-Time Learning with Adaptive Memory

one_line_summary.en: Dynamic Cheatsheet uses self-curated persistent memory so a black-box model can reuse lessons discovered during earlier inference episodes.
one_line_summary.zh: Dynamic Cheatsheet 通过自整理的持久记忆，让黑箱模型复用先前推理过程中发现的策略、代码和纠错经验。

title: Dynamic Sampling that Adapts: Self-Aware Iterative Data Persistent Optimization for Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: SAI-DPO repeatedly selects preference-training records using model-relative knowledge weaknesses and self-aware difficulty.
one_line_summary.zh: SAI-DPO 按模型相对的知识弱点和自感知难度反复选择偏好训练记录。

title: DynamicFocalPO: Adaptive Focusing Strategy for Preference Optimization

one_line_summary.en: DynamicFocalPO schedules preference-pair weighting from easy, already-correctly-ranked records toward harder records as training progresses.
one_line_summary.zh: DynamicFocalPO 随训练推进调度偏好回答对的权重：先侧重已正确排序的容易记录，再逐步纳入困难记录。

title: DynaMiCS: Fine-tuning LLMs with Performance Constraints using Dynamic Mixtures

one_line_summary.en: DynaMiCS repeatedly probes data-source effects and optimizes SFT mixture weights to improve targets without violating protected capabilities.
one_line_summary.zh: DynaMiCS 反复探测数据来源效应并优化监督微调混合权重，在改善目标的同时不违反受保护能力。

title: DYNAMIX SFT: Dynamic Mixture Optimization of Instruction Tuning Collections

one_line_summary.en: DYNAMIX SFT updates source-level instruction-data mixture weights from one-step learning progress while preserving coverage with a prior and exploration floor.
one_line_summary.zh: DYNAMIX SFT 以单步学习进度更新来源级指令数据混合权重，并用先验和探索下限保留覆盖面。

title: Easy Samples Are All You Need: Self-Evolving LLMs via Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: EasyRL grows a GRPO training set from a few easy labels by selecting consistent or reflection-resolved pseudo-labels from progressively harder problems.
one_line_summary.zh: EasyRL 从少量简单标注题出发，逐步选择一致或经反思解决的伪标注难题来扩展 GRPO 训练集。

title: Efficient PRM Training Data Synthesis via Formal Verification

one_line_summary.en: FOVER-40K pairs formal reasoning traces with Boolean step labels produced by Z3 and Isabelle, then trains Llama- and Qwen-based PRMs for process-level verification and Best-of-K selection.
one_line_summary.zh: FoVer 用 Z3 与 Isabelle/HOL 为形式逻辑和形式证明轨迹生成二元步骤标签，组成 FOVER-40K 并训练用于步骤判错与 Best-of-K 选择的 PRM。

title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Temporal Reasoning Aggregation

one_line_summary.en: TRACE halts reasoning when answer consistency and confidence remain stable across recent reasoning steps.
one_line_summary.zh: TRACE 在答案一致性和置信度跨近期推理步骤保持稳定时停止推理。

title: Eliciting Medical Reasoning with Knowledge-enhanced Data Synthesis: A Semi-Supervised Reinforcement Learning Approach
authors: Haolin Li, Shuyang Jiang, Ruipeng Zhang, Jiangchao Yao, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang

one_line_summary.en: MedSSR controls question synthesis with rare-disease knowledge, lets the policy produce pseudo-labels, and combines self-supervised with human-anchored reinforcement learning.
one_line_summary.zh: MedSSR 用罕见病知识控制问题合成，再由策略模型产生伪标签，公开 4.3 万条医学推理记录。

title: Embodied-Reasoner: Synergizing Visual Search, Reasoning, and Action for Embodied Interactive Tasks

one_line_summary.en: Embodied-Reasoner releases 9,390 AI2-THOR Observation-Thought-Action episodes built from GPT-4o imitation traces, environment-filtered self-exploration, and failure-aware reflection tuning, with about 64K images and 8M thought tokens.
one_line_summary.zh: Embodied-Reasoner 发布 9,390 条 AI2-THOR Observation-Thought-Action 轨迹，串联 GPT-4o 模仿数据、环境过滤自探索与失败感知反思调优。

title: Enhancing Language Model Reasoning with Structured Multi-Level Modeling

one_line_summary.en: MLR separates long reasoning into planner-generated cognitive subgoals and executor-generated details, with Step-DPO turning outcome feedback into scalable stepwise preferences.
one_line_summary.zh: MLR 将长推理拆为规划器生成的认知子目标和执行器生成的细节，并以 Step-DPO 把结果反馈转化为可扩展的步骤偏好。

title: EnvFactory: Scaling Tool-Use Agents via Executable Environments Synthesis and Robust RL

one_line_summary.en: EnvFactory releases source-grounded stateful MCP sandboxes, step-expanded SFT records, and turn-level RL records whose feedback mixes reference-call coverage with exact final-state checks, but the public artifacts lack an immutable paper-run binding and rejected-trajectory ledger.
one_line_summary.zh: EnvFactory 发布 source-grounded 的有状态 MCP sandbox、逐 step 展开的 SFT record 与逐 turn 的 RL record，并以 reference-call coverage 和终态精确匹配组成反馈；但 paper-run 绑定、失败轨迹账本、许可证与数据规模说明仍未闭合。

title: EnvScaler: Scaling Tool-Interactive Environments for LLM Agent via Programmatic Synthesis

one_line_summary.en: EnvScaler releases 191 executable tool environments, 7,234 SFT/RL scenarios, and 9,022 SFT trajectories, but SFT success is not terminal-state verified and reproducible RL reuse still lacks rollout, version, and verifier-audit records.
one_line_summary.zh: EnvScaler 发布 191 个可执行工具环境、7,234 条 SFT/RL scenario 和 9,022 条 SFT trajectory，并以终态 Python check 支持 RLVR；但 RL rollout 未发布、SFT 不做终态正确性验证，默认 HF loader、代码隔离和版本回放仍有缺口。

title: Euclean: Automated Geometry Problem Formalization with Unified Verification in Lean

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** Hundreds of thousands of natural-language geometry problems are formalized in native Mathlib and verified uniformly by Lean.
one_line_summary.zh: 把十万级自然语言几何题形式化到原生 Mathlib，并用 Lean 统一验证。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Proof Autoformalization in Lean 4

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** Global and local perturbations on miniF2F and MATH-500 test Lean autoformalization robustness.
one_line_summary.zh: 在 miniF2F 与 MATH-500 上用全局和局部扰动测试 Lean 自动形式化鲁棒性。

title: EVM-QuestBench: An Execution-Grounded Benchmark for Natural-Language Transaction Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: EVM-QuestBench scores generated transaction scripts by the on-chain states they achieve on forked EVM snapshots.
one_line_summary.zh: EVM-QuestBench 在分叉 EVM 链上以终局状态验证生成的自然语言交易脚本。

title: EXP-Bench: Can AI Conduct AI Research Experiments?

one_line_summary.en: EXP-Bench turns 51 AI papers into 461 executable research-experiment tasks requiring agents to design, implement, run, and analyze experiments.
one_line_summary.zh: EXP-Bench 从 51 篇 AI 论文构建 461 个可执行研究实验任务，要求智能体完成设计、实现、运行与结果分析。

title: Exploring Reasoning Reward Model for Agents

one_line_summary.en: The paper provides preference or reward feedback data for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: ReAgent 探索用于智能体的推理奖励模型，并发布相应的奖励训练数据。

title: FaithCoT-Bench: Benchmarking Instance-Level Faithfulness of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: FaithCoT-Bench pairs expert-annotated CoT trajectories with step evidence to test whether a specific explanation reflects a model's internal reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: FaithCoT-Bench 以带步骤证据的专家标注 CoT 轨迹，检验某条解释是否反映模型的内部推理。

title: Faithfulness Metrics Don't Measure Faithfulness: A Meta-Evaluation with Ground Truth

one_line_summary.en: BonaFide creates CoTs with recoverable ground-truth computation labels to show that common faithfulness metrics often measure neither step nor whole-trace faithfulness reliably.
one_line_summary.zh: BonaFide 构造可恢复真实计算标签的 CoT，用以证明常见忠实性指标往往无法可靠衡量步骤或整条轨迹的忠实性。

title: FastTTS: Accelerating Test-Time Scaling for Edge LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: FastTTS accelerates verifier-guided test-time reasoning on a single edge GPU through speculative beam extension, prefix-aware scheduling, and asymmetric generator-verifier memory allocation.
one_line_summary.zh: FastTTS 通过推测式束扩展、前缀感知调度和生成器—验证器的非对称内存分配，在单张边缘 GPU 上加速验证器引导的测试时推理。

title: Feedback-Driven Tool-Use Improvements in Large Language Models via Automated Build Environments
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026

one_line_summary.en: FTRL turns 2,415 synthetic local tool environments into current-policy interaction states scored by executable feedback for GRPO or Reinforce++, while leaving sampled trajectories, data rights, and secure paper-exact replay unresolved.
one_line_summary.zh: FTRL 将 2,415 个合成的本地 Python 工具环境转化为带可执行反馈和标量奖励的当前策略交互状态，用于 GRPO 或 Reinforce++；但论文运行轨迹、数据权利与安全可重放包均未公开。

title: Fine-Grained Data Ordering Improves Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: FOT scores examples by model-relative difficulty, trains easy-to-hard in the first epoch, and restores random order thereafter.
one_line_summary.zh: FOT 按模型相对难度为样本打分，在第一轮按由易到难训练，之后恢复随机顺序。

title: FineVerify: Scaling Test-Time Compute with Fine-Grained Self-Verification for Agentic Search

one_line_summary.en: FineVerify turns each sampled agent trajectory into sub-question-level checks, enabling a more reliable selection policy as the test-time trajectory budget grows.
one_line_summary.zh: FineVerify 将每条搜索轨迹按可检查的子问题逐项验证，再用聚合得分选择答案，从而提升轨迹扩展的有效性。

title: FingerTip 20K: A Benchmark for Proactive and Personalized Mobile LLM Agents

one_line_summary.en: A longitudinal Android benchmark of human state-action episodes for intent anticipation and preference-conditioned execution, with a verified gap between the paper's 21,437-episode corpus and the public 20,000-row index.
one_line_summary.zh: FingerTip 20K 以纵向用户画像和真实 Android 状态—动作示范支持主动意图预测与个性化执行，但论文的 21,437 个 episode 与公开索引的 20,000 行无法对齐，终态成功还依赖未编码进脚本的人工判断。

title: FOL-Traces: Verified First-Order Logic Reasoning Traces at Scale
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2026

one_line_summary.en: FOL-Traces releases programmatically verified first-order-logic reasoning traces with complexity metadata for diagnosing structured inference.
one_line_summary.zh: FOL-Traces 发布带复杂度元数据的程序化验证一阶逻辑推理轨迹，用于诊断结构化推断能力。

title: From Coarse to Fine: Benchmarking and Reward Modeling for Writing-Centric Generation Tasks

one_line_summary.en: W²Bench and WRL provide fine-grained writing requirements and reward-model evaluation records.
one_line_summary.zh: 以需求删除构造写作 reward model 排序评测，并用其训练 WRL。

title: From Correctness to Utility: Gain-Based Prefix Evaluation for LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: PUM-MATH turns the improvement a reasoning prefix gives lightweight student solvers into 282,346 pairwise preference records for prefix utility modeling.
one_line_summary.zh: 282,346 条推理前缀对，以学生模型求解增益形成偏好标签，服务 BoN、搜索与 RL。

title: From Curiosity to Caution: Mitigating Reward Hacking for Best-of-N with Pessimism

one_line_summary.en: Uses a learned uncertainty penalty to make Best-of-N reward selection pessimistic on atypical responses.
one_line_summary.zh: 以典型回答上的预测误差估计不确定性，并在 Best-of-N 选择时惩罚可疑高分。

title: From Insight to Action: A Novel Framework for Interpretability-Guided Data Selection in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: IGDS selects SFT data that activates causally validated internal task features.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法先用因果干预确认模型内部的任务特征，再选择最能激活这些特征的监督微调样本。

title: From Natural Language to Certified Geometry Proofs: A Survey of LLM-Augmented Verification and Neuro-Symbolic Theorem Proving
venue: The Big Picture Workshop at ACL 2026

one_line_summary.en: A survey of hybrid systems that turn geometry problems into checked proof artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: 综述把自然语言与图形几何题转化为可由符号工具或证明助手检查的证明。

title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models

one_line_summary.en: VLM-CapCurriculum releases 32,736 staged RLVR problems with 16 extracted Qwen3-VL-8B answers, per-answer correctness flags, and a pass rate per row, enabling capability-first and within-stage difficulty curricula without releasing the underlying full reasoning completions.
one_line_summary.zh: VLM-CapCurriculum 发布 32,736 条仅含 train split 的分阶段 RLVR 题目；每条保留 16 个抽取答案、逐答案正确性和 pass_rate，但不发布原始 completion 或思维链。

title: From Selection to Refinement: Iterative Optimization for Instruction Data

one_line_summary.en: Instruction data optimization identifies valuable records and iteratively refines weak ones before SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: 指令数据优化先识别有价值的记录，再在 SFT 前迭代改写较弱样本。

title: From Verifiable Dot to Reward Chain: Harnessing Verifiable Reference-based Rewards for Reinforcement Learning of Open-ended Generation

one_line_summary.en: RLVRR turns high-quality references into an ordered reward chain for RL on open-ended generation.
one_line_summary.zh: RLVRR 将高质量参考答案转换为有序奖励链，用于开放式生成的强化学习。

title: FrontierScience: Evaluating AI's Ability to Perform Expert-Level Scientific Tasks

one_line_summary.en: FrontierScience pairs original Olympiad and PhD-level science tasks with granular research-task rubrics.
one_line_summary.zh: FrontierScience 以奥赛和博士级科学任务及细粒度 rubric，测量专家科学推理。

title: FS-Researcher: Test-Time Scaling for Long-Horizon Research Tasks with File-System-Based Agents

one_line_summary.en: FS-Researcher preserves source archives and notes in a shared file-system workspace for long-horizon research.
one_line_summary.zh: FS-Researcher 把资料存档与笔记保存在共享的文件系统工作区中，以支撑长程研究任务。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）

title: GALA: Geometric Data Selection with Strategic Prospecting for Large Language Model Self-Training

one_line_summary.en: GALA selects geometrically representative problems, prospectively generates diverse verified traces, and validates mini-batches before self-training.
one_line_summary.zh: GALA 选择几何上有代表性的题目，生成多样且可验证的推理轨迹，并在自训练前动态验证小批数据。

title: General Process Reward Modeling for Robotic Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: Robo-Dopamine releases multi-view robot-state progress supervision for general process reward modeling and policy-invariant reward shaping in manipulation.
one_line_summary.zh: Robo-Dopamine 发布多视角机器人状态进展监督，用于通用过程奖励建模与操作任务中的策略不变奖励塑形。

title: Generative Universal Verifier as Multimodal Meta-Reasoner

one_line_summary.en: Open verifier release for multi-modal reasoning with reproducible evaluation assets.
one_line_summary.zh: 以生成式通用 verifier 审计并迭代改进多模态视觉结果，配套发布 ViVerBench。

title: GeoRC: A Benchmark for Geolocation Reasoning Chains

one_line_summary.en: GeoRC pairs 800 expert geolocation chains with 500 scenes to expose the gap between accurate location guesses and auditable visual reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: GeoRC 以 500 个街景和 800 条冠军级玩家推理链，评测 VLM 的定位解释是否真正由视觉证据支撑。

title: GitChameleon 2.0: Evaluating AI Code Generation Against Python Library Version Incompatibilities

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** A 328-task benchmark with pinned Python-library versions and unit tests for version-compatible generation.
one_line_summary.zh: 328 个带固定 Python 库版本和单测的补全任务，专门测版本兼容生成。

title: GitTaskBench: A Benchmark for Code Agents Solving Real-World Tasks Through Code Repository Leveraging

one_line_summary.en: GitTaskBench releases 54 repository-linked multimodal tasks with inputs and custom final-output graders for autonomous repository understanding, environment setup, execution, and delivery, while withholding a canonical action-observation rollout corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: GitTaskBench 发布 54 个与代码仓库绑定的多模态评测任务、输入和定制终态 grader，用于评测智能体理解仓库、配置环境、执行任务并交付结果的能力，但未发布规范化 action-observation rollout 语料库。

title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering

one_line_summary.en: GLM-5 combines a 28.5T-token base pipeline with multi-task SFT, reasoning/agentic/general RL, cross-stage distillation, and 10K+ executable SWE plus terminal/search environments, while releasing weights and slime infrastructure but not the training records, exact mixtures, budgets, or safety ledger.
one_line_summary.zh: GLM-5 披露了 28.5T base-token 路线、三类 SFT、四域 Reasoning RL 与全异步 Agentic RL，以及 10K+ SWE、数千 terminal 和 2M+ 网页 WKG 环境，但未开放训练记录、完整 reward、精确预算、污染审计或安全训练账本。

title: Go-Browse: Training Web Agents with Structured Exploration

one_line_summary.en: Go-Browse releases raw and processed WebArena-clone trajectories plus a Qwen checkpoint from graph-frontier task discovery, VLM feasibility judgment, and prefixed/unprefixed browser rollouts.
one_line_summary.zh: Go-Browse 通过图前沿式任务发现、视觉语言模型可行性判定与带前缀及不带前缀的浏览器采样，发布 WebArena 克隆环境的原始与处理后轨迹以及一个 Qwen 检查点。

title: GPT-5.3-Codex System Card

one_line_summary.en: GPT-5.3-Codex's system card discloses one RL safety intervention—simulated conflicting user edits with positive reinforcement for preserving them—while withholding the task, trajectory, reward, and training-environment ledger.
one_line_summary.zh: GPT-5.3-Codex 系统卡披露了一项 RL 安全干预：在 rollout 中模拟相互冲突的用户编辑，并对保留这些编辑给予正向强化；但任务、轨迹、奖励和训练环境台账仍未披露。

title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card

one_line_summary.en: GPT-5.4 Thinking adds long-rollout self-reversion, configurable confirmation, prompt-injection, and cyber-safety training disclosures plus dynamic and production-like safety trajectories, CoT audits, and hidden-test agent evaluations, but not the training records, rewards, global split, or stable versioned artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: GPT-5.4 Thinking 的 living system card 披露长 rollout 自回退并保护模拟用户工作、确认策略与 cyber 安全训练，同时加入动态/production-like 轨迹、CoT monitorability 和 programmatic agent 评测；其关键价值是分离训练、评测、monitor 与部署，而底层记录、reward 和全局 split 仍未公开。

title: GR-Ben: A General Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Process Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: GR-Ben evaluates process reward models on roughly 3.6K human-annotated science and logic traces with error positions, types, and reasons.
one_line_summary.zh: 约3.6k条、9领域推理轨迹给出错误位置、类型与理由，直接测量 PRM 的跨域过程判断。

title: GRACE: Step-Level Benchmark for Faithful Reasoning over Context

one_line_summary.en: GRACE supplies context-grounded reasoning traces with per-step faithfulness labels, error types, and explanations for training or testing process evaluators.
one_line_summary.zh: GRACE 提供带逐步忠实性标签、错误类型和解释的上下文推理轨迹，可训练或评测过程判别器。

title: GRAM-R²: Self-Training Generative Foundation Reward Models for Reward Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: GRAM-R² self-trains a generative foundation reward model by turning labeled and unlabeled preference pairs into rationale-backed comparison supervision.
one_line_summary.zh: 28.5GB 公开训练集；百万级偏好对经自训练生成“反馈—比较—结论—A/B”监督，用于奖励推理。

title: GUI-Libra: Training Native GUI Agents to Reason and Act with Action-aware Supervision and Partially Verifiable RL

one_line_summary.en: GUI-Libra turns public GUI trajectories into 81K action-aligned reasoning steps and trains native agents with action-aware SFT and conservative RL under ambiguous step rewards.
one_line_summary.zh: GUI-Libra 将公开 GUI 轨迹整理为 81K 条动作对齐推理记录，并用 action-aware SFT 与保守 RL 处理逐步奖励存在歧义的问题。

title: Guided by Gut: Efficient Test-Time Scaling with Reinforced Intrinsic Confidence

one_line_summary.en: Guided by Gut calibrates a model’s own step confidence with GRPO and uses it to guide lightweight tree search without a process reward model.
one_line_summary.zh: Guided by Gut 先用 GRPO 校准模型自身的步骤置信度，再以它引导轻量树搜索，无需在推理时调用过程奖励模型。

title: Hack-Verifiable Environments: Towards Evaluating Reward Hacking at Scale

one_line_summary.en: deterministic reward-hacking testbed based on TextArena
one_line_summary.zh: 以植入捷径和确定性监控，将智能体奖励投机从事后判断转为可规模化测量。

title: HAD: HAllucination Detection Language Models Based on a Comprehensive Hallucination Taxonomy

one_line_summary.en: HAD is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
one_line_summary.zh: 建立跨 NLG 任务的 11 类幻觉 taxonomy、约 90K 训练实例及 2,248 条人工标注 HADTest，输出错误类别、span 和修正建议。

title: HalluGuard: Evidence-Grounded Small Reasoning Models to Mitigate Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: HalluGuard 以证据支撑的偏好元组训练小型推理模型，用于识别检索增强生成中的幻觉。

title: Hard2Verify: A Step-Level Verification Benchmark for Open-Ended Frontier Math

one_line_summary.en: Hard2Verify provides over 500 hours of human step-level annotations for testing verifiers on recent, open-ended frontier mathematics.
one_line_summary.zh: Hard2Verify 以 500 余小时人工标注开放前沿数学证明的步骤正确性与首错位置，检验高难过程验证上限。

title: HARM: Learning Hate-Aware Reward Model for Evaluating Natural Language Explanations of Offensive Content

one_line_summary.en: A human-validated explanation dataset and reward-model setup for audit of offensive-content explanations.
one_line_summary.zh: 以分层人工语境重校奖励信号，避免仇恨言论解释因必要的冒犯措辞而被错误降分。

title: Harness-Bench: Measuring Harness Effects across Models in Realistic Agent Workflows

one_line_summary.en: Harness-Bench studies how harness choices change measured agent workflow performance across realistic tasks and models.
one_line_summary.zh: Harness-Bench 衡量 harness 选择如何改变真实智能体工作流中的模型表现。

title: Heteroskedastic Signals in Budgeted LLM Verification: Structural Heterogeneity Limits Optimization Gains

one_line_summary.en: The paper shows that stratifying a limited verification budget by cost can outperform stronger globally shared adaptive policies when uncertainty signals are not comparable across strata.
one_line_summary.zh: 当不确定性信号在不同成本层中不可比较时，按成本分层分配有限验证预算可优于更强的全局自适应策略。

title: Hidden States as Early Signals: Step-level Trace Evaluation and Pruning for Efficient Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: STEP prunes low-promise reasoning traces using step-end hidden states when KV-cache pressure rises, reducing parallel test-time latency without sacrificing accuracy.
one_line_summary.zh: STEP 在 KV 缓存压力上升时，根据步骤末端隐藏状态剪去低前景推理轨迹，以降低并行测试时延迟而不牺牲准确率。

title: HierSVA: A Data Synthesis Pipeline, Dataset, and Benchmark for LLM-Driven Hierarchical Hardware Formal Verification

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** A six-axis SVA benchmark with 342 hierarchical RTL modules and 28 deep bug pairs.
one_line_summary.zh: 342 个层级 RTL 模块、28 组深层 bug pair 与六维 SVA 验证 benchmark。

title: HippoCamp: Benchmarking Contextual Agents on Personal Computers

one_line_summary.en: HippoCamp evaluates contextual agents over realistic personal file systems with evidence-grounded rationales and step-wise failure labels.
one_line_summary.zh: HippoCamp 在真实个人文件系统上评测上下文智能体，并提供证据链与逐步失败诊断标注。

title: HoneyBee: Data Recipes for Vision-Language Reasoners

one_line_summary.en: HoneyBee reports 2.480M caption-plus-solution and text-only SFT records built with Llama-4 Scout around 28K images and 350K questions; the live release is pointer-based, partially materialized, and governed by layered licenses.
one_line_summary.zh: HoneyBee 报告了 248.0 万条由 Llama-4 Scout 构造的图文与纯文本 SFT 记录，覆盖 2.8 万张图像和 35 万个问题；公开版本以来源指针为主，当前仅部分物化，并受多层许可约束。

title: How Reasoning Evolves from Post-Training Data: An Empirical Study Using Chess

one_line_summary.en: Releases a 120M-token chess SFT dataset and code spanning filtered Llama 4 Maverick responses, programmatic alpha-beta-style search traces, and engine-derived best-move and best-line targets, then studies their downstream RL behavior.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作发布一个约 1.20 亿 token 的国际象棋 SFT 数据集和代码；数据涵盖经筛选的 Llama 4 Maverick 回答、程序化的类 alpha-beta 搜索轨迹，以及引擎生成的最佳走法和最佳线路目标，并研究其下游 RL 行为。

title: HoWToBench: Holistic Evaluation for LLM’s Capability in Human-level Writing using Tree of Writing

one_line_summary.en: HoWToBench evaluates 1,302 Chinese writing instructions with a transparent Tree-of-Writing rubric that makes score aggregation explicit.
one_line_summary.zh: HoWToBench 用 1,302 条中文写作指令和显式加权的 Tree-of-Writing rubric，评估开放式长文写作质量。

title: Hubble: a Model Suite to Advance the Study of LLM Memorization

one_line_summary.en: Controlled paired LLMs with injected text and test sets make memorization and contamination experiments reproducible.
one_line_summary.zh: 以可控文本插入的开源配对模型，将记忆与污染研究变为可复现的因果实验。

title: Humanity's Last Exam

one_line_summary.en: Humanity's Last Exam uses expert-written multimodal questions to probe the frontier of human knowledge.
one_line_summary.zh: 由跨学科专家题目构成的多模态极难基准，用于追踪前沿模型的知识边界。

title: HWE-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Real-World Hardware Bug Repair Tasks

one_line_summary.en: HWE-Bench evaluates hardware agents on real repository bugs using native simulation and regression tests.
one_line_summary.zh: HWE-Bench 在真实硬件仓库上以原生仿真和回归测试评估代理修复历史 bug 的能力。

title: IF-RewardBench: Benchmarking Judge Models for Instruction-Following Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: IF-RewardBench uses expert-validated constraint labels to form preference graphs that test listwise ranking by instruction-following judges.
one_line_summary.zh: IF-RewardBench 用专家核验的约束标签构建偏好图，测试评判模型对指令遵循回答的列表排序能力。

title: Improving LLM Code Reasoning via Semantic Equivalence Self-Play with Formal Verification

one_line_summary.en: Releases 28,253 runnable Haskell references and specifies proof/counterexample self-play, but not the central verified interaction corpus or adapters.
one_line_summary.zh: 公开 28,253 条可运行 Haskell 参考程序，并给出形式证明/执行反例自博弈方案，但未发布核心验证交互语料与适配器。

title: Improving the OOD Performance of Closed-Source LLMs on NLI Through Strategic Data Selection

one_line_summary.en: This study selects or replaces NLI fine-tuning records under a fixed API-training budget to improve OOD robustness of closed-source LLMs.
one_line_summary.zh: 本研究在固定 API 训练预算下选择或替换 NLI 微调记录，以提高闭源大语言模型的 OOD 鲁棒性。

title: Inference-Time Scaling of Verification: Self-Evolving Deep Research Agents via Test-Time Rubric-Guided Verification

one_line_summary.en: DeepVerifier converts agent failure rubrics into targeted test-time checks and feedback loops that improve deep-research-agent answers through repeated verification and retry.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepVerifier 将智能体失败量表转为有针对性的测试时检查与反馈循环，通过反复验证和重试提升深度研究智能体的答案。

title: Infinite Problem Generator: Verifiably Scaling Physics Reasoning Data with Agentic Workflows

one_line_summary.en: Infinite Problem Generator expands textbook physics seeds into 1,335 problem-code records whose predefined formulas and executed numeric solutions make generation verifiable.
one_line_summary.zh: Infinite Problem Generator 将教材物理题扩展为 1,335 条题目与代码记录，并用预定义公式和实际执行的数值解验证生成结果。

title: Influence-based Online Experience Selection for Effective RLHF

one_line_summary.en: InfOES filters online RLHF experiences by their estimated influence on an objective-specific validation return before every policy update.
one_line_summary.zh: InfOES 在每次策略更新前，按在线 RLHF 经验对目标特定验证回报的估计影响筛选经验。

title: InstructDiff: Domain-Adaptive Data Selection via Contrastive Entropy for Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning

one_line_summary.en: InstructDiff selects SFT records through calibration-induced NLL and entropy changes, retaining the lowest contrastive-entropy examples.
one_line_summary.zh: InstructDiff 以校准前后的负对数似然和熵变化选择监督微调记录，保留对比熵最低的例子。

title: Instruction Data Selection via Answer Divergence

one_line_summary.en: ADG selects instruction data by the geometry of multiple answers sampled from the target model.
one_line_summary.zh: ADG 依据从目标模型采样的多个答案的几何结构选择指令数据。

title: InT: Self-Proposed Interventions Enable Credit Assignment in LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: InT turns failed on-policy reasoning traces into localized corrective interventions, creating process-supervision records that patch the first error before downstream RL.
one_line_summary.zh: InT 将失败的在策略推理轨迹转为首错位置的定点修复记录，在后续强化学习前先用过程监督修补错误。

title: iOSWorld: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Phone Agents

one_line_summary.en: iOSWorld releases 26 connected SwiftUI apps and 133 rubric-scored tasks with reproducible reset/trajectory tooling, but its GPT-5.4 Mini feedback is judgment-based and only 16 curated runs, not the full success/failure corpus, are public.
one_line_summary.zh: iOSWorld发布26个互联SwiftUI应用、133项任务与1,123条rubric，并开放seed state、runner、MCP和episode judge；但完整成败rollout语料未公开，现阶段仅适合评测复用。

title: JudgeBoard: Benchmarking and Enhancing Small Language Models for Reasoning Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: Public benchmark page for evaluating reasoning judges across multiple datasets.
one_line_summary.zh: 面向多个数据集评测推理类评审模型的公开基准页面。

title: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence

one_line_summary.en: Kimi K2.5 reports 15T multimodal continual pretraining, zero-vision SFT, joint RL, GRMs, and PARL but not data, teachers, environments, rollouts, or reward calibration artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Kimi K2.5 报告了 15T 多模态持续预训练、zero-vision SFT、联合 RL、GRM 和 PARL，但未发布数据、教师、环境、rollout 或 reward 校准 artifact。

title: KnowMe-Bench: Benchmarking Person Understanding for Lifelong Digital Companions

one_line_summary.en: KnowMe-Bench evaluates whether long-context agents infer a person's motives and principles with explicit narrative evidence, not merely retrieve facts.
one_line_summary.zh: KnowMe-Bench 以带证据链接的长篇自传叙事，检验记忆 Agent 能否推断人的动机、状态与决策原则。

title: LaRA: Layer-wise Representation Analysis for Detecting Data Contamination in RL Post-Training

one_line_summary.en: Layer-wise metrics detect reward-driven memorization after RL post-training.
one_line_summary.zh: 以受控扰动下的逐层表征几何，审计 RL 后训练中的奖励驱动记忆污染。

title: Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning

one_line_summary.en: A 2026 framework that maps post-training by who supplied the trajectory and which behavioral bottleneck a stage addresses.
one_line_summary.zh: 一篇按轨迹来源和行为瓶颈重新组织后训练方法的 2026 综述。

title: LEAP: Supercharging LLMs for Formal Mathematics with Agentic Frameworks

one_line_summary.en: LEAP combines Gemini 3.1 Pro, compiler-guided revision, and an AND-OR proof DAG to produce Lean-checked outcomes, but releases successful proofs rather than replayable agent trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: LEAP 用 Gemini 3.1 Pro、Lean 编译反馈和 AND-OR 证明 DAG 生成可机器验收的形式化结果，但公开物只有成功证明，没有可重放的 agent 轨迹。

title: LearnAlign: Data Selection for LLM Reinforcement Learning with Improved Gradient Alignment

one_line_summary.en: LearnAlign ranks prompts for one warmed-up RLVR policy by combining p(1-p) learnability with average cosine alignment among projected GRPO gradients, then trains on the top-N subset; no selected subset or implementation is released.
one_line_summary.zh: LearnAlign 用 p(1-p) learnability 与投影 GRPO gradient 的平均余弦对齐，为一个 warmup 后 RLVR policy 排序并选择 top-N prompts；尚未发布选后子集或实现。

title: Learning from Contrasts: Synthesizing Reasoning Paths from Diverse Search Trajectories

one_line_summary.en: CRPS contrasts successful MCTS paths with high-confidence failures or inefficient successes, uses GPT-5-mini to synthesize verified reasoning traces, and releases 27,256 final math problem/solution pairs.
one_line_summary.zh: CRPS 对比 MCTS 成功路径与高访问失败或低效正确路径，由 GPT-5-mini 合成终局答案可验证的轨迹；公开集实际为 27,256 条。

title: Learning Generative Selection for Best-of-N

one_line_summary.en: Automatically verified math and code candidate sets train a 1.7B DAPO policy to reason over Best-of-N solutions and return the index of a verified-correct candidate.
one_line_summary.zh: 自动验证过的数学与代码候选集用于训练 1.7B 的 DAPO 策略，让它在 Best-of-N 候选上推理并返回一个验证正确候选的编号。

title: Learning to Discover at Test Time

one_line_summary.en: TTT-Discover uses problem-specific test-time reinforcement learning to search for one high-reward scientific or engineering solution rather than merely sample from a frozen model.
one_line_summary.zh: TTT-Discover 在测试时针对当前问题继续强化学习，以连续奖励搜索一个最优科学或工程解，而非只从冻结模型采样。

title: Learning to Reason for Factuality

one_line_summary.en: Releases factual-reasoning SFT and DPO data while online GRPO uses a mixed retrieval-and-judge reward whose rollouts are not released.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作发布经筛选的事实推理 SFT 轨迹与偏好对，而 GRPO 阶段采用检索支撑的 claim 核验和 LLM 相关性判断，反馈并非纯程序化。

title: Learning to Refine: Self-Refinement of Parallel Reasoning in LLMs

one_line_summary.en: GSR trains one model to generate and then synthesize a better solution from parallel candidates, allowing test-time scaling to recover answers even when voting candidates are all wrong.
one_line_summary.zh: GSR 训练同一模型先生成并行候选，再从中综合出更好的答案，使测试时扩展即使在投票候选全错时也可能恢复正确解。

title: Less is More: Improving LLM Reasoning with Minimal Test-Time Intervention

one_line_summary.en: MTI applies classifier-free guidance only to high-entropy tokens, improving reasoning while avoiding the cost of guiding every decoding position.
one_line_summary.zh: MTI 只在高熵词元处施加无分类器引导，在避免逐位置引导成本的同时改善推理。

title: LexInstructEval: Lexical Instruction Following Evaluation for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** A 2,475-item bilingual lexical-constraint benchmark scored deterministically by a formal grammar and programmatic engine.
one_line_summary.zh: 2,475 条中英文细粒度约束指令，使用形式语法和程序引擎确定性判分。

title: LFQA-HP-1M: A Large-Scale Human Preference Dataset for Long-Form Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: LFQA-HP-1M filters and unifies 1,326,356 public human preference pairs for English long-form QA, then uses nine rubrics to audit interpretable and LLM-based judges.
one_line_summary.zh: LFQA-HP-1M 从公开偏好来源筛选并统一 1,326,356 条英语长篇问答人工两两偏好记录，并以九维质量量规审计可解释模型和 LLM 裁判。

title: LiteCoder-Terminal: Scaling Long-Horizon Terminal Environments for Learning Language Agents

one_line_summary.en: LiteCoder scales terminal environments and collects 11,255 verified conversations that preserve the entire instruction-reasoning-command-observation sequence.
one_line_summary.zh: LiteCoder 把终端监督数据从不足千条扩展到 11255 条完整轨迹，保留指令、推理、命令和工具观察。

title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework

one_line_summary.en: LLM-as-a-Verifier turns score-token distributions into continuous trajectory rewards and scales verification along granularity, repetition, and criteria.
one_line_summary.zh: LLM-as-a-Verifier 把评分 token 分布转为连续轨迹奖励，并沿粒度、重复和准则三个维度扩展验证。

title: LLMs Gaming Verifiers: RLVR can Lead to Reward Hacking

one_line_summary.en: IPT detects when an RLVR model passes an original logic-task verifier by enumerating labels yet fails under a logically isomorphic object renaming.
one_line_summary.zh: 揭示模型可能通过迎合验证器而非解决任务来获得 RLVR 奖励，是检查奖励黑客行为的直接证据。

title: LLMs Improving LLMs: Agentic Discovery for Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: AutoTTS discovers test-time branching and stopping controllers in an offline replay environment, improving the accuracy-token frontier without hand-coding a fixed scaling rule.
one_line_summary.zh: AutoTTS 在离线回放环境中发现测试时的分支与停止控制器，无需手工编写固定扩展规则即可改善准确率—词元前沿。

title: Logics-STEM: Empowering LLM Reasoning via Failure-Driven Post-Training and Document Knowledge Enhancement

one_line_summary.en: Logics-STEM curates millions of long-CoT STEM records and uses model failures to retrieve documents and synthesize targeted data for a second SFT or RLVR stage.
one_line_summary.zh: Logics-STEM 整理数百万条 STEM 长 CoT 记录，并围绕模型失败点检索文档、合成针对性数据，用于第二阶段 SFT 或 RLVR。

title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading

one_line_summary.en: LHTB releases 46 test-only containerized terminal tasks with deterministic end-of-rollout subtask rewards, but not the paper's model trajectories, and its current GitHub exposure of tests/solutions conflicts with the HF held-out policy.
one_line_summary.zh: LHTB 发布 46 个仅用于测试的容器化终端任务及确定性回合末子任务评分器，但未发布论文基线轨迹；当前 GitHub 公开全部任务的 tests/ 与 solution/，与 HF 的保留声明冲突。

title: LongRLVR: Long-Context Reinforcement Learning Requires Verifiable Context Rewards

one_line_summary.en: LongRLVR trains long-context models with a verifiable reward for evidence selection as well as answer correctness.
one_line_summary.zh: LongRLVR 将证据块选择与最终答案同时纳入可验证奖励，使长上下文强化学习获得更稠密的定位反馈。

title: Lookahead Tree-Based Rollouts for Enhanced Trajectory-Level Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

one_line_summary.en: LATR generates diverse on-policy RLVR rollout groups by probability-gated branching, lookahead simulation, and similarity pruning, while its public data release contains processed Countdown and math prompt/reward rows rather than the raw rollout trees.
one_line_summary.zh: LATR 在在线 RLVR 中以概率门控分支、前瞻模拟和相似度剪枝构造八路 rollout 组；其 ICLR 2026 配方可用于研究轨迹级探索，但公开数据只有 Countdown 与数学任务的预处理 prompt/reward 行，不含原始搜索树、被拒绝分支或逐样本奖励判定。

title: Lost in Translation: Do LVLM Judges Generalize Across Languages?

one_line_summary.en: MM-JudgeBench evaluates LVLM judges on over 60K multilingual image-text preference pairs across 25 languages and chart-reasoning settings.
one_line_summary.zh: MM-JudgeBench 有逾 6 万个跨 25 种语言的图文偏好实例，检验奖励模型跨语言迁移及图表推理反馈稳定性。

title: M2PO: Multi-Perspective Multi-Pair Preference Optimization for Machine Translation

one_line_summary.en: M2PO converts translation candidate sets into faithfulness-aware multi-pair preferences and trains them with a confidence-scheduled ranking objective.
one_line_summary.zh: M²PO 将翻译候选集转为兼顾忠实度、质量与模型置信度的多对偏好监督，并以排序目标共同训练。

title: Making Slow Thinking Faster: Compressing LLM Chain-of-Thought via Step Entropy

one_line_summary.en: The paper ranks newline-delimited CoT steps by model-derived entropy, replaces low-entropy steps with [SKIP], and trains SFT-plus-GRPO models to generate shorter reasoning traces.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作以模型导出的长度归一化步骤熵筛选完整 CoT 中的低熵步骤，用 [SKIP] 构造压缩轨迹，并以 SFT 和 GRPO 学习更短的推理输出。

title: MathSmith: Towards Extremely Hard Mathematical Reasoning by Forging Synthetic Problems with a Reinforced Policy

one_line_summary.en: Trains and releases Qwen3-8B problem synthesizers that turn PlanetMath-derived concepts into rationales and hard math problems using structural, trace-length, and same-teacher consistency rewards.
one_line_summary.zh: MathSmith 用 PlanetMath 衍生概念训练并发布 Qwen3-8B 出题器，以结构、教师推理长度和同教师答案一致性奖励生成题目与构造 rationale；这些信号仍不是独立数学验证。

title: MC-Search: Evaluating and Enhancing Multimodal Agentic Search with Structured Long Reasoning Chains

one_line_summary.en: MC-Search benchmarks multimodal agents on verified multi-hop image–text evidence chains and turns those chains into process supervision for better retrieval planning.
one_line_summary.zh: MC-Search 以经核验的图文多跳证据链评测多模态智能体，并将其转化为改进检索规划的过程监督。

title: MCP-AgentBench: Evaluating Real-World Language Agent Performance with MCP-Mediated Tools

one_line_summary.en: MCP-AgentBench evaluates 600 category-balanced queries over 33 stateless text MCP servers with answer-only o3-mini-high pass/fail judgments, while releasing no confirmed server bundle, task data, or success/failure trajectory archive.
one_line_summary.zh: MCP-AgentBench 用 600 个均衡分类 query 评测 33 个无状态文本 MCP server 上的工具智能体，但 MCP-Eval 只对 final answer 做 o3-mini-high 二元判断，且未核实到可重放的官方任务、server 或轨迹 release。

title: Mediocrity is the key for LLM as a Judge Anchor Selection

one_line_summary.en: This work shows that middling anchors make pairwise LLM judging more informative than extreme anchors.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究表明，在 LLM Judge 的锚点式比较中，中等能力锚点比极强或极弱锚点更能区分模型排序。

title: MedS³: Towards Medical Slow Thinking with Self-Evolved Soft Dual-sided Process Supervision

one_line_summary.en: MedS³ releases medical MCTS trajectories with positive and negative paths plus per-step Q-values and rollout values for soft dual-sided process supervision.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布医学问题的正负 MCTS 推理轨迹及步骤 Q-value、rollout value，用于软双向过程奖励监督。

title: MegaScience: Pushing the Frontiers of Post-Training Datasets for Science Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: MegaScience combines verified textbook references with source-specific selection and solution annotation to release a 1.25M seven-discipline reasoning mixture.
one_line_summary.zh: MegaScience 用教材参考答案、逐来源筛选和分步解答标注构建 125 万条、覆盖七个学科的科学推理混合。

title: MEnvAgent: Scalable Polyglot Environment Construction for Verifiable Software Engineering

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** MEnvAgent uses a multi-agent feedback loop to construct polyglot SWE sandboxes, addressing the loss of verifiable tasks to environment failures.
one_line_summary.zh: MEnvAgent 用多代理反馈闭环自动构造多语言 SWE 沙箱，解决可验证任务被环境失败卡住的问题。

title: Meta-Judging with Large Language Models: Concepts, Methods, and Challenges

one_line_summary.en: A 2026 map of how automated judges are evaluated, aligned, and still vulnerable to bias and prompt effects.
one_line_summary.zh: 一篇审视自动裁判如何被再评估、对齐和审计的 2026 年综述。

title: MetaScale: Test-Time Scaling with Evolving Meta-Thoughts
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026

one_line_summary.en: MetaScale searches over query-specific cognitive strategies with UCB and LLM-mediated evolution, using an outcome reward model to select the final response under a fixed inference budget.
one_line_summary.zh: MetaScale 用 UCB 与模型中介的演化在与问题相关的认知策略上搜索，并在固定推理预算下由结果奖励模型选出最终回答。

title: MiMo-V2-Flash Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: MiMo-V2-Flash describes MOPD plus agentic RL with teacher-KL, programmatic, judge, and multimodal feedback but withholds data, environments, teachers, and reward implementation.
one_line_summary.zh: MiMo-V2-Flash 描述了结合 teacher-KL、程序化检查、judge 与多模态反馈的 MOPD 和 agentic RL，但未发布数据、环境、教师和 reward 实现。

title: MindLoom: Composing Thought Modes for Frontier-Level Reasoning Data Synthesis

one_line_summary.en: MindLoom extracts reusable thought modes from verified solutions, composes them under compatibility and scarcity control, and keeps 9,230 judged-correct SFT records.
one_line_summary.zh: MindLoom 从已验证解答中提取可复用 thought mode，在兼容性与稀缺度控制下组合新题，并保留 9,230 条判定正确的 SFT 记录。

title: MiniMax-M2.5

one_line_summary.en: MiniMax-M2.5 reports hundreds of thousands of work-derived RL environments, 200K+ software environments, Forge tree-merged asynchronous rollouts, and CISPO rewards, but releases only 229B FP8 weights and inference materials—not environments, reward systems, splits, or training lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: MiniMax-M2.5 报告 20 万+软件环境、Forge 树合并异步 rollout 与 CISPO 性能/过程/速度反馈，并开放 229B FP8 权重；环境、奖励系统、训练数据和 lineage 仍未发布，SWE-Bench 80.2 与 75.8 也未解释。

title: MMFineReason: Closing the Multimodal Reasoning Gap via Open Data-Centric Methods

one_line_summary.en: MMFineReason distills and filters 1.8M multimodal long-CoT examples, then selects a 123K difficult subset that retains most of the training gain.
one_line_summary.zh: MMFineReason 蒸馏并筛选出 181 万条多模态长思维链样本，再选出 12.3 万条难例，以较少数据保留大部分训练收益。

title: MMSearch-R1: Incentivizing LMMs to Search

one_line_summary.en: MMSearch-R1: Incentivizing LMMs to Search records multi-round text/image search traces and cached image-search results under outcome reward plus search penalty.
one_line_summary.zh: MMSearch-R1 以多轮图像和文本搜索训练多模态模型按需调用工具，并发布 FVQA 与缓存图像检索结果。

title: MobileBench-OL: A Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for Evaluating Mobile GUI Agents in Real-World Environment
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
