one_line_summary.en: MobileBench-OL publishes 1,080 real-device Chinese-app evaluation cases with XPath-like success rules, noise injection and inverse-task resets, but not the paper's complete sampled trajectories or a frozen APK/device environment.
one_line_summary.zh: MobileBench-OL公开覆盖80款中文应用的1,080个真实设备评测项，以XPath式成功规则、噪声注入和逆任务重置评分，但没有发布论文所用的完整成败轨迹或冻结APK/设备环境。

title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research

one_line_summary.en: MobileGym is a browser-hosted mobile GUI simulator whose structured state supports reset/forked rollouts, deterministic state-based judging, and a reported GRPO run.
one_line_summary.zh: MobileGym 以可配置、可分叉的结构化 JSON 状态承载移动 GUI episode，并用确定性终局检查同时支持评测与在线 GRPO；其公开物是模拟器、任务和训练代码，而非论文实验的完整 rollout 语料。

title: MobileLLM-R1: Exploring the Limits of Sub-Billion Language Model Reasoners with Open Training Recipes

one_line_summary.en: MobileLLM-R1 derives phase-specific mixtures with capability probes and influence estimates, then trains 140M-950M models through 4T pretraining, 200B distillation mid-training, and staged SFT without releasing the sampled corpus or full curation pipeline.
one_line_summary.zh: MobileLLM-R1 用 capability probe 与 influence estimate 形成分阶段数据配比，并以 4T 预训练、200B 蒸馏式中训练和分阶段 SFT 训练 140M-950M 模型，但未发布抽样语料或完整数据筛选流水线。

title: MobileWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Mobile Agents in Agent-User Interactive and MCP-Augmented Environments

one_line_summary.en: MobileWorld evaluates 201 long-horizon mobile tasks in a containerized, snapshot-reset environment with GUI, simulated-user, and MCP actions plus task-specific programmatic terminal checks.
one_line_summary.zh: MobileWorld 在可快照重置的容器化 Android 环境中评测 201 个长程任务，把 GUI、模拟用户澄清与 MCP 调用写入同一 episode，并以任务特定程序检查终局；当前公开轨迹可审计成功和失败，但论文运行的不可变 replay pin 仍不完整。

title: ModeX: Evaluator-Free Best-of-N Selection for Open-Ended Generation

one_line_summary.en: ModeX selects an existing open-ended response by recursively isolating a dense n-gram-similarity cluster and returning its maximum-degree centroid; ModeX-Lite applies the same idea during decoding.
one_line_summary.zh: ModeX 通过递归分离出稠密的 n-gram 相似度簇并返回其最大度中心点，从已有的开放式回答中挑选结果；ModeX-Lite 在解码过程中应用同一思路。

title: Multi-Agent Reasoning Improves Compute Efficiency: Pareto-Optimal Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: This study shows that mixture-of-agents can dominate matched-budget single-agent scaling and gives concrete parallel-versus-sequential allocation rules.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究表明，混合智能体在等预算下可优于单智能体扩展，并给出并行与顺序计算分配的具体规则。

title: Multi-Crit: Benchmarking Multimodal Judges on Pluralistic Criteria-Following

one_line_summary.en: Multi-Crit supplies criterion-level human preferences and conflict-aware metrics for testing whether multimodal judges follow pluralistic rubrics.
one_line_summary.zh: Multi-Crit 提供准则级人工偏好及冲突感知指标，用于检验多模态评判模型能否遵循多元量规。

title: NaturalGAIA: A Verifiable Benchmark and Hierarchical Framework for Long-Horizon GUI Tasks

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** Real GUI intents are decomposed into verifiable causal pathways, with long-horizon tasks and human-verified trajectories released.
one_line_summary.zh: 将真实 GUI 意图拆成可验证因果路径，并发布长程任务与人工核验轨迹。

title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Nemotron 3 Ultra releases weights, data collections, and recipes while disclosing multi-domain SFT, asynchronous RLVR with 16 rollouts, and two-stage teacher distillation; private inputs, complete reward calibration, and item-level provenance remain incomplete.
one_line_summary.zh: Nemotron 3 Ultra 发布了权重、数据集合与训练配方，并披露多领域 SFT、每样本 16 次 rollout 的异步 RLVR 和两阶段教师蒸馏；私有输入、完整 reward 校准和逐条来源谱系仍不完整。

title: Never Truly Out of Fashion: A Retrospective Look at Evaluation in NLG

one_line_summary.en: Reviews evaluation practice and the incomplete human validation of LLM judges.
one_line_summary.zh: 基于跨七十年论文语料，量化 NLG 评测中人工评估、LLM judge 与评测标准的长期演变。

title: NFT: Bridging Supervised Learning and Reinforcement Learning in Math Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: NFT trains math reasoning from verifier-separated positive and negative rollouts instead of treating rejected answers as disposable.
one_line_summary.zh: NFT 在 DAPO-Math-17k 上进行在线训练：每个 rollout step 抽取 512 个问题、每题生成 16 个答案，并用二元正确性信号同时利用正例和负例。

title: Not All Invariants Are Equal: Curating Training Data to Accelerate Program Verification with SLMs

one_line_summary.en: WONDA turns raw verifier invariants into compact loop-invariant SFT targets, but reuse requires distinguishing the 7,763-row curated table from the grade-filtered 7,284-sample experiment set and auditing lineage, licenses, and version drift.
one_line_summary.zh: WONDA 将 UAutomizer 原始循环不变量整理为紧凑 SFT 目标，并分别记录归纳正确性、充分性与 verifier 加速，但复用时必须区分 7,763 行 curated 表和 7,284 条实验训练集，并补查 lineage、许可与版本漂移。

title: Odysseys: Benchmarking Web Agents on Realistic Long Horizon Tasks

one_line_summary.en: Odysseys releases 200 live-web tasks with 1,225 rubric checkpoints and an OSWorld/Gemini scoring pipeline, but not the 2,380 source histories, complete model trajectories, human labels, frozen sites, or deterministic replay state.
one_line_summary.zh: Odysseys 公开 200 个长程实时网页任务、1,225 条 rubric 和 200 份 OSWorld 配置及评分脚本，但没有公开来源浏览历史、完整模型轨迹、人工标签或可确定重放的网页状态。

title: Offline Preference Optimization via Maximum Marginal Likelihood Estimation

one_line_summary.en: MMPO converts each offline preference pair into a normalized maximum-marginal-likelihood objective that implicitly up-weights the chosen response.
one_line_summary.zh: MMPO 将每个离线偏好回答对转化为归一化的最大边缘似然目标，并隐式提高优选回答的权重。

title: Omni-Reward: Towards Generalist Omni-Modal Reward Modeling with Free-Form Preferences

one_line_summary.en: Omni-RewardData provides multimodal preference pairs and free-form criteria for generalist reward modeling.
one_line_summary.zh: Omni-RewardData 将跨五种模态的候选比较与自由文本偏好准则一起公开，使通用奖励模型能够按指定判断维度评分。

title: Omni-RRM: Advancing Omni Reward Modeling via Automatic Rubric-Grounded Preference Synthesis

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: Omni-RRM 自动合成带模态量规和逐维理由的跨文本、图像、视频、音频偏好数据，训练全模态奖励模型。

title: On Data Engineering for Scaling LLM Terminal Capabilities

one_line_summary.en: Releases exactly 366,154 train-only terminal SFT episodes from dataset adapters and skill-based synthesis, while the paper's no-filter recipe retains incomplete and failed behavior but the public rows expose no normalized outcome or reward.
one_line_summary.zh: 公开 366,154 条 train-only 终端 SFT episode；论文研究的完整混合共 490,520 条，其中 124,366 条 seed-based 轨迹尚未确认发布，且公开行没有规范化 outcome、reward 或 test result。

title: On Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A broad LVLM study finds that standard test-time scaling can strongly help capable small models but can hurt perception tasks when extra reasoning makes models lose visual focus.
one_line_summary.zh: 这项大规模视觉语言模型研究发现，标准测试时扩展能显著帮助有能力的小模型，但额外推理也可能使模型失去视觉焦点并损害感知任务。

title: On the Fragility of Benchmark Contamination Detection in Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: PPO-style RL can erase contamination-detection signals after contaminated SFT, while CoT contamination of mature LRMs drives existing detectors toward chance.
one_line_summary.zh: PPO 类强化学习可在污染 SFT 后抹去检测信号，而成熟推理模型的 CoT 污染会让既有检测器接近随机猜测。

title: On the limits and opportunities of AI reviewers: Reviewing the reviews of Nature-family papers with 45 expert scientists

one_line_summary.en: PeerReviewBench uses expert scientists to rate individual human and AI review criticisms for correctness, significance, and evidential sufficiency.
one_line_summary.zh: PeerReviewBench 由领域科学家逐条评定人类与 AI 评审意见的正确性、重要性和证据充分性。

title: On the Shelf Life of Finetuned LLM-Judges: Future Proofing, Backward Compatibility, and Question Generalization

one_line_summary.en: Audits whether a finetuned judge remains reliable as questions and model generations shift.
one_line_summary.zh: 审计微调 judge 面对新旧生成器与未见问题时的保鲜期，并表明持续训练更平衡。

title: On the Step Length Confounding in LLM Reasoning Data Selection

one_line_summary.en: ASLEC removes step-length bias from likelihood-based reasoning-data selection by dropping or regressing out first-token effects.
one_line_summary.zh: ASLEC 通过丢弃或回归掉首词元效应，消除基于似然的推理数据选择中的步骤长度偏差。

title: Open-SWE-Traces: Advancing Dual-Mode Multilingual Distillation for Software Engineering Agents

one_line_summary.en: Releases 207,489 multilingual software-agent episodes from 20,000 SWE-rebench-V2 pull-request tasks across two teachers and two harness families, retaining solved, unresolved, and unavailable outcomes.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 207,489 条多语言软件工程 agent episode，来源为 20,000 个 SWE-rebench-V2 PR 任务、两类教师模型与两类 harness，并保留已解决、未解决和结果不可用三类 outcome。

title: OpenDiscoveryTrace: Process Traces for Evaluating AI Scientist Workflows
venue: ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop Dataset Proposal Competition

one_line_summary.en: OpenDiscoveryTrace releases complete AI-scientist workflows—thoughts, tools, errors, revisions, and outcomes—for process-level evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenDiscoveryTrace 开放 AI 科学家从思考、工具调用到错误修正和结论的完整工作流轨迹。

title: OpenGenAlign: A Preference Dataset and Benchmark for Trustworthy Reward Modeling in Open-Ended, Long-Context Generation

one_line_summary.en: A 33K preference dataset and benchmark for reward modeling of long-context open-ended generation.
one_line_summary.zh: 用多次 o3 判决构造长上下文偏好数据，专门衡量幻觉与完整性等生成质量。

title: OpenMMReasoner: Pushing the Frontiers for Multimodal Reasoning with an Open and General Recipe

one_line_summary.en: Separates an open 874K multimodal SFT conversation mixture from roughly 73K released RL training prompts and unreleased 16-way online GSPO rollouts, with mixed rule, learned-judge, and format rewards.
one_line_summary.zh: 公开约87.4万条多模态SFT对话与72,971条RL训练提示，训练时再在线采样16路回答并用规则/裁判正确性与格式奖励驱动GSPO，但rollout本身未发布。

title: OpenMobile: Building Open Mobile Agents with Task and Trajectory Synthesis

one_line_summary.en: OpenMobile releases synthesized Android tasks and policy-switching mobile-agent trajectories that retain error-recovery signals.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenMobile 以环境记忆合成移动端任务，并用强弱策略切换保留错误恢复过程，公开任务与轨迹联合训练数据。

title: OpenResearcher: A Fully Open Pipeline for Long-Horizon Deep Research Trajectory Synthesis

one_line_summary.en: OpenResearcher bootstraps an offline evidence corpus, then generates and filters complete search-browse-answer trajectories without repeated live-web dependence.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenResearcher 先建立离线证据库，再合成并筛选 9.7 万多条搜索、浏览与回答交错的长程研究轨迹。

title: OpenRubrics: Towards Scalable Synthetic Rubric Generation for Reward Modeling and LLM Alignment

one_line_summary.en: An open release of generated rubrics and preference data for rubric-conditioned reward modeling.
one_line_summary.zh: 用对比偏好生成并验证 rubric，把隐式偏好转为可训练的显式奖励依据。

title: OpenWebRL: Demystifying Online Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning for Visual Web Agents

one_line_summary.en: OpenWebRL releases 412 success-only SFT trajectories, 2,198 RL task specifications, live-browser MM-GRPO code, hybrid trajectory judging and model weights, while its roughly 54K online training rollouts and exact live-web replay remain unavailable.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenWebRL公开412条success-only SFT轨迹、2,198个RL task spec、hybrid trajectory reward与训练框架，但约54K online rollout未确认发布，2,102默认快照、live-web replay及Judge-13K权利仍需单独审计。

title: Optimal Aggregation of LLM and PRM Signals for Efficient Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: Optimal Aggregation of LLM and PRM Signals for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
one_line_summary.zh: 当过程奖励模型分数与生成器频率产生相关错误时，它可能损害选择。

title: Optimal Self-Consistency for Efficient Reasoning with Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A global self-consistency sampler that reallocates chain-of-thought calls toward uncertain questions without updating the model.
one_line_summary.zh: Blend-ASC 在全局样本预算下按答案计数置信度把下一次 CoT 采样分给最不确定的问题，最后以经验众数输出答案。

title: ORCA: Open-ended Response Correctness Assessment for Audio Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: ORCA models open-ended audio-QA correctness as a distribution, capturing both scores and human disagreement.
one_line_summary.zh: 把开放式音频问答的正确性建模为分布，以同时刻画评分与人类分歧。

title: Outcome Accuracy is Not Enough: Aligning the Reasoning Process of Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: RationaleRM measures whether a reward model’s rationale agrees with atomic human reasons and uses that signal alongside outcome accuracy for RL.
one_line_summary.zh: RationaleRM 衡量奖励模型的理由是否与原子化人工理由一致，并将该信号与结果准确率共同用于强化学习。

title: PaCoRe: Learning to Scale Test-Time Compute with Parallel Coordinated Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: PaCoRe coordinates large parallel trajectory pools through compact messages, allowing multi-million-token effective reasoning without exceeding a model’s context window.
one_line_summary.zh: PaCoRe 用多轮并行轨迹与压缩消息协调推理，在不超出上下文窗口的情况下扩展到数百万级有效测试时令牌。

title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling for Latent Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: This work brings parallel sampling and reward-guided selection to latent reasoning by using dropout or noise for exploration and a step-level latent reward model for aggregation.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作用 dropout 或噪声在潜空间探索，并用逐步潜空间奖励模型聚合，把并行采样与奖励引导选择带入潜式推理。

title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling with Multi-Sequence Verifiers

one_line_summary.en: MSV jointly scores parallel candidates to improve best-of-N selection and reduce latency through streaming early stopping.
one_line_summary.zh: MSV 联合为并行候选打分，以改善 best-of-N 选择并通过流式提前停止降低时延。

title: PaT: Planning-after-Trial for Efficient Test-Time Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: PaT tries inexpensive direct code generation first and invokes a planner only after all verified trials fail, improving the code-generation cost-performance frontier.
one_line_summary.zh: PaT 先用低成本模型直接生成并执行验证，仅在全部失败时才调用规划器分解问题，从而改善代码生成的成本—性能前沿。

title: Personalized RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models with Human Aligned Personalization

one_line_summary.en: Personalized RewardBench isolates user-specific rubric adherence in chosen–rejected pairs to test whether reward models genuinely model individual preferences.
one_line_summary.zh: 数据以用户专属量规构造 chosen/rejected 对，隔离个体偏好变量，并验证其可预测 BoN 与 PPO 下游表现。

title: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B reports a 200B-token, three-stage mixed-reasoning SFT pipeline with public source families and data-quality transformations, but withholds training records, internal/acquired data, verification details, and full audit artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B 披露了约 200B token、三阶段混合推理 SFT、公开源类别与数据质量转换，但未发布训练记录、内部/采购数据、验证细节或完整审计工件。

title: Pixels Don’t Lie (But Your Detector Might): Bootstrapping MLLM-as-a-Judge for Trustworthy Deepfake Detection and Reasoning Supervision

one_line_summary.en: DeepfakeJudge turns explanation faithfulness in deepfake detection into a human-anchored pointwise and pairwise judge-training dataset.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepfakeJudge 以人工视觉证据标注、点式分数和成对偏好，把深伪检测解释的忠实性变为可训练的 Judge 信号。

title: Plan and Budget: Effective and Efficient Test-Time Scaling on Large Language Model Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Plan-and-Budget decomposes a query and adaptively assigns token budgets to subquestions instead of using a fixed thinking length.
one_line_summary.zh: Plan-and-Budget 按子问题复杂度分配 token 预算，以避免简单问题过度思考、困难问题思考不足。

title: Plan and Budget: Effective and Efficient Test-Time Scaling on Reasoning Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Plan-and-Budget uses LLM-produced sub-question plans and credit-weighted schedules to vary test-time compute, with task-specific scoring and E3 aggregation but incomplete released run provenance.
one_line_summary.zh: Plan-and-Budget 用 LLM 生成子问题与 credits，并按调度规则分配测试时计算；其 E3 以任务分数和 token 成本汇总，但完整运行轨迹与来源元数据未发布。

title: Prism: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification for Discrete Diffusion Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Prism allocates denoising-time compute through hierarchical search, partial remasking, and self-verification for discrete diffusion language models.
one_line_summary.zh: Prism 以分层搜索、局部重掩码和自验证反馈，为离散扩散语言模型分配更有效的推理计算。

title: ProBench: Benchmarking GUI Agents with Accurate Process Information

one_line_summary.en: ProBench evaluates 217 bilingual mobile-GUI tasks by feeding action-level process descriptions and the final screen to a terminal Gemini judge, but releases neither a confirmed executable benchmark package nor a trajectory corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: ProBench以a11y converter生成的动作证据和最终截图交给Gemini 2.5 Pro终局judge评测217项双语移动GUI任务，但该证据不是过程监督，且无官方代码、任务、环境或轨迹发布。

title: Probing Preference Representations: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation and Analysis Method for Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: MRMBench probes six preference dimensions to diagnose what reward-model representations encode rather than reporting a single aggregate ranking score.
one_line_summary.zh: MRMBench 从正确性、帮助性、连贯性等六维剖析偏好表示，提供约 16.7 万实例以诊断奖励模型的真实偏好能力。

title: Process Reinforcement through Implicit Rewards

one_line_summary.en: PRIME trains an online implicit process reward model from verifier-derived outcome labels and releases response-level preference data for math and code reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: 88,455 指令×8 响应的约 70 万记录，以隐式过程偏好训练 PRM，并用于数学、代码 RL。

title: Process Reward Models Meet Planning: Generating Precise and Scalable Datasets for Step-Level Rewards

one_line_summary.en: Process Reward Models Meet Planning: Generating Precise and Scalable Datasets for Step-Level Rewards exposes process or trace supervision data.
one_line_summary.zh: 提出 PDDL2PRM：把可执行规划中的动作转为带精确分级奖励的推理步骤，自动生成约百万规模 PRM 训练数据。

title: ProFit: Leveraging High-Value Signals in SFT via Probability-Guided Token Selection

one_line_summary.en: ProFit masks low-probability reference tokens during SFT so high-probability semantic anchors dominate the training signal.
one_line_summary.zh: ProFit 在监督微调中屏蔽低概率参考词元，使高概率语义锚点主导训练信号。

title: Provable and Practical In-Context Policy Optimization for Self-Improvement

one_line_summary.en: Provable and Practical In-Context Policy Optimization for Self-Improvement
one_line_summary.zh: 自我反思可能消耗许多轮次，却不知道自评奖励是否可靠。

title: Pythagoras-Prover: Advancing Efficient Formal Proving via Augmented Lean Formalisation

one_line_summary.en: Augmented Lean Formalisation mutates seed problems, writes reasoning plans and Lean artifacts, and retains only compiler-verified proofs in a 336K-record SFT set.
one_line_summary.zh: Pythagoras 把题目变异、证明计划和 Lean 证明结合，公开 336596 条经编译器验证的形式证明监督记录。

title: QED-Nano: Teaching a Tiny Model to Prove Hard Theorems

one_line_summary.en: QED-Nano couples 128-attempt difficulty statistics, 16-rollout rubric-reward GRPO, and three-turn Reasoning-Cache training, while FineProofs-RL releases prompts, rubrics, and score arrays but not the proofs behind them.
one_line_summary.zh: QED-Nano 将每题名义 128 次的离线难度估计、每题 16 次的 rubric-reward GRPO 与三轮 Reasoning Cache 训练连接起来；FineProofs-RL 发布题目、rubric 和分数数组，但不发布产生这些分数的证明文本或逐次评分意见。

title: Quantifying biases in LLM-as-Judge evals

one_line_summary.en: Models, quantifies, and corrects systematic biases in LLM autograders.
one_line_summary.zh: 以贝叶斯广义线性模型识别、量化并校正 LLM 自动评测器的系统偏差。

title: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents

one_line_summary.en: Qwen-AgentWorld reports CPT, SFT, and GSPO RL over more than 10M seven-domain environment trajectories, releases 35B weights and the separate 2,170-sample AgentWorldBench test set, and leaves the training corpus and reward stack only partially auditable.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen-AgentWorld 报告在七类环境的 1,000 多万条轨迹上依次进行 CPT、SFT 和 GSPO RL，并使用 rubric 加规则的混合奖励；其发布了 35B 权重和独立的 AgentWorldBench 评测集，但训练数据、奖励与环境复现仍不完整。

title: Qwen3-Coder-Next Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Qwen3-Coder-Next discloses executable coding-task synthesis and Docker-based verification with staged agentic training, but not its training tasks, environments, trajectories, or audit records.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen3-Coder-Next 披露了可执行编码任务合成、Docker 验证和分阶段 agentic training，但未发布训练任务、环境、轨迹或审计记录。

title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Qwen3.5-Omni reports aggregate text-vision and 100M-plus-hour audio-visual training scale plus ARIA, but its official abstract leaves post-training data, feedback, and audit artifacts undisclosed.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen3.5-Omni 报告文本—视觉和超过一亿小时音视频语料、256K 上下文与全模态能力，但未披露后训练数据、奖励/verifier、rollout 或审计细节。

title: Qwen3.5: Towards Native Multimodal Agents

one_line_summary.en: Qwen3.5 reports scaled multimodal and multi-turn RL with agent-oriented environments and releases a post-trained checkpoint, but not the tasks, traces, rewards, environment artifacts, or provenance needed to audit or reproduce that training.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen3.5 报告了在面向智能体环境中扩展多模态和多轮 RL，并发布后训练检查点；但未发布审计或复现该训练所需的任务、轨迹、奖励、环境工件或溯源信息。

title: R-Diverse: Mitigating Diversity Illusion in Self-Play LLM Training

one_line_summary.en: Adds skill-aware historical diversity penalties and replay to Challenger-Solver self-play, but releases no executable pipeline or generated records.
one_line_summary.zh: 为 Challenger-Solver 自博弈加入程序级技能多样性和历史记忆惩罚，但未发布可执行流程或生成记录。

title: Ranking Reasoning LLMs under Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: Scorio evaluates how statistical ranking remains stable when reasoning models receive different test-time sampling budgets.
one_line_summary.zh: Scorio 研究推理模型在不同推理时采样预算下如何获得稳定、可信的排名。

title: Reasoning or Memorization? Unreliable Results of Reinforcement Learning Due to Data Contamination

one_line_summary.en: RandomCalculation releases 20 levels of procedurally generated arithmetic prompt-answer pairs and uses two levels to test whether RLVR gains survive a lower-contamination control.
one_line_summary.zh: 程序化生成20个算术难度层级，并以正确/随机/反向奖励对照区分低污染RLVR学习与基准记忆。

title: Reasoning with OmniThought: A Large CoT Dataset with Verbosity and Cognitive Difficulty Annotations

one_line_summary.en: OmniThought releases nested multi-teacher math, code, and science traces with separate reasoning-validity and answer acceptance signals plus RV/CD annotations, while row-level prompt provenance, generation settings, executable verifier assets, and exact nested-trace lineage remain incomplete.
one_line_summary.zh: OmniThought 发布 708,009 个问题行及其嵌套的多教师数学、代码与科学 CoT，分别保留推理有效性、答案接收信号和 RV/CD 标注；但逐行题源、生成设置、可执行验证器资产与精确轨迹 lineage 仍不完整。

title: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory

one_line_summary.en: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory
one_line_summary.zh: 持续运行的代理会反复丢弃成功和失败交互中的洞见，因此更多测试时探索可能重复同样错误，而不是积累有用经验。

title: ReFACT: A Benchmark for Scientific Confabulation Detection with Positional Error Annotations

one_line_summary.en: ReFACT pairs scientific answers with expert-marked error spans to test detection, localization, and correction of confabulations.
one_line_summary.zh: ReFACT 以专家标注的科学错误位置配对答案，评测幻觉检测、定位与纠正。

title: Reliable Fine-Grained Evaluation of Natural Language Math Proofs

one_line_summary.en: ProofBench makes local errors in natural-language mathematical proofs visible through reliable fine-grained evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: 以细粒度判定把自然语言数学证明的局部错误定位转化为可靠评测。

title: ReProbe: Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Multi-Step Reasoning by Probing Internal States of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: ReProbe uses a small probe over a frozen LLM’s internal states to verify reasoning steps during test-time scaling.
one_line_summary.zh: ReProbe 用冻结语言模型的内部状态训练小型探针，在测试时扩展中验证推理步骤。

title: Reproducing, Analyzing, and Detecting Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: controllable LLM-judge bias and reward-hacking environment
one_line_summary.zh: CHERRL 通过注入可控的 LLM judge 偏差，复现并定位基于量规强化学习中的奖励投机。

title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research

one_line_summary.en: ResearchClawBench grades end-to-end scientific re-discovery from raw data using hidden-paper, expert-weighted artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: ResearchClawBench 以隐藏目标论文和专家加权产物准则，衡量 AI 的端到端科学复现与发现能力。

title: ResearchQA: Evaluating Scholarly Question Answering at Scale Across 75 Fields with Survey-Mined Questions and Rubrics

one_line_summary.en: ResearchQA turns surveys from 75 fields into 21K scholarly queries and 160K evaluation rubrics.
one_line_summary.zh: ResearchQA 从 75 个领域的综述文章提炼问题与细粒度 rubric，评测学术问答的引用、解释与局限性。

title: Rethinking Benchmark Comparability: A Survey of Reasoning Benchmarks for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A 2026 survey that explains why two “reasoning benchmark” scores are often not measuring the same thing.
one_line_summary.zh: 解释推理基准分数为何常常不可直接比较的 2026 综述。

title: Rethinking LLM-as-a-Judge: Representation-as-a-Judge with Small Language Models via Semantic Capacity Asymmetry

one_line_summary.en: open judge data and reproducible representation-based evaluator
one_line_summary.zh: INSPECTOR 以小语言模型的隐藏表示预测评测分数，避免依赖生成式 LLM judge。

title: Rethinking Text-to-SQL: Dynamic Multi-turn SQL Interaction for Real-world Database Exploration

one_line_summary.en: DySQL-Bench evaluates multi-turn SQL agents by executing their CRUD actions on database snapshots and checking both query results and state changes.
one_line_summary.zh: DySQL-Bench 在数据库快照中执行多轮 SQL 的 CRUD 操作，并同时检查查询结果和状态变化来评估代理。

title: ReTraceQA: Evaluating Reasoning Traces of Small Language Models in Commonsense Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: ReTraceQA adds expert first-error and error-category annotations to 2,421 commonsense reasoning traces.
one_line_summary.zh: ReTraceQA 为 2,421 条常识推理轨迹提供专家首错与错误类别标注，揭示答案正确但过程错误的失真。

title: Revealing the Seen, Imagining the Beyond: A Survey of Image-Grounded Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs

one_line_summary.en: An ACL survey of multimodal reasoning processes that alternate between text and visual state updates.
one_line_summary.zh: 梳理文字理由与视觉状态交替更新的多模态推理过程的 ACL 综述。

title: Revisiting Self-Play Preference Optimization: On the Role of Prompt Difficulty

one_line_summary.en: The paper improves self-play DPO by ranking prompts with mean reward and retaining only the easiest 30 percent rather than mixing in difficult prompts.
one_line_summary.zh: 该论文以平均奖励排序提示，仅保留最容易的 30% 来构造自博弈 DPO 偏好对。

title: Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents with Tool Use

one_line_summary.en: Public release of deliberately vulnerable code-optimization environments for measuring reward hacking.
one_line_summary.zh: RHB以多步工具任务和自然捷径机会，测量语言模型 agent 的 reward hacking。

title: Reward Hacking in Language Model Agents: Revisiting AI Safety Gridworlds

one_line_summary.en: text-based reward-hacking evaluation environments
one_line_summary.zh: 将 AI Safety Gridworlds 文本化，量化语言模型 agent 在代理奖励下的 specification gaming。

title: Reward Under Attack: Analyzing the Robustness and Hackability of Process Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: Reward Under Attack releases PRM-BiasBench and a three-tier audit showing that process rewards can be optimized on invalid mathematical reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: PRM-BiasBench 含数千受控扰动对与三层攻击，反馈奖励变化，揭示通用数学推理奖励的可被利用性。

title: Rewarding the Scientific Process: Process-Level Reward Modeling for Agentic Data Analysis

one_line_summary.en: DataPRM probes execution states and assigns reflection-aware process rewards to train and guide data-analysis agents.
one_line_summary.zh: DataPRM 探测执行状态并赋予反思感知的过程奖励，用于训练和引导数据分析智能体。

title: Re²: Unlocking LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Re-solving

one_line_summary.en: Re²: Unlocking LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Re-solving
one_line_summary.zh: RLVR 模型可能持续展开一条起点很差的思维链而不放弃它，因此更多 token 造成过度思考而非恢复。

title: RLBFF: Binary Flexible Feedback to bridge between Human Feedback & Verifiable Rewards

one_line_summary.en: RLBFF turns natural-language feedback into binary principles so reward models can score whether a response satisfies a chosen quality criterion.
one_line_summary.zh: 4.08万带人类文字反馈的样本被转为二元原则满足标签，可让 RM 按准确性、代码质量等维度推理。

title: RLVR Datasets and Where to Find Them: Tracing Data Lineage for Better Training Data

one_line_summary.en: ATLAS traces 1.45M RLVR instances to atomic sources and uses leakage and source-utility signals to construct the released 17K-row DAPO++, while the lineage and selection ledgers remain unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: ATLAS 将 145 万条 RLVR 记录追溯到原子来源，并据泄漏与来源效用信号构建公开的 1.7 万条 DAPO++；完整谱系与选择账本尚未发布。

title: Robometer: Scaling General-Purpose Robotic Reward Models via Trajectory Comparisons

one_line_summary.en: Robometer learns robot rewards from both per-frame progress and same-task trajectory preferences, including failed executions.
one_line_summary.zh: RBM-1M 含逾百万机器人轨迹，结合帧级进度与同任务轨迹偏好，显式纳入失败和次优行为。

title: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics

one_line_summary.en: RoboReward turns real-robot videos into a five-level reward dataset and human-verified benchmark for general-purpose vision-language reward models.
one_line_summary.zh: RoboReward 将真实机器人视频转为五级进度奖励数据与人工核验基准，用于训练通用视觉语言奖励模型。

title: RUBRIC-ARROW: Alternating Pointwise Rubric Reward Modeling for LLM Post-training in Non-verifiable Domains

one_line_summary.en: RUBRIC-ARROW alternates rubric generation and pointwise judging to train reward models for non-verifiable tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: RUBRIC-ARROW 交替训练 rubric 生成器与条件化点式 Judge，为不可验证任务提供可学习的奖励信号。

title: RubricBench: Aligning Model-Generated Rubrics with Human Standards

one_line_summary.en: RubricBench tests whether model-generated evaluation criteria align with expert atomic rubrics.
one_line_summary.zh: RubricBench 以专家原子 rubric 和胜负标签检验模型生成准则是否忠实反映人类评判标准。

title: RubricHub: A Comprehensive and Highly Discriminative Rubric Dataset via Automated Coarse-to-Fine Generation

one_line_summary.en: RubricHub releases roughly 110K cross-domain, weighted rubric evaluations for fine-tuning and rubric-based RL on open-ended generation.
one_line_summary.zh: 约 11 万跨域 rubric/评分样本，含 criterion、权重、评分和评审细节，可供 RM 微调与 RL。

title: SafeRun: Enabling Determinism in LLM Planning for Running

one_line_summary.en: SafeRun pairs running-plan requests with a CP-SAT solver so every accepted plan is checked against explicit safety constraints.
one_line_summary.zh: SafeRun 将跑步计划请求交给 CP-SAT 求解器执行硬约束，使每个被接受的计划都通过明确的安全规则检查。

title: Sage: A Scalable Framework for Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge Without Human Effort

one_line_summary.en: Introduces consistency-based judge evaluation without human labels; status is explicitly recorded as submission.
one_line_summary.zh: 用局部偏好稳定性和全局传递性，无需人工标注地审计 LLM judge 的一致性。

title: SAJA: A Simple Approach to Judge Alignment for LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: A rubric-based calibration approach that aligns one-call LLM judgments to a small human-labeled set.
one_line_summary.zh: 用一次多维 rubric 调用和少量人工标签训练校准头，在不读取 logit 的条件下对齐 LLM 评委。

title: ScaleEnv: Scaling Environment Synthesis from Scratch for Generalist Interactive Tool-Use Agent Training

one_line_summary.en: ScaleEnv synthesizes 16 database-backed domains and 2,560 verifiable tasks for large-batch GRPO, but the environments, rollouts, rewards, code, checkpoints, reset mechanism, and replay manifests are not verified as released.
one_line_summary.zh: ScaleEnv 自动合成 16 个数据库工具域与 2,560 个可验证任务，用于大批量 GRPO；但完整环境、轨迹、奖励、代码、checkpoint、reset 机制与 replay 清单尚未核实公开。

title: Scaling Unverifiable Rewards: A Case Study on Visual Insights

one_line_summary.en: Selective TTS uses stage-specific judges to prune weak branches early in a data-analysis agent pipeline, improving visual-insight quality under a fixed compute budget.
one_line_summary.zh: 选择性测试时扩展使用阶段专属评审器，在数据分析智能体流程中及早剪去弱分支，以固定计算预算提升视觉洞见质量。

title: Scaling Up, Speeding Up: A Benchmark of Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: Scaling Up, Speeding Up: A Benchmark of Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Test-Time Scaling
one_line_summary.zh: 重复推理轨迹存在冗余，因此额外测试时样本可能让系统过慢。

title: Scaling with Confidence: Calibrating Confidence of LLMs for Adaptive Test Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: C3RL trains verbalized confidence to track correctness, then CAS uses that signal to stop easy queries early and reserve sampling for uncertain ones.
one_line_summary.zh: C3RL 先训练模型把口头置信度校准到真实正确率，再由 CAS 据此为不确定问题追加采样。

title: Search Arena: Analyzing Search-Augmented LLMs

one_line_summary.en: Search Arena releases real multi-turn search-LLM battles with user votes and full retrieval traces, exposing the difference between preferred and well-supported answers.
one_line_summary.zh: Search Arena 发布真实搜索增强模型对话、用户偏好票和检索轨迹，可检验偏好与引用支撑是否一致。

title: Search-Time Contamination in Deep Research Agents: Measuring Performance Inflation in Public Benchmark Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: Across 6,803 questions from six medical/clinical benchmarks, the study labels benchmark metadata, question context, and explicit answers inside deep-research search trajectories and shows that direct answer exposure can inflate accuracy and accelerate prediction convergence.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究在六个医学/临床基准的 6,803 个问题上逐步标注 deep-research 轨迹中的基准 metadata、问题上下文与显式答案泄漏，表明 web observation 会抬高准确率并加快预测收敛。

title: SecRepoBench: Benchmarking Code Agents for Secure Code Completion in Real-World Repositories

one_line_summary.en: SecRepoBench uses paired developer tests and exploit checks on 318 real C/C++ repository holes to measure whether code agents produce both functional and secure completions.
one_line_summary.zh: SecRepoBench 在 318 个真实 C/C++ 仓库缺口上以开发者测试与漏洞利用复验共同衡量补全的功能和安全性。

title: Seeing the Whole Elephant: A Benchmark for Failure Attribution in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

one_line_summary.en: TraceElephant releases 220 fully observable failed Captain-Agent, Magentic-One, and SWE-Agent episodes with expert component/step attribution and replay code, while archive repair history and environment drift remain material audit limits.
one_line_summary.zh: TraceElephant 发布 220 条 Captain-Agent、Magentic-One 与 SWE-Agent 失败 episode，保留可观察的完整输入、输出和工具轨迹并标注负责组件与决定性步骤；但数据包修复历史和环境漂移限制精确回放。

title: Select2Reason: Efficient Instruction-Tuning Data Selection for Long-CoT Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Select2Reason ranks long-CoT examples by model-relative difficulty and normalized trace length to form a compact SFT subset.
one_line_summary.zh: Select2Reason 按题目难度和去重后的推理长度排序长 CoT 样本，以更小的 SFT 子集训练推理能力。

title: SETA: Scaling Environments for Terminal Agents

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** A dual Synth/Evol pipeline releasing over 4,500 uniformly verifiable terminal RL environments.
one_line_summary.zh: 通过 Synth 与 Evol 双流水线发布 4,500+ 个统一可验证终端 RL 环境。

title: Shepherd: Enabling Programmable Meta-Agents via Reversible Agentic Execution Traces

one_line_summary.en: Shepherd turns agent execution into a reversible Git-like trace and uses meta-agent-selected forks for Tree-GRPO, while leaving generated trajectories, checkpoints, splits, and data-governance artifacts unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: Shepherd 将智能体动作、工具调用与耦合沙箱状态写成可逆的 Git 式执行轨迹，并以元智能体选点分支构造 Tree-GRPO 监督；但生成轨迹、模型检查点、精确划分和数据治理材料尚未发布。

title: Skill-Aware Data Selection and Fine-Tuning for Data-Efficient Reasoning Distillation

one_line_summary.zh: 技能感知蒸馏按学生薄弱技能抽取教师轨迹，并把完整技能链加入监督微调目标。

title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks

one_line_summary.en: SkillsBench evaluates model capabilities across skill-labeled tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: SkillsBench 以公开任务、技能包和确定性 verifier 评测 Agent Skills 对多领域任务表现的增益。

title: Small RL Controller, Large Language Model: RL-Guided Adaptive Sampling for Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: RL-Guided Sampling trains a small CPU-deployable policy to stop or expand parallel reasoning samples under explicit cost penalties.
one_line_summary.zh: RL-Guided Sampling 用可在 CPU 部署的小型策略网络，决定何时停止或追加并行推理样本。

title: SmartEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated Smart Contracts from Natural Language Specifications

one_line_summary.en: SmartEval evaluates 9,000 LLM-generated Solidity contracts using references, audits, and a five-dimensional quality rubric.
one_line_summary.zh: SmartEval 用专家实现、五维 rubric、审计和编译记录，系统评测 9,000 份 LLM 生成 Solidity 合约的质量。

title: Soft Contamination Means Benchmarks Test Shallow Generalization

one_line_summary.en: Local BibTeX seed for the 🧭 Surveys and Primers map; use it to inspect the paper's data object, verifier contract, and release metadata before promoting it.
one_line_summary.zh: 讨论软污染如何让基准看似测到泛化、实则只测到浅层相似性，适合补充传统去重检查。

title: Solve-Detect-Verify: Inference-Time Scaling with Flexible Generative Verifier

one_line_summary.en: Solve-Detect-Verify: Inference-Time Scaling with Flexible Generative Verifier records reasoning traces completion probes and verification feedback under fast/slow generative verification.
one_line_summary.zh: Solve-Detect-Verify 在快速与慢速生成式验证之间分配预算，并用验证反馈定向修正答案。

title: SorryDB: Can AI Provers Complete Real-World Lean Theorems?

one_line_summary.en: SorryDB continuously harvests open Lean proof obligations with pinned repository metadata so proposed proofs can be compiled in their original projects.
one_line_summary.zh: SorryDB 从真实 Lean 项目持续抽取待证明命题，并以固定提交、Lean 版本和编译复现信息构成可更新的证明任务库。

title: SPaCe: Unlocking Sample-Efficient Large Language Models Training With Self-Pace Curriculum Learning

one_line_summary.en: SPaCe reduces a reasoning pool by semantic-difficulty clusters and uses a progress-aware bandit to schedule RFT samples.
one_line_summary.zh: SPaCe 以语义—难度簇缩减推理池，再用感知进展的老虎机调度强化微调样本。

title: SpatialReward: Bridging the Perception Gap in Online RL for Image Editing via Explicit Spatial Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: SpatialReward 将图像编辑要求锚定到预测的空间区域，用显式空间推理提供细粒度在线强化学习奖励。

title: SPIRAL: Self-Play on Zero-Sum Games Incentivizes Reasoning via Multi-Agent Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: Generates an evolving online stream of multi-turn reasoning and action trajectories through shared-policy self-play in rule-scored zero-sum games.
one_line_summary.zh: 在规则可评分的零和游戏中让同一策略扮演双方，在线生成多轮推理与动作轨迹；其价值是把环境反馈变成数据构造循环，但并未冻结可审计的在线 rollout 数据。

title: SpreadsheetBench 2: Evaluating Agents on End-to-End Business Spreadsheet Workflows

one_line_summary.en: SpreadsheetBench 2 evaluates agents on end-to-end business spreadsheet workflows.
one_line_summary.zh: SpreadsheetBench 2 用 321 个端到端业务电子表格工作流评测智能体。

title: Spurious Rewards Paradox: Mechanistically Understanding How RLVR Activates Memorization Shortcuts in LLMs

one_line_summary.en: Mechanistic audit showing that spurious RLVR activates a Qwen memorization shortcut through middle-layer anchors and later structural adapters.

title: SrDetection: Self-Referential Leakage Detection for Code Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: controlled leakage testbed and self-referential detection code
one_line_summary.zh: 以语义等价代码变体为内部参照，无阈值检测 Code LLM 的逐题预训练泄漏。

title: Strategic Scaling of Test-Time Compute: A Bandit Learning Approach

one_line_summary.en: A global bandit allocation framework for allocating test-time reasoning compute across instances.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究把不同问题间的测试时算力分配建模为 bandit 学习，在线估计难度并优先把预算给可解的困难问题。

title: SWE Data Construction, Automatically!

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Factory converts issue and pull-request pairs into runnable coding-agent tasks through binary-test recovery, four-agent Docker and test-script generation, execution feedback, and gold-patch fail-to-pass validation, then samples Kimi-K2 trajectories for supervised fine-tuning.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Factory 以四代理生成 Dockerfile 与评测脚本，并用 gold-patch fail-to-pass 退出码契约验证 issue-resolution 环境；它公开 671 条任务、2,809 条 messages-only 轨迹和 430 条 Gym 记录，但三者缺少逐行谱系与不可变环境绑定。

title: SWE-CI: Evaluating Agent Capabilities in Maintaining Codebases via Continuous Integration

one_line_summary.en: SWE-CI evaluates 100 long-horizon repository evolutions from 68 public Python repositories through a 20-epoch Architect-Programmer CI loop and now releases tasks, Docker environments, code, and 115 GB of trajectories, with material split-version, verifier, completeness, replay, rights, privacy, and secret risks.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-CI 以 68 个公开 Python 仓库中的 100 个长期演化任务构造最长 20 轮 Architect–Programmer CI 轨迹，并已发布任务、Docker 环境、代码及 115 GB 轨迹；但版本漂移、测试验证器、归档完整性、回放、权利、隐私和凭据隔离仍需审计。

title: SWE-Factory: Your Automated Factory for Issue Resolution Training Data and Evaluation Benchmarks

one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Factory 自动完成环境、退出码判分和 F2P 验证，并发布 2,809 条 Gym 任务。

title: SWE-fficiency: Can Language Models Optimize Real-World Repositories on Real Workloads?

one_line_summary.zh: SWE-fficiency 用 498 个真实工作负载任务衡量智能体能否在通过单测的同时达到或逼近专家性能加速。

title: SWE-Perf: Can Language Models Optimize Code Performance on Real-World Repositories?

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Perf evaluates repository-level performance patches on 140 real pull-request tasks using executable correctness tests and runtime measurements.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Perf 从真实性能优化 PR 构建 140 个仓库级任务，并以正确性测试和运行时间共同验证补丁。

title: SWE-rebench V2: Language-Agnostic SWE Task Collection at Scale

one_line_summary.en: SWE-rebench V2 releases 32,079 prebuilt, test-verifiable repository repair environments across 20 languages plus 126,300 PR-derived training tasks, built by an automated setup, oracle-extraction, LLM-filtering, and metadata pipeline.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-rebench V2 发布 32,079 个跨 20 种语言的预构建可执行仓库修复环境及 126,300 个 PR 衍生训练任务，并公开测试终态反馈与自动构造配方，但不可变回放、污染、权利与失败记录仍不完整。

title: SWE-Shepherd: Advancing PRMs for Reinforcing Code Agents

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Shepherd pairs code-agent trajectories with process-level rewards to reinforce intermediate engineering decisions rather than only final issue resolution.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Shepherd 将代码智能体轨迹与过程级奖励配对，监督中间工程决策而非只看最终问题是否解决。

title: SWE-World: Building Software Engineering Agents in Docker-Free Environments

one_line_summary.en: SWE-World trains a step-feedback simulator and a virtual test runner from Docker rollouts, then uses them to generate and reward repository-agent episodes without Docker, while the complete task and trajectory corpora remain unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-World 用 Docker 轨迹训练 step-level SWT 与 episode-level SWR，在确定性文件系统沙箱中模拟执行反馈和终局测试奖励；完整任务与轨迹语料尚未发布。

title: T1: Tool-integrated Verification for Test-time Compute Scaling in Small Language Models

one_line_summary.en: T1 uses tools to remove memorization-heavy verification work before a small verifier ranks candidates under test-time scaling.
one_line_summary.zh: T1 先用工具完成记忆负担重的核验，再由小型验证器进行最终判别，从而提高有限测试时计算下的候选选择效率。

title: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces

one_line_summary.en: Terminal-Bench evaluates agents on hard realistic command-line tasks with execution feedback.
one_line_summary.zh: Terminal-Bench 用真实困难命令行任务和执行反馈评测智能体。

title: TerminalWorld: Benchmarking Agents on Real-World Terminal Tasks

one_line_summary.en: TerminalWorld converts public terminal recordings into 1,530 Docker-backed CLI tasks with reference solutions and state-based tests, including a manually reviewed 200-task evaluation subset.
one_line_summary.zh: TerminalWorld 将公开终端录制转换为 1,530 个带 Docker 环境、参考解答与状态测试的 CLI 任务，并提供人工复核的 200-task 评测子集；该发布仅适合评测，且版本、谱系与许可证边界仍未解决。

title: Test-Time Scaling for Multistep Reasoning in Small Language Models via A* Search

one_line_summary.en: TTA* uses a training-free A*-style search over partial solutions so a small model can spend test-time compute on the most promising self-refined branches.
one_line_summary.zh: TTA* 以 A* 风格优先级搜索部分解答，让小语言模型在测试时把计算投入最有希望的自我修订分支。

title: Test-Time Scaling Makes Overtraining Compute-Optimal

one_line_summary.en: Train-to-Test scaling laws jointly optimize parameter count, training tokens, and inference samples under an end-to-end budget.
one_line_summary.zh: Train-to-Test 标度律在端到端预算下联合优化参数规模、训练 token 和推理采样数。

title: Test-Time Scaling of Reasoning Models for Machine Translation

one_line_summary.en: This study shows that test-time reasoning helps translation mainly with task-specialized models and post-editing, not by indiscriminately lengthening thought.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究表明，测试时推理在翻译中主要通过任务专化模型与后编辑发挥作用，而非无差别延长思考。

title: Test-Time Scaling with Reflective Generative Model

one_line_summary.en: RGM shares a policy backbone with a self-supervised process scorer to select trajectories under controllable test-time reasoning length.
one_line_summary.zh: RGM 让策略模型与自监督过程评分器共享主干，在可控思考长度下选择高质量推理轨迹。

title: Test-time Verification via Optimal Transport: Coverage, ROC, & Sub-optimality

one_line_summary.en: This work models verifier-guided test-time scaling as optimal transport, exposing coverage, verifier, and sampling trade-offs.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作将验证器引导的推理时扩展建模为最优传输，揭示覆盖率、验证器与采样之间的取舍。

title: The Impact of Post-training on Data Contamination

one_line_summary.en: Controlled clean-versus-contaminated models show that SFT and GRPO can resurface leakage after extended pre-training.
one_line_summary.zh: 受控配对实验表明，SFT 与 GRPO 会重新暴露预训练污染，且外部迁移边界不同。

title: The Limits of Inference Scaling Through Resampling

one_line_summary.en: Audits verifier-gated code resampling with weak and extended unit tests, showing that more attempts can preserve false positives and make a finite or zero budget optimal.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究用原始单元测试作为弱验收器、用 EvalPlus 扩展测试进行追溯审计，表明增加重采样次数仍会保留错误代码，并可能使有限预算乃至零预算最优。

title: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence

one_line_summary.en: MiniMax-M2 reports executable-workspace trajectories and artifact-aligned rewards under Forge agent RL, but not the task corpus, validator implementation, or replayable trajectory ledger.
one_line_summary.zh: MiniMax-M2 报告了由可执行工作区、工件对齐奖励和 Forge 驱动的长程智能体 RL，但未公开任务、环境、奖励实现或轨迹台账。

title: The Periodic Table of LLM Reasoning: A Structured Survey of Reasoning Paradigms, Methods, and Failure Modes

one_line_summary.en: A 2026 reasoning survey that maps paradigms, method families, benchmarks, and failure modes before readers enter data-specific tracks.
one_line_summary.zh: 一篇把推理范式、方法趋势、评测与失效模式放入同一张表的 2026 综述。

title: The Signal is in the Steps: Local Scoring for Reasoning Data Selection

one_line_summary.en: The method turns step-local student likelihood into an offline selector for mixed-teacher reasoning traces, improving reported SFT results while releasing neither the selected corpus nor a currently usable implementation.
one_line_summary.zh: LALP 在 817 个 LIMO prompt 上用 GLM-4.5-Air 切分候选完整 response，再按目标 student 的局部 step likelihood 排序并保留每题一条完整轨迹；它是 student-specific 的离线数据选择器，不是 step correctness/process supervision，且当前匿名仓库没有可用实现或数据。

title: Think Hard Only When Needed: A Hybrid Best-of-N and Beam Search for Efficient Test-Time Compute

one_line_summary.en: THROW uses early PRM scores to spend less search on easy prompts and selectively expand promising branches for hard ones.
one_line_summary.zh: THROW 利用早期过程奖励模型分数，让简单提示少花搜索预算，并为困难提示选择性扩展有前景的分支。

title: ThinkBooster: A Unified Framework for Seamless Test-Time Scaling of LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: ThinkBooster is an MIT-licensed toolkit and ACL 2026 demo that generates and inspects prompt, candidate, step-score, selection, token, TFLOP, latency, and config traces for nine test-time reasoning strategies, but does not release the historical paper-run trace corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: ThinkBooster 是一个采用 MIT 许可证的测试时推理工具包，为九种策略统一记录候选轨迹、步骤分数、选择、token、理论 TFLOPs、延迟与配置；公开发布只有两个 Claude Sonnet 4 调试器示例，而没有论文运行的逐样本轨迹语料。

title: Thinking Long, but Short: Stable Sequential Test-Time Scaling for Large Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: Min-Seek stabilizes sequential test-time scaling by retaining only short reconstruction thoughts in a custom KV cache.
one_line_summary.zh: Min-Seek 通过在定制 KV 缓存中仅保留短重构思考，稳定串行测试时扩展。

title: Thinking on the Fly: Test-Time Reasoning Enhancement via Latent Thought Policy Optimization

one_line_summary.en: Thinking on the Fly: Test-Time Reasoning Enhancement via Latent Thought Policy Optimization
one_line_summary.zh: 潜在推理避免冗长文本链，却可能在最需要稳健测试时推理的困难或分布外问题上崩溃。

title: Thinking-Free Policy Initialization Makes Distilled Reasoning Models More Effective and Efficient Reasoners

one_line_summary.en: An RLVR initialization recipe aimed at reducing explicit reasoning cost while retaining answer-level reward training.
one_line_summary.zh: TFPI 以空的 closed-think 前缀初始化策略，在 Polaris-53K 上使用 8 个 RLVR rollout 训练较少显式思考但保持性能的模型。

title: Time to Impeach LLM-as-a-Judge: Programs are the Future of Evaluation
venue: ICML 2025 Workshop on Programmatic Representations for Agent Learning

one_line_summary.en: Contrasts program-based judges with LLM judges for bias and consistency failures; status is submission.
one_line_summary.zh: PAJAMA 将 LLM 的判决逻辑合成为可执行程序，以降低成本并改善偏差与一致性。

title: Timely Machine: Awareness of Time Makes Test-Time Scaling Agentic

one_line_summary.en: Timely Machine makes wall-clock time, rather than token length, the test-time budget for tool agents and trains policies to adapt their interaction strategy to latency.
one_line_summary.zh: Timely Machine 将工具智能体的测试时预算定义为墙钟时间而非词元长度，并训练策略依据延迟调整交互方式。

title: TMAS: Scaling Test-Time Compute via Multi-Agent Synergy

one_line_summary.en: TMAS coordinates parallel solution, verification, summarization, and two memory banks so later test-time iterations can reuse reliable progress without repeating strategies.
one_line_summary.zh: TMAS 让解答、验证、摘要与双层记忆智能体在多轮推理中协同，从而复用可靠进展并避免重复探索。

title: Token-level Data Selection for Safe LLM Fine-tuning

one_line_summary.en: TOSS masks unsafe response tokens before SFT using a loss-difference signal from safety and utility reference models.
one_line_summary.zh: TOSS 依据安全与效用参考模型的损失差，在 SFT 前掩掉不安全回复词元。

title: Too Good to be Bad: On the Failure of LLMs to Role-Play Villains

one_line_summary.en: Moral RolePlay evaluates whether safety-aligned LLMs can preserve a fictional persona across a four-level moral spectrum.
one_line_summary.zh: Moral RolePlay 以四级道德谱系和角色特质标签，测量安全对齐模型能否忠实扮演虚构反派。

title: ToolRM: Towards Agentic Tool-Use Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: ToolRM builds verifiable pairwise preferences from tool-use trajectories and trains generative and discriminative reward models for agentic optimization.
one_line_summary.zh: ToolRM 从工具使用轨迹构造可验证的成对偏好，并训练生成式和判别式奖励模型服务智能体优化。

title: Towards a Mechanistic Understanding of Large Reasoning Models: A Survey of Training, Inference, and Failures

one_line_summary.en: An ACL survey of what evidence explains how large reasoning models learn, reason, and fail.
one_line_summary.zh: 从训练、推理过程与失效行为三条线理解大推理模型的 ACL 综述。

title: Towards Hierarchical Multi-Step Reward Models for Enhanced Reasoning in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: HRM scores individual and consecutive reasoning steps and augments process-supervision data through hierarchical node compression.
one_line_summary.zh: HRM 同时判断单个步骤和连续步骤，并以节点压缩扩充过程监督数据来训练更稳健的奖励模型。

title: Towards Inference-time Scaling for Continuous Space Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: This paper shows that latent reasoning has unused Pass@N potential but weak reward-model separability, then tests geometric regularization to improve its test-time scaling.
one_line_summary.zh: 本文显示隐空间推理虽有尚未利用的通过率上界，却因奖励模型可分性弱而难以扩展，并以几何正则化测试改进测试时扩展的可能。

title: Towards Understanding Valuable Preference Data for Large Language Model Alignment

one_line_summary.en: LossDiff-IRM selects preference pairs by approximating their model-specific validation influence.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法用近似验证集影响的 LossDiff-IRM 选择对当前模型真正有益的偏好对。

title: Tracing the Roots: A Multi-Agent Framework for Uncovering Data Lineage in Post-Training LLMs

one_line_summary.en: Reconstructs a 430-node, 971-edge post-training dataset lineage graph and uses 31 upstream QA sources plus exact/MinHash deduplication to report a 570K diversity-oriented corpus that is not included in the verified release.
one_line_summary.zh: 重建含 430 个节点、971 条边的后训练数据集谱系图，并从 31 个上游问答源经精确匹配与 MinHash 去重报告 57 万条多样性导向语料；经核验的官方发布并不包含该语料。

title: Tree Search for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: Tree-GRPO builds shared-prefix forests of complete ReAct agent steps during online RL, scores terminal leaves with EM/F1 and format rules, and derives intra-/inter-tree process signals, but it releases code rather than the raw trees, discarded branches, or reward lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Tree-GRPO 在在线 RL 中构造共享前缀的 ReAct agent-step 树，以 EM/F1 与格式规则给终点叶子评分并形成树内/树间相对优势；官方发布提供实现代码，但未发布原始树、舍弃分支或逐记录奖励谱系。

title: TreePO: Enhancing Policy Efficacy and Inference Efficiency with Tree Modeling

one_line_summary.en: TreePO replaces independent math rollouts with shared-prefix segment trees and trains on terminal answer rewards through hierarchical subgroup advantages, releasing code, prompts, and checkpoints but not complete paper-run trees.
one_line_summary.zh: TreePO以共享前缀分段树替代独立数学rollout，并用终局答案奖励构造层级子组优势；官方发布了代码、提示与检查点，但没有发布可重建论文训练过程的完整树记录。

title: TrimR: Verifier-based Training-Free Thinking Trimming for Efficient Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: TrimR uses a lightweight verifier to trim redundant reasoning online and preserve computation for unresolved traces.
one_line_summary.zh: TrimR 用轻量验证器在线识别冗余推理，并把计算保留给尚未解决的推理轨迹。

title: TrustJudge: Inconsistencies of LLM-as-a-Judge and How to Alleviate Them

one_line_summary.en: Accepted study of judge inconsistency with public conference materials.
one_line_summary.zh: 审计 LLM judge 的打分—比较冲突与成对传递性失效，并以概率推理降低不一致。

title: Truth or Mirage? Towards End-To-End Factuality Evaluation with LLM-Oasis

one_line_summary.en: LLM-Oasis is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
one_line_summary.zh: 从维基事实构造真伪长文本对，再以人工验证和金标准测试集标注端到端事实性，关注生成文本整体而非孤立 claim 分类。

title: TUA-Bench: A Benchmark for General-Purpose Terminal-Use Agents

one_line_summary.en: TUA-Bench benchmarks general-purpose terminal-use agents with executable tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: TUA-Bench 用可执行任务评测通用终端使用智能体。

title: TUMIX: Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling with Tool-Use Mixture

one_line_summary.en: TUMIX: Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling with Tool-Use Mixture
one_line_summary.zh: 没有一种工具使用策略适合每个问题，但代理常在测试时承诺单一路径的推理、编程或搜索。

title: Uncertainty-Based Methods for Automated Process Reward Data Construction and Output Aggregation in Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: UnPRM uses uncertainty-guided sampling and automated step annotation to build mathematical process-reward data, then combines reward scores and answer frequencies for output aggregation.
one_line_summary.zh: UnPRM 发布约 4 万条数学过程样本，以不确定性筛选和自动验证赋予步骤正确性标签，直接服务 PRM 训练与答案聚合。

title: Understanding the Role of Training Data in Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: Understanding the Role of Training Data in Test-Time Scaling
one_line_summary.zh: 更多思考无法修复训练数据从未提供的下游技能。

title: Unified Data Selection for LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Unified Data Selection ranks reasoning trajectories by entropy concentrated at their highest-uncertainty tokens and applies the score to SFT, correctness-filtered RFT and online GRPO rollout selection.
one_line_summary.zh: Unified Data Selection以回答内最高熵0.5%词元的熵和排序轨迹，并将其用于SFT、正确性过滤RFT和在线GRPO选择。

title: UniRRM: Unified Reasoning Reward Models Across Languages and Evaluation Paradigms

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: UniRRM 以多语种混合奖励数据训练一个能处理成对、列表和单点评审的推理型奖励模型。

title: UniSRM: A Unified Speech Reward Model for Reasoning-Based Fine-grained Assessment

one_line_summary.en: A speech reward-model dataset and benchmark for multi-dimensional, reasoning-based assessment.
one_line_summary.zh: 以统一数据、逐维理由和一致性奖励，把语音质量判断从黑盒标量扩展为可审计的多任务奖励模型。

title: V-Droid: Advancing Mobile GUI Agent Through Generative Verifiers

one_line_summary.en: V-Droid trains a Llama-3.1-8B action verifier on 110K human-agent-annotated P3 preference pairs derived from Android trajectories, using entropy to target corrections and a small reverse-action subset for self-correction; the full corpus, replay state, licenses, and exact experiment-to-artifact mapping remain unavailable.
one_line_summary.zh: V-Droid 将 Android 轨迹扩展为 110K 组逐步 P3 动作偏好并训练标量验证器，但完整语料、可回放环境及实验—发布版本映射均未公开。

title: Variation in Verification: Understanding Verification Dynamics in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A released 15-generator by 15-verifier trace matrix for auditing how reference-free generative verification changes with task difficulty and model capability.
one_line_summary.zh: Variation in Verification 系统审计生成式验证器在任务难度、生成器和验证器能力变化下的选择行为。

title: VeriContest: A Competitive-Programming Benchmark for Verifiable Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: VeriContest pairs 946 programming problems with Rust code, Verus specifications and proofs, and positive/negative tests to evaluate end-to-end verifiable code generation.
one_line_summary.zh: VeriContest 为 946 道竞赛编程题配套 Rust 代码、Verus 规格与证明以及正负测试，用于评测端到端可验证代码生成。

title: Verifiable Rewards Beyond Math and Code: Lightweight Corpus-Grounded Process Supervision for Factual Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: CorVer supplies corpus-grounded sentence-level rewards and 62.5K factual-QA training records without relying on a neural verifier in the reward loop.
one_line_summary.zh: CorVer 提供基于语料库的句子级奖励及 6.25 万条事实问答训练记录，无需在奖励环中调用神经验证器。

title: Verifying Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Its Computational Graph

one_line_summary.en: CRV treats a reasoning step's attribution graph as an execution trace, using its structural features to identify and causally repair chain-of-thought errors.
one_line_summary.zh: CRV 把推理步骤的归因图视为计算执行轨迹，从图结构中识别并干预导致 CoT 错误的因果特征。

title: VERINA: Benchmarking Verifiable Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** 189 Lean tasks provide code, specifications, proofs, and tests for modular and end-to-end vericoding.
one_line_summary.zh: 189 个 Lean 任务同时提供代码、规格、证明和测试，支持模块化与端到端 vericoding。

title: Video-Based Reward Modeling for Computer-Use Agents

one_line_summary.en: ExeVR-53k provides 53K instruction–execution-video–reward triplets and adversarial step annotations for judging computer-use trajectories from observable video.
one_line_summary.zh: ExeVR-53k 提供 5.3 万个指令—执行视频—奖励三元组及对抗式步骤标注，用可观测视频评判计算机使用轨迹。

title: Video-MMMU: Evaluating Knowledge Acquisition from Multidisciplinary Professional Videos

one_line_summary.en: Video-MMMU exposes expert videos with perception, comprehension, and adaptation QA as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: Video-MMMU 把专家视频上的感知、理解与迁移应用问答做成可审计的评测面。

title: VisReason: A Large-Scale Dataset for Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: VisReason supplies large-scale region-grounded visual CoT traces that teach a global-to-local routine: inspect, localize, zoom, and verify before answering.
one_line_summary.zh: VisReason 提供大规模区域定位的视觉 CoT 轨迹，训练模型按“全局观察、定位、放大、核验”的流程作答。

title: Visual-ERM: Reward Modeling for Visual Equivalence

one_line_summary.en: Visual-ERM releases VC-RewardBench and a generative reward model that judges fine-grained visual equivalence between target and rendered code outputs.
one_line_summary.zh: VC-RewardBench 含 1,335 个图表、表格与 SVG 视觉等价性实例，以位置、类型、严重度反馈支持视觉代码推理奖励。

title: VISUALPRM400K: An Effective Dataset for Multimodal Process Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: VISUALPRM400K: An Effective Dataset for Multimodal Process Reward Modeling exposes process or trace supervision data.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布约 40 万条 VisualPRM400K 多模态过程监督数据，并基于它训练 VisualPRM、构建 VisualProcessBench 评测步骤纠错。

title: VRPO: Rethinking Value Modeling for Robust RL under Noisy Supervision in LLM Post-Training

one_line_summary.en: VRPO makes the value model a noise-regulating part of RL training so uncertain rewards produce more reliable advantage signals.
one_line_summary.zh: VRPO 把价值模型变为强化学习中的噪声调节器，使不确定奖励产生更可靠的优势信号。

title: VRPRM: Process Reward Modeling via Visual Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: VRPRM uses a small set of teacher-written visual CoT reviews to initialize process reasoning, then scales with ordinary step labels through RL for efficient multimodal reward modeling.
one_line_summary.zh: VRPRM 先以少量教师生成的视觉 CoT 评审激活过程推理，再用普通步骤标签强化学习，以较低数据成本训练多模态 PRM。

title: WebArbiter: A Principle-Guided Reasoning Process Reward Model for Web Agents

one_line_summary.en: WebArbiter turns web-agent state and competing actions into principle-guided process judgements for preference learning and reward-guided search.
one_line_summary.zh: WebArbiter 把网页状态与竞争行动转为由原则引导的过程判断，用于偏好学习和奖励引导的搜索。

title: WebChain: A Large-Scale Human-Annotated Dataset of Real-World Web Interaction Traces

one_line_summary.en: Releases 31,725 human-verified live-web trajectories with 317,993 visually, structurally, and action-aligned steps, plus separate grounding and planning recipes, under a gated academic license.
one_line_summary.zh: WebChain 发布 31,725 条人工核验的真实网页轨迹，包含 317,993 个视觉、结构与动作对齐的步骤，并以 gated 学术许可提供 grounding 与长程规划训练材料。

title: WebDevJudge: Evaluating (M)LLMs as Critiques for Web Development Quality

one_line_summary.en: An ICLR 2026 oral benchmark for evaluating model critiques of web-development quality.
one_line_summary.zh: 以部署网页、rubric tree 与专家偏好审计网页开发 judge 的基准。

title: WebForge: Breaking the Realism-Reproducibility-Scalability Trilemma in Browser Agent Benchmark

one_line_summary.en: WebForge generates self-contained browser environments and WebForge-Bench tasks to evaluate browser agents without relying on drifting live websites.
one_line_summary.zh: WebForge 生成自包含浏览器环境和 WebForge-Bench 任务，用来在不依赖易漂移真实网站的情况下评测浏览器智能体。

title: WebSeer: Training Deeper Search Agents through Reinforcement Learning with Self-Reflection

one_line_summary.en: WebSeer constructs verified self-reflective SFT trajectories and trains a web-search agent with multi-submission RL feedback, while releasing code, two datasets, and a 14B checkpoint with incomplete evaluation tooling.
one_line_summary.zh: WebSeer 结合反思式拒绝采样与在线强化学习训练深度搜索代理，并链接数据、代码和模型。

title: WebSTAR: Scalable Data Synthesis for Computer Use Agents with Step-Level Filtering

one_line_summary.en: WebSTAR releases scalable synthetic computer-use trajectories together with WebSCORE step-level quality feedback for training web agents.
one_line_summary.zh: 以网页交互轨迹合成与逐步过滤构建 WebSTAR 和 WebSCORE，为计算机使用智能体提供带细粒度质量信号的大规模训练数据。

title: WebWorld: A Large-Scale World Model for Web Agent Training

one_line_summary.en: WebWorld trains large web world models for web-agent simulation, synthetic trajectory generation, and search.
one_line_summary.zh: WebWorld 训练网页世界模型，用于网页智能体仿真、合成轨迹生成和搜索。

title: What Makes Good Instruction-Tuning Data? An In-Context Learning Perspective

one_line_summary.en: wICI ranks instruction data by how much a candidate demonstration reduces difficulty for semantically related peers.
one_line_summary.zh: wICI 按候选示例降低语义相近样本难度的程度为指令数据排序。

title: When Benchmarks Leak: Inference-Time Decontamination for LLMs

one_line_summary.en: DeconIEP suppresses memorization-driven behavior at evaluation time with bounded embedding perturbations.
one_line_summary.zh: 以参考模型引导的有界嵌入扰动，在不改题目或参数的前提下抑制污染捷径。

title: When More Thinking Hurts: Overthinking in LLM Test-Time Compute Scaling

one_line_summary.en: This study shows that longer reasoning can reverse correct answers and proposes marginal-utility and flip-event analysis for selecting test-time budgets.
one_line_summary.zh: 这项研究显示，更长的推理会把原本正确的答案改错，并用边际效用和答案翻转分析来选择测试时预算。

title: Where Do Deep-Research Agents Go Wrong? Span-Level Error Localization in Agent Trajectories

one_line_summary.en: TELBench labels harmful spans in deep-research trajectories, while DRIFT traces unsupported claims to localize where an agent first goes wrong.
one_line_summary.zh: TELBench 标注深度研究代理轨迹中的有害错误片段，DRIFT 通过追踪无证据主张定位代理最早出错的位置。

title: Which Reasoning Trajectories Teach Students to Reason Better? A Simple Metric of Informative Alignment

one_line_summary.en: RSR scores each teacher trajectory under the target student and selects one of 33 candidates per math problem by balancing clipped token rank against surprisal.
one_line_summary.zh: RSR 在目标学生模型下权衡 token rank 与 surprisal，从每题 33 条教师轨迹中选择一条；它衡量适配性而非正确性。

title: Who Judges the Judge? Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge for French Medical open-ended QA

one_line_summary.en: Evaluates generator-aware, domain-specific judge reliability for medical open-ended QA.
one_line_summary.zh: 在法语开放式医疗问答中，LLM 评判会随答案生成器而偏移；小模型经 SFT 与 GRPO 对齐可改善但不能替代专家。

title: Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?

one_line_summary.en: Who&When Pro reports 12,326 controlled failed trajectories across 3 modalities and 26 benchmarks with responsible-agent, decisive-step, and error-mode labels, while the official data and evaluation code remain unavailable.
one_line_summary.zh: Who&When Pro 报告 12,326 条跨 3 种模态与 26 个基准的受控失败轨迹，并提供责任智能体、决定性步骤和错误模式标签，但官方数据与评测代码尚未公开。

title: WildReward: Learning Reward Models from In-the-Wild Human Interactions

one_line_summary.en: The paper provides preference or reward feedback data for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: WildReward 从真实人类交互中学习奖励模型，提供面向开放场景的偏好反馈数据。

title: WorkForceAgent-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLM-based Web Agents via Reinforcement Learning
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2026

one_line_summary.en: WorkForceAgent-R1 turns filtered WorkArena oracle trajectories into single-step action-verification problems for SFT and GRPO, but releases code without the trajectory corpus, rejection ledger, or trained checkpoints.
one_line_summary.zh: WorkForceAgent-R1 将筛选后的 WorkArena oracle 轨迹拆成单步动作验证样本，用规则奖励进行 SFT 与 GRPO，但未公开轨迹语料、淘汰记录或训练后模型。

title: Writing-RL: Advancing Long-form Writing via Adaptive Curriculum Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: Writing-RL selects long-form writing instructions by policy-to-reference quality margin and promotes the reference after each policy win.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作按策略与参考写作质量差选择长文指令，并在策略获胜后逐步提升参考答案难度。

title: You Only Judge Once: Multi-response Reward Modeling in a Single Forward Pass

one_line_summary.en: MR²Bench turns multimodal response evaluation into an N-way human-ranking task and supports a reward model that scores all candidates jointly in one forward pass.
one_line_summary.zh: MR²Bench 含图像多响应排序与视频问答约 9.4 万众包偏好判断，可直接训练一次前向完成 N 路比较的奖励模型。

title: ZEBRAARENA: A Diagnostic Simulation Environment for Studying Reasoning-Action Coupling in Tool-Augmented LLMs

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** A procedurally generated Zebra tool environment with unique solutions and optimal query counts for reasoning–action coupling.
one_line_summary.zh: 程序生成的 Zebra 工具环境，用唯一解和最优查询数测推理—行动耦合。

title: Zero-to-CAD: Agentic Synthesis of Interpretable CAD Programs at Million-Scale Without Real Data

one_line_summary.en: Zero-to-CAD uses tool-using agents to synthesize, execute, repair, and validate nearly one million CadQuery construction programs without real trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: Zero-to-CAD 用工具代理生成、执行、修复并验证近百万条可编辑的 CAD 构造程序。

title: Zipping the Thought: When and How Compressed Reasoning Data Works in LLM Post-Training

one_line_summary.en: Zipping the Thought varies CoT compression in controlled synthetic data to show how data diversity, repetition, and RLVR affect step decomposition and length generalization.
one_line_summary.zh: Zipping the Thought 在受控合成数据中改变 CoT 压缩粒度，分析数据多样性、重复训练与 RLVR 如何影响步骤拆解和长度泛化。

title: ∇-Reasoner: LLM Reasoning via Test-Time Gradient Descent in Textual Space

one_line_summary.en: ∇-Reasoner: LLM Reasoning via Test-Time Gradient Descent in Textual Space
one_line_summary.zh: 离散搜索和试错提示可能花费许多测试时调用，却只能间接改善推理策略。

title: $\tau^2$-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment

one_line_summary.en: tau2-bench releases a dual-control telecom environment with 114 sampled tasks from 2,285 generated compositions, state/action-grounded rewards, and full success/failure evaluation trajectories, but exact reuse requires a paper-era version pin.
one_line_summary.zh: tau2-bench 发布双控制客服环境，从 2,285 个 telecom 完整组合中抽取 114 个评测任务，并保留状态/动作反馈及成功与失败轨迹；准确复用必须固定论文时代的 v0.1.0。

title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large Language Model Training
domains: Chinese and English mathematics, code, science, and general reasoning

one_line_summary.en: AM-Distilled unifies 1.4 million R1 responses and routes math, code, and other tasks through answer checks, execution, or reward-model review.
one_line_summary.zh: AM-Distilled 把 140 万条中英双语 R1 推理按数学答案、代码测试或奖励模型分别验证。

title: 3DS: Medical Domain Adaptation of LLMs via Decomposed Difficulty-based Data Selection

one_line_summary.en: 3DS filters domain SFT records by target-model quality, decomposed moderate difficulty, and diversity.
one_line_summary.zh: 3DS 按目标模型质量、分解后的适度难度和多样性过滤领域监督微调记录。

title: A benchmark for vericoding: formally verified program synthesis

one_line_summary.en: Vericoding aggregates 12,504 Dafny, Verus, and Lean specifications whose generated code and proofs can be replayed against formal verifiers.
one_line_summary.zh: Vericoding 汇集 12,504 个 Dafny、Verus 与 Lean 规格任务，并可用相应形式验证器复跑生成的代码与证明。

title: A Comprehensive Survey of Reward Models: Taxonomy, Applications, Challenges, and Future

one_line_summary.en: A 2025 reward-model map that separates feedback collection, reward fitting, and downstream use.
one_line_summary.zh: 梳理反馈收集、奖励建模、奖励使用与评测边界的 2025 年奖励模型综述。

title: A Comprehensive Survey on Learning from Rewards for Large Language Models: Reward Models and Learning Strategies

one_line_summary.en: A 2025 EMNLP Findings survey that maps reward signals from feedback collection through training, inference, and post-inference correction.
one_line_summary.zh: 一篇把奖励信号从反馈收集延伸到训练、推理与后处理的 2025 EMNLP Findings 综述。

title: A Lean Dataset for International Math Olympiad: Small Steps towards Writing Math Proofs for Hard Problems

one_line_summary.en: IMO-Steps decomposes International Mathematical Olympiad Lean proofs into 1,329 checkable intermediate lemmas and complete proofs.
one_line_summary.zh: IMO-Steps 将国际奥赛题的 Lean 证明拆分为可单独验证的引理与完整证明，便于诊断证明器的局部失败。

title: A Sober Look at Progress in Language Model Reasoning: Pitfalls and Paths to Reproducibility

one_line_summary.en: Audits reasoning-model progress claims by showing that benchmark results can be highly sensitive to decoding, seeds, prompt format, and environment details.
one_line_summary.zh: 指出解码、随机种子、提示格式和运行环境都可能改变推理结论，是复现与比较模型进展的基础审计读物。

title: A Survey of Frontiers in LLM Reasoning: Inference Scaling, Learning to Reason, and Agentic Systems

one_line_summary.en: A TMLR survey that maps reasoning by when it is achieved and which system components perform it.
one_line_summary.zh: 按实现阶段和系统架构组织大模型推理前沿的 TMLR 2025 综述。

title: A Survey of Mathematical Reasoning in the Era of Multimodal Large Language Model: Benchmark, Method & Challenges

one_line_summary.en: A Findings ACL 2025 survey of multimodal mathematical reasoning benchmarks, methods, and challenges.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统整理多模态大模型数学推理的基准、方法与挑战。

title: A Survey of Multilingual Reasoning in Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A Findings EMNLP 2025 survey of multilingual reasoning methods, training resources, and evaluation benchmarks.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理语言模型跨语言推理的方法、数据资源与评测基准。

title: A Survey of RAG-Reasoning Systems in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A 2025 EMNLP Findings survey that maps how retrieval and multi-step reasoning can strengthen each other.
one_line_summary.zh: 用统一框架梳理检索增强生成与多步推理如何相互促进。

title: A Survey of Reasoning with Foundation Models: Concepts, Methodologies, and Outlook

one_line_summary.en: A 2025 survey that connects reasoning tasks to the models, data, methods, and benchmarks used to study them.
one_line_summary.zh: 把推理任务、模型、方法与基准放进同一张图的 2025 综述。

title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning for Large Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: A TsinghuaC3I survey of the reinforcement-learning machinery that turns language models into reasoning models.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统整理大推理模型强化学习、训练资源、奖励与应用的清华综述。

title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

one_line_summary.en: This survey separates RLHF into feedback acquisition, reward learning, and policy learning across control, robotics, and LLMs.
one_line_summary.zh: 这篇综述把跨控制、机器人和 LLM 的 RLHF 拆成反馈采集、奖励学习与策略学习三阶段。

title: A Survey on Efficient Large Language Model Training: From Data-centric Perspectives

one_line_summary.en: A 2025 ACL survey that treats data selection, quality, synthesis, compression, and self-evolution as distinct levers in efficient post-training.
one_line_summary.zh: 一篇把数据选择、质量增强、合成、蒸馏压缩和自进化分开讨论的 2025 ACL 后训练综述。

title: A Survey on Evaluation of LLM-based Agents

one_line_summary.en: Surveys LLM-agent evaluation across core capabilities, application domains, benchmark dimensions, and development-time evaluation frameworks.
one_line_summary.zh: 从能力、应用、基准维度与开发框架四个层面梳理 LLM 智能体评测。

title: A Survey on Post-training of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A 2025 map of post-training that connects data, feedback, reasoning, and system stages before readers enter specialized tracks.
one_line_summary.zh: 一篇把后训练中的数据、反馈、推理与系统阶段连成概念地图的 2025 综述。

title: A Systematic Analysis of Base Model Choice for Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: Accepted analysis of base-model choices as a reward-model reliability variable.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统证明 RM 基座选择与训练阶段会显著改变 RewardBench 表现，并给出低维筛选线索。

title: A Systematic Examination of Preference Learning through the Lens of Instruction-Following

one_line_summary.en: A 47,198-prompt synthetic constraint suite is used to compare independent RS pairs with shared-prefix MCTS pairs and isolate the effects of pair contrast and prompt difficulty on DPO.
one_line_summary.zh: 论文以47,198个合成约束提示为控制平台，对比独立拒绝采样与共享前缀MCTS偏好对，分析对比度和提示难度对DPO的影响。

title: A Theoretical Study on Bridging Internal Probability and Self-Consistency for LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: RPC combines internal probability with self-consistency and prunes low-probability paths to reduce sampling cost in reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: RPC 将内部概率与自一致性结合，并裁剪低概率路径以降低推理采样成本。

title: A*-Thought: Efficient Reasoning via Bidirectional Compression for Low-Resource Settings

one_line_summary.en: A*-Thought compresses s1K-1.1 long-CoT traces with BIS-guided A* search and s1.1-32B validation, releasing a one-thousand-record SFT dataset and model checkpoints.
one_line_summary.zh: A*-Thought 使用 BIS 引导的 A* 搜索与 s1.1-32B 验证，将 s1K-1.1 长链推理压缩为一千条 SFT 轨迹。

title: Absolute Zero: Reinforced Self-play Reasoning with Zero Data

one_line_summary.en: Absolute Zero turns a growing buffer of self-proposed Python triplets into an online RLVR curriculum, rewarding proposer learnability from eight solver attempts and solver correctness by execution, while releasing the recipe and seeds but not the complete paper-run trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: Absolute Zero 让同一 policy 在线提出并求解 Python deduction、abduction 与 induction 任务，以执行结果和八次 solver 尝试构造 RLVR reward；其“zero data”仅指 RL 阶段无外部人工或蒸馏任务答案数据，完整 rollout 并未发布。

title: AbstentionBench

one_line_summary.en: AbstentionBench evaluates whether LLMs know when not to answer across unknown, underspecified, false-premise, subjective, and stale-information questions.
one_line_summary.zh: 检验模型面对未知、歧义和过时问题时能否正确拒答，把“知道何时不答”纳入推理可靠性审计。

title: Accelerating Large Language Model Reasoning via Speculative Search

one_line_summary.en: An ICML 2025 tree-search accelerator that accepts PRM-scored small-model thoughts above a history-based threshold and replaces rejected thoughts through lossless large-model speculative decoding.
one_line_summary.zh: 这项 ICML 2025 工作是一种树搜索加速器，接受过程奖励模型打分高于历史阈值的小模型思路，并用无损的大模型推测解码替换被拒绝的思路。

title: AceMath: Advancing Frontier Math Reasoning with Post-Training and Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: AceMath releases 2.26M, 1.63M, and 1.66M-row SFT stages for general-to-math post-training with explicit synthesis and filtering controls.
one_line_summary.zh: AceMath 发布三阶段通用到数学监督微调数据，以统一教师解答、跨模型答案核对和数据筛选支撑后训练。

title: AceReason-Nemotron 1.1: Advancing Math and Code Reasoning through SFT and RL Synergy

one_line_summary.en: AceReason-Nemotron 1.1 releases a four-field, DeepSeek-R1-generated math/code SFT corpus and model weights while reporting staged, rule-verified on-policy GRPO; the consumed SFT subset, complete code-RL tasks/tests, and example-to-checkpoint lineage remain unavailable.
one_line_summary.zh: AceReason-Nemotron 1.1 发布四字段、由 DeepSeek-R1 生成的数学/代码 SFT 语料与模型权重，并报告分阶段、规则验证的严格 on-policy GRPO；但实际使用的 SFT 子集、完整代码 RL 任务/测试和样本到检查点谱系仍不可得。

title: AceReason-Nemotron: Advancing Math and Code Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** AceReason-Nemotron studies sequential cross-domain RL with about 49K rule-verifiable math prompts and executable code tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: AceReason-Nemotron 用约 49K 可规则验证数学题和执行式代码任务研究顺序跨域 RL。

title: Adaptive Batch-Wise Sample Scheduling for Direct Preference Optimization

one_line_summary.en: SamS dynamically schedules the preference pairs used by each DPO batch from learning feedback.
one_line_summary.zh: SamS 根据模型在每个批次中的学习反馈，动态安排 DPO 实际使用的偏好对。

title: Adaptive Inference-Time Scaling via Cyclic Diffusion Search

one_line_summary.en: ABCD uses cyclic diffusion search to adapt exploration depth and stopping time to the available inference budget.
one_line_summary.zh: ABCD 通过循环式双向扩散搜索，自适应决定探索深度和停止时间，从而按推理预算扩展计算。

title: Adaptive Preference Optimization with Uncertainty-aware Utility Anchor

one_line_summary.en: UAPO learns a prompt-conditioned utility anchor so paired and unpaired preference records can be used under an uncertainty-aware objective.
one_line_summary.zh: UAPO 学习与提示相关的效用锚点，使成对和未配对的偏好记录都能在不确定性感知目标下被使用。

title: AdaptiveStep: Automatically Dividing Reasoning Step through Model Confidence

one_line_summary.en: AdaptiveStep replaces hand-written step delimiters with model-confidence boundaries, producing process-reward supervision that targets actual decision points in math and code traces.
one_line_summary.zh: AdaptiveStep 用模型置信度确定推理步骤边界，替代人工规则切分，使数学和代码轨迹的过程奖励对准实际决策点。

title: AdaptThink: Reasoning Models Can Learn When to Think

one_line_summary.en: Answer-verified RL chooses a full math trace or an immediate answer.
one_line_summary.zh: AdaptThink 以答案正确性为终点信号，结合受约束优化与重要性采样，在完整思考和直接回答两种输出模式之间学习按题目难度分配推理。

title: Addendum to GPT-5 system card: GPT-5-Codex

one_line_summary.en: GPT-5-Codex discloses RL on real-world project building, feature and test work, debugging, refactoring, and code review plus synthetic malware and new prompt-injection safety data, but not the task records, preference or reward representation, trajectories, split, or reusable artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: GPT-5-Codex 披露了面向真实项目构建、功能与测试、调试、重构和代码审查的 RL，以及继承的恶意软件安全数据和新 prompt-injection 数据；其价值是区分训练目标、人工/测试评测与部署防护，但 reward 表示、trajectory、split 和可复用 artifact 均未公开。

title: Addendum to GPT-5.2 System Card: GPT-5.2-Codex

one_line_summary.en: The GPT-5.2-Codex addendum discloses RL rollouts where a user model makes conflicting edits and preserving them earns positive reinforcement, while separately documenting internal PR evaluations with human-written prompts/tests/hints and hidden unit tests but withholding the underlying training records and reward implementation.
one_line_summary.zh: GPT-5.2-Codex 补充系统卡披露了一项编码智能体 RL 干预：user model 在 rollout 中制造冲突编辑，模型保留用户修改可获得正向强化；但训练记录、奖励实现和逐项 lineage 均未公开。

title: Addendum to OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card: Codex

one_line_summary.en: OpenAI's Codex addendum reports RL on real-world coding tasks plus synthetic/perturbed safety environments for malware, false-completion, and prompt-injection risks, but does not release task manifests, trajectories, the main reward, or training artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenAI 的 Codex addendum 报告了现实编码任务上的 RL、合成安全管线和窄动作一致性目标，但未披露任务、奖励、来源和轨迹账本。

title: AdvancedIF: Rubric-Based Benchmarking and Reinforcement Learning for Advancing LLM Instruction Following

one_line_summary.en: AdvancedIF uses human-written rubrics to evaluate and train complex, multi-turn, and system-level instruction following.
