one_line_summary.zh: AdvancedIF 将专家 rubric 用于复杂、多轮和系统提示指令跟随的评测与强化学习。

title: Advancing LLM Reasoning Generalists with Preference Trees

one_line_summary.en: UltraInteract turns objectively checked reasoning actions and correction trajectories into public SFT demonstrations and companion preference pairs.
one_line_summary.zh: UltraInteract 把经过客观检查的推理动作与纠错轨迹转成公开的 SFT 示范，并同时发布偏好对。

title: Advancing Mathematical Reasoning in Language Models: The Impact of Problem-Solving Data, Data Synthesis Methods, and Training Stages

one_line_summary.en: Compares four math problem-synthesis operators and controlled CPT/SFT allocations, but releases MathGPT-8B rather than the source or synthetic corpora.
one_line_summary.zh: 比较 response diversification、query expansion、retrospective enhancement 与 tutorship amplification 四种数学数据变换，并系统对照相同问题求解数据在 CPT 与 SFT 阶段的作用。

title: Adversarial Training for Process Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: APRM trains a generator to create PRM-deceiving wrong steps and continuously feeds those hard negatives back into process reward modeling.
one_line_summary.zh: APRM 训练生成器制造能欺骗过程奖励模型的错误步骤，并持续把这些难负样本反馈给过程奖励模型训练。

title: AGENT GYM: Evaluating and Training Large Language Model-based Agents across Diverse Environments

one_line_summary.en: AgentTraj-L releases 14,485 reward-filtered ReAct demonstrations from 11 interactive environments for cross-environment agent SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentTraj-L 公开来自十一个交互环境的 14,485 条奖励过滤示范，用于跨环境代理监督微调。

title: Agent Lightning: Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: Microsoft's MIT framework converts user-run agent executions into state/action/reward transitions and trace spans for LightningRL, but its official release is framework code and examples—not a canonical corpus, reward ledger, environment bundle or benchmark data release.
one_line_summary.zh: Agent Lightning 是微软的 MIT 智能体优化框架，它将用户运行的智能体执行转换为 LightningRL 所需的状态/动作/奖励转移和 trace span；官方发布的是框架代码与示例，不是规范语料、奖励账本、环境包或基准数据发布。

title: Agent-as-a-Judge: Evaluate Agents with Agents

one_line_summary.en: An agent-based evaluator that turns task completion and evidence gathering into an auditable judgment procedure.
one_line_summary.zh: Agent-as-a-Judge 主动读取 workspace 证据，按分层 requirements 评测开发 agent，并以 DevAI 提供可复核的概念验证。

title: Agent-R1: Training Powerful LLM Agents with End-to-End Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: Agent-R1 discloses a tool-environment RL framework and a v1 Multi-hop QA reward contract across PPO/GRPO/REINFORCE++/RLOO, but no immutable v1 train split, environment/corpus snapshot, rollout/reward ledger or provenance-complete checkpoint package was verified.
one_line_summary.zh: Agent-R1 v1 披露了工具环境 RL 框架，以及覆盖 PPO/GRPO/REINFORCE++/RLOO 的多跳问答奖励契约；未核验到不可变 v1 训练切分、环境/语料快照、rollout/奖励账本或溯源完整的检查点包。

title: Agent-RewardBench: Towards a Unified Benchmark for Reward Modeling across Perception, Planning, and Safety in Real-World Multimodal Agents

one_line_summary.en: Agent-RewardBench evaluates whether multimodal reward models can choose better agent steps across perception, planning, and safety.
one_line_summary.zh: 约 1,140 条图文 Agent 样本，横跨感知、规划和安全，提供分场景的优劣行为比较与奖励评测。

title: Agent-RLVR: Training Software Engineering Agents via Guidance and Environment Rewards

one_line_summary.en: Agent-RLVR collects test-verified software-agent trajectories and teacher-guided reattempts, then reuses same-task positive/negative pairs for SFT, offline DPO, and a test-time patch reward model.
one_line_summary.zh: Agent-RLVR 收集经测试验证的软件智能体轨迹与教师引导的重试记录，再把同一任务的正负样本对复用于监督微调、离线 DPO 和推理时的补丁奖励模型。

title: AgentAuditor: Human-Level Safety and Security Evaluation for LLM Agents

one_line_summary.en: ASSEBench pairs agent trajectories with strict and lenient safety/security judgments, while AgentAuditor retrieves prior cases to strengthen automated auditing.
one_line_summary.zh: ASSEBench 为智能体安全与安全防护轨迹提供双标准专家判定，AgentAuditor 以检索式经验记忆增强自动审计。

title: AgentChangeBench: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for Goal-Shift Robustness in Conversational AI
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Multi-Turn Interactions in Large Language Models (MTI-LLM)

one_line_summary.en: AgentChangeBench evaluates 315 banking, airline, and retail goal-shift tasks through simulated tool-use episodes and mixed environment/LLM metrics, but its 2,835-sequence mapping and supplementary release remain insufficiently pinned for replay or training reuse.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentChangeBench 用 315 个银行、航空与零售 goal-shift 任务及混合环境/LLM 指标评测对话 agent，但 2,835 条 sequence 的映射和补充发布不足以支持 replay 或训练复用。

title: AgentGym: Evaluating and Training Large Language Model-based Agents across Diverse Environments

one_line_summary.en: AgentGym contributes a 14-environment agent platform with AgentEval, AgentTraj/AgentTraj-L, and AgentEvol as linked evaluation, trajectory, and training artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentGym 将 14 个交互环境、AgentEval 评测任务、AgentTraj/AgentTraj-L 轨迹和 AgentEvol 训练方法组织成一个可审计的 agent 平台。

title: Agentic Reward Modeling: Integrating Human Preferences with Verifiable Correctness Signals for Reliable Reward Systems

one_line_summary.en: A reward-agent framework that combines a preference reward model with factuality and instruction-following verifiers, and releases its implementation.
one_line_summary.zh: 以偏好奖励结合事实性与指令遵循验证器，构造可审计的复合奖励代理。

title: AGENTIF: Benchmarking Instruction Following of Large Language Models in Agentic Scenarios

one_line_summary.en: AGENTIF turns long agent instructions from real applications into atomic constraints with auditable verifiers.
one_line_summary.zh: 从真实 Agent 应用提取长指令与原子约束，逐项衡量模型能否完整遵循。

title: AgentRewardBench: Evaluating Automatic Evaluations of Web Agent Trajectories

one_line_summary.en: AgentRewardBench releases 1,302 web-agent episodes with expert success, side-effect, optimality, and repetition labels plus 15 automatic-evaluator outputs per episode, but it supports offline audit rather than licensed deterministic replay.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentRewardBench 发布 1,302 条网页智能体完整轨迹、专家标签与每条轨迹 15 组自动评估输出，用于审计 LLM judge 和环境规则，但不提供已获许可的确定性环境重放。

title: AgentRM: Enhancing Agent Generalization with Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: An 8B reward model with released code and data for testing whether reward-guided search generalizes across unseen agent tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: 用搜索状态价值训练通用过程奖励，以测试时搜索提升智能体跨任务表现。

title: AgentTrek: Agent Trajectory Synthesis via Guiding Replay with Web Tutorials

one_line_summary.en: AgentTrek mines and structures RedPajama tutorials, executes them through GPT-4o-guided BrowserGym replay on 127 sites, and filters trajectories with a GPT-4o evaluator for GUI-agent SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentTrek 将 RedPajama 教程经筛选、结构化、live-browser guided replay 与 GPT-4o judgment 转为 GUI-agent SFT 数据；论文主张 23,430 个教程产生 10,398 条成功 trajectory，但当前 HF 只发布 52,594 条无 trajectory 映射的 text turn，未提供完整 multimodal/native traces、失败数据、license 或环境 manifest。

title: AgentTTS: Large Language Model Agent for Test-time Compute-optimal Scaling Strategy in Complex Tasks

one_line_summary.en: AgentTTS uses an LLM agent and execution feedback to find compute-optimal model and sampling allocations across dependent stages of a complex task.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentTTS 通过语言模型智能体和执行反馈，在多阶段复杂任务中搜索模型选择与重复采样预算的计算最优分配。

title: AIMO-2 Winning Solution: Building State-of-the-Art Mathematical Reasoning Models with OpenMathReasoning dataset
venue: arXiv report of the AIMO-2 winning submission; retitled poster at the 2nd AI for Math Workshop @ ICML 2025

one_line_summary.en: OpenMathReasoning packages 5.68M rows across CoT, Python-interleaved TIR, GenSelect, and problem-only modes for answer-level mathematical-reasoning SFT and selection, but the official release corrects the paper's 540K problem figure to 306K unique solution-bearing problems.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenMathReasoning 发布 5,678,317 条 CoT、Python-TIR、GenSelect 与 problem-only 记录；官方数据卡把论文早期 540K 题目口径更正为 306K 个有 solution 的唯一题目，另含 193,170 条仅题目记录，且仍缺原始 AoPS 抓取与逐条 verifier lineage。

title: AInsteinBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Scientific Repositories

one_line_summary.en: AInsteinBench evaluates coding agents on executable scientific-repository tasks derived from maintainer pull requests and checked by task-specific tests.
one_line_summary.zh: AInsteinBench 从科学软件仓库维护者的 PR 构建可执行任务，并以任务测试检验智能体的代码修改。

title: Aligning Reasoning LLMs for Materials Discovery with Physics-aware Rejection Sampling
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on AI for Science: The Reach and Limits of AI for Scientific Discovery (poster)

one_line_summary.en: PaRS samples teacher QD-LED reasoning traces and keeps an early candidate only if range, wet-lab-error, and PLQY-envelope gates pass before distilling Qwen3-32B.
one_line_summary.zh: PaRS 为 QD-LED 配方采样教师推理轨迹，仅保留同时通过范围、湿实验误差和 PLQY 上包络门的早期候选，再蒸馏 Qwen3-32B；但轨迹与门控审计记录未发布。

title: Amazon Nova 2 Sonic - AWS AI Service Cards

one_line_summary.en: AWS's Nova 2 Sonic card discloses high-level multimodal sources, SFT/RL/RLHF, runtime filters, and evaluation layers but not records, rights, rewards, or reproducibility artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: AWS 的 Nova 2 Sonic 服务卡披露了高层多模态来源、SFT/RL/RLHF、运行时过滤与评测层，但没有公开记录、权利、奖励或可复现制品。

title: Ambiguity Awareness Optimization: Towards Semantic Disambiguation for Direct Preference Optimization

one_line_summary.en: AAO reweights tokens in DPO preference pairs using their semantic similarity across chosen and rejected responses, reducing ambiguous supervision and emphasizing discriminative content.
one_line_summary.zh: AAO 根据优选与劣选回答之间的语义相似度为 DPO 回答对中的词元赋权，压制含混监督并强调区分性内容。

title: AMEX: Android Multi-annotation Expo Dataset for Mobile GUI Agents

one_line_summary.en: AMEX provides Android GUI screenshots with multi-annotation labels and action chains.
one_line_summary.zh: AMEX 提供 Android GUI 截图、多层标注和动作链。

title: An Efficient and Precise Training Data Construction Framework for Process-supervised Reward Model in Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: An Efficient and Precise Training Data Construction Framework for Process-supervised Reward Model in Mathematical Reasoning exposes process or trace supervision data.
one_line_summary.zh: 提出 EpicPRM 数据构建框架，并公开 Epic50K：通过贡献度标注和自适应二分首错定位生成 5 万条高质量过程监督样本。

title: An Empirical Study of LLM-as-a-Judge for LLM Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: Audits whether fine-tuned LLM judges generalize beyond their training evaluation format, and finds they often behave as task-specific classifiers.
one_line_summary.zh: 审计微调判别模型能否跨越原训练评测格式；结果显示其常退化为任务特定分类器。

title: An Illusion of Progress? Assessing the Current State of Web Agents

one_line_summary.en: Online-Mind2Web releases 300 mutable live-site tasks, evaluation code and task-level labels plus WebJudge-7B, but not a complete immutable corpus of all paper trajectories or the external website states needed for exact replay.
one_line_summary.zh: Online-Mind2Web 发布 300 个会随真实网站变化的任务、评测代码、任务级标签与 WebJudge-7B，但未形成包含六类论文智能体全部截图/动作及网站快照的不可变轨迹语料。

title: Analyzing Uncertainty of LLM-as-a-Judge: Interval Evaluations with Conformal Prediction

one_line_summary.en: judge uncertainty evaluation data and conformal prediction code
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作以保形预测为评分型 LLM judge 输出覆盖率可检验的区间与中点分数。

title: Anchored Preference Optimization and Contrastive Revisions: Addressing Underspecification in Alignment
venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics

one_line_summary.en: APO and CLAIR use contrastive revisions to make preference optimization more robust to underspecified alignment feedback.
one_line_summary.zh: APO 与 CLAIR 利用对比式修订数据缓解偏好反馈对齐中的欠确定性。

title: AndroidControl-Curated: Revealing the True Potential of GUI Agents through Benchmark Purification

one_line_summary.en: AndroidControl-Curated releases five static Android step-data views and screenshot archives, couples box-aligned scoring with LLM-human task and label correction, and uses 2,400 selected samples for GRPO agent training.
one_line_summary.zh: AndroidControl-Curated 将 AndroidControl 净化为五种静态 step 数据视图，以 box 对齐评分和 LLM-人工任务/标签修订支撑评测与 Magma-R1 训练，但训练重叠、许可证和可回放环境仍未披露。

title: AndroidLab: Training and Systematic Benchmarking of Android Autonomous Agents

one_line_summary.en: AndroidLab releases a 726-trajectory Android SFT subset and a 138-task AVD benchmark with UI/device-state and LLM-judged terminal feedback, while splits, failed traces, data rights, and immutable replay remain unresolved.
one_line_summary.zh: AndroidLab 发布 726 条 Android SFT 轨迹及含混合终态反馈的 138 任务 AVD 基准，但数据划分、失败轨迹、数据权利与不可变回放条件仍未解决。

title: Answer Convergence as a Signal for Early Stopping in Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Stops CoT when partial-chain answers stabilize, optionally using logit adjustment or a learned stop predictor.
one_line_summary.zh: 当部分思维链的答案趋于稳定时提前终止推理，可选配 logit 调整或学习式停止预测器。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）

title: AntiLeakBench: Preventing Data Contamination by Automatically Generating Benchmark Data

one_line_summary.en: automatically refreshed contamination-resistant benchmark data
one_line_summary.zh: 从截止时间后的事实变化自动构建并更新带来源证据的抗污染问答基准。

title: APIGen-MT: Agentic Pipeline for Multi-Turn Data Generation via Simulated Agent-Human Interplay

one_line_summary.en: APIGen-MT releases 5,000 success-filtered Retail/Airline tool-use dialogues from a blueprint-and-simulation pipeline, but omits failed runs, replay state, verifier logs, and the complete xLAM training mixture.
one_line_summary.zh: APIGen-MT 发布 gated 的 5,000 条 Retail/Airline 成功轨迹，用蓝图验证与模拟交互构造 SFT 数据，但未公开失败运行、重放状态、验证日志或完整 xLAM 训练混合。

title: ARC-AGI-2: A New Challenge for Frontier AI Reasoning Systems

one_line_summary.en: ARC-AGI-2 evaluates few-shot abstract grid transformation with exact output-grid scoring.
one_line_summary.zh: ARC-AGI-2 用少样例彩色网格转换任务评测抽象规则归纳，并以输出网格 exact match 验收。

title: Are LLM-Judges Robust to Expressions of Uncertainty? Investigating the effect of Epistemic Markers on LLM-based Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: EMBER is a released benchmark showing that LLM judges can systematically penalize epistemic markers even when answer correctness is unchanged.
one_line_summary.zh: EMBER 证明 LLM 评判器会因不确定性措辞偏离正确性判决，并提供可复用的反事实审计基准。

title: AReaL: A Large-Scale Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: AReaL releases Apache-2.0 infrastructure and a NeurIPS asynchronous PPO recipe for math/code RL, but no canonical reasoning corpus, paper-run rollout/reward ledger, immutable data split or final-checkpoint provenance package was verified.
one_line_summary.zh: AReaL 发布了用于数学/代码 RL 的 Apache-2.0 异步 PPO 基础设施和 NeurIPS 系统配方；未核验到规范推理语料、论文运行 rollout/奖励账本、不可变数据切分或最终检查点溯源包。

title: ATLAS: Autoformalizing Theorems through Lifting, Augmentation, and Synthesis of Data

one_line_summary.en: ATLAS expands natural-language–Lean theorem pairs through lifting, augmentation, and synthesis, filtering autoformalization data with Lean checking.
one_line_summary.zh: ATLAS 通过提升、增广和合成扩展自然语言—Lean 定理对，并以 Lean 检查筛选自动形式化数据。

title: Atom of Thoughts for Markov LLM Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: Atom of Thoughts converts a problem into answer-equivalent atomic states so inference compute targets the current subproblem rather than an accumulated history.
one_line_summary.zh: Atom of Thoughts 将复杂问题转为答案等价的原子状态，使测试时计算聚焦当前子问题而非累积历史。

title: Atomic Consistency Preference Optimization for Long-Form Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: ACPO turns agreement among sentence-level facts in sampled long-form answers into chosen-rejected pairs for factuality-oriented DPO.
one_line_summary.zh: ACPO 将长回答中句子级事实在多次采样中的一致程度转化为优选—劣选回答对，并用它进行面向事实性的直接偏好优化。

title: Audio Flamingo 3: Advancing Audio Intelligence with Fully Open Large Audio Language Models

one_line_summary.en: AudioSkills-XL expands multiple audio sources into 8M capability-labeled QA pairs and separates a 250K controlled-thought subset for reasoning-focused training.
one_line_summary.zh: AudioSkills-XL 把声音、音乐和语音来源扩展为 800 万条问答，并另设 25 万条受控思考记录。

title: Automated Benchmark Generation for Repository-Level Coding Tasks

one_line_summary.en: SetUpAgent turns issue-resolving GitHub pull requests into executable repository tasks by reconstructing historical dependencies and parsing tests; paper-time SWA/SWEE scales are 535/885 tasks, while current Hub releases expose 450/798.
one_line_summary.zh: SetUpAgent 通过历史依赖重建、测试解析与 F2P/P2P 终态契约构造 SWA-Bench 和 SWEE-Bench，但公开行数漂移、数据集许可和生成源码仍阻碍可复现实验。

title: Autonomous Data Selection with Zero-shot Generative Classifiers for Mathematical Texts

one_line_summary.en: AutoDS ranks mathematical text with zero-shot generative-classifier logits before continual pretraining.
one_line_summary.zh: AutoDS 用零样本生成式分类器词元概率给数学文本排序，再决定哪些数据进入持续预训练。

title: AWS AI Service Cards: Amazon Nova 2 Lite

one_line_summary.en: AWS's Nova 2 Lite Service Card discloses high-level source categories, SFT/RLHF, filters, and evaluation layers but withholds records, rewards, and reproducibility artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: AWS 的 Nova 2 Lite 服务卡披露了高层来源类别、SFT/RLHF、过滤和评测层，但没有公开记录、奖励或可复现制品。

title: BadJudge: Backdoor Vulnerabilities of LLM-As-A-Judge

one_line_summary.en: Defines data-centric backdoors against LLM judges and evaluates model merging as a mitigation.
one_line_summary.zh: 定义针对 LLM 判别器的数据后门，并以模型合并缓解被操纵的评测结果。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models Under Data Contamination: A Survey from Static to Dynamic Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: This survey and living repository map static and dynamic defenses against benchmark contamination.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理污染下静态与动态 LLM 基准，并提出动态基准的六项审计准则。

title: Beyond Chain-of-Thought: A Survey of Chain-of-X Paradigms for LLMs

one_line_summary.en: A COLING 2025 survey that classifies Chain-of-X methods by their intermediate nodes and their application tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: 从中间节点类型和应用任务两条线系统整理 Chain-of-X 方法。

title: Beyond the Surface: Enhancing LLM-as-a-Judge Alignment with Human via Internal Representations

one_line_summary.en: Aggregates score-token logits across frozen transformer layers to improve point-wise judge alignment with humans.
one_line_summary.zh: 聚合冻结 Transformer 各层的分数 token logit，以提升点式 LLM 评审与人工评分的一致性。

title: Beyond the Surface: Measuring Self-Preference in LLM Judgments

one_line_summary.en: gold-judgment-controlled self-preference bias measurement
one_line_summary.zh: 用 gold judgment 校正回答质量后，测量 LLM judge 的真实自偏好。

title: Big-Math: A Large-Scale, High-Quality Math Dataset for Reinforcement Learning in Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Big-Math turns diverse open mathematical sources into a 251,122-item RL dataset of open-ended questions with uniquely checkable closed-form answers.
one_line_summary.zh: Big-Math 将多源开放数学题清洗并重构为 251,122 条开放式、闭式且答案唯一可核验的 RL 训练记录。

title: BigCodeArena: Unveiling More Reliable Human Preferences in Code Generation via Execution

one_line_summary.en: BigCodeArena couples human code preferences with execution to make code-feedback labels more reliable.
one_line_summary.zh: BigCodeArena 把可交互的代码执行结果接入人类两两偏好收集，使代码奖励模型能同时利用行为证据与用户判断。

title: BigCodeBench: Benchmarking Code Generation with Diverse Function Calls and Complex Instructions

one_line_summary.en: BigCodeBench uses high-coverage tests to assess executable Python generation under diverse library calls and complex instructions.
one_line_summary.zh: BigCodeBench 用高覆盖单元测试考察模型在多库函数调用与复杂指令下生成可执行 Python 程序的能力。

title: Blackbox Model Provenance via Palimpsestic Membership Inference

one_line_summary.en: model-provenance membership-inference data and code
one_line_summary.zh: 以训练样本随机顺序的相关性，为黑盒衍生模型或文本提供可量化来源证据。

title: Both Text and Images Leaked! A Systematic Analysis of Data Contamination in Multimodal LLM

one_line_summary.en: Accepted multimodal contamination audit with the authors’ MM-Detect public repository.
one_line_summary.zh: 将文本与图像泄漏统一为多模态污染审计，并提供可复现的来源分析框架。

title: BPP-Search: Enhancing Tree of Thought Reasoning for Mathematical Modeling Problem Solving

one_line_summary.en: BPP-Search uses a learned process reward model to prune a mathematical-modeling tree and a pairwise classifier to select the final candidate, while the public StructuredOR artifact contains 124 final structured examples rather than the raw search trees.
one_line_summary.zh: BPP-Search 用学习式过程奖励模型剪枝数学建模树，再用成对偏好分类器选择最终候选；公开的 StructuredOR 仅含 124 条最终结构化样例，而不含原始搜索树。

title: Breaking the Reasoning Barrier A Survey on LLM Complex Reasoning through the Lens of Self-Evolution

one_line_summary.en: An ACL survey of growing reasoning ability by jointly improving training data and models.
one_line_summary.zh: 从数据演化、模型演化和循环改进理解复杂推理能力的 ACL 综述。

title: Bridging the Data Provenance Gap Across Text, Speech, and Video

one_line_summary.en: Releases a human-audited dataset-level catalogue covering 3,916 reported text, speech, and video datasets, with source, derivation, creator, representation, license, and source-terms metadata but no per-record provenance.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布人工审计的数据集级目录，覆盖论文表中 3,916 个文本、语音与视频数据集的来源、派生、创建者、表示、许可证和来源条款，但不提供逐记录 provenance。

title: BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents

one_line_summary.en: BrowseComp releases 1,266 obfuscated hard factual web questions and short answers scored by an answer-only LLM judge, but no browsing trajectories, citations, or replayable web state, and its current official reference scorer has a label-parsing defect.
one_line_summary.zh: BrowseComp 发布 1,266 道经可逆混淆的高难度网页事实问答题，以答案级 LLM judge 评分；它不发布浏览轨迹、引用或可回放网页状态，且当前官方参考 scorer 存在标签解析缺陷。

title: BuildBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Compiling Real-World Open-Source Software
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Deep Learning for Code Workshop (DL4C), Poster

one_line_summary.en: BuildBench turns real C/C++ repositories into executable build-agent tasks with README/web retrieval, iterative shell feedback, and strict/flexible target-binary checks; the current release retains 385 candidate labels but not full rollouts or a pinned public scaffold.
one_line_summary.zh: BuildBench 在全新 Ubuntu 22.04 容器中以文档检索、迭代 Bash 执行反馈和目标二进制文件名 predicate 评测 C/C++ 仓库编译 agent；当前发布保留 385 个候选标签，但不含完整 command-observation rollout。

title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM? Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: The study shows that optimal inference-time search depends jointly on generator, verifier, and problem difficulty rather than model size alone.
one_line_summary.zh: 研究表明最优推理时搜索由生成器、验证器和题目难度共同决定，而非仅由模型规模决定。

title: Can Large Language Models Detect Errors in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning?

one_line_summary.en: DeltaBench pairs 1,236 long o1-like traces with fine-grained annotations to test whether critics can find process errors beyond final-answer accuracy.
one_line_summary.zh: DeltaBench 为 1,236 条长推理轨迹提供细粒度过程标注，用于检验批评器能否发现终局答案之外的过程错误。

title: Chain-of-Thought Matters: Improving Long-Context Language Models with Reasoning Path Supervision

one_line_summary.en: LongRePS bootstraps and quality-filters explicit evidence paths for long documents, training language models to reason through context rather than only predict the final answer.
one_line_summary.zh: LongRePS 自举并筛选长文档中的显式证据推理路径，训练模型基于上下文完成推理而非只预测最终答案。

title: ChartM3: A Multi-Stage Code-Driven Pipeline for Constructing Multi-Dimensional and Multi-Step Visual Reasoning Data in Chart Comprehension

one_line_summary.en: ChartM3 reports a code-driven pipeline for 141,800 training and 2,871 test Q&A, but execution checks, learned judges, privileged code-output rationales, and unreconciled retained-versus-final counts remain unauditable without an official release.
one_line_summary.zh: ChartM3 报告以数据、渲染和分析代码驱动的图表推理构造流程，但未发布可核验的官方语料，执行、学习型 judge 与代码输出型推理仍须分开审计。

title: ChartMimic: Evaluating LMM's Cross-Modal Reasoning Capability via Chart-to-Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: ChartMimic exposes chart-to-code generation and rendered-output comparison as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: ChartMimic 用 chart-to-code 生成、代码执行和渲染图相似度评测 LMM 的跨模态推理。

title: Checklist Engineering Empowers Multilingual LLM Judges

one_line_summary.en: Provides a public multilingual judge method and evaluates checklist-based reliability.
one_line_summary.zh: 用双向动态核对清单引导开源 7B 模型，在不微调条件下执行多语言文本评测。

title: Checklists Are Better Than Reward Models For Aligning Language Models

one_line_summary.en: RLCF generates weighted checklists from instructions and uses item-level AI/program judgments as reinforcement-learning feedback.
one_line_summary.zh: RLCF 从指令生成加权核对表，以逐项 AI／程序判分构成强化学习反馈，替代固定奖励模型。

title: CHEEMS: A Practical Guidance for Building and Evaluating Chinese Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: A released Chinese reward-model benchmark and preference dataset designed to expose gaps in reward-model training and evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: CHEEMS 构建人工监督的中文奖励模型基准与偏好数据，揭示并改善中文偏好建模缺口。

title: Cheems: A Practical Guidance for Building and Evaluating Chinese Reward Models from Scratch

one_line_summary.en: Introduces Cheems, an end-to-end recipe for Chinese reward models covering preference-data construction, reward-model training, and localized evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: 提出 Cheems 中文奖励模型构建配方：覆盖偏好数据生产、奖励模型训练和本土化评测，可直接复现中文 Reward Model 流程。

title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card

one_line_summary.en: Claude 3.7 Sonnet's system card discloses broad source categories, classifier-derived appropriate-harmlessness preferences, RL-trained extended thinking, and selected monitors, but not the underlying records, rewards, rollout settings, or replay artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Claude 3.7 Sonnet 系统卡披露了宽泛来源类别、由分类器构造的适当无害性偏好、经强化学习训练的扩展思维及若干监控机制，但未公开底层记录、奖励、采样预算或可回放产物。

title: Claude 4 System Card

one_line_summary.en: Claude 4's system card and transparency materials name broad source categories, human feedback, and Constitutional AI, but do not disclose record-level data, reward, or environment contracts.
one_line_summary.zh: Claude 4 的系统卡和透明度材料列出广义来源类别、人工反馈与 Constitutional AI，但未披露记录级数据、奖励或环境合约。

title: Claude Haiku 4.5 System Card

one_line_summary.en: Anthropic's Haiku 4.5 system card discloses five coarse training-source classes, RLHF/RLAIF, context-aware agent RL, prior-model reasoning traces, and a recursive later-stage training audit, but releases no source proportions, reward contract, global split, or reusable records.
one_line_summary.zh: Claude Haiku 4.5 System Card 披露五类训练来源、RLHF/RLAIF、偏好选择、上下文感知 agentic RL、前代模型推理文本与后训练行为审计，但不提供来源比例、reward model、全局 split、授权账本或可复用训练记录。

title: Claude Opus 4.5 System Card

one_line_summary.en: Claude Opus 4.5's system card discloses broad source categories, RLHF/RLAIF, prior-model reasoning text in earlier supervised learning, no RL reward on reasoning-text content, selected reward-hacking safeguards, and concrete decontamination rules, but not auditable records, rewards, or environments.
one_line_summary.zh: Claude Opus 4.5 的系统卡披露了宽泛来源类别、RLHF/RLAIF、早期监督学习中的先前模型 reasoning text、RL 不按 reasoning-text 内容奖惩、部分 reward-hacking 防护和具体去污染规则，但没有公开可审计的记录、奖励或环境。

title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 System Card

one_line_summary.en: Claude Sonnet 4.5's system card discloses broad source categories, RLHF/RLAIF, safety-pipeline changes, reward-hacking stress tests, and a white-box evaluation-awareness audit, but not the associated training data, reward functions, model internals, or reproducibility artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Claude Sonnet 4.5 的系统卡披露了宽泛来源类别、RLHF/RLAIF、安全管线变更、reward-hacking 压力测试和 white-box evaluation-awareness 审计，但没有公开相关训练数据、奖励函数、模型内部或可复现制品。

title: Clean First, Align Later: Benchmarking Preference Data Cleaning for Reliable LLM Alignment

one_line_summary.en: PrefCleanBench compares how cleaning preference records changes downstream alignment across data, models, and objectives.
one_line_summary.zh: PrefCleanBench 比较偏好记录的不同清洗方式如何影响下游对齐表现。

title: CLEVER: A Curated Benchmark for Formally Verified Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: CLEVER evaluates end-to-end Lean verified code generation on 161 hand-curated tasks with held-out specifications and post-hoc type checking.
one_line_summary.zh: CLEVER 包含 161 个手工审校任务，要求生成与保留规格一致的 Lean 实现，并由类型检查器在事后验证。

title: CM-Align: Consistency-based Multilingual Alignment for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: CM-Align constructs multilingual DPO pairs by selecting a reliable English anchor and cross-lingually consistent responses.
one_line_summary.zh: CM-Align 用英语锚点与跨语言一致性构造多语言 DPO 偏好对。

title: Co-Evolving LLM Coder and Unit Tester via Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: CURE alternates one policy between coder and tester roles, using a code-by-test execution matrix and private gold-test anchors to train both capabilities and to rank code at test time.
one_line_summary.zh: CURE 用代码与单元测试的执行矩阵共同训练生成器和测试器，并在测试时用生成测试选择代码。

title: CODE I/O: Condensing Reasoning Patterns via Code Input-Output Prediction

one_line_summary.en: CODE I/O transforms 454.9K executable functions into 3.52M CoT prediction records, while publicly releasing the ODC-BY PythonEdu-Reasoning subset.
one_line_summary.zh: CODE I/O 把 454.9K 个可执行函数转化为 3.52M 条带程序校验与修订反馈的自然语言推理示范，并公开其中的 PythonEdu-Reasoning 子集。

title: Code Migration Benchmark

one_line_summary.en: Code Migration evaluates whether models can reimplement real-world programs in another language and pass hidden behavioral tests in an offline sandbox.
one_line_summary.zh: Code Migration 评测模型能否把真实程序迁移到另一种语言，并在离线沙箱中通过隐藏行为测试。

title: Code to Think, Think to Code: A Survey on Code-Enhanced Reasoning and Reasoning-Driven Code Intelligence in LLMs

one_line_summary.en: An EMNLP 2025 survey of code as a structured, executable medium for reasoning and of reasoning as a driver of code intelligence.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理代码如何作为可执行的推理媒介，以及推理如何提升代码智能。

title: CodeContests-O: Powering LLMs via Feedback-Driven Iterative Test Case Generation

one_line_summary.en: CodeContests-O iteratively improves competitive-programming test cases using execution feedback from correct and incorrect solution pools.
one_line_summary.zh: CodeContests-O 利用正确与错误解池的执行反馈迭代改进竞赛编程测试用例，从而增强代码结果核验。

title: CodeCriticBench: A Holistic Code Critique Benchmark for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: CodeCriticBench evaluates code critics with code-generation and code-QA records, execution checks, and fine-grained critique checklists.
one_line_summary.zh: 万级代码生成与问答批评记录，结合测试与人工维度标签，可训练代码推理的批评和修正反馈器。

title: CodeElo: Benchmarking Competition-level Code Generation of LLMs with Human-comparable Elo Ratings

one_line_summary.en: CodeElo exposes recent Codeforces problems submitted to official judge as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: CodeElo 把提交至官方评测机的近期 Codeforces 题目做成可审计的评测面。

title: CodeUltraFeedback: An LLM-as-a-Judge Dataset for Aligning Large Language Models to Coding Preferences
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology

one_line_summary.en: CodeUltraFeedback: An LLM-as-a-Judge Dataset for Aligning Large Language Models to Coding Preferences releases 10,000 coding instructions, four candidate answers from fourteen models, and GPT-3.5 scores plus textual feedback across five coding preferences for preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and feedback audit.
one_line_summary.zh: 为编程指令的多模型回答提供五维裁判评分和文字反馈，可训练代码偏好与奖励模型。

title: CogCoM: A Visual Language Model with Chain-of-Manipulations Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: CogCoM releases visual manipulation chains whose grounding, OCR, and calculation results form evidence-bearing multimodal SFT targets.
one_line_summary.zh: CogCoM 公开由 GPT-4 规划、视觉工具执行并以金答案终止筛选的视觉操作链，用作带证据的多模态 SFT 目标。

title: Collaborative Reasoner: Self-Improving Social Agents with Synthetic Conversations

one_line_summary.en: Collaborative Reasoner uses symmetric same-model agents, five-way turn sampling, LLM belief extraction, and gold-answer matching to create next-turn SFT targets and DPO pairs for collaborative reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: Collaborative Reasoner（Coral）让两个对称的同模型 agents 对 reasoning problems 进行五路逐 turn 采样与五棵独立 conversation trees，通过 same-family LLM belief extraction 加 gold matching 构造 SFT targets 和 same-prefix DPO pairs；论文报告 8B/70B 接受 379.6K/311.3K turns，但没有公开 conversations、SFT/DPO rows、rejects、checkpoints、logs 或 splits。

title: Comparing Bad Apples to Good Oranges: Aligning Large Language Models via Joint Preference Optimization

one_line_summary.en: JPO learns from comparisons between complete instruction-response pairs, expanding preference optimization beyond fixed-context response rankings.
one_line_summary.zh: JPO 从完整的指令—回答对之间学习比较，使偏好优化超出固定上下文下的回答排序。

title: CompassVerifier: A Unified and Robust Verifier for LLMs Evaluation and Outcome Reward

one_line_summary.en: A staged outcome-verifier pipeline with ternary human labels, error-driven synthesis, a public benchmark, and three public Qwen2.5-based checkpoints.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作将 53 个模型的回答池加工为 2,817 条三分类 VerifierBench，并发布三个 CompassVerifier 检查点；但 96,832 条训练语料、投票与过滤谱系以及完整构建代码仍未发布。

title: Comprehensive Verilog Design Problems: A Next-Generation Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating Large Language Models and Agents on RTL Design and Verification

one_line_summary.en: CVDP releases 783 engineer-authored RTL generation, verification, and debugging problems with tool-backed evaluation for models and agents.
one_line_summary.zh: CVDP 发布覆盖 RTL 生成、验证与调试的 783 个工程师编写问题，以工具执行和评分基础设施评测模型与代理。

title: Consistent Paths Lead to Truth: Self-Rewarding Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Converts 16 on-policy trajectories into consistency, volatility, answer-group, and curiosity rewards for Reinforce++ without using correctness labels for optimization.
one_line_summary.zh: 把 16 条策略轨迹转换为一致性、波动性和好奇心奖励，用于无需外部正确性标签的 Reinforce++。

title: COPR: Continual Human Preference Learning via Optimal Policy Regularization

one_line_summary.en: COPR constrains continual preference updates with historical optimal-policy distributions so new feedback can be learned without collapsing earlier preferences.
one_line_summary.zh: COPR 用历史最优策略分布约束持续偏好更新，使模型学习新反馈时不至于遗忘或压扁早期偏好。

title: CoT-Valve: Length-Compressible Chain-of-Thought Tuning

one_line_summary.en: A released mixed-length CoT resource and tuning recipe for controllable reasoning compression.
one_line_summary.zh: CoT-Valve 使用 MixChain 中不同长度的推理链训练长度可压缩的 CoT，并把压缩与正确性筛选作为可审计的构造步骤。

title: Critic-CoT: Boosting the Reasoning Abilities of Large Language Model via Chain-of-Thought Critic

one_line_summary.en: Critic-CoT releases weakly supervised step-wise critiques and revisions so models can reject or repair flawed mathematical reasoning chains.
one_line_summary.zh: 27.6万数学批评／改写实例，弱监督产生逐步批评反馈，可用于筛除和迭代修复错误推理。

title: Critic-V: VLM Critics Help Catch VLM Errors in Multimodal Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Critic-V releases 29,012 multimodal critique preference pairs and trains a DPO critic that gives natural-language feedback to refine VLM reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布按规则奖励排序的多模态批评偏好数据，用自然语言 critique 修正视觉推理路径，可直接训练 critic 与策略模型。

title: Critique Fine-Tuning: Learning to Critique is More Effective than Learning to Imitate

one_line_summary.en: WebInstruct-CFT teaches models to diagnose noisy solutions with GPT-4o-generated critiques instead of merely imitating correct answers.
one_line_summary.zh: 65.4万问题—噪声解—批评记录（论文用50k子集），以文字批评促进数学与 STEM 推理修正。

title: Cross-Lingual Auto Evaluation for Assessing Multilingual LLMs

one_line_summary.en: The CIA Suite's RECON provides human-scored instructions in six languages for training and meta-evaluating cross-lingual judges.
one_line_summary.zh: CIA Suite 的 RECON 以六语种人工判分指令数据，支持跨语言自动评测器的训练与元评测。

title: Crossing the Reward Bridge: Expanding Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards Across Diverse Domains

one_line_summary.en: This work distils cross-domain generative reward models from exploration-time answer–judgement records and uses soft rewards for RLVR.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作用探索中收集的回答—判定记录蒸馏跨领域生成式奖励模型，并以软奖励扩展自由文本任务的 RLVR。

title: CRPO: Confidence-Reward Driven Preference Optimization for Machine Translation

one_line_summary.en: CRPO selects translation preference pairs with both reward contrast and model uncertainty, concentrating DPO on records with higher learning value.
one_line_summary.zh: CRPO 同时依据奖励差距与模型置信度选择翻译偏好对，让 DPO 聚焦仍有学习价值的记录。

title: CUARewardBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Reward Models on Computer-using Agent

one_line_summary.en: CUARewardBench evaluates whether reward models can judge computer-use trajectories at both the step and whole-trajectory levels across diverse software tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: CUARewardBench 在多类软件任务上同时评测奖励模型对计算机操作轨迹的逐步判断和整轨判断能力。

title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale

one_line_summary.en: DAPO couples a 17K integer-answer math prompt recipe with rule-scored online rollouts, dynamic group filtering, token-level loss, and length shaping, but the current public split and source lineage require audit before reuse.
one_line_summary.zh: DAPO 以 17K 整数答案数学题和每题 16 条在线 rollout 为对象，通过规则奖励、动态题组筛选、token-level loss 与长度塑形组织 RLVR；但当前公开 split 的重复块和来源谱系仍阻碍直接复用。

title: DAST: Difficulty-Adaptive Slow-Thinking for Large Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: DAST samples 20 self-rollouts per MATH question, uses correctness and a difficulty-conditioned token budget to rank candidates, and trains SimPO on the resulting preference pairs.
one_line_summary.zh: DAST 对每个 MATH 训练题收集 20 条自生成推理响应，以正确性和难度相关的 Token Length Budget 校准奖励、构造偏好对，并用 SimPO 训练长度自适应的慢思考行为。

title: Data Contamination Quiz: A Tool to Detect and Estimate Contamination in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Accepted TACL paper; official repository releases the quiz inputs, code, and contamination reports.
one_line_summary.zh: 以原题与词级扰动组成选择题，在黑盒模型中估计逐字数据污染及其位置偏差边界。

title: Data Mixing Optimization for Supervised Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A fitted transfer-and-scaling loss model selects SFT domain weights for a fixed token budget.
one_line_summary.zh: 拟合迁移—缩放损失模型，在固定词元预算下选择监督微调的领域权重。

title: Data Whisperer: Efficient Data Selection for Task-Specific LLM Fine-Tuning via Few-Shot In-Context Learning

one_line_summary.en: Data Whisperer selects task-specific fine-tuning records by measuring how attention-weighted few-shot demonstrations improve query performance before any scoring-model training.
one_line_summary.zh: Data Whisperer 在任何评分模型训练之前，衡量带注意力权重的少样本示例如何改善查询表现，并据此选择任务微调记录。

title: DataSciBench: An LLM Agent Benchmark for Data Science

one_line_summary.en: DataSciBench exposes data-science tasks with executable metric framework as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: DataSciBench 把配有可执行指标框架的数据科学任务做成可审计的评测面。

title: DCRM: A Heuristic to Measure Response Pair Quality in Preference Optimization

one_line_summary.en: DCRM selects preference pairs whose reward-relevant contrast is large relative to their noisy lexical and model-probability differences.
one_line_summary.zh: DCRM 以奖励相关差异相对于词面和模型概率噪声的密度来选择偏好对，避免仅按奖励差距训练。

title: Debiasing Online Preference Learning via Preference Feature Preservation

one_line_summary.en: PFP preserves the feature distribution behind preference labels while generating and training on new online preference records.
one_line_summary.zh: PFP 在生成并训练新的在线偏好记录时保留偏好标签背后的特征分布，减少迭代中的特征坍缩。

title: Deconstructing Long Chain-of-Thought: A Structured Reasoning Optimization Framework for Long CoT Distillation

one_line_summary.en: DLCoT parses long mathematical teacher traces into structured approaches and verifications, prunes redundant branches for SFT, and releases processing code plus a Step 1 input rather than a confirmed final optimized corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: 该条目将推理轨迹、搜索选择或测试时计算作为可审计的研究对象；未披露字段已明确标为 unknown。

title: Deep Research System Card

one_line_summary.en: OpenAI's Deep Research System Card discloses browsing-task reinforcement learning with ground-truth or rubric grading by a chain-of-thought model and added browsing safety data, but not the datasets, trajectories, graders, reward design, or reproducibility artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenAI 的 Deep Research System Card 披露了浏览任务强化学习：以真值或量规为依据、由思维链模型评分，并加入浏览安全数据；但未披露数据集、轨迹、评分器、奖励设计或复现工件。

title: DeepDistill: Enhancing LLM Reasoning Capabilities via Large-Scale Difficulty-Graded Data Training

one_line_summary.en: Builds about 40M mixed-domain teacher responses for roughly 3.34M sourced queries and grades them with category-specific verification, while the official data card says the public release is only a subset.
one_line_summary.zh: 围绕约 334 万条有来源的查询生成约 4000 万条多教师响应，并以分类型验证器给出难度信号；但官方数据卡说明公开内容仅是完整数据的子集。

title: DeepDiver: Adaptive Web-Search Intensity Scaling via Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: DeepDiver trains 7B policies on WebPuzzle with live-web iterative-RAG GRPO, using answer judgments and a conditional search bonus to study how search depth changes with information demand.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepDiver 在 WebPuzzle 上用真实网页的迭代式检索增强生成与 GRPO 训练 7B 策略，以答案评判加条件化搜索奖励研究搜索深度如何随信息需求变化。

title: DeepMath-103K: A Large-Scale, Challenging, Decontaminated, and Verifiable Mathematical Dataset for Advancing Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: DeepMath-103K retains difficult decontaminated questions, stores a verified final answer, and supplies three independent R1 reasoning traces for each problem.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepMath-103K 为 10.3 万道去污染难题各保留三条 R1 解题过程，并把答案、难度和主题写入记录。

title: DeepResearch Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Deep Research Agents

one_line_summary.en: DeepResearch Bench evaluates PhD-level web research reports with adaptive criteria and citation-quality assessments.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepResearch Bench 用博士级研究任务、适应性准则和引文评估，衡量深度研究 Agent 的报告质量与检索能力。

title: DeepResearcher: Scaling Deep Research via Reinforcement Learning in Real-world Environments

one_line_summary.en: DeepResearcher releases 80,000 filtered QA prompts, code, and a 7B checkpoint for live-web GRPO with 16 rollouts per prompt and short-answer F1 reward, but not a verified corpus of the original training episodes.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepResearcher 在真实网页搜索与浏览环境中进行 GRPO，发布处理后的输入、代码和模型但未发布训练轨迹。

title: DeepSeek-Prover-V2: Advancing Formal Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Subgoal Decomposition

one_line_summary.en: DeepSeek-Prover-V2 combines DeepSeek-V3 proof-sketch decomposition, recursively solved Lean subgoals, Lean-verified cold starts, expert iteration, and GRPO RL, while releasing models and evaluation artifacts but not the core training or audit corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepSeek-Prover-V2 将 DeepSeek-V3 证明草图分解、递归求解的 Lean 子目标、Lean 验证冷启动、expert iteration 和 GRPO RL 结合起来；它公开模型和评测工件，但未公开核心训练或审计语料。

title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: DeepSeek-R1 reports cold-start/RL/SFT/RL stages, rule/reward feedback, and 800K-row distillation while withholding prompts, traces, verifiers, rewards, splits, and audit artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepSeek-R1 报告了 cold-start/RL/SFT/RL 阶段、规则/奖励反馈和 80 万条蒸馏数据，却未公开 prompt、轨迹、verifier、reward、切分或审计 artifact。

title: DeepSeek-V3.1
venue: Official DeepSeek Hugging Face model release

one_line_summary.en: DeepSeek-V3.1 releases weights, interface formats, 128K context, and base-extension token counts, but not its post-training data, feedback, or audit stack.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepSeek-V3.1 发布了权重、接口、128K 上下文和基础延长 token 数，但未公开后训练数据、反馈或审计栈。

title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: DeepSeek-V3.2 reports 85,267 agent prompts, 1,827 synthetic tool environments, specialist distillation, and mixed GRPO, while releasing model weights and inference code but not training records, environments, or reward artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepSeek-V3.2 报告 scalable GRPO、专家蒸馏以及覆盖 1,800+ 环境、85K+ 指令的合成 agentic 训练；数据、环境、奖励契约和审计资产未公开。

title: DeepSeekMath-V2: Towards Self-Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: DeepSeekMath-V2 alternates GRPO-trained proof verification and generation, bootstraps harder proof labels through multi-sample verifier and meta-verifier judgments, and scales self-verification at test time, while releasing model weights and evaluation artifacts but not the training records or formal correctness certificates.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepSeekMath-V2 以专家三级标签训练自然语言 proof verifier 和 meta-verifier，再通过多采样自动标注与 GRPO 形成生成—验证闭环；其价值是披露反馈型数据飞轮，但 LLM 判断与 64 次一致通过都不是 Lean/Isabelle 形式证明证书。

title: Defects4C: Benchmarking Large Language Model Repair Capability with C/C++ Bugs

one_line_summary.en: Defects4C provides executable C/C++ repair tasks with 248 real bugs, 102 vulnerabilities, and reproduction tests for validating patches.
one_line_summary.zh: Defects4C 从真实 C/C++ 仓库整理 248 个缺陷与 102 个漏洞，配套可复现测试以执行验证修复补丁。

title: Deliberate Reasoning in Language Models as Structure-Aware Planning with an Accurate World Model

one_line_summary.en: SWAP releases trajectory and process-supervision data for structure-aware reasoning that updates and verifies entailment graphs during planning.
one_line_summary.zh: SWAP 发布结构感知推理的轨迹与过程监督数据，在规划中更新并验证蕴含图。

title: Demystifying Multilingual Reasoning in Process Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: Demystifying Multilingual Reasoning in Process Reward Modeling exposes process or trace supervision data.
one_line_summary.zh: 将 PRM800K 与 Math-Shepherd 翻译为七种训练语言，系统检验多语过程奖励模型在 11 种语言数学推理上的迁移。

title: Detecting Benchmark Contamination Through Watermarking

one_line_summary.en: Proactive benchmark watermarking produces a calibrated white-box test for memorized contamination.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布前给基准题目加秘密水印，并用有确定假阳性率的白盒统计检验发现模型是否记住该基准。

title: Detecting Data Contamination from Reinforcement Learning Post-training for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: RL-MIA benchmark and post-training contamination detector
one_line_summary.zh: Self-Critique以初始与批评回复的熵轨迹相似度检测 RL 后训练数据污染。

title: Direct Judgement Preference Optimization

one_line_summary.en: DJPO builds three complementary DPO pair types to train generalized LLM judges from critiques, direct decisions, and response deductions.
one_line_summary.zh: DJPO 构造三类互补的 DPO 样本对，从批评、直接决策和回答反推训练可泛化的大语言模型评审器。

title: Distributional LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: Aligns distributions of automated verdicts with human evaluation distributions.
one_line_summary.zh: 让 LLM 输出与人类分歧结构对齐的分布式判别器。

title: Diverse, not Short: A Length-Controlled Data Selection Strategy for Improving Response Diversity of Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Diverse-NS creates DPO pairs whose chosen response is more diverse and better scored than the rejected response without exploiting shorter length.
one_line_summary.zh: Diverse-NS 构造用于 DPO 的偏好对：入选回答更具多样性且质量更高，同时不靠缩短文本取得优势。

title: Does Context Matter? ContextualJudgeBench for Evaluating LLM-based Judges in Contextual Settings

one_line_summary.en: ContextualJudgeBench supplies 2,000 context-dependent response pairs that test whether LLM judges apply conditional factuality, completeness, refusal, and conciseness criteria.
one_line_summary.zh: ContextualJudgeBench 提供约 2K RAG 与摘要比较样本，以忠实性、完整性等上下文条件评测 judge 的推理反馈质量。

title: Does Data Contamination Detection Work (Well) for LLMs? A Survey and Evaluation on Detection Assumptions

one_line_summary.en: Accepted evaluation of contamination-detection assumptions with public proceedings materials.
one_line_summary.zh: 从假设层面审计数据污染检测，揭示实例级 MIA 的适用边界。

title: Does Thinking More Always Help? Mirage of Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: The paper diagnoses overthinking under sequential test-time scaling and compares it with parallel allocation of the same reasoning-token budget.
one_line_summary.zh: 该论文揭示单轨迹延长思考的过度思考拐点，并以并行推理比较同一 token 预算的更稳健分配。

title: Dolomites: Domain-Specific Long-Form Methodical Tasks
venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics

one_line_summary.en: DoLoMiTes is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
one_line_summary.zh: 收集 25 个领域专家提出的 519 类长文方法任务及 1,857 份专家修订，保留真实输入、输出与修订判断，适合通用长程推理生成。

title: Don't Get Lost in the Trees: Streamlining LLM Reasoning by Overcoming Tree Search Exploration Pitfalls

one_line_summary.en: FETCH reduces redundant tree expansion by clustering equivalent reasoning states and stabilizes verifier-guided search with TD-trained, ensembled scores.
one_line_summary.zh: FETCH 合并语义等价推理状态，并以 TD(λ) 训练且集成的 verifier 分数引导树搜索，从而减少冗余扩展与评分方差。

title: DORM: Preference Data Weights Optimization for Reward Modeling in LLM Alignment

one_line_summary.en: DORM learns validation-regularized weights for heterogeneous preference data so reward-model training emphasizes informative uncertainty and downweights likely noise.
one_line_summary.zh: DORM 为异构偏好数据学习由验证集正则化的权重，使奖励模型训练强调有信息量的不确定样本并降低可能噪声的影响。

title: DOTS: Learning to Reason Dynamically in LLMs via Optimal Reasoning Trajectories Search

one_line_summary.en: DOTS searches 12 solver-conditioned reasoning-action trajectories with repeated ground-truth scoring, trains external or internalized planners on the selected paths, and releases a 4.8 GB MATH file containing raw dialogues, failed trials, trajectory IDs, predicted answers, and binary scores.
one_line_summary.zh: DOTS 对 12 条三层推理动作轨迹进行 solver 条件化重复搜索和真值评分，用选中路径构造 planner SFT 数据；公开的 4.8 GB MATH 原始 JSON 保留成功与失败对话、轨迹、预测答案和二值分数，但缺少稳定计数、splits、剪枝清单、最终 SFT 数据与 checkpoints。

title: DR Tulu: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics for Deep Research

one_line_summary.en: Releases SFT/RL datasets, code and checkpoints for a deep-research agent trained with GRPO and search-grounded evolving rubrics, while the final data mixture, online rubric history and evaluator calibration remain only partially disclosed.
one_line_summary.zh: DR-Tulu 发布了深度研究智能体的 SFT/RL 数据、代码和检查点；其 GRPO 训练结合检索锚定、持续与演化的自然语言 rubric 以及程序化协议奖励，但最终数据混合、在线 rubric 历史与评判校准仍未完整披露。

title: Dynamic Early Exit in Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: DEER probes trial answers at reasoning transitions and exits when model self-confidence is high, while the official repository releases only part of the paper's implementation and no reusable rollout corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: DEER 在推理的转折处试探性给出答案，当模型自信度足够高时提前退出；官方仓库只发布了论文实现的一部分，且没有可复用的采样语料。

title: Dynamic Scaling of Unit Tests for Code Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: Dynamic Scaling of Unit Tests for Code Reward Modeling records candidate solutions generated unit tests execution rewards and test budgets under test-derived reward.
one_line_summary.zh: CodeRM 发布合成单元测试与错误率字段，并按题目难度动态分配测试时验证预算。

title: Dyve: Thinking Fast and Slow for Dynamic Process Verification

one_line_summary.en: An open process-supervision recipe that filters noisy MCTS traces and converts retained steps into mixed one-token and explanatory verifier targets.
one_line_summary.zh: 这是一个开放的 process-supervision 配方：它过滤带噪 MCTS 轨迹，并把保留步骤转换成单 token 快速判决或带分析的慢速验证 target。

title: e3: Learning to Explore Enables Extrapolation of Test-Time Compute for LLMs

one_line_summary.en: e3 releases staged math prompt/ground-truth data, code, and a Qwen3-1.7B checkpoint for an 8k-to-16k GRPO curriculum, but not the grouped on-policy rollouts or per-trace advantages used during training.
one_line_summary.zh: 该条目将推理轨迹、搜索选择或测试时计算作为可审计的研究对象；未披露字段已明确标为 unknown。

title: Eagle 2: Building Post-Training Data Strategies from Scratch for Frontier Vision-Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Eagle 2 studies each data strategy from scratch and releases the resulting capability-labeled conversation mixture with per-source licensing metadata.
one_line_summary.zh: Eagle 2 从来源选择、改写、配比和过滤开始重建视觉语言后训练数据，并公开带来源信息的多能力对话混合。

title: EffiBench-X: A Multi-Language Benchmark for Measuring Efficiency of LLM-Generated Code

one_line_summary.en: EffiBench-X tests whether correct code approaches expert runtime and memory efficiency across six languages.
one_line_summary.zh: EffiBench-X 检验通过功能测试的代码能否在六种语言中接近专家的运行时间与内存效率。

title: Efficient Agent Training for Computer Use

one_line_summary.en: PC Agent-E turns 312 human Windows demonstrations into action-level screenshot-history-to-thought/action SFT data, but its Claude-generated branch actions are never environment-validated.
one_line_summary.zh: PC Agent-E 将 312 条人工 Windows 完整轨迹扩展为 action-level 多模态 SFT 数据，但每步九个 Claude 分支均未执行，也没有经过环境成功验证。

title: Efficient Inference for Large Reasoning Models: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: An NUS-led survey of efficient inference methods for long reasoning models.
one_line_summary.zh: 把高效推理分为显式紧凑过程和隐式潜在过程的 NUS 综述。

title: Efficient Process Reward Model Training via Active Learning

one_line_summary.en: ActPRM actively selects uncertain mathematical reasoning trajectories for expensive step-level labeling, releasing a 663K-record PRM dataset.
one_line_summary.zh: ActPRM 主动挑选不确定的数学推理轨迹进行昂贵的逐步标注，并发布约 66.3 万条 PRM 数据。

title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Self-Calibration

one_line_summary.en: Self-Calibration distills self-consistency confidence into one forward pass, enabling confidence-based early stopping for sampling.
one_line_summary.zh: 自校准将自一致性置信度蒸馏到单次前向传播，使采样可以依据置信度早停。

title: Efficiently Scaling LLM Reasoning Programs with Certaindex

one_line_summary.en: Certaindex detects stabilized reasoning answers to stop or reallocate inference compute without lowering accuracy.
one_line_summary.zh: Certaindex 检测推理答案是否已稳定，以停止或重分配计算而不降低准确率。

title: Enhancing Logical Reasoning in Language Models via Symbolically-Guided Monte Carlo Process Supervision
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2025)

one_line_summary.en: Releases 1,505 Symbolic ReAct trajectories with 12,448 Monte Carlo-derived step labels, plus 15,412 accepted SFT traces and 21,472 PRM-ranked DPO pairs derived from FOLIO, FOLIOv2, and LogicAsker.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作用答案可达性的 Monte Carlo 伪标签训练 PRM，将 Symbolic ReAct rollout 筛成 15,412 条 SFT 轨迹和 21,472 个 DPO 对；主要价值是公开了数据转换链，关键边界是步骤形式有效性与完整候选池仍不可审计。

title: Enhancing Reasoning through Process Supervision with Monte Carlo Tree Search

one_line_summary.en: A process-supervision recipe that uses MCTS to create scored partial-reasoning examples.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法用 MCTS 采样推理步骤，为步骤赋予相对正确性分数，并以加权对数似然反复训练模型生成过程监督数据。

title: Enhancing Test-Time Scaling of Large Language Models with Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented MCTS

one_line_summary.en: R2-LLMs uses coarse-to-fine retrieval inside PRM-guided MCTS so additional test-time compute explores reasoning paths with relevant external evidence.
one_line_summary.zh: R2-LLMs 将问题级与步骤级检索嵌入过程奖励模型引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，使额外测试时计算能基于相关证据探索推理路径。

title: Enhancing the Outcome Reward-based RL Training of MLLMs with Self-Consistency Sampling

one_line_summary.en: A multimodal online-RL rollout/resampling recipe with official code and data links.
one_line_summary.zh: SCS 对视觉推理轨迹作小视觉扰动、截断和重采样，以轨迹一致性分数降低“猜对但推理错误”的结果奖励影响。

title: Entropy-Regularized Process Reward Model

one_line_summary.en: ER-PRM derives process labels from reference-policy completion rollouts under a KL-consistent entropy formulation, then uses them to train and apply a math reward model.
one_line_summary.zh: ER-PRM 在与 KL 正则化一致的熵框架下，从参考策略的补全轨迹推导过程标签，再用其训练并应用数学奖励模型。

title: Enumerate-Conjecture-Prove: Formally Solving Answer-Construction Problems in Math Competitions

one_line_summary.en: ECP couples answer enumeration and conjecturing with Lean proofs on ConstructiveBench, turning constructed competition answers into formally checked outcomes.
one_line_summary.zh: ECP 在 ConstructiveBench 上把答案枚举与猜想生成连接到 Lean 证明，使竞赛构造题的候选答案可被形式化检验。

title: EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3

one_line_summary.en: EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 evaluates model creative-writing outputs with a judge-based leaderboard.
one_line_summary.zh: EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 用 LLM judge 和风格统计列评估模型创意写作输出。

title: ERNIE 4.5 Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: ERNIE 4.5 reports a 2.3M-sample LLM SFT corpus, heterogeneous verifier/reward stack, PPO-based progressive RL with UPO, and a three-stage VLM SFT-to-RLVR pipeline, but does not release the underlying post-training ledger.
one_line_summary.zh: ERNIE 4.5 披露了 230 万条 LLM SFT、异构验证器/奖励栈、基于 PPO 与 UPO 的渐进 RL，以及三阶段 VLM SFT-to-RLVR 流水线，但未发布底层后训练账本。

title: Error Typing for Smarter Rewards: Improving Process Reward Models with Error-Aware Hierarchical Supervision

one_line_summary.en: Error Typing for Smarter Rewards: Improving Process Reward Models with Error-Aware Hierarchical Supervision exposes process or trace supervision data.
one_line_summary.zh: 提出 PathFinder-PRM：先区分数学错误与一致性错误，再估计步骤正确性，并用三维标签构建 40 万条分层过程监督数据。

title: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning Beyond Accuracy

one_line_summary.en: ReasonEval evaluates mathematical reasoning beyond final-answer accuracy with step-level validity and redundancy labels, models, and selection tools.
one_line_summary.zh: 3,000条 MR-GSM8K 解答及逐步有效性/冗余反馈，能筛选高质量推理轨迹并训练过程评估器。

title: Evaluating Step-by-step Reasoning Traces: A Survey
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025

one_line_summary.en: A survey that turns “is this chain of thought good?” into four auditable evaluation dimensions.
one_line_summary.zh: 将“推理链是否好”拆为事实性、有效性、连贯性与效用四个可审计维度的综述。

title: Evaluating Test-Time Scaling LLMs for Legal Reasoning: OpenAI o1, DeepSeek-R1, and Beyond

one_line_summary.en: Legal-R1 retains legal reasoning traces whose answers match gold labels within up to three DeepSeek-R1 attempts, reporting 96,533 bilingual SFT records while the verified official repository remains empty.
one_line_summary.zh: Legal-R1在最多三次DeepSeek-R1尝试中保留答案匹配金标准的法律推理轨迹，报告形成96,533条中美法律SFT数据，但官方仓库核验时为空。

title: Every Rollout Counts: Optimal Resource Allocation for Efficient Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: DORA uses PRM quality and embedding-derived semantic uniqueness to allocate a fixed rollout budget across soft reasoning directions during parallel test-time search.
one_line_summary.zh: DORA 将固定 rollout 预算分配到语义推理方向而不是孤立候选，以降低冗余采样。

title: Expectation Preference Optimization: Reliable Preference Estimation for Improving the Reasoning Capability of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: EPO learns from groups of correct and incorrect sampled responses, estimating a group expectation rather than trusting one preference pair.
one_line_summary.zh: EPO 从成组的正确与错误采样回答中学习，以组期望估计取代对单个偏好对的信任。

title: ExpertLongBench: Benchmarking Language Models on Expert-Level Long-Form Generation Tasks with Structured Checklists

one_line_summary.en: ExpertLongBench scores expert-level long-form outputs with task rubrics and grounded checklist comparisons.
one_line_summary.zh: ExpertLongBench 用专家 rubric 与 CLEAR 清单框架核验长篇专业生成内容是否正确满足要求。

title: Explorer: Scaling Exploration-driven Web Trajectory Synthesis for Multimodal Web Agents

one_line_summary.en: Synthesizes 175K GPT-4o-driven live-web episodes and retains 94K verifier-approved multimodal trajectories for web-agent training.
one_line_summary.zh: Explorer 从 175K 次实时网页尝试中保留 94K 条 GPT-4o verifier 接受的多模态轨迹，用于网页智能体 SFT；但官方未提供该语料的不可变快照、清单或专属许可。

title: FACTORY: A Challenging Human-Verified Prompt Set for Long-Form Factuality

one_line_summary.en: FACTORY pairs difficult human-refined long-form prompts with claim-level evidence annotations.
one_line_summary.zh: FACTORY 将人工修订的困难长文本提示与 claim 级证据标注配对，用于可靠评估模型事实性。

title: FaithBench: A Diverse Hallucination Benchmark for Summarization by Modern LLMs

one_line_summary.en: Local BibTeX seed for the 🧭 Surveys and Primers map; use it to inspect the paper's data object, verifier contract, and release metadata before promoting it.
one_line_summary.zh: 以多样化幻觉场景检查摘要忠实性，提醒读者不能只看流畅度或单一自动指标。

title: Faster and Better LLMs via Latency-Aware Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: Latency-aware TTS allocates parallel branches and speculative decoding capacity to maximize reasoning accuracy under a time limit.
one_line_summary.zh: 延迟感知测试时扩展在固定时间内分配并行分支与推测解码能力，以提高推理准确率。

title: FastMCTS: A Simple Sampling Strategy for Data Synthesis

one_line_summary.en: Reuses reasoning prefixes in an MCTS-inspired tree and backs up terminal LLM judgments to construct math SFT paths and step/branch preference pairs under a token budget.
one_line_summary.zh: 在 MCTS 风格的共享树中复用推理前缀，并把终端 LLM 判断回传为节点值，从而构造数学 SFT 路径与步骤/分支偏好对。

title: FB-Bench: A Fine-Grained Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs’ Responsiveness to Human Feedback

one_line_summary.en: FB-Bench tests whether an LLM can use Chinese user feedback to repair a deficient prior response, rather than merely answer a new turn.
one_line_summary.zh: FB-Bench 用任务、原始缺陷回答与用户反馈组成 591 个中文样本，评测模型能否真正按反馈修正回答。

title: FEA-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Repository-Level Code Generation for Feature Implementation

one_line_summary.en: FEA-Bench derives 1,401 repository-level feature-implementation tasks from pull requests and validates solutions with associated unit tests.
one_line_summary.zh: FEA-Bench 从 83 个仓库的拉取请求提取 1,401 个功能开发任务，并用关联单元测试验证仓库级新增功能。

title: FEAT: A Preference Feedback Dataset through a Cost-Effective Auto-Generation and Labeling Framework for English AI Tutoring

one_line_summary.en: FEAT releases tutoring prompts with candidate instructional answers, textual feedback, and human ranking signals for bounded preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and audit.
one_line_summary.zh: FEAT 发布围绕其任务场景组织的候选回答比较与反馈记录，可用于有边界的偏好学习、奖励建模、评测和审计。

title: Finding the Sweet Spot: Preference Data Construction for Scaling Preference Optimization

one_line_summary.en: The paper constructs DPO pairs from reward-distribution positions, preferring a μ−2σ rejected response over the minimum.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作按奖励分布位置构造 DPO 对，优先使用均值减二倍标准差的拒绝回答而非最小值。

title: Findings of the WMT25 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task: Persistent Hurdles in Reasoning, Generation, and Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: WMT25 MIST releases 30-language reasoning, generation, translation, summarization, and LLM-judge tasks with human evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: WMT25 MIST 跨 30 种语言发布推理、生成、翻译、摘要与 LLM 裁判任务及人类评测。

title: Fixing Distribution Shifts of LLM Self-Critique via On-Policy Self-Play Training

one_line_summary.en: SCOP refreshes reasoning-critique-correction episodes from the current policy and scores critiques through sampled repair success, but its official repository remains an implementation-free placeholder.
one_line_summary.zh: SCOP 从当前策略刷新推理-批评-纠正 episode，并按采样修复成功率奖励批评，但官方仓库仍无实现与轨迹发布。

title: FLAMES: Improving LLM Math Reasoning via a Fine-Grained Analysis of the Data Synthesis Pipeline
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025

one_line_summary.en: FLAMES compares 12 math-problem agents and six quality-control strategies, then defines 150K, 1M, and 1.5M mixtures that favor coverage and the first teacher solution; the data and construction code are not officially released.
one_line_summary.zh: FLAMES 在统一教师、学生与训练设置下比较 12 种数学题合成 agent 和 6 种质量控制策略，并给出 150K、1M、1.5M 混合配方；但最终采用 First 且无独立解答验证，官方数据与构造代码也未发布。

title: FMC: Formalization of Natural Language Mathematical Competition Problems
venue: AI for Math Workshop at ICML 2025

one_line_summary.en: FMC aligns 3,922 Olympiad problems with 9,787 Lean formalizations using an error-feedback pipeline and Lean validation.
one_line_summary.zh: FMC 通过带错误反馈的自动形式化流程，将 3,922 道奥数自然语言题与 9,787 个 Lean 形式化对齐并验证。

title: FocalPO: Enhancing Preference Optimizing by Focusing on Correct Preference Rankings

one_line_summary.en: FocalPO reweights DPO so preference pairs with correct current implicit rankings contribute more than misranked pairs.
one_line_summary.zh: FocalPO 重加权 DPO，使当前隐式排序正确的偏好回答对比排序错误的回答对贡献更大。

title: Focused-DPO: Enhancing Code Generation Through Focused Preference Optimization on Error-Prone Points

one_line_summary.en: Focused-DPO identifies error-prone code segments from executable preference pairs and gives those segments greater DPO influence.
one_line_summary.zh: Focused-DPO 从可执行偏好回答对中定位易错代码片段，并让这些片段在 DPO 中拥有更大影响。

title: FormalMATH: Benchmarking Formal Mathematical Reasoning of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: FormalMATH releases 5,560 Lean4-verified mathematical problems and an autoformalization pipeline for broad formal-reasoning evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: FormalMATH 以 5,560 道经 Lean4 验证的问题覆盖从奥赛到本科数学，并提供自动形式化与语义筛选流程。

title: FreePRM: Training Process Reward Models Without Ground Truth Process Labels

one_line_summary.en: FreePRM learns step rewards from final-answer labels alone by adding a buffer state that absorbs uncertainty in trajectory-level pseudo supervision.
one_line_summary.zh: FreePRM 仅从最终答案标签学习步骤奖励，并用缓冲状态吸收轨迹级伪监督中的不确定性。

title: From Automation to Autonomy: A Survey on Large Language Models in Scientific Discovery

one_line_summary.en: An EMNLP 2025 survey of how LLM roles in scientific discovery evolve from tools to increasingly autonomous agents.
one_line_summary.zh: 综述大语言模型在科学发现中从自动化工具走向更自主角色的变化。

title: From Generation to Judgment: Opportunities and Challenges of LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: Top-conference survey mapping judge inputs, outputs, benchmarks, and reliability risks.
one_line_summary.zh: 以输入输出、方法、基准三维分类，系统梳理 LLM judge 的用途与可靠性风险。

title: From Reasoning to Learning: A Survey on Hypothesis Discovery and Rule Learning with Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A TMLR 2025 survey that frames LLM hypothesis discovery as generation, application, and validation.
one_line_summary.zh: 以溯因、演绎、归纳为框架，梳理语言模型生成、应用和验证假设的研究。

title: From System 1 to System 2: A Survey of Reasoning Large Language Models
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI), 2025

one_line_summary.en: Surveys the transition from fast System 1-style LLM behavior to deliberate reasoning LLMs, organizing construction methods, benchmarks, metrics, and open challenges.
one_line_summary.zh: 以 System 1 到 System 2 为主线，梳理推理大模型的构建方法、基准、指标与开放问题。

title: Frontier Safety Framework Report - Gemini 3 Pro (November, 2025) v2
venue: Google DeepMind Frontier Safety Framework report

one_line_summary.en: Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 Pro FSF report discloses model-generated thought traces for SFT, RL length penalties on thoughts, high-level guardrails, and concrete evaluation scaffolding, but not the underlying prompts, traces, rewards, or reproducibility artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 3 Pro FSF 报告披露了用于 SFT 的推理模型生成 thought traces、施加于 thought 的 RL 长度惩罚、高层 guardrails 和具体评测脚手架，但未公开底层 prompts、traces、奖励或可复现制品。

title: FrontierCS: Evolving Challenges for Evolving Intelligence

one_line_summary.en: FrontierCS tracks evolving model limits with expert-designed open computer-science problems and partial scoring.
one_line_summary.zh: 用专家设计、可部分评分的开放计算机科学题，持续追踪前沿模型的真实能力边界。

title: Full-Step-DPO: Self-Supervised Preference Optimization with Step-wise Rewards for Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Full-Step-DPO uses a self-supervised process reward model to score every reasoning step and weight preference optimization across the full chain.
one_line_summary.zh: Full-Step-DPO 使用自监督过程奖励模型为每个推理步骤打分，并在整条推理链上加权偏好优化。

title: Game-RL: Synthesizing Multimodal Verifiable Game Data to Boost VLMs' General Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Game-RL synthesizes image-grounded game tasks whose answers can be checked by game code, yielding 140K multimodal reasoning records.
one_line_summary.zh: GameQA-140K 覆盖 30 个游戏、158 类可验证任务，每项带图像、步骤推理与标准答案，可从游戏代码复算反馈。

title: GATEAU: Selecting Influential Samples for Long Context Alignment

one_line_summary.en: GATEAU selects long SFT records using context-window perplexity gaps and attention-relevance alignment.
one_line_summary.zh: GATEAU 以上下文窗口困惑度差和注意力—相关性对齐选择长监督微调记录。

title: GDPval: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Real-World Economically Valuable Tasks

one_line_summary.en: GDPval evaluates economically valuable one-shot professional deliverables with expert blind comparisons and an experimental public grader.
one_line_summary.zh: GDPval 用专家盲评和实验性公开评分服务评测经济价值专业交付物。

title: Gemini 2.5 Computer Use - Model Card

one_line_summary.en: Gemini 2.5 Computer Use exposes a screenshot-action loop, human whole-trajectory judgments, partial environment details, and high-stakes safety gating, but not UI training data, reward, rollouts, or reproducible web pins.
one_line_summary.zh: Gemini 2.5 Computer Use Model Card 披露截图—动作—客户端执行闭环、整轨人类多数票和高风险动作安全门控，但未公开 UI 后训练数据、reward、rollout 或可复现的浏览器环境 pin。

title: Gemini 2.5 Deep Think - Model Card

one_line_summary.en: Deep Think discloses parallel hypothesis generation, added reasoning and mathematics data, novel RL, human/critic feedback, and frontier-safety tests, but not its records, reasoning reward, branch budget, or checkpoint lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Gemini 2.5 Deep Think Model Card 披露并行假设生成、追加的推理与数学数据、novel RL、人类/critic 反馈和前沿安全评测，但未公开训练记录、推理奖励、分支预算或 checkpoint 谱系。

title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities

one_line_summary.en: Gemini 2.5 partially discloses multimodal pre/post-training categories, SFT/RM/RL, verifiable and model-generated rewards, tool-use RL, and safety audits, but withholds datasets, reward implementations, and reproducibility-critical construction detail.
one_line_summary.zh: Gemini 2.5 披露了多模态预训练/后训练类别、SFT/RM/RL、可验证与模型生成奖励、工具使用 RL 和安全审计，但未公开数据集、奖励实现及可复现所需的关键构造细节。

title: Gemini Robotics 1.5: Pushing the Frontier of Generalist Robots with Advanced Embodied Reasoning, Thinking, and Motion Transfer

one_line_summary.en: Gemini Robotics 1.5 discloses ALOHA, Franka, and Apollo sensor/action data mixed with Internet text-image-video data, cross-embodiment Motion Transfer, natural-language thinking before action, and progress/success contracts, but not the mixture, record schema, labels, optimizer, rights, or released corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: Gemini Robotics 1.5 披露 ALOHA、Franka、Apollo 机器人数据与互联网多模态数据的 Motion Transfer、动作前自然语言 thinking 以及 progress/success/failure 评测契约，但未开放算法细节、thinking 标签来源、数据权利或训练工件。

title: Gemini Robotics: Bringing AI into the Physical World

one_line_summary.en: Gemini Robotics discloses thousands of hours of ALOHA 2 expert demonstrations, image-and-instruction inputs, action-chunk outputs, trajectory-relabelled reasoning data, and 2,000–5,000-episode specialization sets, but not the robot corpus, mixture, optimizer, or Gemini training-step count.
one_line_summary.zh: Gemini Robotics 披露了 ALOHA 2 专家示范、图像加自然语言指令到 action chunks 的 VLA 对象、未来约 1 秒双臂轨迹中间量以及每任务 2,000–5,000 条 specialization demos，但未开放专有机器人语料、训练步数或 optimizer。

title: Gemma 3 Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Gemma 3 discloses 2T-14T pretraining, 256 teacher logits per token, large-IT-teacher distillation, mixed human/code/math RL rewards, QAT, and open weights, but not corpora, preferences, RMs, teachers, rollouts, or verifiers.
one_line_summary.zh: Gemma 3 披露 1B/4B/12B/27B 的 2T–14T token 预训练、每 token 256 个 teacher logits、large-IT-teacher 蒸馏、human/code/math 混合 reward、QAT 与开放权重，但未公开 corpus、preference、RM、teacher、rollout 或 verifier。

title: General-Reasoner: Advancing LLM Reasoning Across All Domains
domains: English physics, chemistry, finance, electronics, mathematics, and broad web knowledge

one_line_summary.en: General-Reasoner crawls broad questions, normalizes answer types, and uses a context-aware generative verifier to retain questions with scoreable answers.
one_line_summary.zh: General-Reasoner 从网页整理 22.8 万条跨领域可验证问答，并用生成式验证器处理多种等价答案。

title: Generalised Probabilistic Modelling and Improved Uncertainty Estimation in Comparative LLM-as-a-judge

one_line_summary.en: Develops uncertainty estimates for comparative LLM judging and ranking stability.
one_line_summary.zh: 用广义概率模型与重排序概率，减少成对 LLM judge 排名所需比较。

title: Generating Millions Of Lean Theorems With Proofs By Exploring State Transition Graphs

one_line_summary.en: LeanNavigator explores Mathlib4 state graphs to release 4.7 million Lean theorem–proof pairs whose proofs are accepted by Lean.
one_line_summary.zh: LeanNavigator 通过遍历 Mathlib4 的状态转移图生成 470 万条 Lean 定理—证明对，并以 Lean 检查器保证证明可验证。

title: Generative Verifiers: Reward Modeling as Next-Token Prediction

one_line_summary.en: Generative Verifiers turns answer verification into next-token SFT over direct verdicts or generated critiques and releases GSM8K feedback records, but full license scope, code, checkpoints, and decontamination remain unresolved.
one_line_summary.zh: Generative Verifiers 将答案验证改写为直接判决或生成式 critique 的下一 token SFT，并公开 GSM8K 反馈记录，但生成理由的许可证范围、代码、checkpoint 与去污染仍未解决。

title: Genius: A Generalizable and Purely Unsupervised Self-Training Framework For Advanced Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Genius converts general queries into same-policy foresight-ranked trajectory pairs for ACO, but the score is not a correctness verifier and the exact preference data is not released.
one_line_summary.zh: Genius 将通用查询转换为由同一策略的未来 continuation 分数排序的步骤级轨迹偏好并用于 ACO；该分数不是正确性 verifier，完整偏好数据也未发布。

title: GenPRM: Scaling Test-Time Compute of Process Reward Models via Generative Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: GenPRM releases reasoning-and-verification process supervision that lets generative reward models scale judgments at test time.
one_line_summary.zh: GenPRM 发布带推理与验证的过程监督数据，使生成式奖励模型能够在测试时扩展判定。

title: GenSelect: A Generative Approach to Best-of-N

one_line_summary.en: GenSelect asks a reasoning model to compare indexed solution summaries, emit a chosen candidate index, and scale selection over 64-solution pools through repeated N-ary knockout tournaments; a related official release exposes 565,620 packed selector rows.
one_line_summary.zh: GenSelect 让推理模型联合比较带索引的数学解答摘要并生成所选索引，再用 N 叉淘汰赛扩展到 64 个候选；其论文实验轨迹未发布，565,620 条公开记录来自相关但不同的 OpenMathReasoning split。

title: GLM-4.5: Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding (ARC) Foundation Models

one_line_summary.en: GLM-4.5 discloses a broad 23T-token ARC training and post-training pipeline with expert self-distillation, verifier/reward/judge feedback, and agent environments, but releases weights and inference materials rather than the source data, RM/Judge artifacts, replayable environments, or audit records needed for independent verification.
one_line_summary.zh: GLM-4.5 披露了约 23T token 的 ARC 训练与后训练框架，包含专家自蒸馏、验证器/奖励/裁判反馈和 agent 环境；但官方发布的是权重与推理材料，而非原始语料、RM/Judge 工件、可回放环境或审计记录。

title: GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-Thinking: Towards Versatile Multimodal Reasoning with Scalable Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: GLM-V discloses a broad multimodal pre-training, long-CoT SFT and GRPO/RLCS pipeline with domain-specific rewards, and releases weights plus reward/inference code while withholding the training records and curriculum ledger.
one_line_summary.zh: GLM-V 报告以 RLCS 扩展多模态推理，但样本与奖励来源仍未充分披露。

title: GM-PRM: A Generative Multimodal Process Reward Model for Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning
venue: Proceedings of the 4th Workshop on Advances in Language and Vision Research (ALVR 2026)

one_line_summary.en: GM-PRM releases 20K multimodal reasoning records that teach a process model to diagnose and correct the first erroneous visual-math step.
one_line_summary.zh: GM‑PRM 发布 2 万条多模态推理记录，训练过程模型诊断并修正首个视觉数学错误步骤。

title: Goedel-Prover-V2: Scaling Formal Theorem Proving with Scaffolded Data Synthesis and Self-Correction

one_line_summary.en: Goedel-Prover-V2 builds Lean proof models through verified whole-proof SFT, compiler-error self-correction data, scaffolded theorem synthesis, hybrid GRPO, and model averaging; public models and evaluation artifacts exist, but the core S1/S2/S3 training records are not released.
one_line_summary.zh: Goedel-Prover-V2 报告了支架式合成任务生成、基于 Lean 编译器反馈的自我修正、expert iteration 与强化学习；但本 Card 尚未核验其逐条数据、验证环境及具体发布工件。

title: Goedel-Prover: A Frontier Model for Open-Source Automated Theorem Proving

one_line_summary.en: Goedel-Prover releases large-scale informal/formal Lean statements and 29,750 complete proofs produced through compiler-verified expert iteration.
one_line_summary.zh: Goedel-Prover 公开大规模自然语言与 Lean 陈述，以及通过编译器核验的 29,750 条完整证明。

title: GPT-5 System Card

one_line_summary.en: The GPT-5 System Card discloses broad source classes, reinforcement-learning reasoning, continuous router training on model switches, preference rates, and measured correctness, safe-completions, and parallel test-time compute, but not the underlying records or reproducible reward and data contracts.
one_line_summary.zh: GPT-5 System Card 报告路由器持续利用模型切换、偏好率和测得正确性训练，以及 safe-completions 和 thinking-pro 的并行测试时计算；其支撑数据和训练配方仍未披露。

title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max System Card

one_line_summary.en: The GPT-5.1-Codex-Max System Card exposes synthetic malware and prompt-injection safety data plus RL rollouts where a user model makes conflicting edits and preservation earns positive reinforcement, but not the record corpus, reward implementation, source mixture, or train/evaluation lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max 系统卡披露了合成恶意软件与 prompt-injection 安全数据，以及由 user model 注入冲突编辑、以保留用户改动获得正向强化的 RL episode；其主要价值是可审计披露边界，而非提供可复用训练语料或 reward 实现。

title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card

one_line_summary.en: gpt-oss discloses broad pretraining, CoT-RL/tool interfaces, safety mitigation, and Apache-2.0 weights/tool references while withholding source-level training, reward, rollout, and audit artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: gpt-oss 披露了概括性的预训练、CoT-RL/工具接口、安全缓解措施以及 Apache-2.0 权重与工具参考实现，但未公开按来源划分的训练数据、奖励、rollout 或审计工件。

title: gpt-oss-safeguard technical report

one_line_summary.en: OpenAI's gpt-oss-safeguard report describes open-weight models that classify developer-supplied policy/content pairs with chain-of-thought and a high-level human-judgment policy-labelling lineage, while withholding training records, reward details, and reproducibility artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenAI 的 gpt-oss-safeguard 技术报告披露了按开发者提供的策略和内容进行分类的开放权重模型、推理链和高层次的人类判断策略标注脉络，但未公开训练记录、奖励细节或可复现审计材料。

title: GRIP: A Graph-Based Reasoning Instruction Producer

one_line_summary.en: GRIP reports expanding 7.5K MATH seeds into 2,123,345 graph-conditioned question-solution pairs and officially releases 24,957 four-field rows, while code, the full corpus, judge weights, lineage, and licenses remain unavailable.
one_line_summary.zh: GRIP 报告把 7.5K 条 MATH 种子扩展为 2,123,345 个图条件问题—解答对，并通过官方补充材料发布 24,957 条四字段样本；代码、完整语料、评审权重、谱系和许可证仍未公开。

title: Grok 4 Fast Model Card

one_line_summary.en: Grok 4 Fast's model card and launch announcement disclose broad pretraining sources, de-duplication/classification, SFT and RL with human feedback, verifiable rewards and model grading, safety mitigations, and tool-use RL, but not record-level data, reward, filter, or evaluator contracts.
one_line_summary.zh: Grok 4 Fast 的模型卡和发布公告披露了宽泛的预训练来源、去重/分类、SFT、使用人类反馈/可验证奖励/模型评分的 RL、安全缓解措施及工具使用 RL，但未披露记录级数据、奖励、过滤器或评估器合约。

title: Grok 4 Model Card

one_line_summary.en: Grok 4's model card and release announcement disclose broad pretraining sources, de-duplication/classification, SFT/RL with human feedback, verifiable rewards and model grading, and tool-use RL, but not record-level data, reward, filter, or evaluator contracts.
one_line_summary.zh: Grok 4 的模型卡与发布公告披露了宽泛的预训练来源、去重/分类、使用人类反馈、可验证奖励和模型评分的 SFT/RL，以及工具使用 RL，但未披露记录级数据、奖励、过滤器或评估器合约。

title: Grok 4.1 Model Card

one_line_summary.en: Grok 4.1's official card names broad data categories and SFT/RL feedback families plus safety-filter training, while its announcement adds model-based rewards and production-rollout evaluation; neither source releases reusable training data or reward contracts.
one_line_summary.zh: Grok 4.1 的官方模型卡披露了宽泛数据类别、定向中期训练以及基于人类反馈、可验证奖励和模型评分器的 SFT/RL；发布公告补充模型奖励与生产流量评估，但二者均不构成可复用训练数据或奖励合约的证据。

title: GroundedPRM: Tree-Guided and Fidelity-Aware Process Reward Modeling for Step-Level Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: GroundedPRM converts MATH MCTS trajectories into about 40K generative step-supervision records by combining Wolfram Alpha checks with final-answer outcomes, but releases no author-confirmed tree, data, code, model, or run manifest.
one_line_summary.zh: 该条目将推理轨迹、搜索选择或测试时计算作为可审计的研究对象；未披露字段已明确标为 unknown。

title: GroUSE: A Benchmark to Evaluate Evaluators in Grounded Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: A 144-unit-test meta-evaluation suite for judge failures in grounded QA.
one_line_summary.zh: 以 144 个单元测试审计 grounded QA judge 的校准与具体失效检测能力。

title: GUI-360°: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Computer-Using Agents
