venue: arXiv preprint; submitted to ICLR 2026 (no acceptance decision verified)

one_line_summary.en: GUI-360° releases 17,189 successful and 62,170 failed Windows Office trajectories with screenshots, accessibility state, reasoning, and GUI/API actions, then derives grounding, screen-parsing, and action-prediction SFT/benchmark data; the collector, replay environment, judge prompt, and claimed RL setup remain incomplete.
one_line_summary.zh: GUI-360° 发布约 574 GB 的 Windows Office 多模态 GUI/API 轨迹、独立保留的失败轨迹及四类 SFT-ready 数据，但未发布 TrajAgent/EvaAgent 采集栈、VM replay、judge prompt 或可执行 terminal checker。

title: HalluCounter: Reference-free LLM Hallucination Detection in the Wild!

one_line_summary.en: HalluCounterEval is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
one_line_summary.zh: HalluCounterEval 发布合成与人工专家标注的问答响应，并保留幻觉二元标记、置信度和最优回答，适合黑盒模型输出质量监督。

title: HALoGEN: Fantastic LLM Hallucinations and Where to Find Them

one_line_summary.en: HALoGEN is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
one_line_summary.zh: 以九类真实生成场景、10,923 提示和原子事实核验器标注 150K 输出，并按幻觉来源给出可解释 taxonomy，适合通用事实性研究。

title: Harnessing the Reasoning Economy: A Survey of Efficient Reasoning for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A 2025 survey of how to reduce redundant reasoning without confusing fewer tokens with better reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: 讨论如何减少冗长推理，同时不把少输出误当成更会推理的 2025 综述。

title: HelpSteer2-Preference: Complementing Ratings with Preferences

one_line_summary.en: HelpSteer2-Preference: Complementing Ratings with Preferences contributes a preference/reward feedback data object or construction method.
one_line_summary.zh: 将 HelpSteer2 的多维评分补充为成对偏好数据，并比较评分监督与偏好监督对奖励模型训练的作用。

title: HelpSteer3-Preference: Open Human-Annotated Preference Data across Diverse Tasks and Languages

one_line_summary.en: HelpSteer3-Preference is a CC-BY-4.0 human-annotated, multilingual and specialist preference dataset for reward modeling and RLHF.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 HelpSteer3-Preference 多任务、多语言人工偏好数据，扩展通用、STEM 与中文场景的奖励模型监督覆盖。

title: Herald: A Natural Language Annotated Lean 4 Dataset

one_line_summary.en: Herald dependency-orders Mathlib informalization, retrieves from 1,000 manual examples, and augments statements through tactic states and LLM rewrites, but omits the construction code, exact source revision, row lineage, rejects, and decontamination evidence.
one_line_summary.zh: Herald 按依赖层级对 Mathlib4 进行非形式化，检索 1,000 个人工示例，并通过 tactic state 与 LLM 改写扩充数据；它公开 579,883 条 statement rows 和 44,553 条 proof rows，但未公开完整构造代码、精确源版本、逐行 lineage、rejects 与去污染证据。

title: Holistic Agent Leaderboard: The Missing Infrastructure for AI Agent Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: HAL standardizes nine agent benchmarks into cost-aware run archives with task evaluator outputs and Weave call logs; the paper reports 21,730 rollouts/2.5B tokens, but the mutable 113 GB release lacks a dataset card, license, and frozen paper manifest.
one_line_summary.zh: HAL 将九个异构 agent benchmark 统一为带任务 evaluator、成本与 Weave 调用轨迹的评测运行；但论文的 21,730 个 rollout、项目当前的 26,597 个 rollout 与 HF 当前 380 个加密 run archive 不能混为同一语料快照。

title: How Contaminated Is Your Benchmark? Measuring Dataset Leakage in Large Language Models with Kernel Divergence

one_line_summary.en: Kernel Divergence Score compares embedding-kernel structure before and after benchmark fine-tuning to quantify leakage.
one_line_summary.zh: 以微调前后样本嵌入核矩阵的结构变化，量化候选基准的数据集级泄漏。

title: How Much Can We Forget about Data Contamination?

one_line_summary.en: Controlled training experiments measure when repeated benchmark exposure is forgotten as training data scales.
one_line_summary.zh: 基准污染的影响取决于重复次数、模型与训练规模；大量后续新数据可使早期污染痕迹自然遗忘。

title: How Reliable is Multilingual LLM-as-a-Judge?

one_line_summary.en: Accepted multilingual judge-reliability study with public ACL paper materials.
one_line_summary.zh: 审计多语 LLM 评测器的跨语言一致性，发现平均 Fleiss' Kappa 约为 0.3。

title: How to Evaluate Reward Models for RLHF

one_line_summary.en: PPE evaluates reward models on human-preference and correctness proxies calibrated against real post-RLHF preference outcomes.
one_line_summary.zh: PPE 将 12 个领域的人类偏好与可验证正确性代理指标连接到真实 RLHF 后效，适合检验奖励数据是否真正有训练价值。

title: Hunyuan-A13B Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: A frontier-model disclosure describing a >20T-token foundation corpus, a 250B-token STEM subset, four post-training stages, a 150K-problem reasoning-RL mixture, a five-role agent synthesis engine, and a multi-service reward stack, while leaving record-level data and rollout artefacts unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: Hunyuan-A13B 报告了 20T 级数据、250B STEM 数据、四个 SFT/RL 阶段、GRPO 及 sandbox/GRM 反馈；但来源清单、教师模型、奖励权重和审计工件仍未披露或未核验。

title: Hunyuan-MT Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Hunyuan-MT maps a reported 1.3T multilingual foundation through RegMix-style CPT, a 3M-to-268K SFT funnel, judge-based GRPO, and six-candidate Chimera fusion, but releases no training manifests, rewards, rollouts, splits, or paper-run lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Hunyuan-MT 将论文所述 1.3T 多语基础，经 RegMix-style CPT、3M→268K SFT 漏斗、judge-based GRPO 与六候选 Chimera fusion 串成完整路线，但未发布训练 manifest、reward、rollout、split 或 paper-run lineage。

title: Hunyuan-T1

one_line_summary.en: Hunyuan-T1 reports that 96.7% of post-training compute went to RL over broad science-and-reasoning problems, with curriculum, replay/reset, ground-truth feedback, and T1-preview-plus-reward-model preference scoring, but releases none of the underlying training records or reward implementation.
one_line_summary.zh: Hunyuan-T1 披露了重 RL 的后训练、课程和混合奖励，但未公开数据与奖励账本。

title: Hunyuan-TurboS: Advancing Large Language Models through Mamba-Transformer Synergy and Adaptive Chain-of-Thought

one_line_summary.en: Hunyuan-TurboS reports 16T pre-training tokens, 3M SFT samples, adaptive teacher-generated traces, about 200K human preference labels, more than 800K executable code samples, and 300K plus 160K two-stage GRPO inputs, but releases no training corpus, weights, construction code, reward checkpoints, or replay ledger.
one_line_summary.zh: Hunyuan-TurboS 报告 300 万条 SFT 指令、自适应长短 CoT、人工标注 GRM、代码沙箱反馈和两阶段 GRPO，但未公开来源 manifest 与多数关键复现配置。

title: Hybrid Preferences: Learning to Route Instances for Human vs. AI Feedback

one_line_summary.en: Hybrid Preferences releases MultiPref, where the same response comparisons carry crowdworker, expert, and language-model feedback for studying when human annotation is worth its additional cost.
one_line_summary.zh: Hybrid Preferences 发布 MultiPref：同一回答比较同时带有众包、专家和语言模型反馈，用于研究何时值得为人工标注付出额外成本。

title: ICON2: Aligning Large Language Models Using Self-Synthetic Preference Data via Inherent Regulation

one_line_summary.en: ICON2 filters self-synthesized instructions by representation consistency and directly generates chosen and rejected responses through opposite internal steering directions.
one_line_summary.zh: ICON2 以表征一致性筛选自合成指令，再用相反的内部引导方向直接生成优选和拒选回答。

title: ImpossibleBench: Measuring LLMs' Propensity of Exploiting Test Cases

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** Conflicting specifications and tests make every pass a deterministic cheating label.
one_line_summary.zh: 通过构造规格与测试冲突的任务，让任何 pass 都成为确定性作弊标签。

title: Improve LLM-as-a-Judge Ability as a General Ability

one_line_summary.en: Two-stage SFT-DPO training turns filtered pairwise judgments into an open generative judge and tests its downstream preference signals.
one_line_summary.zh: 以经双重核验的成对判决数据进行 SFT-DPO 训练，并审计其作为偏好信号的效用。

title: Improving In-Context Learning with Reasoning Distillation

one_line_summary.en: ReDis distils rule generation and rule following into smaller models for inductive in-context learning.
one_line_summary.zh: ReDis 将规则生成和规则遵循蒸馏到较小模型中，以改善归纳式上下文学习。

title: Improving Rationality in the Reasoning Process of Language Models through Self-playing Game

one_line_summary.en: CDG generates one-step Prover–Critic–revision episodes and converts correctness- thresholded helpful, misleading, corrected, and resistant outcomes into role-specific training data.
one_line_summary.zh: CDG 生成一次 Prover—Critic—修订回合，并把通过正确性阈值筛选的纠错、误导、修正与抗误导结果转成分角色训练数据。

title: Ineq-Comp: Benchmarking Human-Intuitive Compositional Reasoning in Automated Theorem Proving on Inequalities

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** A 375-task Lean benchmark created by controlled transformations of elementary inequalities to test composition.
one_line_summary.zh: 375 个从基础不等式受控变换得到的 Lean 任务，专门测组合泛化。

title: Inference-Time Scaling for Generalist Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: A generalist reward-model pipeline whose inference-time scaling relies on generated principles and critiques.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作以 SPCT 让通用生成式奖励模型在线生成原则和批评，再以并行采样和 Meta RM 投票扩展奖励判断的测试时计算。

title: Inference-time Scaling of Diffusion Models through Classical Search

one_line_summary.en: Classical search improves diffusion inference through verifier-guided Langevin local search and BFS/DFS global exploration.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作以朗之万局部搜索和 BFS/DFS 全局搜索扩展扩散模型推理。

title: InSTA: Towards Internet-Scale Training For Agents
venue: arXiv preprint; submitted to ICLR 2026 (no acceptance record found)

one_line_summary.en: InSTA combines an LLM safety and task proposer, one live Playwright exploration loop, LLM-agent rollouts, and LLM success judgment to construct internet-scale web-agent SFT data.
one_line_summary.zh: InSTA 用 LLM 对 100 万个 Common Crawl 排名站点进行安全筛选与任务生成，再以 live Playwright rollout 和 LLM success judge 构造 web-agent SFT 数据；论文与 v2 的精确任务数为 146,746，但当前官方发布只有约 146K 条 task rows 与 recipe code，没有论文声称的完整 multimodal trajectories、失败样本、judge rationales 或 checkpoints。

title: INTELLECT-3: Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Prime Intellect reports SFT and asynchronous RL of a 106B MoE on released verifier-backed environments, with open infrastructure but no frozen run-level data manifest.
one_line_summary.zh: Prime Intellect 披露了 106B MoE 的 SFT 与大规模异步 RL 基础设施和环境，但未提供冻结的运行级数据清单。

title: InterMT: Multi-Turn Interleaved Preference Alignment with Human Feedback

one_line_summary.en: InterMT releases human preference annotations for competing multi-turn, interleaved image-text conversations, covering both local turns and complete interaction trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: InterMT 发布竞争性多轮图文交错对话的人工偏好标注，同时覆盖局部回合与完整交互轨迹。

title: Intern-S1: A Scientific Multimodal Foundation Model

one_line_summary.en: Intern-S1 reports 5T continual-pretraining tokens, best-of-N instruction curation, and 8-rollout online RL across more than 1,000 Internbootcamp tasks using CompassVerifier, rules, environment feedback, and POLAR-7B; weights are open, but training records and the full reward stack are not.
one_line_summary.zh: Intern-S1 报告了 5T 持续预训练 token（其中超过 2.5T 为科学 token），以及 InternBootCamp 中从离线到在线的 RL 与覆盖超过 1,000 个任务的 Mixture-of-Rewards；任务、数据和奖励细节仍为 unknown。

title: Introducing MAI-DS-R1
venue: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry technical release

one_line_summary.en: Microsoft's MAI-DS-R1 release reports about 350K keyword-derived multilingual questions with DeepSeek-R1/internal-model bootstrapped answers and CoT plus 110K named Tulu3 safety examples, but not the underlying records, feedback contract, splits, or source-level rights.
one_line_summary.zh: Microsoft 的 MAI-DS-R1 发布披露约 350K 个关键词派生的多语问题及由 DeepSeek-R1/内部模型引导的答案与 CoT，加上 110K 个具名 Tulu3 安全样本；底层记录、反馈合约、切分和来源级权利未披露。

title: Investigating Non-Transitivity in LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: Shows ranking instability when pairwise LLM judge preferences violate transitivity.
one_line_summary.zh: 审计两两 LLM 判决的非传递性，并以锦标赛聚合降低排名对基线的敏感度。

title: Is Best-of-N the Best of Them? Coverage, Scaling, and Optimality in Inference-Time Alignment

one_line_summary.en: The paper formalizes when Best-of-N overoptimizes imperfect reward models and proposes InferenceTimePessimism, a chi-squared-regularized rejection sampler evaluated across math, science, and instruction-following tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: 该论文形式化刻画了 Best-of-N 在何时会对不完美的奖励模型过度优化，并提出以卡方正则化的拒绝采样器 InferenceTimePessimism，在数学、科学与指令遵循任务上评测。

title: ITBench: Evaluating AI Agents across Diverse Real-World IT Automation Tasks

one_line_summary.en: ITBench packages live IT incidents and controls as tool-using agent episodes with explicit stop/success contracts, then extends them with versioned offline snapshots and SRE traces.
one_line_summary.zh: ITBench把真实IT运维问题组织为可部署环境中的工具调用episode，并发布静态场景与SRE轨迹；其价值在于明确stop与success契约，但跨版本映射、回放、污染、隐私和许可仍未解决。

title: Iterative Deepening Sampling as Efficient Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: Iterative Deepening Sampling uses progressively deeper self-correction samples to improve fixed-model reasoning at test time.
one_line_summary.zh: 迭代加深采样以逐步加深的自我纠错样本改善固定模型的测试时推理。

title: J4R: Learning to Judge with Equivalent Initial State Group Relative Policy Optimization

one_line_summary.en: J4R trains a position-robust reasoning judge and releases 1,483 outcome-oriented response pairs across eight source benchmarks.
one_line_summary.zh: 1,483组跨八基准的正负推理答案，提供偏好标签，适合训练可泛化的推理结果判别器。

title: JI²S: Joint Influence-Aware Instruction Data Selection for Efficient Fine-Tuning

one_line_summary.en: JI²S selects a compact instruction-tuning subset by combining marginal and pairwise joint influence relative to a human-preference proxy.
one_line_summary.zh: JI²S 相对人工偏好代理结合边际与成对联合影响，选择紧凑的指令微调子集。

title: Judge Anything: MLLM as a Judge Across Any Modality

one_line_summary.en: JudgeAnything benchmarks multimodal judges across any-to-any tasks with human judgments, rubrics, and pairwise or score-based protocols.
one_line_summary.zh: JudgeAnything 以人工判定、量规及成对或评分协议，评测多模态模型在任意模态任务上的评判能力。

title: Judge's Verdict: A Comprehensive Analysis of LLM Judge Capability Through Human Agreement
venue: arXiv preprint; under review at ICLR 2026

one_line_summary.en: Public submission materials define a benchmark for factual judge reliability.
one_line_summary.zh: 公开的投稿材料界定了一个衡量事实性评审可靠度的基准。

title: JudgeLM: Fine-tuned Large Language Models are Scalable Judges

one_line_summary.en: JudgeLM releases judge-training examples and a benchmark while explicitly measuring position, knowledge, and format bias.
one_line_summary.zh: JudgeLM 用 GPT-4 蒸馏的成对判决数据训练可本地部署的 LLM 裁判，并针对位置、知识与格式偏差设计干预。

title: Judging the Judges: A Systematic Study of Position Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: Accepted systematic audit of position bias with public proceedings materials.
one_line_summary.zh: 以重复查询与候选换序审计 LLM judge 的位置偏差、稳定性与偏好方向。

title: Judging the Judges: Evaluating Alignment and Vulnerabilities in LLMs-as-Judges

one_line_summary.en: Measures how LLM judges agree with humans and how prompting and references destabilize their verdicts.
one_line_summary.zh: 量化 LLM 评审与人工的一致性，并揭示提示词、参考答案顺序和宽松偏差造成的失稳。

title: KernelBench: Can LLMs Write Efficient GPU Kernels?
venue: arXiv preprint; official repository labels ICML 2025

one_line_summary.en: KernelBench exposes CUDA kernel generation with correctness and speed checks as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: KernelBench 把带正确性与加速比检查的 CUDA 核函数生成做成可审计的评测面。

title: Kimi k1.5: Scaling Reinforcement Learning with LLMs

one_line_summary.en: Kimi k1.5 discloses a multimodal RL pipeline with prompt filtering, verified long-CoT warmup, math reward models, synthesized code tests, long2short preference/RL methods, and partial-rollout infrastructure, but releases no model, training data, reward data, or executable training stack.
one_line_summary.zh: Kimi k1.5 披露了包含 prompt 过滤、已验证 Long-CoT warmup、数学奖励模型、合成代码测试、long2short 偏好/RL 方法与 partial-rollout 基础设施的多模态 RL 管线，但未发布模型、训练数据、奖励数据或可执行训练栈。

title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence

one_line_summary.en: Kimi K2 reports 3,000+ real MCP and 20,000+ synthetic tools feeding rubric-filtered trajectories, execution environments, RLVR, and self-critique without releasing data, verifier implementation, or audit artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Kimi K2 报告称 3,000+ 个真实 MCP 工具和 20,000+ 个合成工具经由 rubric 过滤轨迹、执行环境、RLVR 与 self-critique 反馈进入后训练，但未公开数据、verifier 实现或审计工件。

title: Kimi-Dev: Agentless Training as Skill Prior for SWE-Agents

one_line_summary.en: Kimi-Dev turns GitHub patch and simulated file-tool data into an Agentless skill prior, then applies full-test-suite binary RLVR and a reported 5,016-trajectory agent bridge, but withholds the training corpus, Docker provenance, exact splits, failures, and adapted checkpoint.
one_line_summary.zh: Kimi-Dev 将 GitHub 补丁与模拟文件工具数据训练成 Agentless 技能先验，再用完整任务测试的二元 RLVR 和论文所述 5,016 条 agent 轨迹连接 SWE-Agent；但训练语料、Docker 谱系、精确划分、失败 rollout 与适配后 checkpoint 未发布。

title: Kimi-VL Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Kimi-VL reports a mixed multimodal pipeline from human and model-generated SFT to Kimi k1.5 long-CoT filtering and ground-truth-centered RL, while releasing weights and inference material but not the training data, reward artifacts, agent environment, or audit records.
one_line_summary.zh: Kimi-VL 报告了从人工和模型生成 SFT、Kimi k1.5 长 CoT 筛选到以真值为中心的 RL 的混合多模态管线；其公开了权重和推理材料，但未公开训练数据、奖励工件、agent 环境或审计记录。

title: Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: Kimina-Prover discloses a 200K Lean prompt construction, about 20K cold starts, whole-proof compiler-terminal RL, and public distills/tooling, but not core prompts, rollouts, rewards, environment pins, or full lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Kimina-Prover 披露了 20 万条 Lean prompt 构建、约 2 万条冷启动轨迹、整证明的 Lean 编译终态 RL，以及公开的蒸馏模型/工具；但未公开核心 prompt、rollout、奖励、环境版本锁定或完整谱系。

title: Klear-Reasoner: Advancing Reasoning Capability via Gradient-Preserving Clipping Policy Optimization

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** Klear-Reasoner combines difficult MathSub-30K prompts with GPPO to use failed RLVR trajectories more effectively.
one_line_summary.zh: Klear-Reasoner 用 MathSub-30K 困难题和 GPPO 共同提高 RLVR 对负轨迹的利用。

title: Know Your Limits: A Survey of Abstention in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A TACL 2025 survey organizing LLM abstention through the query, model, and human values.
one_line_summary.zh: 从查询、模型和人类价值三个角度梳理大语言模型何时应当拒答。

title: KodCode: A Diverse, Challenging, and Verifiable Synthetic Dataset for Coding

one_line_summary.en: KodCode releases large CC BY-NC coding triplets and 268,211 verified R1-SFT records with tests, trial statistics, difficulty, and contamination fields.
one_line_summary.zh: KodCode 公开大规模 CC BY-NC 编程三元组与 268,211 条经单元测试验收的 R1-SFT 记录，并保留试验、难度和污染字段。

title: Kvasir-VQA-x1: A Multimodal Dataset for Medical Reasoning and Robust MedVQA in Gastrointestinal Endoscopy
venue: Data Engineering in Medical Imaging, Springer

one_line_summary.en: Kvasir-VQA-x1 turns atomic GI-endoscopy QAs into 159,549 expert-validated, complexity-stratified multimodal demonstrations for clinical VQA training and robustness evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: Kvasir-VQA-x1 将胃肠内镜原子问答扩展为 159,549 条经专家验证、按复杂度分层的多模态示范，用于临床视觉问答训练和鲁棒性评估。

title: L1: Controlling How Long A Reasoning Model Thinks With Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: L1 trains DeepScaleR-based policies with programmatic final-answer and token-budget rewards so a prompt can request either an exact reasoning length or a maximum token ceiling.
one_line_summary.zh: L1 以正确性和长度约束奖励使推理长度成为提示词可控的测试时计算预算。

title: Large Language Models and Causal Inference in Collaboration: A Comprehensive Survey

one_line_summary.en: A Findings NAACL 2025 survey of two-way collaboration between causal inference and language models.
one_line_summary.zh: 综述因果推断与大语言模型双向协作的研究。

title: Larger or Smaller Reward Margins to Select Preferences for LLM Alignment?

one_line_summary.en: Alignment Potential selects preference pairs whose current policy margin differs most from the reward-model target margin.
one_line_summary.zh: 对齐潜力指标选择当前策略间隔与奖励目标间隔差距最大的偏好对。

title: LastingBench: Defend Benchmarks Against Knowledge Leakage

one_line_summary.en: Local BibTeX seed for the 🧱 Foundations: Instruction, Preference, and Alignment Data map; use it to inspect the paper's data object, verifier contract, and release metadata before promoting it.
one_line_summary.zh: 聚焦如何抵抗知识泄漏并延长基准有效期，是训练—测试重叠审计的重要工具。

title: LazyReview: A Dataset for Uncovering Lazy Thinking in NLP Peer Reviews

one_line_summary.en: LazyReview uses expert and silver review segments to identify shallow reasoning in NLP peer reviews.
one_line_summary.zh: 用专家与银标评审片段识别 NLP 同行评审中缺少实质论证的惰性思考。

title: Leaky Thoughts

one_line_summary.en: Leaky Thoughts shows that reasoning traces from personal-agent settings can expose sensitive user data through prompt injection or accidental leakage.
one_line_summary.zh: 显示个人智能体场景中的推理痕迹会被提示注入或意外输出泄露，把 CoT 直接转化为隐私攻击面。

title: Learn-by-interact: A Data-Centric Framework For Self-Adaptive Agents in Realistic Environments

one_line_summary.en: The recipe expands 85,905 documentation-seeded agent episodes into 1,456,808 instruction-subtrajectory candidates and reports 440,008 committee-filtered examples, but releases neither the corpus nor its implementation.
one_line_summary.zh: Learn-by-interact 将 85,905 条由文档任务驱动的智能体交互轨迹扩展为 1,456,808 个指令—子轨迹候选，经双模型一致筛选后报告 440,008 条样本，但未发布语料、实现或模型。

title: Learning How Hard to Think: Input-Adaptive Allocation of LM Computation

one_line_summary.en: This work predicts each prompt’s marginal return from extra decoding and uses those predictions to allocate sampling or strong-model calls under a shared compute budget.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作预测每个提示从额外解码中获得的边际收益，并在共享计算预算下分配采样次数或强模型调用。

title: Learning to Better Search with Language Models via Guided Reinforced Self-Training

one_line_summary.en: Guided-ReST uses optimal solutions as training-time landmarks to repair, verify, and distill current-policy search traces.
one_line_summary.zh: Guided-ReST 用最优解作为仅构造期可见的局部地标，修补并筛选策略自身的搜索轨迹；其价值在于展示特权引导蒸馏配方，但未发布冻结轨迹语料。

title: Learning to Solve and Verify: A Self-Play Framework for Code and Test Generation
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Deep Learning for Code in the Agentic Era

one_line_summary.en: Sol-Ver uses one Llama 3.1 8B model to co-generate Python solutions and unit tests, turning execution agreement into Solver/Verifier SFT records and DPO pairs over three self-play rounds.
one_line_summary.zh: Sol-Ver 让同一个 Llama 3.1 8B 同时生成代码与单元测试，以执行一致性构造 SFT 正例和 DPO 胜负对；其价值在闭环配方，而非未发布语料的直接复用。

title: LeMAJ (Legal LLM-as-a-Judge): Bridging Legal Reasoning and LLM Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: Decomposes legal answers into claims for reference-free judging validated against legal experts.
one_line_summary.zh: 将法律回答拆为主张级数据点，以无参考评审同法律专家判断对齐。

title: LEMMA: Learning from Errors for MatheMatical Advancement in LLMs

one_line_summary.en: LEMMA turns diverse model mistakes into error-to-correction training pairs, teaching mathematical LLMs to repair their own reasoning without an external critique model.
one_line_summary.zh: LEMMA 将多样化模型错误组织为错误到正确解的反思连接，使数学模型无需外部批评器也能在生成中自主纠错。

title: Less is More: Improving LLM Alignment via Preference Data Selection

one_line_summary.en: BeeS selects DPO pairs with high confidence across external and implicit reward margins, improving alignment while training on much less preference data.
one_line_summary.zh: BeeS 选择在外部与隐式奖励间隔上均具高置信度的 DPO 样本对，以更少偏好数据改善对齐。

title: LessLeak-Bench: A First Investigation of Data Leakage in LLMs Across 83 Software Engineering Benchmarks

one_line_summary.en: Measures and removes verified pre-training leakage across 83 software-engineering benchmarks.
one_line_summary.zh: 测量并删除 83 个软件工程基准中经核验的预训练泄漏样本。

title: Let LRMs Break Free from Overthinking via Self-Braking Tuning

one_line_summary.en: SBT derives masked/truncated math traces with braking prompts from OpenR1-Math.
one_line_summary.zh: SBT 从 OpenR1-Math 推导截断或掩码的推理轨迹并加入 braking prompt，以监督模型在冗余推理前自行终止；派生样本和决策账本尚未确认独立发布。

title: Leveraging Online Olympiad-Level Math Problems for LLMs Training and Contamination-Resistant Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: AoPS-Instruct turns pre-2024 forum questions and community answers into 647,255 rewritten SFT pairs, while LiveAoPSBench applies stricter answer checks to newer timestamped posts.
one_line_summary.zh: AoPS-Instruct 将 2024 年前的论坛问题与社区解答转为 647,255 条重写 SFT 记录，LiveAoPSBench 则用更严格的答案检查筛选较新的时间戳帖子；训练快照、逐记录来源与内容复用权利仍不完整。

title: Libra: Assessing and Improving Reward Model by Learning to Think

one_line_summary.en: Libra Bench turns difficult mathematical reasoning outputs into a 3,740-record correctness benchmark for training and testing thinking reward models.
one_line_summary.zh: Libra-Bench 提供约 3,740 条数学推理偏好样本，要求奖励模型先形成评判推理再排序，直接服务于 RM 训练与推理时选择。

title: LIFBench: Evaluating the Instruction Following Performance and Stability of Large Language Models in Long-Context Scenarios

one_line_summary.en: LIFBench uses scalable long-context instructions and LIFEval rubrics to measure instruction following and stability.
one_line_summary.zh: LIFBench 用可扩展长上下文指令和 LIFEval 量表，测量模型遵循指令的能力与稳定性。

title: LIMO: Less is More for Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: LIMO-v2 distills a massive mixed mathematics pool into 800 long-reasoning SFT triples using model solve-rate difficulty filters and a lexical quality score, achieving data-efficient elicitation while leaving the original pool, item lineage, rejects, and construction implementation unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: LIMO-v2 用两阶段模型解题率筛选与偏好长、验证词、试探词和连接词的词法分数，从海量数学池中保留 800 条长 CoT SFT 三元组；它展示了小数据 elicitation 的可能性，但 v1/v2 漂移、构造代码与逐条 lineage 缺失使 recipe 尚不能完整重放。

title: LIMOPro: Reasoning Refinement for Efficient and Effective Test-time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: LIMOPro prunes low-importance functional reasoning steps from training traces, producing models that retain or improve accuracy while spending fewer tokens at inference.
one_line_summary.zh: LIMOPro 从训练推理轨迹中剪去低重要性的功能性步骤，使模型在测试时以更少词元保持或提高准确率。

title: Linguistic Generalizability of Test-Time Scaling in Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: MCLM tests outcome rewards, process rewards, and budget forcing at matched compute across 55 languages, exposing weak cross-lingual scaling gains.
one_line_summary.zh: MCLM 在 55 种语言中以匹配计算比较结果奖励、过程奖励和预算强制，揭示测试时扩展的跨语言收益很弱。

title: LiveBench: A Challenging, Contamination-Limited LLM Benchmark

one_line_summary.en: LiveBench combines dated task releases, periodic replacement, and objective scoring so model results can be audited against a specific contamination-limited benchmark version.
one_line_summary.zh: LiveBench 把带日期的任务版本、定期替换和客观评分组合起来，让模型结果能够对应一个明确的抗污染 benchmark 版本接受审计。

title: Llama-Nemotron: Efficient Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: Llama-Nemotron releases Nano, Super, and Ultra weights plus a versioned SFT/RL dataset and detailed domain pipelines, but the report's 33,011,757-example accounting is not reconciled with current released-row views or complete stage-to-record lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Llama-Nemotron 报告架构搜索、蒸馏、持续预训练、推理 SFT 与大规模 RL，并声称发布模型、后训练数据和代码；具体反馈与审计边界仍需工件级核验。

title: LLaVA-CoT: Let Vision Language Models Reason Step-by-Step

one_line_summary.en: LLaVA-CoT-100k turns 99k VQA pairs into four-stage summary-caption-reasoning-conclusion demonstrations for multimodal SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: LLaVA-CoT-100k 把 9.9 万条 VQA 样本改写为摘要、图像描述、推理和结论四阶段的多模态 SFT 示范。

title: LLaVA-Critic: Learning to Evaluate Multimodal Models

one_line_summary.en: LLaVA-Critic releases 113,000 multimodal evaluation records—scores, preference pairs, and rationales—to train an open generalist vision-language evaluator.
one_line_summary.zh: LLaVA-Critic-113k 含 46K 图像、113K 评分或成对偏好及理由，覆盖多种视觉任务，可用于多模态 judge 与偏好训练。

title: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5: Fully Open Framework for Democratized Multimodal Training

one_line_summary.en: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 releases a 22M instruction mixture and an efficient full training stack, separating the instruction stage from its 85M mid-training corpus and 67K RL set.
one_line_summary.zh: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 公开 2200 万条多模态指令混合及完整训练框架，并把它与中期训练和强化学习数据分开。

title: LLM-as-a-Judge: Reassessing the Performance of LLMs in Extractive QA

one_line_summary.en: Audits LLM judging against human labels for extractive QA where EM and F1 can miss valid paraphrases.
one_line_summary.zh: 审计大语言模型评审能否修正 EM 与 F1 对抽取式问答有效改述的误判。

title: LLMs as Planning Formalizers: A Survey for Leveraging Large Language Models to Construct Automated Planning Models

one_line_summary.en: A Findings ACL 2025 survey of using language models to formalize planning specifications for automated planners.
one_line_summary.zh: 综述如何借助大语言模型构造和改进自动规划模型。

title: LLMs Cannot Reliably Judge (Yet?): A Comprehensive Assessment on the Robustness of LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: Public RobustJudge release evaluates reliability under multiple automated judge-attack scenarios.
one_line_summary.zh: 以 15 类攻击和 7 类防御审计 LLM-as-a-Judge 的稳健性。

title: LLMs instead of Human Judges? A Large Scale Empirical Study across 20 NLP Evaluation Tasks

one_line_summary.en: JUDGE-BENCH is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
one_line_summary.zh: JUDGE-BENCH 汇聚 20 个带人类评分的数据集，覆盖事实性、推理、对话和生成质量，用于定位 LLM judge 与专家判断偏离的条件。

title: LLMSQL: Upgrading WikiSQL for the LLM Era of Text-to-SQL
venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining Workshops (ICDMW)

one_line_summary.en: LLMSQL repairs and re-releases WikiSQL as complete SQL records scored by executable SQLite result sets.
one_line_summary.zh: LLMSQL 修复并重发布 WikiSQL 为完整 SQL 记录，再以可执行的 SQLite 结果集合评分。

title: LMArena / Arena AI Leaderboard

one_line_summary.en: LMArena is a continuing human-preference leaderboard infrastructure that ranks models from anonymized pairwise battles rather than fixed-answer correctness.
one_line_summary.zh: LMArena 是持续运行的人类偏好排行榜基础设施，通过匿名双模型对战和用户投票聚合模型排名，而不是固定答案正确率。

title: LNE-Blocking: An Efficient Framework for Contamination Mitigation Evaluation on Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: contamination detection and response-blocking evaluation code
one_line_summary.zh: LNE-Blocking 以长度归一化熵决定解码扰动强度，估计潜在泄漏基准上的非记忆性能。

title: Logical Reasoning with Outcome Reward Models for Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: LogicORM releases 10,009 FOLIO CoT traces and a 19,105-row Echo-augmented set with binary outcome labels, then trains Qwen2.5 ORMs to rerank sampled deductive-logic solutions at test time.
one_line_summary.zh: LogicORM 公开 10,009 条 FOLIO CoT 轨迹及含 19,105 条记录的 Echo 增强集，以二元结果标签训练 Qwen2.5 ORM，并在测试时对多次采样的演绎逻辑解答执行 Best-of-N 重排。

title: Long-Short Chain-of-Thought Mixture Supervised Fine-Tuning Eliciting Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: LS-Mixture SFT pairs long reasoning traces with structure-preserving short rewrites to train efficient reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: LS-Mixture SFT 将长推理轨迹与保留结构的短改写配对，以训练更高效的推理。

title: LongDPO: Unlock Better Long-form Generation Abilities for LLMs via Critique-augmented Stepwise Information

one_line_summary.en: LongDPO uses MCTS, factual memory, and external critiques to build stepwise preference pairs for fine-grained long-form DPO.
one_line_summary.zh: LongDPO 用蒙特卡洛树搜索、事实记忆和外部批评构造逐步偏好回答对，供细粒度长文本 DPO 使用。

title: M-MAD: Multidimensional Multi-Agent Debate for Advanced Machine Translation Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: multi-judge debate data and evaluator reproducibility assets
one_line_summary.zh: 将 MQM 维度拆分、维度内辩论与最终综合结合，用于细粒度机器翻译评测。

title: M-RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models in Multilingual Settings

one_line_summary.en: M-RewardBench translates and validates preference pairs across 23 languages to test whether reward models preserve chat, safety, reasoning, and translation preferences.
one_line_summary.zh: 2.87k偏好实例覆盖23种语言及推理子集，用成对优劣标签检验跨语言通用推理奖励。

title: macOSWorld: A Multilingual Interactive Benchmark for GUI Agents

one_line_summary.en: macOSWorld releases 202 resettable macOS GUI tasks with multilingual instructions, VNC screenshot/action episodes, task-specific executable graders, and an overlapping 29-task context-deception safety subset.
one_line_summary.zh: macOSWorld发布202项可重置的多语言macOS GUI任务、可执行终态grader及重叠的29项上下文欺骗安全子集，但公开grader、二值反馈和缺失的固定轨迹清单限制训练复用。

title: Magistral

one_line_summary.en: Magistral reports filtered math/code RL and Medium-to-Small trace transfer, but releases only Small model weights rather than the training corpus, traces, tests or reward logs.
one_line_summary.zh: Magistral 具体披露数学/代码筛选、结果奖励、异步 GRPO 和 Medium-to-Small 冷启动，但未发布来源清单、trace、完整测试和审计证据。

title: Magnet: Multi-turn Tool-use Data Synthesis and Distillation via Graph Translation
venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

one_line_summary.en: MAGNET synthesizes graph-derived multi-turn function-call episodes and positive/negative trajectory pairs for SFT and mDPO, but the paper does not release the traces, executable environment, or replay metadata needed to audit the recipe end to end.
one_line_summary.zh: MAGNET 从 API 依赖图合成多轮函数调用轨迹，并构造正负轨迹对用于 SFT 与 mDPO；但未发布轨迹、可执行环境或回放元数据，无法端到端审计该配方。

title: Magpie: Alignment Data Synthesis from Scratch by Prompting Aligned LLMs with Nothing

one_line_summary.en: Magpie samples seedless instructions from an aligned model's chat-template prefix and releases millions of instruction-response demonstrations plus filtered SFT subsets.
one_line_summary.zh: Magpie 只向已对齐模型输入聊天模板中的用户角色前缀，就能无种子地采样指令与回答，并开放数百万条示范及其筛选版 SFT 数据。

title: Majority of the Bests: Improving Best-of-N via Bootstrapping

one_line_summary.en: MoB estimates the modal answer of a reward-ranked Best-of-m distribution from a fixed completion pool and releases prompts, generations, extracted answers, correctness scores, and reward scores for offline selection studies.
one_line_summary.zh: MoB 从固定的候选池中估计奖励排序后 Best-of-m 分布的众数答案，并发布提示、生成结果、抽取答案、正确性与奖励分数以支持离线选择研究。

title: MAmmoTH-VL: Eliciting Multimodal Reasoning with Instruction Tuning at Scale

one_line_summary.en: MAmmoTH-VL rewrites and filters 153 public multimodal sources into 12M rationale-rich instruction-response records using open models.
one_line_summary.zh: MAmmoTH-VL 用开源模型把 153 个公开多模态来源改写并过滤为 1200 万条带 rationale 的 instruction-response 记录。

title: Marco-o1 v2: Towards Widening The Distillation Bottleneck for Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: An open reasoning pipeline connecting MCTS chain-of-thought search to SFT and DPO data construction.
one_line_summary.zh: Marco-o1 v2 从头用 MCTS 构造树状 CoT 数据，再结合思考长度平衡、细粒度 DPO 和联合后训练目标缓解长推理蒸馏瓶颈。

title: Massive Supervised Fine-tuning Experiments Reveal How Data, Layer, and Training Factors Shape LLM Alignment Quality

one_line_summary.en: A controlled release of 1,000+ SFT runs finds base-model perplexity is a strong compatibility signal for choosing training data.
one_line_summary.zh: 超过 1,000 次受控监督微调表明，基础模型困惑度是选择训练数据的强兼容性信号。

title: MathArena: Evaluating LLMs on Uncontaminated Math Competitions
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks platform / arXiv

one_line_summary.en: MathArena exposes newly released math competitions and current contest math as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: MathArena 把新发布的数学竞赛与当期赛题做成可审计的评测面。

title: MathCoder2: Better Math Reasoning from Continued Pretraining on Model-translated Mathematical Code

one_line_summary.en: MathCoder2 translates selected mathematical documents into conditions-expression-result-Python records, execution-filters and flattens them into MathCode-Pile, then uses the mixture for continued pretraining before separate supervised math post-training.
one_line_summary.zh: MathCoder2 将筛选后的数学网页翻译为“条件—表达式—结果—Python”记录，与网页、合成、代码和教材数据组成论文报告的 19,487,652 文档、19,184,073,343 token 的 MathCode-Pile；当前公开数据仍是只有 train split 的 partial text-only 版本，且执行过滤、谱系、许可、去污染和 checkpoint 绑定均不完整。

title: MathConstruct: Challenging LLM Reasoning with Constructive Proofs

one_line_summary.en: MathConstruct releases 126 constructive mathematics problems with programmatic checkers and generated variations for robustness evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: MathConstruct 提供 126 道构造型竞赛题与程序化检查器，并通过题目变体检验模型是否真正满足构造约束。

title: MCTS-Judge: Test-Time Scaling in LLM-as-a-Judge for Code Correctness Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: A test-time MCTS framework for code-correctness judging that exposes trajectory-aware self-assessment and unit-test-level reward as its feedback objects.
one_line_summary.zh: MCTS-Judge 将代码正确性判断分解为树搜索，结合历史动作自评、UCT 和单元测试级奖励机制形成测试时 LLM-as-a-Judge 轨迹。

title: MCTS-RAG: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Monte Carlo Tree Search
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025

one_line_summary.en: MCTS-RAG interleaves six reasoning and retrieval actions in UCT-guided search, but releases code and benchmark inputs rather than the paper-run trees, score traces, retrieval states, or budget logs.
one_line_summary.zh: MCTS-RAG 用 UCT 引导的搜索交替执行六类推理与检索动作，但官方发布的是生成器代码和少量 benchmark 输入，而不是论文运行产生的树、检索状态、选择分数或逐样本预算日志。

title: Measuring the Faithfulness of Thinking Drafts in Large Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: A counterfactual benchmark tests whether reasoning-model thinking drafts causally guide both subsequent steps and final answers.
one_line_summary.zh: 以反事实干预测试推理模型的思维草稿是否真正影响后续推理与最终答案。

title: Med-PRM: Medical Reasoning Models with Stepwise, Guideline-verified Process Rewards

one_line_summary.en: Med-PRM: Medical Reasoning Models with Stepwise, Guideline-verified Process Rewards exposes process or trace supervision data.
one_line_summary.zh: 提出 Med-PRM，通过检索临床指南和文献逐步核验医学推理，并将证据驱动的过程评分用于诊疗问答。

title: Med-REFL: Medical Reasoning Enhancement via Self-Corrected Fine-grained Reflection

one_line_summary.en: Med-REFL creates self-corrected fine-grained reflection preference pairs for medical reasoning optimization.
one_line_summary.zh: Med-REFL 将细粒度自我反思转化为医学推理的偏好对，用于纠错式偏好优化。

title: MedReason: Eliciting Factual Medical Reasoning Steps in LLMs via Knowledge Graphs

one_line_summary.en: MedReason maps medical QA entities through PrimeKG, uses GPT-4o to write grounded rationales, and releases 32,682 answer-filtered step-by-step SFT records.
one_line_summary.zh: MedReason 把医疗问答实体映射到 PrimeKG，由 GPT-4o 生成有知识路径约束的解释，并开放 32,682 条通过答案恢复筛选的逐步 SFT 记录。

title: Membership Inference Attacks on Tokenizers of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: tokenizer membership-inference datasets and defense code
one_line_summary.zh: 以 tokenizer 词表为攻击面推断语料成员关系，提供更可控的 LLM 预训练数据泄漏审计路径。

title: MiMo-Embodied: X-Embodied Foundation Model Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: MiMo-Embodied stages embodied, driving, generated-CoT, and deterministic-GRPO supervision, then separately studies NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO, but discloses no training scale, mixtures, immutable splits, sensor ledger, rollouts, or planner artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: MiMo-Embodied 以四阶段课程串联 embodied、driving、generated-CoT 与规则 GRPO，并另行研究 NAVSIM IL+DiffGRPO；但训练规模/比例、不可变 split、传感器账本、rollout 与 planner artifact 均未披露。

title: MiMo-VL Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: MiMo-VL reports synthetic long-CoT regeneration with rejection sampling in later pre-training and mixed on-policy RL, but does not release the underlying traces, reward contract, or corpus audit.
one_line_summary.zh: MiMo-VL 报告 2.4T token 四阶段预训练、长 CoT 推理数据与 MORL，但未披露数据来源、奖励契约、rollout 或审计细节。

title: MiMo: Unlocking the Reasoning Potential of Language Model -- From Pretraining to Posttraining

one_line_summary.en: MiMo reports 25T-token reasoning-oriented pretraining, 500K then 6M distilled SFT instances, and 130K rule-verifiable RL problems, while releasing weights and inference code but not the training data, tests, verifiers, rollouts, or complete training stack.
one_line_summary.zh: MiMo 报告 13 万条可规则验证的数学/代码 RL 题、测试难度奖励、重采样与公开 checkpoints；任务记录、验证器细节、奖励标定和审计资产仍未公开。

title: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention

one_line_summary.en: MiniMax-M1 releases 40K and 80K model weights and reports separate continual-pretraining, Long-CoT SFT, and mixed-feedback RL recipes, but not the training rows, reward traces, sandboxes, or training code needed for replay.
one_line_summary.zh: MiniMax-M1 披露混合注意力推理模型、面向含沙盒软件工程问题的大规模 RL 与 CISPO，但未公开训练数据、奖励或 rollout 审计工件。

title: MIR-Bench: Can Your LLM Recognize Complicated Patterns via Many-Shot In-Context Reasoning?

one_line_summary.en: MIR-Bench evaluates whether models can infer complex patterns from many in-context demonstrations.
one_line_summary.zh: MIR-Bench 以多示例上下文中的复杂模式归纳任务，评估模型从大量演示中提炼规则的能力。

title: MiroMind-M1: A Multi-Stage Framework for Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** MiroMind-M1 combines 719K long-CoT SFT records, 62K verifiable RL prompts, and length-progressive optimization in a fully open stack.
one_line_summary.zh: MiroMind-M1 将 719K 长 CoT SFT、62K 可验证 RL 问题和长度渐进优化组成完整开放训练栈。

title: MLAlgo-Bench: Can Machines Implement Machine Learning Algorithms?

one_line_summary.en: MLAlgo-Bench tests machine-learning algorithm implementation with sandboxed execution, performance references, and runtime-aware validation.
one_line_summary.zh: MLAlgo-Bench 以算法实现和真实应用两类任务检验机器学习代码，使用沙箱执行、性能参照和时间开销自动验证。

title: MLGym: A New Framework and Benchmark for Advancing AI Research Agents

one_line_summary.en: MLGym releases 13 containerized ML-research tasks and a current 676-run action/observation corpus with task-specific evaluator scores and replay code, but repeated validation exposes test feedback, native Gym reward remains zero, and the release is untagged and license-mixed.
one_line_summary.zh: MLGym 将 13 个容器化 ML 研究任务表示为 thought/action/observation/state 与 evaluator score 轨迹；论文分析 624 条运行，而当前仓库为 676 对轨迹/结果文件，但无限 test-set validate、恒为 0 的 Gym reward、可变 latest 镜像与混合许可限制其复用。

title: MM-BrowseComp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Browsing Agents

one_line_summary.en: MM-BrowseComp exposes multimodal browsing questions involving image/video evidence as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: MM-BrowseComp 把需要图像与视频证据的多模态浏览问答做成可审计的评测面。

title: MM-OPERA: Benchmarking Open-ended Association Reasoning for Large Vision-Language Models

one_line_summary.en: MM-OPERA evaluates open-ended multimodal association reasoning with process-aware judging of divergent and convergent associations.
one_line_summary.zh: MM-OPERA 以开放式图文联想任务和过程感知裁判，评估视觉语言模型的发散与收敛关联推理。

title: MM-PRM: Enhancing Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning with Scalable Step-Level Supervision

one_line_summary.en: An OmegaPRM-style multimodal pipeline that turns answer-judged rollout success rates into soft step labels and trains an 8B PRM, while releasing the seed data and checkpoint but not the reported annotation trees.
one_line_summary.zh: 该条目将推理轨迹、搜索选择或测试时计算作为可审计的研究对象；未披露字段已明确标为 unknown。

title: MM-RLHF: The Next Step Forward in Multimodal LLM Alignment

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: MM-RLHF 发布大规模人工标注的多模态偏好比较对，并配套奖励模型与偏好优化方法。

title: MMAT-1M: A Large Reasoning Dataset for Multimodal Agent Tuning

one_line_summary.en: MMAT-1M releases million-scale multimodal Rationale-and-Reflection dialogues with dynamic API and retrieval interactions.
one_line_summary.zh: MMAT-1M 将多模态问答扩展为包含推理、反思、API 调用与 RAG 的百万级智能体训练对话。

title: MMSearch-Plus: Benchmarking Provenance-Aware Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents

one_line_summary.en: MMSearch-Plus releases 311 image-grounded QA rows and evaluates agents over SerpAPI/Gemini search with answer-level GPT-4o judgment, but does not release the agent framework, SoM boxes, complete trajectories, or replay snapshots.
one_line_summary.zh: MMSearch-Plus发布单一train split中的311条图像问答与来源引用，并以SerpAPI/Gemini动态搜索和GPT-4o答案judge评测智能体；完整轨迹、框架、evaluator与SoM均未发布。

title: MobileRL: Online Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Mobile GUI Agents

one_line_summary.en: MobileRL combines 97.9k action-only SFT steps, 23.6k reasoning-SFT steps, and online Android rollouts over 3,103 training tasks with mixed terminal verification, length shaping, positive replay, and failure filtering.
one_line_summary.zh: MobileRL 用 97.9k 步 action-only SFT、23.6k 步 reasoning SFT 和 3,103 个在线 Android 训练任务构建移动端 RL pipeline，并以混合终局 verifier、路径长度 shaping、正向 replay 和失败课程控制轨迹分布，但训练代码、数据和 replay 尚未发布。

title: MobileWorldBench: Towards Semantic World Modeling For Mobile Agents

one_line_summary.en: MobileWorldBench evaluates one-step Android future-state semantics with GPT-judged descriptions and yes/no QA, while MobileWorld supplies roughly 1.4M model-annotated transition items for SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: MobileWorldBench把移动智能体行为压缩为离线单步state/action/next-state预测，并以GPT-4o rubric和Yes/No准确率混合评测；MobileWorld另供SFT数据，但split、图像完整性、judge版本、许可与隐私仍有缺口。

title: More Data or Better Data? A Critical Analysis of Data Selection and Synthesis for Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Compares math-data recipes under a fixed 80/20 scaffold, finding benefits from restructuring and strong-model distillation but releasing none of the constructed corpora.
one_line_summary.zh: 在固定 80% 基线与 20% 候选混合中比较数学数据配方，教育化重构和 QwQ 蒸馏仅改善部分数学指标，且存在跨任务回退、代码与构造语料未公开。

title: MPBench: A Comprehensive Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Process Errors Identification

one_line_summary.en: MPBench evaluates multimodal PRMs through step correctness, answer aggregation, and reasoning-process search.
one_line_summary.zh: MPBench 以首错步骤和错误类型标注评测多模态过程奖励模型的步骤判断、答案聚合与过程搜索。

title: MR-GSM8K: A Meta-Reasoning Benchmark for Large Language Model Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: MR-GSM8K turns GSM8K solutions into meta-reasoning tasks that require models to score a trace and pinpoint its first error, exposing process-evaluation gaps hidden by answer accuracy.
one_line_summary.zh: MR-GSM8K 将 GSM8K 解答转为评判推理与定位首错的元推理任务，揭示仅看最终答案会掩盖的过程评估差距。

title: mR3: Multilingual Rubric-Agnostic Reward Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: mR3 将量规式奖励推理扩展到 72 种语言，并以多语种课程数据训练统一评审模型。

title: MT-RewardTree: A Comprehensive Framework for Advancing LLM-Based Machine Translation via Reward Modeling
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025

one_line_summary.en: MT-RewardTree turns top-2 translation-token branches and three COMETKiwi-scored rollouts per node into 8,652 prefixed training pairs and a 1,200-pair benchmark, while releasing only selected pairs rather than the raw search trees.
one_line_summary.zh: MT-RewardTree 以 top-2 同前缀 token 分支和每节点三次 COMETKiwi 评分 rollout 构造 8,652 组偏好对及 1,200 组 benchmark，但公开数据只保留筛选后的 chosen/rejected，而不含原始搜索树。

title: Mulberry: Empowering MLLM with o1-like Reasoning and Reflection via Collective Monte Carlo Tree Search

one_line_summary.en: Mulberry-260K uses four-model tree search to release image-grounded reasoning and reflection demonstrations for multimodal SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: Mulberry-260K 用四模型树搜索发布图像推理与反思示范，供多模态 SFT 使用。

title: Multi-Agent Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization

one_line_summary.en: MATPO trains planner and worker roles within one LLM by assigning joint tool-use rollout rewards across nested agent trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: MATPO 在单一 LLM 内训练规划者与工作者角色，并对嵌套工具使用轨迹进行联合奖励归因。

title: Multi-Agent Verification: Scaling Test-Time Compute with Multiple Verifiers

one_line_summary.en: MAV scales test-time verification by aggregating multiple aspect-specific verifiers over best-of-n candidates.
one_line_summary.zh: MAV 通过聚合多个方面验证器来扩展 best-of-n 候选的测试时验证。

title: Multi-modal Agent Tuning: Building a VLM-Driven Agent for Efficient Tool Usage

one_line_summary.en: Multi-modal Agent Tuning synthesizes queries and files, executes GPT-4o-mini-controlled ReAct trajectories, applies query-file and trajectory judges, and fine-tunes VLM controllers on thought-and-code supervision.
one_line_summary.zh: Multi-modal Agent Tuning 用 GPT-4o mini 生成查询、文件与 ReAct 轨迹并经可执行代码门槛和双重同源 judge 筛选，公开 21,168 条 MM-Traj 记录；其构造 recipe 可供研究，但许可冲突、schema 失败、缺少拒绝账本与独立正确性核验阻断直接训练复用。

title: Multi-SWE-bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Issue Resolving

one_line_summary.en: Multi-SWE-bench releases expert-curated multilingual repository issues with Dockerized tests that programmatically score proposed patches.
one_line_summary.zh: Multi-SWE-bench 将专家审校的多语言仓库 issue、补丁与 Docker 测试环境打包，以可复现执行评测候选修复。

title: MultiChallenge: A Realistic Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark Challenging to Frontier LLMs

one_line_summary.en: MultiChallenge evaluates instruction retention, inference memory, versioned editing, and self-coherence in multi-turn dialogue with instance-level rubrics.
one_line_summary.zh: MultiChallenge 用实例级量表评估多轮对话中的指令保持、推断记忆、版本编辑与自洽性。

title: Multimodal RewardBench 2: Evaluating Omni Reward Models for Interleaved Text and Image

one_line_summary.en: MMRB2 tests one reward-model interface across image generation, editing, interleaved outputs, and image reasoning using 4,000 expert preference pairs.
one_line_summary.zh: 四类任务各 1,000 个专家偏好对，覆盖图像生成、编辑、交错生成与图像推理，适合研究统一多模态 judge。

title: Multimodal RewardBench: Holistic Evaluation of Reward Models for Vision Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Multimodal RewardBench provides 5,211 expert-annotated multimodal preference triplets for evaluating VLM reward models across six domains.
one_line_summary.zh: 5,211 个图文提示—优/劣回答三元组，覆盖推理、知识、安全、VQA 等六类反馈面，是训练和审计视觉语言判别器的基础基准。

title: Mutual-Taught for Co-adapting Policy and Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: Alternates RM-ranked on-policy DPO with mixed reward-model self-training, using filtered updated-versus-previous policy pairs to refresh the RM without new human labels.
one_line_summary.zh: 交替用当前 RM 排序的 on-policy 偏好训练策略，再用策略更新前后的响应构造经低质量过滤的混合偏好数据刷新 RM；机制可核验，但官方代码链接当前没有 Mutual-Taught 专用实现。

title: MWPO: Enhancing LLMs Performance through Multi-Weight Preference Strength and Length Optimization

one_line_summary.en: MWPO weights each DPO preference pair by its implicit reward margin and response-length margin to improve alignment while counteracting verbosity.
one_line_summary.zh: MWPO 依据隐式奖励差距与回答长度差距为每个 DPO 偏好回答对赋权，以提升对齐表现并抑制冗长输出。

title: NATURALREASONING: Reasoning in the Wild with 2.8M Challenging Questions
domains: English STEM, economics, social science, and other natural-domain reasoning

one_line_summary.en: NATURALREASONING scales domain-diverse question generation, attaches reference answers and named teacher responses, and exposes those records for distillation or self-training.
one_line_summary.zh: NATURALREASONING 把自然领域难题、参考答案和具名教师回答整理为 280 万条可蒸馏记录。

title: NaturalThoughts: Selecting and Distilling Reasoning Traces for General Reasoning Tasks

one_line_summary.en: NaturalThoughts selects DeepSeek-R1 traces by scale, difficulty, and reasoning-strategy diversity to identify which demonstrations best transfer general STEM reasoning to smaller students.
one_line_summary.zh: NaturalThoughts 按规模、难度和推理策略多样性选择 DeepSeek-R1 轨迹，研究哪些示范最能把通用 STEM 推理迁移给小模型。

title: Nemotron-Cascade: Scaling Cascaded Reinforcement Learning for General-Purpose Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: Nemotron-Cascade documents and partially releases a two-stage SFT plus RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math -> Code -> SWE cascade, with stage-specific feedback ranging from a scalar RM to tests and patch-similarity judging, but complete data-to-run lineage is unavailable.
one_line_summary.zh: Nemotron-Cascade 报告了 SFT 和 RLHF 之后按领域顺序开展的 RL，并提供 NVIDIA 的模型/数据工件，但逐领域反馈合约与端到端审计谱系仍不完整。

title: Nemotron-CrossThink: Scaling Self-Learning beyond Math Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Nemotron-CrossThink builds a 588,645-prompt multi-domain RLVR mixture with template and answer-space filters, releases 287,376 synthetic QA/math prompt records, and trains Qwen2.5 policies with exact answer-plus-format GRPO rewards.
one_line_summary.zh: Nemotron-CrossThink 报告了采用结构化、可验证问答和优化数据混合的跨领域 RL，但未披露语料清单、验证器实现或可复现控制信息。

title: Nemotron-Math: Efficient Long-Context Distillation of Mathematical Reasoning from Multi-Mode Supervision
domains: English competition and community mathematics, with optional Python tool use

one_line_summary.en: Nemotron-Math generates six supervision modes per source family and packages expected answers and provenance for long-context distillation.
one_line_summary.zh: Nemotron-Math 为奥数与社区数学题生成 750 万条多推理预算、可选 Python 工具的长解答。

title: Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2

one_line_summary.en: Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2 releases 6,341,414 SFT-style records across technical reasoning, chat, and five target languages, with generator and license metadata but without row-level selection or RL-stage lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2 发布 6,341,414 条覆盖技术推理、对话和五种目标语言的 SFT 风格记录，并保留生成器与许可字段；但逐条来源、筛选判定、拒绝候选、verifier 输出和训练阶段映射仍未披露。

title: Nex-N1: Agentic Models Trained via a Unified Ecosystem for Large-Scale Environment Construction
domains: English coding, research, chat, HTML generation, and tool-using agents

one_line_summary.en: Nex Agent-SFT reselects tasks from the Nex ecosystem, regenerates responses with a tool-capable teacher, and publishes six splits under one message-and-tools contract.
one_line_summary.zh: Nex Agent-SFT 把 69008 条代码、研究、对话、网页和工具轨迹统一为消息与工具结构。

title: No Free Labels: Limitations of LLM-as-a-Judge Without Human Grounding

one_line_summary.en: No Free Labels shows that LLM judges need human grounding to reliably grade correctness beyond questions they can answer.
one_line_summary.zh: No Free Labels 以金融专家的参考答案和正确性裁决揭示：没有人类依据时，LLM Judge 难以稳定判断正确性。

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3: Efficient and Open Intelligence

one_line_summary.en: Nemotron 3 documents multi-environment RL and broad weights/data/recipe releases, while retaining proprietary or gated source boundaries and incomplete per-environment audit detail.
one_line_summary.zh: Nemotron 3 披露多环境 RL 以及广泛的权重、数据和 recipe 发布，但仍保留专有或门控来源边界与不完整的逐环境审计细节。

title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model

one_line_summary.en: Nemotron Nano 2 aligns a 12B hybrid model with about 80B SFT tokens, rule- and reward-model feedback, on-policy DPO, GRPO and RLHF, then prunes/distills it to 9B while releasing the models and most training data.
one_line_summary.zh: Nemotron Nano 2 使用约 80B token 的 SFT、规则与奖励模型反馈、在线 DPO、GRPO 和 RLHF 对齐 12B 模型，再剪枝蒸馏至 9B，并发布模型与大部分训练数据。

title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL

one_line_summary.en: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL discloses a five-stage multimodal SFT schedule, weights, an 8.15M-row dataset, and OCR tooling, but the public release is not reconciled with the 39.49M-sample inventory or exact stage lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL 报告混合 Mamba-Transformer VLM、token reduction 和部分数据/配方/代码共享，但具体共享范围及反馈审计工件仍为 unknown。

title: Off-Policy Corrected Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

one_line_summary.en: Retrains reward models on one fixed preference dataset using stage-specific current-to-SFT importance weights between blocks of policy optimization.
one_line_summary.zh: 在 PPO 阶段之间，用当前策略相对 SFT 行为策略的重要性权重重训奖励模型；278,496 条偏好记录与标签不变，改变的是有效训练分布。

title: OLMo 2 32B: First fully open model to outperform GPT 3.5 and GPT 4o mini

one_line_summary.en: Ai2's OLMo 2 32B release links its data, weights, and recipe, and discloses SFT filtering, five-completion math majority selection, on-policy preference data, and GRPO-RLVR task families, while leaving reward implementation and complete provenance/audit details unresolved.
one_line_summary.zh: Ai2 的 OLMo 2 32B 发布链接了数据、权重和 recipe，并披露 SFT 过滤、五次 completion 的数学多数选择、on-policy 偏好数据和 GRPO-RLVR 任务族；reward 实现与完整来源/审计细节仍未解决。

title: Olympiad-level formal mathematical reasoning with reinforcement learning

one_line_summary.en: Olympiad-level formal mathematical reasoning with reinforcement learning records Lean tactic-state search and verified proof/disproof outcomes under Lean checker feedback.
one_line_summary.zh: AlphaProof 在 Lean 中以树搜索和测试时强化学习构造可验证证明经验，但核心课程与搜索日志未公开。

title: OmniAlign-V: Towards Enhanced Alignment of MLLMs with Human Preference

one_line_summary.en: OmniAlign-V-DPO releases 150K image-grounded chosen-rejected pairs built from OmniAlign-V answers and model-sampled negative responses for MLLM preference optimization.
one_line_summary.zh: OmniAlign-V-DPO 将图像、开放式问题、优选回答和模型采样的劣选回答发布为 15 万条偏好对，用于多模态大语言模型的 DPO 对齐。

title: On Evaluating LLM Alignment by Evaluating LLMs as Judges

one_line_summary.en: Connects generation-evaluation consistency with alignment assessment of LLM judges.
one_line_summary.zh: 以 LLM 作为判别器的能力间接评测生成对齐。

title: On the Effectiveness of LLM-as-a-judge for Code Generation and Summarization

one_line_summary.en: Tests whether LLM judges reliably assess code correctness and code-summary quality against executable and human references.
one_line_summary.zh: 审计大语言模型评审代码正确性和代码摘要质量时的可靠性与失效模式。

title: One Missing Piece for Open-Source Reasoning Models: A Dataset to Mitigate Cold-Starting Short CoT LLMs in RL
venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 6: Industry Track)

one_line_summary.en: A paper-described 100K long-CoT recipe retrieves o1 flow/budget seeds to guide GPT-4o stepwise generation and answer judgment, but the publication's release target remains the literal text LINK and no paper-matched artifact is verified.
one_line_summary.zh: Long CoT Collection 以 o1 推理流与思考预算种子检索来引导 GPT-4o 分步生成并进行答案判断；论文声称构造 100K 条数据，但发布位置仍是字面量“LINK”，尚无可核验的论文配套制品。

title: One Token to Fool LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: Superficial symbols or reasoning openers can make LLM judges award reference-conditioned positive rewards; truncated-lead-in negatives harden Master-RMs.
one_line_summary.zh: 证明极小的表面线索也能翻转 LLM 裁判结果，提醒量规和评审提示本身需要做对抗性测试。

title: Open-Reasoner-Zero: An Open Source Approach to Scaling Up Reinforcement Learning on the Base Model

one_line_summary.en: Open-Reasoner-Zero starts PPO directly from Qwen2.5 Base, samples 64 responses per prompt, scores boxed mathematical answers programmatically, and trains a token-value critic, while releasing prompts, code, and weights but withholding exact run trajectories, failures, and immutable manifests.
one_line_summary.zh: Open-Reasoner-Zero 不经过 SFT 或蒸馏、直接从 Qwen2.5 Base 启动 PPO，按每题 64 条在线响应分配终局数学奖励并训练 token-value critic；但公开的是 prompt/参考答案、代码和权重，而不是论文运行的 rollout、失败轨迹、奖励或日志。

title: OpenAI GPT-4.5 System Card

one_line_summary.en: OpenAI's GPT-4.5 system card discloses broad public/partnership/in-house data categories, smaller-model-derived alignment data, SFT, RLHF, filtering, and selected safety evaluation protocols, but not reproducible data or feedback contracts.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenAI 的 GPT-4.5 系统卡披露了宽泛的公开/合作/内部数据类别、来自小模型的对齐数据、SFT、RLHF、过滤及部分安全评测协议，但没有公开可复现的数据或反馈契约。

title: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card

one_line_summary.en: OpenAI's o3/o4-mini System Card discloses high-level data-source and filtering claims plus CoT reinforcement learning and safety alignment, while withholding reusable data, feedback contracts, and recipe details.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenAI o3/o4-mini System Card 仅披露高层数据来源、过滤、CoT 强化学习与安全对齐主张；训练数据、反馈契约和具体配方仍不可复用。

title: OpenAI o3-mini System Card

one_line_summary.en: OpenAI's o3-mini System Card reports broad pretraining-source categories, data filtering, large-scale reasoning RL, deliberative alignment, and safety evaluations, but not reusable records, the RL reward contract, or a reproducible post-training recipe.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenAI o3-mini System Card 披露了宽泛的预训练数据类别、过滤、大规模推理强化学习、deliberative alignment 与安全评测，但没有公开可复用记录、RL 奖励契约或可复现的后训练配方。

title: OpenCodeInstruct: A Large-scale Instruction Tuning Dataset for Code LLMs
domains: English code generation, debugging, algorithms, and programming questions

one_line_summary.en: OpenCodeInstruct scales multiple generation algorithms to five million pairs and stores unit tests, execution status, and model judgments beside each solution.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenCodeInstruct 为 500 万条代码指令配上测试、执行状态和模型评审，使解答质量可以逐条检查。

title: OpenCodeReasoning: Advancing Data Distillation for Competitive Coding

one_line_summary.en: OpenCodeReasoning releases DeepSeek-R1 competitive-programming traces for Qwen2.5 SFT and shows a diversity-versus-execution-filtering trade-off, but the main rows are not functionally certified and the current recipe has moved toward OCR-2.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenCodeReasoning 将 DeepSeek-R1 的竞赛编程推理与 Python 解答蒸馏为 Qwen2.5 的 SFT 数据，并揭示多样性与执行过滤的取舍；但主发布集只通过格式和语法检查，当前官方配方也已转向 OCR-2。

title: OpenCUA: Open Foundations for Computer-Use Agents

one_line_summary.en: OpenCUA turns 22,625 human desktop tasks into aligned screenshot-action traces with Claude-generated reflective supervision and releases the data, models, tools, and offline evaluator, while leaving full training and environment replay incomplete.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenCUA 将 22,625 个人类桌面任务处理为对齐的截图—动作轨迹并加入 Claude 合成的反思式监督，已发布数据、模型、工具和离线评测器，但完整训练与环境复现仍不完备。

title: OpenMathInstruct-2: Accelerating AI for Math with Massive Open-Source Instruction Data

one_line_summary.en: OpenMathInstruct-2 packages original and augmented GSM8K/MATH problems with teacher-written solutions and source-or-majority proxy answers, alongside reproducible generation, decontamination, downsampling, and SFT recipes.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenMathInstruct-2 用 Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct 的 solution augmentation 与 question-solution augmentation 构造 13,972,791 条数学 SFT 记录，并用 32 个解答的表面多数票生成新题答案；其规模与开放 recipe 价值明确，但阈值为 0、逐条投票/lineage 缺失和残余 Omni-MATH overlap 限制了可审计性。

title: OpenThoughts: Data Recipes for Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: OpenThoughts releases a 1.2M-row math/code/science SFT corpus and a controlled recipe showing that source choice, prompt filtering, repeated teacher sampling, and teacher selection matter more than the tested answer filters, while leaving row-level correctness and rights unresolved.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenThoughts 用来源筛选、prompt 过滤、16 次 QwQ-32B 采样和完整 SFT 构成 120 万条数学/代码/科学推理数据；其主要价值是把构造选择变成可对照的 recipe，但答案未做正确性验证，且来源权利、逐条 provenance 与仓库密钥卫生问题阻断直接训练复用。

title: OpenTuringBench: An Open-Model-based Benchmark and Framework for Machine-Generated Text Detection and Attribution

one_line_summary.en: Open benchmark relevant to attribution and audit of generated text under model shift.
one_line_summary.zh: 以七类压力场景检验开源 LLM 生成文本的检测与作者归因鲁棒性。

title: Operator System Card

one_line_summary.en: OpenAI's Operator System Card reports specialized supervised computer-use data, broad public-data sources, and reinforcement learning for a GPT-4o-based CUA, but leaves task records, rewards/verifiers, training environments, and lineage undisclosed.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenAI 的《Operator System Card》披露：基于 GPT-4o 的 CUA 使用专门的计算机操作监督数据、广义公开数据来源和强化学习；任务记录、奖励/验证器、训练环境及数据谱系均未披露。

title: Optimizing Chain-of-Thought Reasoners via Gradient Variance Minimization in Rejection Sampling and RL

one_line_summary.en: GVM-RAFT estimates per-prompt Math-Verify acceptance and accepted-response gradient magnitude from pilot rollouts, then reallocates a fixed online sampling budget before RAFT++ or GRPO updates.
one_line_summary.zh: GVM-RAFT 用 pilot rollout 估计逐提示 Math-Verify 接受率与被接受回答的梯度幅度，在固定总预算下重分配 RAFT++ 或 GRPO 采样，但论文运行缺少可审计的逐项 lineage 发布。

title: Optimizing Test-Time Compute via Meta Reinforcement Finetuning

one_line_summary.en: Optimizing Test-Time Compute via Meta Reinforcement Finetuning records test-time episodes and reasoning fragments under success-probability-change bonus plus outcome reward.
one_line_summary.zh: MRT 把思考过程切分为 episode，并以元证明器估计的进展奖励辅助终局强化学习。

title: OS-Genesis: Automating GUI Agent Trajectory Construction via Reverse Task Synthesis

one_line_summary.en: OS-Genesis explores virtual GUIs first, reverse-synthesizes executable tasks from state-action-state triples, and uses graded trajectory rewards to sample mobile and web agent trajectories for SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: OS-Genesis 先探索虚拟 GUI，再从状态—动作—状态三元组反向合成可执行任务，并用分级轨迹奖励采样移动端与网页智能体轨迹用于 SFT。

title: OS-Harm: A Benchmark for Measuring Safety of Computer Use Agents

one_line_summary.en: OS-Harm evaluates computer-use agents on 150 OSWorld tasks spanning misuse, prompt injection, and model misbehavior, with multimodal episode logs and a GPT-4.1 AER judge whose safety/completion F1 against 150 human-labeled o4-mini traces is 0.76/0.79.
one_line_summary.zh: OS-Harm以150个OSWorld Ubuntu VM任务评测计算机使用智能体的误用、prompt injection与模型失当，并用GPT-4.1 AER输出安全/完成判定及首个违规步骤，但judge召回不足与50/51条注入配置漂移限制了复现。

title: OSWorld-MCP: Benchmarking MCP Tool Invocation In Computer-Use Agents

one_line_summary.en: OSWorld-MCP evaluates 361 OSWorld desktop tasks with 158 curated MCP tools, per-step GUI/tool choice, task-specific environment checks, and tool-choice-aware TIR, while complete paper trajectories and immutable replay artifacts remain unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: OSWorld-MCP 在 361 个 OSWorld 桌面任务上引入 158 个经筛选的 MCP 工具，让智能体逐步选择 GUI 或工具，并用任务特定环境检查与 TIR 评估结果；论文实验的完整轨迹和不可变重放材料尚未发布。

title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research

one_line_summary.en: PaperBench evaluates 20 from-scratch ML-paper replications with 8,316 weighted rubric leaves, fresh-container execution, and an o3-mini judge, but releases no complete 646-run trajectory/submission corpus and remains exposed to judge, contamination, rights, replay, and secret-handling risks.
one_line_summary.zh: PaperBench 以 20 篇机器学习论文、8,316 个加权 rubric 叶节点和新鲜容器复现评估科研智能体，但官方并未发布覆盖 646 次论文实验的完整日志、快照、提交物、执行产物与逐叶裁判输出。

title: Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning: Exploring the Limits of Small Reasoning Language Models in Math

one_line_summary.en: Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning documents a four-stage math-reasoning pipeline over about 10M rollouts, with correct-trace distillation, rejected-rollout DPO, and final-answer RLVR, but releases weights rather than the training data or verifier stack.
one_line_summary.zh: Phi-4-Mini-Reasoning 报告了合成 CoT、Rollout DPO 与答案可验证 RL 的四阶段数学推理配方，但未发布完整数据、verifier 或审计资产。

title: Phi-4-reasoning Technical Report
domains: English mathematics, coding, science, planning, and algorithmic reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Mixture-of-Thoughts selects teachable prompts and packages teacher reasoning from several domains into a source-labeled conversation mixture.
one_line_summary.zh: Mixture-of-Thoughts 先挑选适合学生学习的题目，再汇集 34.9 万条跨数学、代码与科学的教师推理对话。

title: PhysReason: A Comprehensive Benchmark towards Physics-Based Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: PhysReason evaluates 1,200 diagram-aware physics problems with answer and step-level scoring, exposing whether errors arise from theorem use, process understanding, calculation, or conditions.
one_line_summary.zh: PhysReason 用 1,200 道含图物理题同时评测答案与逐步推理，区分定理应用、过程理解、计算和条件分析四类失误。

title: PKU-SafeRLHF: Towards Multi-Level Safety Alignment for LLMs with Human Preference

one_line_summary.en: PKU-SafeRLHF: Towards Multi-Level Safety Alignment for LLMs with Human Preference contributes a preference/reward feedback data object or construction method.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 PKU-SafeRLHF 安全偏好数据集，分离有用性与无害性偏好，并加入 19 类风险和三级严重度标签。

title: Planetarium: A Rigorous Benchmark for Translating Text to Structured Planning Languages

one_line_summary.en: Planetarium pairs four textual descriptions with planning problems and uses object-renaming-aware PDDL equivalence to distinguish solvable outputs from semantically correct ones.
one_line_summary.zh: Planetarium 以对象重命名不变的 PDDL 语义等价检查，区分可求解的规划输出与真正表达同一初始状态和目标的输出。

title: Policy Guided Tree Search for Enhanced LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: PGTS trains a GPS graph policy with PPO to navigate LLaMA 3.1 reasoning trees through expand, branch, backtrack, and paper-defined terminate decisions under explicit depth, breadth, and search-step budgets.
one_line_summary.zh: PGTS 用 PPO 训练 GPS 图策略，在显式宽度、深度和搜索步数预算下导航 LLaMA 3.1 的部分推理树；代码可表示未访问或已放弃分支，但未发布论文运行的原始树、完整策略分布、checkpoint 或逐样本预算日志。

title: Praetor: A Fine-Grained Generative LLM Evaluator with Instance-Level Customizable Evaluation Criteria

one_line_summary.en: Praetor trains a bilingual judge to apply optional or instance-specific criteria in pointwise and pairwise evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: Praetor 训练可在点式和成对评测中使用可选或实例化标准的中英双语评判模型。

title: Predicate-Guided Generation for Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Prolog-MATH translates 7,500 MATH training problems and CoTs into predicate-guided SWI-Prolog candidates, filters terminal answers symbolically, and applies SFT/GRPO recovery; the 97.4% paper union is not present as a reconciled public manifest.
one_line_summary.zh: Prolog-MATH 将 7,500 道 MATH 训练题及 CoT 转成 predicate-guided SWI-Prolog 候选，以终态符号等价筛选并用 SFT/GRPO 恢复失败；论文所述 97.4% 并集尚无可核对的公开清单。

title: Preference Leakage: A Contamination Problem in LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: judge relatedness bias and released synthesis/judgment data
one_line_summary.zh: 揭示生成器与 judge 的谱系关联会使 judge 偏向相关学生模型。

title: Preference Optimization for Reasoning with Pseudo Feedback

one_line_summary.en: PFPO constructs preference pairs for math and code reasoning by evaluating sampled solutions against frontier-generated or self-consistent pseudo test cases.
one_line_summary.zh: PFPO 通过在前沿模型生成或自一致伪测试用例上评估采样解答，为数学与代码推理构造偏好回答对。

title: Principled Data Selection for Alignment: The Hidden Risks of Difficult Examples

one_line_summary.en: Selective DPO filters preference pairs that are too difficult for the current model capacity.
one_line_summary.zh: Selective DPO 按模型容量筛除过难的偏好对，再执行直接偏好优化。

title: PRMBENCH: A Fine-grained and Challenging Benchmark for Process-Level Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: PRMBENCH provides 6,216 mathematical problems and 83,456 step labels to measure whether process reward models detect subtle reasoning errors.
one_line_summary.zh: 6,216题、83,456步标签，以正确性/合理性等细粒度反馈训练和诊断 PRM，直接服务多步数学推理。

title: Process Reward Models That Think

one_line_summary.en: ThinkPRM trains generative process verifiers on 1,000 QwQ-generated, PRM800K-label-filtered verification CoTs and spends additional verifier compute to score or select reasoning paths.
one_line_summary.zh: ThinkPRM 生成逐步验证推理，并把验证计算用于候选选择和奖励引导搜索。

title: Process vs. Outcome Reward: Which is Better for Agentic RAG Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: ReasonRAG releases RAG-ProGuide, 13K process-level preference pairs from MCTS and shortest-path reward estimation for training agentic retrieval policies.
one_line_summary.zh: ReasonRAG 发布 RAG-ProGuide：由 MCTS 和最短路径奖励估计构造的 1.3 万个过程级偏好对，用于训练智能检索策略。

title: Process-based Self-Rewarding Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Process-based Self-Rewarding Language Models addresses process-based self-rewarding supervision.
one_line_summary.zh: 过程式自奖励把长思维、逐步 LLM 裁判和逐步偏好优化引入数学推理的自奖励流程。

title: Process-Level Trajectory Evaluation for Environment Configuration in Software Engineering Agents

one_line_summary.en: EnConda-Bench turns pinned Python repositories and minimally corrupted READMEs into 4,201 environment-repair tasks scored by error labels, LLM-judged fixes, and Docker build/test success; the public release contains task records rather than replayable agent episodes.
one_line_summary.zh: EnConda-Bench 将固定版本的 Python 仓库与最小化破坏的 README 组织成 4,201 个环境修复任务，以错误标签、LLM 语义判断和 Docker 构建/测试终止条件评分；公开发布的是任务与金标修复记录，不是可回放的 agent trajectory。

title: Process-Supervised Reinforcement Learning for Interactive Multimodal Tool-Use Agents

one_line_summary.en: Each 1-30-turn retail sandbox rollout carries interleaved agent/environment tokens, GPT-4.1 turn scores, and a rule-verified terminal outcome, but the promised sandbox, tasks, rollouts, and checkpoints are not linked as released artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: TARL 为约3,000个零售任务的文本与语音工具使用 rollout 组合规则终局奖励和 GPT-4.1 逐轮评分，但稳定训练实际优化聚合后的轨迹标量，且论文承诺的 sandbox、任务、rollout 与 checkpoint 尚无已核验发布。

title: ProDS: Preference-oriented Data Selection for Instruction Tuning

one_line_summary.en: ProDS selects instruction records by their alignment with positive and negative target preference directions.
one_line_summary.zh: ProDS 用目标任务的正反偏好方向衡量样本影响，从而选择更适合监督微调的指令记录。

title: ProfBench: Multi-Domain Rubrics requiring Professional Knowledge to Answer and Judge

one_line_summary.en: ProfBench pairs professional prompts and grounding documents with expert response-rubric supervision across four domains.
one_line_summary.zh: ProfBench 为科学、金融和咨询报告提供专家撰写的细粒度准则，可同时评估回答模型与 Judge。

title: ProJudge: A Multi-Modal Multi-Discipline Benchmark and Instruction-Tuning Dataset for MLLM-based Process Judges

one_line_summary.en: ProJudge combines a 2,400-case human-labeled multimodal process-judge benchmark with a 173K instruction-tuning release for step-level error diagnosis.
one_line_summary.zh: ProJudge 以 2,400 个专家标注样例评测多模态过程裁判，并发布 17.3 万条训练记录强化逐步错误诊断。

title: Proposer-Agent-Evaluator (PAE): Autonomous Skill Discovery For Foundation Model Internet Agents

one_line_summary.en: PAE releases web-agent tasks and trajectories whose outcome rewards come from an autonomous VLM evaluator after context-aware task proposal.
one_line_summary.zh: PAE 让提案器自动发现网页任务、让智能体执行，并以视觉结果评估器产生 RL 奖励，公开任务与示例轨迹。

title: Provable Scaling Laws for the Test-Time Compute of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: The paper gives knockout and league aggregation algorithms with provable error decay as black-box LLM inference compute grows.
one_line_summary.zh: 该论文以淘汰赛和联赛式候选聚合证明：黑箱语言模型的测试时调用增加可使错误率按可刻画规律下降。

title: Proving the Coding Interview: A Benchmark for Formally Verified Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: FVAPPS reformulates coding-interview problems as Lean 4 programming-and-proof tasks, with compilation and theorem checking as the final verifier.
one_line_summary.zh: FVAPPS 将编程面试题改写为 Lean 4 的程序与证明任务，以编译和定理检查共同验证最终结果。

title: QCoder Benchmark: Bridging Language Generation and Quantum Hardware through Simulator-Based Feedback

one_line_summary.en: QCoder combines human quantum-programming contest submissions with simulator feedback so LLMs can be judged beyond ordinary Python execution.
one_line_summary.zh: QCoder 将量子编程竞赛中的人工代码与量子模拟器反馈结合，评测并改进受硬件约束的代码推理。

title: QuestBench: Can LLMs ask the right question to acquire information in reasoning tasks?

one_line_summary.en: QuestBench turns clarification into a solver-checked choice: select the single missing variable whose answer makes an underspecified reasoning problem uniquely solvable.
one_line_summary.zh: QuestBench 将澄清提问变为可由求解器验证的选择：找出唯一能消除题目剩余解歧义的缺失变量。

title: Qwen2.5-Math-PRM

one_line_summary.en: Qwen released 7B and 72B mathematical process reward models that score segmented reasoning steps through a 0–1 positive-class probability interface, but not their training data, labels, calibration, or construction/audit records.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen 发布了 7B 和 72B 数学过程奖励模型：通过分段推理文本中 extra_0 分隔 token 的正类概率给出 0–1 步级奖励；但训练数据、标签、校准和构造/审计记录没有公开。

title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Qwen2.5-Omni discloses multimodal pre-training categories and Phase-2 token totals, ChatML instruction-data modalities, and a WER/punctuation-ranked Talker DPO interface, but not the underlying records, reward implementation, sources, or audit artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen2.5-Omni 披露了多模态预训练类别及第二阶段 token 总量、ChatML 指令数据的模态构成，以及以 WER/标点停顿误差排序的 Talker DPO 接口；但未公开底层记录、奖励实现、数据来源或审计工件。

title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Qwen2.5-VL partially discloses 4.1T-scale multimodal training, a roughly 2M-entry SFT mixture, filtering, rejection-sampled reasoning, and SFT/DPO, while withholding reusable data, reward, lineage, and audit artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen2.5-VL 部分披露了 4.1T 规模多模态训练、约 200 万条 SFT 混合数据、过滤、拒绝采样推理与 SFT/DPO，但未公开可复用数据、reward、lineage 或审计工件。

title: Qwen3 Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Qwen3 partially discloses 36T pretraining, long-CoT filtering, 3,995 GRPO query-verifier pairs, fusion SFT, and distillation while withholding underlying data and verifier/audit details.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen3 技术报告部分披露了 36T 预训练、Long-CoT 过滤、3,995 个 GRPO query-verifier pairs、融合 SFT 与蒸馏，但未公开底层数据、verifier 细节或审计日志。

title: Qwen3-Coder: Agentic Coding in the World

one_line_summary.en: Qwen3-Coder reports 7.5T/70-percent-code pretraining, data cleaning, execution-driven Code RL, and 20,000 parallel Agent-RL environments but not the tasks, tests, trajectories, rewards, or audit records.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen3-Coder 报告了 7.5T、70% code 的预训练、数据清理、execution-driven Code RL 和 20,000 个并行 Agent-RL 环境，但未发布任务、测试、轨迹、reward 或审计记录。

title: Qwen3-Next: Towards Ultimate Training & Inference Efficiency

one_line_summary.en: Qwen3-Next releases Instruct and Thinking weights and reports 15T pretraining plus GSPO-assisted RL, but does not disclose post-training prompts, rewards or verifiers, rollout groups, filters, or audit records.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen3-Next 发布了 Instruct 与 Thinking 权重，并披露了 15T 预训练及以 GSPO 改善 RL 稳定性的高层信息；但后训练数据、奖励/验证器、rollout、过滤和审计记录均未公开。

title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Qwen3-VL discloses a 1.2M-sample multimodal SFT mixture and roughly 30K-query, 16-rollout Reasoning-RL recipe with separate rule and judge rewards, but releases no post-training corpus, rollout ledger, reward configuration, or item-level checkpoint lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen3-VL 报告原生 256K 多模态上下文和图像、视频、文本推理能力，但未披露后训练数据、反馈契约或审计工件。

title: Qwen3Guard Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Qwen3Guard discloses a 1.19M-scale human/synthetic safety-classification mixture, Gen SFT and Stream token-label construction, and a separate safety-RL use case, while withholding record provenance, full label/reward calibration, and reproducible training artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen3Guard 披露了约 119 万条人工/合成安全分类样本、Gen 的 SFT、Stream 的 token 级标签构造及一个独立的安全 RL 应用，但未公开记录级来源、完整标签/奖励校准或可复现训练工件。

title: QwQ-32B: Embracing the Power of Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: QwQ-32B discloses cold-start, outcome-based mathematics/code RL and a later general-RL stage, but withholds the training data, verifier implementations, reward calibration, and audit artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: QwQ-32B 披露了 cold-start、基于结果的数学/代码 RL 及后续通用 RL 阶段，但未公开训练数据、verifier 实现、奖励校准或审计工件。

title: R-PRM: Reasoning-Driven Process Reward Modeling
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

one_line_summary.en: R-PRM pairs step-level mathematical judgments with generated rationales and preference optimization to make process evaluation more accurate and useful.
one_line_summary.zh: R-PRM 将逐步数学判定与生成式理由及偏好优化结合，提高过程评估的准确性和可用性。

title: R.I.P.: Better Models by Survival of the Fittest Prompts

one_line_summary.en: RIP selects instruction prompts by rejected-answer quality and preference reward gap before DPO training.
one_line_summary.zh: RIP 通过拒选回答质量和偏好奖励间隔筛选提示，再构造用于 DPO 的记录。

title: R1-Onevision: Advancing Generalized Multimodal Reasoning through Cross-Modal Formalization

one_line_summary.en: R1-Onevision formalizes images for a language reasoner, filters the resulting multimodal CoT, and releases more than 155K demonstrations for visual reasoning SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: R1-Onevision 先把图像形式化为文本表示，再生成并过滤多模态思维链，发布超过 155K 条视觉推理示范用于 SFT。

title: R1-Reward: Training Multimodal Reward Model Through Stable Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: R1-Reward 以稳定强化学习训练多模态奖励模型，并公开相应的奖励训练数据和代码。

title: R2E-Gym: Procedural Environments and Hybrid Verifiers for Scaling Open-Weights SWE Agents

one_line_summary.en: R2E-Gym procedurally turns repository commits into more than 8,000 executable SWE environments with test-based rewards for training and evaluating open agents.
one_line_summary.zh: R2E-Gym 将仓库提交程序化转换为 8,000 余个可执行 SWE 环境，并以单测奖励支持开放代码 agent 的训练与评测。

title: R3: Robust Rubric-Agnostic Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: R3 让奖励模型根据输入量规生成可解释评分与理由，使奖励判断可控且可迁移。

title: RAG-Critic: Leveraging Automated Critic-Guided Agentic Workflow for Retrieval Augmented Generation

one_line_summary.en: RAG-Error-Critic-100K is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
one_line_summary.zh: 100K RAG回答含正确性判断、细粒度错误层级与诊断文本，可复用于检索推理反馈。

title: RAG-RewardBench: Benchmarking Reward Models in Retrieval Augmented Generation for Preference Alignment

one_line_summary.en: RAG-RewardBench provides 1,485 preference pairs for testing reward models on retrieval-specific reasoning, citation, abstention, and conflict cases.
one_line_summary.zh: 1,485组偏好对覆盖多跳推理、引用与冲突处理，以偏好标签训练或评估检索增强推理奖励。
