title: RAGferee: Contextual Reward Models for RAG

one_line_summary.en: RAGferee releases retrieval-grounded question answering contexts paired with competing answers and contextual quality choices for bounded preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and audit.
one_line_summary.zh: RAGferee 发布围绕其任务场景组织的候选回答比较与反馈记录，可用于有边界的偏好学习、奖励建模、评测和审计。

title: RATIONALYST: Pre-training Process-Supervision for Improving Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Reports a 79K implicit-rationale mixture filtered by future-token predictiveness and trains an 8B process supervisor, while the linked 15178-row dataset leaves the full release unreconciled.
one_line_summary.zh: 论文报告用后续 token 可预测性筛得约 7.9 万条隐式 rationale，并训练 8B 过程监督器；但官方链接数据集只有 15,178 行，完整发布尚未对齐。

title: RealCritic: Towards Effectiveness-Driven Evaluation of Language Model Critiques

one_line_summary.en: RealCritic evaluates critiques in a closed loop through whether they lead to effective corrections.
one_line_summary.zh: 以批评能否促成正确修正为闭环标准，评估自批评、交叉批评与迭代批评。

title: REASONING GYM: Reasoning Environments for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

one_line_summary.en: Reasoning Gym is an open library of more than 100 configurable procedural reasoning generators with task-specific executable rewards for dynamic RLVR training and evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: Reasoning Gym 将 100 多种可配置程序化推理生成器与任务专用可执行奖励组合起来，使带版本的“生成器—verifier”而非固定语料库成为可复用 RLVR 数据对象。

title: ReasonMed: A 370K Multi-Agent Generated Dataset for Advancing Medical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Routes nine candidate paths per medical MCQ through answer-key-conditioned verification and easy/medium/difficult repair, then releases three unequal SFT views totaling 1,111,555 rows.
one_line_summary.zh: 每道医学选择题拟生成九条路径，经答案键条件下的验证与难度路由修复后，发布三套不等长的 SFT 视图，共 1,111,555 行。

title: RefactorBench: Evaluating Stateful Reasoning in Language Agents Through Code

one_line_summary.en: RefactorBench tests language agents' persistent reasoning over cross-file state and code transformations through executable refactoring tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: RefactorBench 以可执行重构任务测试语言代理对跨文件状态与代码变换的持续推理。

title: Reference-Guided Verdict: LLMs-as-Judges in Automatic Evaluation of Natural Language Generation

one_line_summary.en: Studies reference-guided multi-judge evaluation and reliability tradeoffs.
one_line_summary.zh: 以参考答案引导多个 LLM judge 多数投票，评估自由问答回答与人工判决的一致性。

title: ReGenesis: LLMs can Grow into Reasoning Generalists via Self-Improvement

one_line_summary.en: ReGenesis transforms 25 general reasoning guidelines into task-specific structures and answer-selected paths, retaining at most five trajectories per instruction for SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: ReGenesis 用 25 条通用推理准则逐层生成任务准则、结构与答案筛选轨迹，展示了跨任务自生成 SFT 配方，但终局匹配不能验证步骤且官方语料与代码尚未发布。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models via Group Preference Reward Shaping

one_line_summary.en: GPRS replaces raw reward optimization with within-group preference shaping to reduce reward-model sensitivity.
one_line_summary.zh: 以组内偏好塑形替代原始分数优化，降低无 critic RLHF 对奖励模型质量的敏感性。

title: Reinforcement Learning Teachers of Test Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: RLT trains a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct teacher with dense frozen-student likelihood and explanation-KL feedback to generate raw explanations from known question-solution pairs for downstream distillation.
one_line_summary.zh: RLT 以冻结学生的答案似然和解释 KL 反馈训练 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 教师，让其基于已知问题—答案对生成供蒸馏的原始解释，但未发布轨迹数据或明确的教师权重。

title: RePanda: Pandas-powered Tabular Verification and Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: RePanda converts table claims into executable pandas queries so fact verification is determined by rerunnable table operations rather than a black-box label.
one_line_summary.zh: RePanda 将表格断言编译为可执行的 pandas 查询，使事实核验可由重运行的表格操作决定。

title: Replay Failures as Successes: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following

one_line_summary.en: HiR selects partially successful failed rollouts, rewrites them from satisfied constraints, and replays them during RL.
one_line_summary.zh: HiR 挑出部分成功的失败采样，按其已满足的约束改写它们，并在强化学习中回放。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）

title: ResearchRubrics: A Benchmark of Prompts and Rubrics For Evaluating Deep Research Agents

one_line_summary.en: ResearchRubrics pairs realistic research prompts with human-written criteria for granular agent evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: ResearchRubrics 用人类撰写并复核的细粒度准则，衡量深度研究 Agent 的事实依据、推理与表达。

title: Rethinking and Improving Autoformalization: Towards a Faithful Metric and a Dependency Retrieval-Based Approach

one_line_summary.en: This work couples a bidirectional Lean equivalence verifier with dependency retrieval and the 961-item Con-NF benchmark to measure and improve faithful autoformalization.
one_line_summary.zh: 论文以双向 BEq 验证、依赖检索和 961 题 Con-NF，将自动形式化的评测从可编译性推进到可验证的语义等价。

title: Rethinking Data Selection at Scale: Random Selection is Almost All You Need
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025

one_line_summary.en: The study selects 10K or 50K OpenHermes and English WildChat conversations with gradient, loss, uncertainty, diversity, compression, random, or token-length rules, then compares Qwen2-7B and Llama3-8B SFT across five benchmark families.
one_line_summary.zh: 该 Findings of EMNLP 2025 研究在 OpenHermes 与 English WildChat 两个大池上比较六种 self-scoring selector、五次 random control 及 10K/50K SFT subset，显示复杂选择很少稳定胜过随机；其 token-length+K-means 实用 recipe 虽强，但公开代码只处理前 100 个 embedding 并选择 cluster center，不能复现论文的按 cluster 比例选择最长样本。

title: Rethinking Fine-Tuning when Scaling Test-Time Compute: Limiting Confidence Improves Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: DCO aligns fine-tuning with a chosen pass@N test-time budget by limiting overconfidence and preserving useful answer diversity.
one_line_summary.zh: DCO 通过限制过度置信，使微调目标与预定的 pass@N 测试时采样预算对齐，并保留有用的答案多样性。

title: Rethinking Optimal Verification Granularity for Compute-Efficient Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: VG-Search controls verifier cadence to trade prefix pruning against inference cost.
one_line_summary.zh: VG-Search 通过控制验证器的调用频率，在前缀剪枝收益与推理开销之间做权衡。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）

title: Retrieval-Augmented Process Reward Model for Generalizable Mathematical Reasoning
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025

one_line_summary.en: RetrievalPRM releases retrieval-augmented step supervision so process reward models can judge unfamiliar mathematical reasoning patterns more reliably.
one_line_summary.zh: RetrievalPRM 发布检索增强的步骤监督数据，使过程奖励模型能更可靠地判断陌生的数学推理模式。

title: ReVISE: Learning to Refine at Test-Time via Intrinsic Self-Verification

one_line_summary.en: ReVISE converts failed and successful reasoning paths into preference pairs for intrinsic verification and refinement.
one_line_summary.zh: ReVISE 把失败与成功的推理路径转成偏好对，用于内生的自我验证与改写。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）

title: Revisiting Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning from A Cross-Domain Perspective

one_line_summary.en: GURU filters about 684.9K public and synthetic candidates into 91,909 training rows spanning mathematics, code, science, logic, simulation, and tables, with rule, execution, or model-based rewards.
one_line_summary.zh: GURU 将约 68.49 万条候选过滤为 91,909 条六领域 RLVR 训练记录，并为不同领域配置规则、执行或模型验证奖励。

title: RewardBench 2: Advancing Reward Model Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: RewardBench 2 adds 1,865 new human-prompt preference examples for harder, multi-skill reward-model evaluation linked to downstream use.
one_line_summary.zh: 1,865条新偏好评测覆盖数学等任务，以相对偏好检验 RM，适合验证通用推理奖励的泛化。

title: RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Language Modeling

one_line_summary.en: RewardBench supplies 2,985 prompt-chosen-rejected comparisons for evaluating reward models on chat, reasoning, safety, and subtle correctness failures.
one_line_summary.zh: 2,985组偏好对含推理与代码子集，提供 chosen/rejected 监督，是通用奖励模型的基础对照。

title: Rewarding Graph Reasoning Process makes LLMs more Generalized Reasoners
venue: Proceedings of the 31st ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2025)

one_line_summary.en: GraphSilo provides 118,189 graph-reasoning solution pairs with automatically derived step labels for training GraphPRM across 13 tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: GraphSilo 提供 11.8 万余个图推理解答对及自动生成的步骤标签，用于在 13 类任务上训练 GraphPRM。

title: reWordBench: Benchmarking and Improving the Robustness of Reward Models with Transformed Inputs

one_line_summary.en: Meaning-preserving input transformations audit whether reward models rely on brittle shortcuts.
one_line_summary.zh: reWordBench用语义或排序不变改写揭示奖励模型捷径，并以同分改写训练提升鲁棒性。

title: RLAIF-V: Open-Source AI Feedback Leads to Super GPT-4V Trustworthiness

one_line_summary.en: RLAIF-V: Open-Source AI Feedback Leads to Super GPT-4V Trustworthiness releases open-source visual-language-model feedback over image-text responses; synthetic labels target hallucination and trustworthiness for preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and feedback audit.
one_line_summary.zh: 开放视觉语言模型生成的图文偏好反馈，用于降低视觉幻觉并训练多模态奖励模型。

title: RLVR-World: Training World Models with Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: Releases code, two derived language-transition datasets and RLVR checkpoints for world models whose programmatic rewards are exact state/item agreement or frame-level L1 plus LPIPS, while upstream lineage and audit artifacts remain partial.
one_line_summary.zh: RLVR-World 发布了代码、两个派生语言状态转移数据集和 RLVR 检查点；其文本、网页与视频世界模型分别采用精确状态/条目一致性或 L1 加 LPIPS 反馈，但上游数据血缘、权利、切分和审计工件仍不完整。

title: RM-Bench: Benchmarking Reward Models of Language Models with Subtlety and Style

one_line_summary.en: RM-Bench tests reward models on 11,943 controlled comparisons that separate subtle content quality from style bias.
one_line_summary.zh: 1,327提示、11,943偏好比较含数学和代码，以细微内容差异检验奖励是否真正识别推理质量。

title: RMB: Comprehensively Benchmarking Reward Models in LLM Alignment

one_line_summary.en: RMB evaluates reward models across 49 real-world scenarios with both pairwise and Best-of-N preference tests.
one_line_summary.zh: 49类真实场景、约1.8万偏好比较，同时测 pairwise 与 Best-of-N，含代码和推理场景的奖励反馈。

title: RoboMonkey: Scaling Test-Time Sampling and Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models

one_line_summary.en: RoboMonkey ranks sampled VLA actions with a verifier trained on RMSE-derived preferences.
one_line_summary.zh: RoboMonkey 用基于均方根误差偏好训练的验证器，对采样出的视觉语言动作候选排序。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）

title: Robust Preference Optimization via Dynamic Target Margins

one_line_summary.en: γ-PO converts each preference pair's reward margin into an instance-specific target, strengthening clear supervision and smoothing ambiguous supervision.
one_line_summary.zh: γ-PO 将每个偏好对的奖励间隔转为动态目标边界，强化清晰监督并平滑模糊监督。

title: Rollout Roulette: A Probabilistic Inference Approach to Inference-Time Scaling of LLMs using Particle-Based Monte Carlo Methods

one_line_summary.en: Rollout Roulette uses particle filtering to preserve diverse reasoning trajectories under process-reward uncertainty.
one_line_summary.zh: Rollout Roulette 利用粒子滤波在过程奖励不确定时保留多样化的推理轨迹。

title: RottenReviews: Benchmarking Review Quality with Human and LLM-Based Judgments

one_line_summary.en: RottenReviews benchmarks peer-review quality with human expert labels, review metadata, and LLM-based judgments.
one_line_summary.zh: 将评审文本、学者画像与专家标注结合，量化检验同行评审质量及 LLM 裁判的可靠性。

title: RPM-MCTS: Knowledge-Retrieval as Process Reward Model with Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: RPM-MCTS: Knowledge-Retrieval as Process Reward Model with Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation records thought/tree nodes retrieval scores similarity filter and sandbox feedback under retrieval-as-PRM and execution feedback.
one_line_summary.zh: RPM-MCTS 将检索相似度、沙盒反馈与 LLM 判断结合为代码规划树的过程信号。

title: rStar-Coder: Scaling Competitive Code Reasoning with a Large-Scale Verified Dataset

one_line_summary.en: rStar-Coder expands reference-bearing competition problems into synthesized problems, executable tests, and long-reasoning solutions through LLM generation, program execution, agreement filtering, and decontamination, while its public configs and supplemental code do not fully reconstruct the paper run.
one_line_summary.zh: rStar-Coder 将竞赛编程种子扩展为合成题、多尺度测试和长推理解答，并以程序执行和跨解答一致性筛选；但公开配置与补充代码尚不能完整重建论文运行。

title: rStar-Math: Small LLMs Can Master Math Reasoning with Self-Evolved Deep Thinking

one_line_summary.en: rStar-Math turns answer-keyed math problems into code-executed MCTS trajectories and Q-ranked step preferences across four self-evolution rounds, releasing flattened SFT and PPM tables but not the underlying source/tree lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: rStar-Math 通过四轮自演化，把带答案的数学题转化为经 Python 执行筛选的 MCTS 轨迹与按 Q-value 构造的步骤偏好；公开 SFT 和 PPM 扁平表，但未公开支撑审计的来源与搜索树 lineage。

title: Rubrics as Rewards: Reinforcement Learning Beyond Verifiable Domains

one_line_summary.en: RaR trains policies with instance-specific, checklist-style rubrics, releasing medicine and science data for structured reward learning beyond binary verification.
one_line_summary.zh: 22.9K 科学推理题含 5–12 条带权 rubric，以实例级标准作 GRPO 奖励，覆盖多类科学推理。

title: Rubrik’s Cube: Testing a New Rubric for Evaluating Explanations on the CUBE dataset

one_line_summary.en: Rubrik’s CUBE releases 26,000 explanations with human and model quality annotations under an education-inspired evaluation rubric.
one_line_summary.zh: CUBE 含约 2.6 万解释及人类、六类模型的量规质量标注，覆盖推理和语言任务，可训练可解释的质量评判器。

title: S*: Test Time Scaling for Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: S*: Test Time Scaling for Code Generation
one_line_summary.zh: 代码生成既需要更广候选覆盖，也需要可靠选择，但仅靠并行采样可能错过修复机会，而代码正确性需要可执行的区分。

title: s1: Simple test-time scaling

one_line_summary.en: s1 filters a 59,029-question mixed-source pool by generation quality, Qwen difficulty, Claude-labeled diversity, and trace length into the 1,000-example Gemini-distilled s1K, then combines SFT with inference-time budget forcing.
one_line_summary.zh: s1 从 59,029 道混合来源题目经生成成功、格式、Qwen 难度与 Claude 领域筛选得到 1,000 条 Gemini 蒸馏 s1K，再用 inference-time budget forcing 控制思考长度；但 s1K 仅 53.6% 被 judge 判对，公开 full59K 还缺 43 行。

title: Safe: Enhancing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models via Retrospective Step-aware Formal Verification

one_line_summary.en: Safe turns each mathematical reasoning step into a Lean 4 verification problem, releasing FormalStep to make process judgments interpretable and checkable.
one_line_summary.zh: Safe 将数学推理的每一步回溯性地形式化为 Lean 4 验证问题，并以 FormalStep 提供可检查的逐步正确性信号。

title: Safer or Luckier? LLMs as Safety Evaluators Are Not Robust to Artifacts

one_line_summary.en: Audits artifact sensitivity, self-consistency, and human alignment in safety judges.
one_line_summary.zh: 审计 11 个安全 judge 的 artifact 偏差、重复一致性与人类对齐，显示 jury 也无法消除风险。

title: Safety in Large Reasoning Models: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: A Findings EMNLP 2025 survey of safety risks, attacks, and defenses for large reasoning models.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统整理大推理模型的安全风险、攻击与防御。

title: Sampling-Efficient Test-Time Scaling: Self-Estimating the Best-of-N Sampling in Early Decoding

one_line_summary.en: A Best-of-N selector that replaces explicit reward scoring with hidden-state Chain-of-Embedding information.
one_line_summary.zh: ST-BoN 在 Best-of-N 的早期解码阶段用内部状态的一致性估计潜在优质路径，提前截断较差候选而不训练显式奖励模型。

title: Scalable Best-of-N Selection for Large Language Models via Self-Certainty

one_line_summary.en: A NeurIPS 2025 Best-of-N selector that scores each sampled response from its full token distributions and optionally combines confidence rank with answer frequency through Borda voting.
one_line_summary.zh: 这项 NeurIPS 2025 工作用完整词元分布为每个采样回答打分以做 Best-of-N 选择，并可通过 Borda 投票把置信度排名与答案频次结合。

title: Scale Down to Speed Up: Dynamic Data Selection for Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: ScalingRL turns a 220K mathematical prompt pool into a dynamically sampled 1.5K RL curriculum using difficulty, reasoning complexity, and reward adaptability.
one_line_summary.zh: ScalingRL 用难度、推理复杂度和奖励适应性，把 22 万道数学题转化为动态抽取的 1,500 题强化学习课程。

title: SCALE: Selective Resource Allocation for Overcoming Performance Bottlenecks in Mathematical Test-time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: SCALE releases QwQ-32B mathematical traces with decomposed steps and self-assessed difficulty scores, routing each step by a threshold and filtering only final-answer matches.
one_line_summary.zh: SCALE 发布带子问题、难度分数和详细步骤的 QwQ-32B 数学轨迹，并按阈值选择测试时模式；它只以最终答案匹配过滤，缺少完整选择与算力审计记录。

title: Scaling Code-Assisted Chain-of-Thoughts and Instructions for Model Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Caco converts four source mixtures into 146K verified seed programs, samples about 5.3M new programs, and releases 1,348,799 reversed instruction-solution rows with their answers and code after multi-stage filtering.
one_line_summary.zh: Caco 将四类来源数据转为 146K 条已验证种子程序，再采样约 5.3M 个程序，并在多级过滤后发布 1,348,799 条带答案与代码的反向构造指令—解答记录。

title: Scaling Test-time Compute for LLM Agents

one_line_summary.en: This study maps which test-time scaling mechanisms improve tool-using language agents and finds selective reflection, list-wise comparison, and diverse rollouts effective.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究系统比较并行采样、选择性反思、列表式验证与多智能体轨迹多样性对语言智能体测试时扩展的影响。

title: Scaling Test-Time Compute Without Verification or RL is Suboptimal

one_line_summary.en: The paper argues that verifier-guided RL or search scales test-time compute better than cloning expert traces when correct reasoning is heterogeneous.
one_line_summary.zh: 论文论证：当正确推理具有异质性时，验证器引导的强化学习或搜索比模仿专家轨迹更能扩展测试时计算。

title: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning: A Recurrent Depth Approach

one_line_summary.en: A depth-recurrent language model scales inference compute by iterating hidden-state reasoning rather than producing longer visible chains.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究以隐空间循环深度替代更长文字思维链，使模型通过更多内部迭代扩展测试时计算。

title: SCAN: Self-Denoising Monte Carlo Annotation for Robust Process Reward Learning

one_line_summary.en: SCAN-Pro releases 197K mathematical trajectories with step scores, using confidence-guided Monte Carlo denoising for robust PRM training.
one_line_summary.zh: SCAN-Pro 发布 19.7 万条带步骤分数的数学轨迹，以置信度引导的蒙特卡洛去噪支持稳健过程奖励训练。

title: SciArena: An Open Evaluation Platform for Non-Verifiable Scientific Literature-Grounded Tasks

one_line_summary.en: SciArena collects researcher pairwise votes to evaluate literature-grounded scientific answers without one gold response.
one_line_summary.zh: 以科研用户的对战偏好和引用记录，评测没有唯一答案的科学文献问答。

title: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery

one_line_summary.en: ScienceAgentBench rigorously evaluates data-tool-using language agents on expert-validated scientific discovery tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: 以专家验证的科学发现任务，严谨评测可调用数据工具的语言 Agent。

title: ScienceBoard: Evaluating Multimodal Autonomous Agents in Realistic Scientific Workflows

one_line_summary.en: ScienceBoard evaluates computer-use agents on 169 human-curated scientific workflows across six domains using a released Ubuntu VM, task-specific internal-state evaluators, and partially documented trajectory archives.
one_line_summary.zh: ScienceBoard 用 169 个六领域科学工作流任务、Ubuntu 科学软件 VM 和任务特定内部状态 evaluator 评测 computer-use agents，并公开环境、代码及部分轨迹压缩包。

title: SeaPO: Strategic Error Amplification for Robust Preference Optimization of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: SeaPO creates deliberately more erroneous rejected responses so preference optimization can suppress targeted reasoning, logic, and hallucination errors.
one_line_summary.zh: SeaPO 刻意构造错误更明显的被拒回答，使偏好优化能压低指定的推理、逻辑和幻觉错误。

title: Search-o1: Agentic Search-Enhanced Large Reasoning Models

one_line_summary.en: Search-o1 interleaves QwQ-32B-Preview reasoning with live top-10 web retrieval and a separate Reason-in-Documents rewrite, but releases no versioned trajectory corpus or web snapshot.
one_line_summary.zh: Search-o1 在推理时生成查询、检索网页并压缩文档内容；它是推理时搜索框架而非训练轨迹发布。

title: Search-Time Data Contamination
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Evaluating the Evolving LLM Lifecycle

one_line_summary.en: Local BibTeX seed for the 🧭 Surveys and Primers map; use it to inspect the paper's data object, verifier contract, and release metadata before promoting it.
one_line_summary.zh: 把检索或搜索阶段引入的泄漏作为独立污染源，提示评测不能只检查训练语料重叠。

title: Seed-Coder: Let the Code Model Curate Data for Itself

one_line_summary.en: Seed-Coder builds a 6T curriculum with external-teacher quality scoring, then adds 3M SFT, 20K sandbox-derived preferences, and 250-step LongCoT GRPO while withholding data, scorer, tests, rewards, and lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Seed-Coder 用外部 teacher 标注与 1.3B scorer 构造 6T-token curriculum，再加入 3M SFT、20K sandbox preference 与 250-step LongCoT GRPO，但未发布数据、scorer、测试、reward 或记录级 lineage。

title: Seed-Prover 1.5: Mastering Undergraduate-Level Theorem Proving via Learning from Experience

one_line_summary.en: Seed-Prover 1.5 turns Lean, Mathlib search, Python calls, cached lemmas, and failure summaries into outcome-rewarded trajectories, then adds rubric-trained NL-to-Lean sketches and recursive proof search; 11 Putnam 2025 proofs are open, but training experience is not.
one_line_summary.zh: Seed-Prover 1.5 将 Lean、Mathlib 搜索、Python 调用、缓存 lemma 与失败摘要组织为终止奖励的 agent 轨迹，再以 Rubric RL 的 NL-to-Lean sketch 和递归证明树扩展推理；公开的 11 个 Putnam 2025 证明并不等于训练经验数据发布。

title: Seed-Prover: Deep and Broad Reasoning for Automated Theorem Proving

one_line_summary.en: Seed-Prover trains a lemma-first Lean policy with binary proof rewards and feedback-rich prompts, then scales from iterative repair to 5,000-conjecture search; Seed-Geometry adds a reported 230M-problem corpus, while only successful proof artifacts are open.
one_line_summary.zh: Seed-Prover 以 Lean 二值成功奖励训练 lemma-first 证明策略，并从编译反馈迭代扩展到 5,000 个猜想的重搜索；Seed-Geometry 报告了 2.3 亿问题，但公开仓库仅含成功证明 artifact，不是训练数据发布。

title: Seed1.5-Thinking: Advancing Superb Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: ByteDance Seed reports four reasoning-RL data families, 400k long-CoT SFT examples, filters, verifiers, and reward modeling without releasing source-level data or full audit metadata.
one_line_summary.zh: ByteDance Seed 披露四类推理 RL 数据、40 万条 long-CoT SFT、过滤器、verifier 与 reward modeling，但未发布来源级数据或完整审计元数据。

title: Seed1.5-VL Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Seed1.5-VL discloses a 3T-scale multimodal pipeline and hybrid RLHF/RLVR recipe, while releasing API access and sample code rather than model weights or training records.
one_line_summary.zh: Seed1.5-VL 报告了彼此分离的数据构建、SFT、RLHF 与 RLVR 阶段，但未确立可复用数据工件或完整、可审计的反馈配方。

title: Selective Preference Optimization via Token-Level Reward Function Estimation

one_line_summary.en: SePO trains a small DPO oracle to select only high-value chosen tokens and low-value rejected tokens for preference optimization.
one_line_summary.zh: SePO 训练一个小型 DPO oracle，从偏好对中选出高价值的入选 token 与低价值的拒绝 token 进行偏好优化。

title: Self-Consistency Preference Optimization

one_line_summary.en: A DPO construction recipe that derives preference labels from repeated-answer self-consistency.
one_line_summary.zh: ScPO 对同一问题采样多份答案，依据答案频次把更一致的回答作为偏好对的正例，用 DPO 训练模型偏向一致答案。

title: Self-rewarding correction for mathematical reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Sequential rejection sampling builds verifier-selected answer/evaluation/correction trajectories for SFT before correctness-reward PPO or DPO; the 31,990-row final release lacks complete construction lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: 公开 31990 条经筛选的自评/纠正轨迹及 SFT 到 PPO/DPO 配方，但谱系、拒绝数和许可证不完整。

title: Self-Steering Optimization: Autonomous Preference Optimization for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Self-Steering Optimization trains a policy-derived generator to synthesize accurate, near-on-policy preference pairs for later preference optimization.
one_line_summary.zh: Self-Steering Optimization 训练一个源自策略模型的生成器，为后续偏好优化合成准确且接近 on-policy 的偏好对。

title: Self-Training Elicits Concise Reasoning in Large Language Models
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025

one_line_summary.en: Per-question self-training selects the shortest parser-correct target-model rollout—optionally from few-shot-conditioned candidates—and distills it with one-epoch SFT for shorter greedy math reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法从目标模型在数学题上生成的多个推理路径中选择最终答案经解析器核验的最短路径（可结合少样本条件），再用于 SFT 以获得更简洁的推理。

title: Self-Training Meets Consistency: Improving LLMs' Reasoning with Consistency-Driven Rationale Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: CREST samples 16 rationales per multiple-choice item, scores originally correct candidates with option-wise consistency probes, and converts the scores into tolerance-filtered SFT records and mixed DPO pairs.
one_line_summary.zh: 按原题答案和选项级追问一致性评价每题 16 条自生成 rationale，再构造容错 SFT 与混合 DPO 数据。

title: SeRL: Self-play Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models with Limited Data

one_line_summary.en: SeRL generates questions from a 500-example seed, filters them by diversity and self-consensus difficulty, and trains on sixteen-response agreement rewards, while releasing code and prompt snapshots rather than complete paper-run trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: SeRL 从 500 条 seed instructions 出发，在线生成问题，以 16 个响应的 Math-Verify 等价聚类和多数一致构造二元奖励，再用 Reinforce++ 更新同一 policy；但公开物只有代码与 prompt snapshots，缺少论文运行的完整 responses、rewards、failures、logs、checkpoints 与 manifests，并存在 paper/code 配置漂移和 2,802 条 exact duplicate prompts。

title: SETS: Leveraging Self-Verification and Self-Correction for Improved Test-Time Scaling

one_line_summary.en: A training-free self-verification/self-correction loop with explicit repeated-answer and correction objects.
one_line_summary.zh: SETS 先并行生成多个答案，再由模型自我核验并在有限轮次内自我修正；它依赖模型自身判断，不等同于外部正确性验证器。

title: SiriuS: Self-improving Multi-agent Systems via Bootstrapped Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: SiriuS turns terminally successful interactions into per-role SFT records and repairs failed QA episodes through critique, regeneration, rephrasing, and downstream replay, but does not release the libraries.
one_line_summary.zh: SiriuS 用终局成功筛选角色级 SFT 记录，并通过 ground-truth-guided critique、regeneration、rephrasing 与下游 replay 修复失败轨迹；当前只公开五条 physics sample input，未公开论文 experience library、失败账本、feedback、模型或日志。

title: Skip-Thinking: Chunk-wise Chain-of-Thought Distillation Enable Smaller Language Models to Reason Better and Faster

one_line_summary.en: A selective CoT compression approach that treats omitted intermediate steps as a controlled construction decision.
one_line_summary.zh: Skip-Thinking 以 text-davinci-002 生成的 CoT 为教师轨迹，按 chunk 进行 CWT、SBC 与 STT 等选择性跳过，以训练更短的推理。

title: Skywork-Reward-V2: Scaling Preference Data Curation via Human-AI Synergy

one_line_summary.en: Skywork-Reward-V2: Scaling Preference Data Curation via Human-AI Synergy contributes a preference/reward feedback data object or construction method.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 SynPref-40M 并提出人机协同的数据筛选与校验流程，用大规模高质量偏好数据训练通用奖励模型。

title: SmolLM2: When Smol Goes Big - Data-Centric Training of a Small Language Model
domains: primarily English chat, mathematics, code, rewriting, constraints, and everyday instruction following

one_line_summary.en: SmolTalk combines inherited and newly generated conversations under one message schema, then tunes source weights through ablations and manual mixture review.
one_line_summary.zh: SmolTalk 用统一对话结构汇集约 110 万条指令记录，并通过消融与人工复核调整小模型的后训练配比。

title: Socratic-MCTS: Test-Time Visual Reasoning by Asking the Right Questions

one_line_summary.en: A test-time MCTS that makes subquestion generation and agreement-weighted visual reasoning explicit.
one_line_summary.zh: Socratic-MCTS 在冻结的视觉语言模型输出中插入子问题—子答案对，以 MCTS 方式延展视觉推理，并用内部一致性投票选择答案。

title: SolEval: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Repository-level Solidity Smart Contract Generation

one_line_summary.en: SolEval releases 1,507 Solidity repository tasks whose generated contracts are jointly checked by Foundry tests, Slither scans, and gas profiling.
one_line_summary.zh: SolEval 从 28 个 Solidity 仓库发布 1,507 个任务，并以 Foundry 测试、Slither 安全扫描和 gas 指标联合验证合约生成。

title: SoTA with Less: MCTS-Guided Sample Selection for Data-Efficient Visual Reasoning Self-Improvement

one_line_summary.en: ThinkLite-VL uses model-specific MCTS solve depth and unsolved-after-50 status to select 11K/7.5K visual-reasoning prompts from a 70K pool for one-stage GRPO self-improvement.
one_line_summary.zh: ThinkLite-VL 以模型特定的 MCTS 求解深度与 50 轮未解状态，从 69,997 条视觉推理候选中选出 11K/7.5K 提示用于 GRPO；价值在难度感知筛选，边界是判别器与决策谱系未完整公开。

title: SoundMind: RL-Incentivized Logic Reasoning for Audio-Language Models

one_line_summary.en: SoundMind converts 6,446 logical triplets into aligned text and speech chain-of-thought demonstrations with entailment labels for audio-language SFT and rule-reward training.
one_line_summary.zh: SoundMind 将 6,446 个逻辑三元组转为文本与语音对齐的长推理示范和蕴含标签，用于音频语言模型的监督微调与规则奖励训练。

title: SPARQ: Synthetic Problem Generation for Reasoning via Quality-Diversity Algorithms

one_line_summary.en: SPARQ recursively mutates MATH problems, scores each child with 16 student rollouts, and turns successful student solutions from nontrivial children into SFT tuples organized by learned skill cells.
one_line_summary.zh: SPARQ 递归变异 MATH 题目，用 16 条学生 rollout 估计子题难度，并将非平凡子题的成功学生解答组织成按技能单元索引的 SFT 元组。

title: SparsePO: Controlling Preference Alignment of LLMs via Sparse Token Masks

one_line_summary.en: SparsePO learns sparse token masks that independently weight reward and KL contributions inside preference optimization.
one_line_summary.zh: SparsePO 学习稀疏 token 掩码，在偏好优化中分别加权奖励项和 KL 项的贡献。

title: SPC: Evolving Self-Play Critic via Adversarial Games for LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: SPC bootstraps a step critic and error generator, then creates solver-filtered adversarial traces and binary rewards over two self-play rounds.
one_line_summary.zh: SPC 先用 PRM800K 与教师模型初始化步骤批评器和错误生成器，再通过求解器影响筛选与两轮对抗自博弈生成批评轨迹和二元奖励。

title: Spread Preference Annotation: Direct Preference Judgment for Efficient LLM Alignment

one_line_summary.en: SPA expands a small preference seed with direct, model-logit preference judgments and noise-aware training.
one_line_summary.zh: SPA 用模型 logits 直接标注新生成的回答对，并以噪声感知方式迭代训练。

title: Spurious Rewards: Rethinking Training Signals in RLVR

one_line_summary.en: Controlled RLVR audit showing that GRPO can raise Qwen math scores under random or incorrect rewards by amplifying pretrained behaviors, while the effect often fails outside Qwen.
one_line_summary.zh: 受控审计显示：GRPO 可在随机或错误奖励下放大 Qwen 的既有推理行为并提高数学分数，但这一效应常无法迁移到其他模型家族。

title: SQaLe: A Large Text-to-SQL Corpus Grounded in Real Schemas
venue: AI for Tabular Data Workshop at EurIPS 2025

one_line_summary.en: SQaLe scales text-to-SQL to 517,676 execution-validated triples grounded in 135,875 real-derived database schemas.
one_line_summary.zh: SQaLe 基于 135,875 个真实来源数据库模式构建 517,676 条经执行验证的文本到 SQL 三元组。

title: SRA-MCTS: Self-driven Reasoning Augmentation with Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: An end-to-end MCTS-to-SFT code-reasoning recipe with official code and a model release.
one_line_summary.zh: SRA-MCTS 从中高难 LeetCode 题目出发，在树中生成思考步骤和代码，并把选中路径转换为 question-thinking-code 的 SFT 记录。

title: START: Self-taught Reasoner with Tools

one_line_summary.en: START inserts diverse hints into long reasoning, filters Python-interleaved trajectories for corrective success, trains a 10K-seed intermediate model, and expands to a reported 40K self-training set, while releasing none of the records, code, environment, or checkpoints.
one_line_summary.zh: START 通过在长推理中插入多类 hint、调用 Python，并筛选由错转对的工具轨迹，先构造 10K D_seed 再扩展到报告的 40K D_START；其构造思路可供研究，但数据、checker、环境、模型和代码均未发布，且来源计数存在内部矛盾。

title: STeCa: Step-level Trajectory Calibration for LLM Agent Learning

one_line_summary.en: STeCa releases and constructs calibrated agent trajectories that attach deviation-aware corrections to environment-grounded steps.
one_line_summary.zh: 通过定位偏离专家轨迹的动作并生成反思与校准轨迹，STeCa 将终局环境回报转化为可用于智能体学习的步骤级监督。

title: STELAR-VISION: Self-Topology-Aware Efficient Learning for Aligned Reasoning in Vision

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: STELAR-VISION 发布拓扑感知的视觉推理偏好数据，以兼顾多模态推理正确性与输出效率。

title: Step-level Verifier-guided Hybrid Test-Time Scaling for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A process verifier decides where to refine reasoning steps and how to combine sequential and parallel inference-time scaling.
one_line_summary.zh: 该方法用过程验证器决定何处细化推理步骤，并组合串行与并行的推理时扩展。

title: StepSearch: Igniting LLMs Search Ability via Step-Wise Proximal Policy Optimization

one_line_summary.en: StepSearch: Igniting LLMs Search Ability via Step-Wise Proximal Policy Optimization records subquestion search trajectories under information-gain and redundancy intermediate feedback.
one_line_summary.zh: StepSearch 以检索信息增益与冗余惩罚为每一步搜索提供 PPO 反馈，处理后的监督语料仍未核验公开。

title: Stepwise Reasoning Checkpoint Analysis: A Test Time Scaling Method to Enhance LLMs' Reasoning
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

one_line_summary.en: SRCA probes a reasoning prefix with a temporary answer cue, uses checkpoint answers to diversify PRM-guided search and augment final candidates, but releases no code, traces, or replay ledger.
one_line_summary.zh: SRCA 在推理步骤间探测 checkpoint 答案，以其聚类维持 PRM 引导搜索的多样性并扩展最终候选；但没有公开代码、轨迹或可重放选择账本。

title: Sticker-TTS: Learn to Utilize Historical Experience with a Sticker-driven Test-Time Scaling Framework

one_line_summary.en: Sticker-TTS turns previous reasoning traces into corrected compact cues that guide later test-time solution attempts.
one_line_summary.zh: Sticker-TTS 将先前推理轨迹压缩为可校正的关键线索，用以引导后续测试时解题。

title: Stop Overthinking: A Survey on Efficient Reasoning for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A TMLR survey of how to reduce redundant reasoning without treating trace length as the only goal.
one_line_summary.zh: 从模型、输出与提示三层整理高效推理的 TMLR 2025 综述。

title: STORM-BORN: A Challenging Mathematical Derivations Dataset Curated via a Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Framework

one_line_summary.en: A 100-row expert-selected derivation dataset built from a 2,000-pair multi-agent pool, released with source IDs, long answers, a 73/27 split, and four-option variants but without full lineage or the candidate pool.
one_line_summary.zh: STORM-BORN 从 2,000 条多智能体生成问答中由专家筛选出 100 条数学推导记录，并发布 73/27 切分与四选一变体；但完整谱系、候选池、人工协议与许可仍缺失。

title: Subliminal Learning: Language models transmit behavioral traits via hidden signals in data

one_line_summary.en: Subliminal Learning shows that teacher models can transmit behavioral traits through semantically unrelated generated data, even after visible trait references are filtered.
one_line_summary.zh: 即使训练样本只含数字、代码或推理轨迹，且过滤了特征词，教师模型的偏好或失调仍可沿同基础模型蒸馏链传给学生。

title: SuperGPQA: Scaling LLM Evaluation across 285 Graduate Disciplines

one_line_summary.en: SuperGPQA exposes graduate-level QA across many disciplines as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: SuperGPQA 把横跨众多研究生学科的高难度问答做成可审计的评测面。

title: SWE-bench Goes Live!

one_line_summary.en: SWE-bench-Live refreshes repository repair evaluation with fresh GitHub issues.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-bench-Live 用新鲜 GitHub issue 刷新仓库修复评测。

title: SWE-Bench Pro: Can AI Agents Solve Long-Horizon Software Engineering Tasks?

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Bench Pro offers long-horizon engineering tasks with human-augmented specifications and Dockerized F2P/P2P tests, while its later audit exposes substantial task-quality risk.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Bench Pro 以人工补全的长程工程需求和 Docker 化 F2P/P2P 测试评测补丁，但后续官方审计指出其中相当一部分任务存在质量问题。

title: SWE-Bench++: A Framework for the Scalable Generation of Software Engineering Benchmarks from Open-Source Repositories

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** SWE-Bench++ automatically constructs 11,133 multilingual tasks, while its current downloadable public set contains 500.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Bench++ 自动构造 11,133 条多语言任务，但当前公开下载集为其中 500 条。

title: SWE-Dev: Building Software Engineering Agents with Training and Inference Scaling
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Dev constructs repository repair tasks and fail-to-pass tests, releases 20,147 SFT/RFT-format OpenHands records, and studies trajectory and iteration scaling, while row-level lineage and replay remain incomplete.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Dev 从仓库修复任务构造 fail-to-pass 测试并发布 20,147 条 SFT/RFT 格式的 OpenHands 记录，用于研究训练与迭代扩展；但逐条来源、环境重放和污染审计仍不完整。

title: SWE-Dev: Evaluating and Training Autonomous Feature-Driven Software Development

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Dev supplies 14,000 runnable feature-development training tasks and 500 test tasks where developer-authored unit tests score repository-level implementations.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Dev 提供 1.4 万个可运行的功能开发训练任务和 500 个测试任务，并以开发者编写的单测验证仓库级实现。

title: SWE-Lancer: Can Frontier LLMs Earn $1 Million from Real-World Freelance Software Engineering?

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Lancer evaluates agents on more than 1,400 real freelance engineering tasks using triple-verified tests or the original manager's hiring choice.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Lancer 以 1,400 余项真实自由职业软件任务评测智能体，独立工程任务由三重核验测试判分，管理任务对照原始经理选择。

title: SWE-MERA: A Dynamic Benchmark for Agenticly Evaluating Large Language Models on Software Engineering Tasks

one_line_summary.en: SWE-MERA releases refreshable repository-repair records with commits, patches, tests, commands, and environment metadata, but its pinned public checker marks solved using PASS_TO_PASS only and does not enforce FAIL_TO_PASS.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-MERA 持续发布带 base commit、补丁、测试和环境命令的仓库修复任务，但固定版本的公开 checker 仅检查 PASS_TO_PASS，没有强制 FAIL_TO_PASS。

title: SWE-Mirror: Scaling Issue-Resolving Datasets by Mirroring Issues Across Repositories

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Mirror constructs 60,671 executable repair tasks by re-instantiating real GitHub issue semantics in 40 reusable repository Gyms, then reports an SFT mixture of 12,456 successful OpenHands trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Mirror 将真实 GitHub issue 的语义重建到 40 个可复用仓库 Gym 中，形成 60,671 个可执行修复任务和 12,456 条成功轨迹的 SFT 混合，但官方数据与代码发布入口尚未核实。

title: SWE-PolyBench: A multi-language benchmark for repository level evaluation of coding agents

one_line_summary.en: SWE-PolyBench pairs 2,110 multi-language repository tasks with Dockerized F2P/P2P tests to measure whether coding-agent patches really resolve an issue.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-PolyBench 为 2,110 个多语言仓库任务提供 Docker 环境与 F2P/P2P 测试，用可执行结果判定代码 agent 补丁是否真正修复问题。

title: SWE-rebench: An Automated Pipeline for Task Collection and Decontaminated Evaluation of Software Engineering Agents

one_line_summary.en: SWE-rebench automates fresh SWE task collection and decontaminated agent evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-rebench 自动收集新鲜 SWE 任务并进行去污染智能体评测。

title: SWE-Sharp-Bench: A Reproducible Benchmark for C# Software Engineering Tasks

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Sharp-Bench brings reproducible, test-verified software-engineering tasks to 150 C#/.NET instances across 17 repositories.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Sharp-Bench 提供 150 个 C#/.NET 真实仓库任务，并以 .NET 测试执行验证智能体修复。

title: SWE-smith: Scaling Data for Software Engineering Agents

one_line_summary.en: SWE-smith builds 50,137 executable Python repair tasks from test-breaking synthetic diffs and distills 5,016 successful SWE-agent episodes selected from 17,906 attempts.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-smith 把 Python 仓库变成 Docker 化执行环境，并合成 5 万多条破坏测试的修复任务、轨迹和一个训练后的 SWE 智能体。

title: SWE-Synth: Synthesizing Verifiable Bug-Fix Data to Enable Large Language Models in Resolving Real-World Bugs

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Synth turns repository components into test-verifiable synthetic bugs and retains successful agent repair trajectories as bug-fix training data.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Synth 把仓库组件改写为可测试的合成缺陷，并保留通过测试的 agent 修复轨迹，形成可验证的缺陷修复训练数据。

title: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond

one_line_summary.en: SynLogic releases verifier-ready prompts and generator/verifier code for 35 logical tasks, with a 27-task Easy configuration and a 35-task Hard configuration, while online RL rollouts remain unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: SynLogic 开放 35 类逻辑任务的可配置生成器、任务专用验证器和 Easy/Hard RLVR 提示数据，而其修订历史也说明可执行数据仍需版本化审计。

title: Synthesizing Software Engineering Data in a Test-Driven Manner

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Flow turns unit tests and runtime dependency graphs into executable, incremental software-development tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Flow 将单元测试和运行时依赖图转化为可执行、增量式的软件开发任务。

title: Synthetic Data Generation & Multi-Step RL for Reasoning & Tool Use

one_line_summary.en: SWiRL trains Gemma 2 from fixed search/calculator trajectories by turning every action and its full prefix into a reward-bearing RL sample; the recipe and prompts are public, but the trajectories, reward logs, implementation, and checkpoints are not.
one_line_summary.zh: SWiRL 将离线搜索/计算器完整轨迹拆为动作结束的前缀子轨迹，以 Gemini 1.5 Pro 过程筛选和逐动作生成式奖励训练 Gemma 2；方法与提示公开，但轨迹、奖励日志、代码和模型未发布。

title: System Card Addendum: Claude Opus 4.1

one_line_summary.en: The Opus 4.1 addendum adds a concrete 290-seed/1,160-transcript model-audit pipeline, specialized prompt-injection RL, agentic safety environments and training-distribution reward-hacking rates, while leaving the underlying data, scorers, rewards and model delta unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: Claude Opus 4.1 增量系统卡披露 human/synthetic safety prompts、290 seeds 扩展为每模型 1,160 条 24–64-turn 审计轨迹、专门 prompt-injection RL 与 agentic 环境，但基础数据 delta、生成/评分偏差、reward 和记录均未开放。

title: T1: Advancing Language Model Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning and Inference Scaling
venue: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025), PMLR 267

one_line_summary.en: T1 synthesizes trial-and-error/self-verification math chains for SFT and applies answer-verified, high-temperature 64-rollout RLOO to study training and inference scaling, but public release semantics, lineage, and replay remain incomplete.
one_line_summary.zh: T1 将公开数学题构造成含试错与自我核查的推理链，用答案核验的 64-rollout RLOO 研究训练和推理时扩展；但公开数据的语义、谱系与可复现性仍不完整。

title: T2: An Adaptive Test-Time Scaling Strategy for Contextual Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: T2 selects a question-specific reasoning strategy from analogous examples to spend more inference effort only where it is useful.
one_line_summary.zh: T2 从相似示例中选择针对问题的推理策略，只在确有必要时投入更多推理计算。

title: Teach Small Models to Reason by Curriculum Distillation

one_line_summary.en: Curriculum Distillation filters a 6,445-problem matched teacher pool with Math-Verify and changes trace style across two difficulty-aware SFT stages, but releases neither the pool nor its construction artifacts.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作以 Math-Verify 筛得 6,445 道题的匹配教师池，并按难度在两阶段 SFT 中切换轨迹类型，但未发布语料与构建产物。

title: Teaching Your Models to Understand Code via Focal Preference Alignment

one_line_summary.en: Target-DPO releases CodeFlow, 59,000 iterative-debugging code preference pairs that focus DPO on the tokens resolving test-verified errors.
one_line_summary.zh: CodeFlow 发布约 5.9 万代码偏好对，聚焦模型最易混淆的局部质量差异，适合代码推理 DPO 与奖励建模。

title: TestGenEval: A Real World Unit Test Generation and Test Completion Benchmark

one_line_summary.en: TestGenEval evaluates unit-test generation and completion on 1,210 real repository file pairs using execution, coverage, and mutation-score feedback.
one_line_summary.zh: TestGenEval 从真实 Python 仓库构造 1,210 个代码—测试文件对，用执行通过率、覆盖率和 mutation score 评估测试生成与补全。

title: Text2SQL-Flow: A Robust SQL-Aware Data Augmentation Framework for Text-to-SQL

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** An 89,544-example Text-to-SQL dataset built by six-dimensional SQL-aware augmentation and database execution.
one_line_summary.zh: 用六维 SQL-aware 扩增和数据库执行验证构建 89,544 条 Text-to-SQL 数据。

title: TGPO: Tree-Guided Preference Optimization for Robust Web Agent Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: TGPO merges repeated web-agent episodes into state trees and derives mixed process rewards plus weighted action preferences for offline training, but releases no trajectories, trees, verifier decisions, split manifest, environment snapshot, code, or license.
one_line_summary.zh: TGPO 把重复 web-agent episode 合并成 trajectory tree，并生成四项 process reward 与 node-level chosen/rejected action pair；机制可用于研究离线 agent 训练，但未核验到代码、数据、模型、环境快照与许可证的公开发布。

title: The AI Productivity Index (APEX)

one_line_summary.en: APEX assesses professional finance, law, consulting, and medical work using expert-authored cases and rubric grading.
one_line_summary.zh: APEX 以资深从业者设计的任务、材料和 rubric，检验模型能否完成金融、法律、咨询和医疗中的高价值专业工作。

title: The Art of Scaling Test-Time Compute for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: This study maps when shortest-trace voting, beam search, or majority voting is the best use of test-time compute.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究说明最短轨迹投票、束搜索和多数投票各自适用的模型类型、题目难度与测试时预算不同。

title: The BiGGen Bench: A Principled Benchmark for Fine-grained Evaluation of Language Models with Language Models

one_line_summary.en: BiGGen Bench supplies instance-specific criteria across 77 generation tasks for fine-grained multi-judge evaluation of nine LM capabilities.
one_line_summary.zh: BiGGen Bench 为 77 类生成任务提供实例专属标准，以多裁判细粒度测量九种语言模型能力。

title: The Emperor's New Clothes in Benchmarking? A Rigorous Examination of Mitigation Strategies for LLM Benchmark Data Contamination

one_line_summary.en: Official code release evaluates contamination-mitigation strategies under controlled settings.
one_line_summary.zh: 以保真度和污染抵抗力审计基准更新策略。

title: The FACTS Grounding Leaderboard: Benchmarking LLMs' Ability to Ground Responses to Long-Form Input

one_line_summary.en: FACTS Grounding exposes long-document grounding with public/private split and judge ensemble as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: FACTS Grounding 把带公开与私有划分、由评审集成打分的长文档依据核查做成可审计的评测面。

title: The Lessons of Developing Process Reward Models in Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: Qwen process-reward models use MC plus critic consensus step labels and release weights, but not their query, trace, label, calibration, or audit corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: Qwen process-reward models 使用 MC 加 critic consensus 的步骤标签并公开权重，但没有发布 queries、traces、labels、calibration 或审计语料。

title: The Llama 4 Herd: The Beginning of a New Era of Natively Multimodal AI Innovation

one_line_summary.en: Meta reports multimodal pretraining plus hard-example SFT, online RL, DPO, safety tuning, and Behemoth-to-Maverick codistillation for Llama 4, releases Scout/Maverick weights, and withholds the training records and core feedback stack.
one_line_summary.zh: Llama 4 Herd 报告了超过 30T 的多模态训练 token、200 种语言，以及 Behemoth 为 Scout 和 Maverick 提供教师能力；但数据清单和后训练反馈均为 unknown。

title: The Silent Judge: Unacknowledged Shortcut Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: Tests provenance and recency shortcut biases and the faithfulness of stated judge rationales.
one_line_summary.zh: 受控注入来源与时间线索，揭示 LLM judge 会改变判决却不在理由中承认该捷径。

title: The Tool Decathlon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Diverse, Realistic, and Long-Horizon Task Execution

one_line_summary.en: Toolathlon pairs 108 fuzzy cross-application tasks with initialized software states, recorded tool-use episodes, and deterministic terminal evaluators; its gated Verified trajectories are explicitly evaluation/audit-only and must not be used for training.
one_line_summary.zh: Toolathlon 将 108 个模糊的跨应用长程任务、初始化软件状态、工具调用 episode 与确定性终态 evaluator 绑定；其 gated Toolathlon-Verified 轨迹仅允许评测与审计，不得用于训练。

title: Theorem Prover as a Judge for Synthetic Data Generation

one_line_summary.en: A Lean-grounded recipe for generating and selecting synthetic mathematical reasoning, with executable step checks, retry feedback, and explicit SFT/DPO routing.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作用 Lean 的可执行证明反馈筛选合成数学推理，并将回答对分配到 SFT、DPO、丢弃或重试路径；核心审计风险是自然语言与形式化陈述的对齐，以及当前不可访问的发布仓库。

title: Think Right, Not More: Test-Time Scaling for Numerical Claim Verification

one_line_summary.en: VerifierFC uses claim complexity to decide when to sample multiple fact-checking paths and a process verifier to select among them.
one_line_summary.zh: VerifierFC 按声明复杂度决定何时采样多条核查路径，并用过程验证器从中选择。

title: Think-RM: Enabling Long-Horizon Reasoning in Generative Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: Think-RM releases long-chain preference judgments that train a generative reward model to deliberate before issuing a pairwise verdict.
one_line_summary.zh: 6.01K 长 CoT 偏好评审样本，含 chosen/rejected 判定过程，训练能先推理再裁决的通用 GenRM。

title: Thinking vs. Doing: Agents that Reason by Scaling Test-Time Interaction

one_line_summary.en: TTI turns terminally successful multimodal web episodes into state/action behavior-cloning data under an expanding interaction horizon, but its public release omits trajectories and does not reproduce a clean paper-aligned split/configuration.
one_line_summary.zh: TTI 以终局成功筛选在线多模态网页 episode，再对其中的 state-action 步骤做 behavior cloning 并逐步扩大交互 horizon；但公开发布没有 rollout 语料，且划分、judge 与训练配置存在审计缺口。

title: Thinking vs. Doing: Improving Agent Reasoning by Scaling Test-Time Interaction

one_line_summary.en: TTI scales a web agent’s test-time interaction horizon, then trains that behavior with a horizon curriculum so the agent can explore, backtrack, and re-plan.
one_line_summary.zh: TTI 将网页智能体的环境交互步数作为测试时预算，并用逐步拉长交互上限的在线学习，使其能够探索、回退和动态重规划。

title: Thought Anchors: Which LLM Reasoning Steps Matter?

one_line_summary.en: Thought Anchors releases MATH reasoning traces with sentence-level keep/remove continuation banks, correct and incorrect outcomes, answer- distribution importance metrics, and LLM-labeled dependencies for auditing which steps steer downstream reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: Thought Anchors 公开了 MATH 正确与错误推理链、逐句保留/移除的反事实续写、强制回答续写及答案分布指标，用于审计哪些句子改变后续推理；HF 的 20,997 行是原始文件索引而非 rollout 数量。

title: Thought calibration: Efficient and confident test-time scaling

one_line_summary.en: Thought calibration uses lightweight hidden-state probes and risk control to stop a reasoning trace once further thought is unlikely to add useful work.
one_line_summary.zh: Thought calibration 利用隐藏状态上的轻量探针与风险控制，在进一步思考不太可能带来新信息时终止推理轨迹。

title: TinyV: Reducing False Negatives in Verification Improves RL for LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: TinyV refreshes a rule-based verifier by re-judging rejected answers with two large models, augmenting equivalent-answer variants, training a small binary judge, and querying it only after Prime rejection.
one_line_summary.zh: TinyV 先让 Prime Verifier 检查答案，仅在其拒绝时调用 1.5B 学习式验证器；公开对象包括 159,136 条平衡 SFT 数据、7,009 条困难提示和 250 条 HardVerify-Math，但 638K 前体池、实验所用 5K 清单、双裁判账本与 held-out 验证器评测未发布。

title: Token Cleaning: Fine-Grained Data Selection for LLM Supervised Fine-Tuning

one_line_summary.en: Token Cleaning removes low-information supervision tokens according to their estimated influence on model updates.
one_line_summary.zh: Token Cleaning 按模型更新对每个 token 的影响筛除低信息监督，以更细粒度方式构造 SFT 训练目标。

title: Token Preference Optimization with Self-Calibrated Visual-Anchored Rewards for Hallucination Mitigation

one_line_summary.en: TPO dynamically rewards preference-pair tokens by how much their predictions depend on the original image rather than a corrupted image.
one_line_summary.zh: TPO 按 token 预测对原图而非扰动图的依赖程度，动态加权既有偏好对中的训练奖励。

title: TokenSqueeze: Performance-Preserving Compression for Reasoning LLMs

one_line_summary.en: TokenSqueeze self-samples answer-checked traces, selects depth-adaptive correct positives against longer incorrect responses, KL-filters step rewrites, and trains concise reasoners with SFT plus length-aware DPO; the final generated corpus remains unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: TokenSqueeze 用自采样、答案核验的推理轨迹构造自适应深度的正例与更长的错误负例，再以 KL 约束筛选逐步改写并结合 SFT 与长度感知 DPO 训练短推理；最终生成语料尚未发布，因而只能审计其配方而非逐条数据。

title: Tool Zero: Training Tool-Augmented LLMs via Pure RL from Scratch
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025

one_line_summary.en: Tool Zero applies pure GRPO to offline ToolACE/xLAM function-calling records and dynamically tightens each completion's scalar rule reward from exploratory token overlap to strict reference-AST correctness.
one_line_summary.zh: Tool Zero 在离线 ToolACE/xLAM 函数调用记录上用 GG-GRPO 将整段 completion 的规则奖励从参考 token 重叠逐步收紧到 AST 等价；它展示了无 SFT 的 RLVR 配方，但专属代码、处理后语料与 checkpoint 均未发布。

title: ToolHop: A Query-Driven Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Hop Tool Use

one_line_summary.en: One-sentence position:** A verifiable multi-hop tool-use benchmark with 995 queries and 3,912 local tools.
one_line_summary.zh: 995 个查询与 3,912 个本地工具构成可验证的多跳工具使用 benchmark。

title: ToolMind Technical Report: A Large-Scale, Reasoning-Enhanced Tool-Use Dataset
domains: English function calling and multi-turn tool use

one_line_summary.en: ToolMind constructs a function graph, simulates realistic interactions, and filters each turn before retaining complete self-corrective trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: ToolMind 用函数图驱动多代理交互，并在逐轮过滤后发布 16 万条合成与 20 万条增强工具记录。

title: ToolOrchestra: Elevating Intelligence via Efficient Model and Tool Orchestration
domains: English model routing, web search, code execution, and multi-tool orchestration

one_line_summary.en: ToolScale serializes difficult tool-routing scenarios with initial state and evaluation actions, supplying the task substrate for ToolOrchestra training.
one_line_summary.zh: ToolScale 把 4063 个困难工具编排任务写成场景、初始状态与评估条件，供小型编排器训练。

title: TOUCAN: Synthesizing 1.5M Tool-Agentic Data from Real-World MCP Environments

one_line_summary.en: TOUCAN releases 1,527,259 synthetic task-tool episodes generated through 495 live MCP servers plus a 119,287-row SFT subset, while mixed heuristic/judge labels and mutable remote environments limit correctness guarantees and replay.
one_line_summary.zh: TOUCAN 发布 1,527,259 条经 495 个真实 MCP 服务生成的工具 agent 轨迹，并从中筛出 119,287 行 SFT 子集；混合规则与模型评审及可变远程环境限制了任务正确性保证和精确回放。

title: Towards Alignment-Centric Paradigm: A Survey of Instruction Tuning in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: This survey organizes instruction tuning around data origin, tuning strategy, and evaluation rather than treating all prompts and answers as one data type.
one_line_summary.zh: 该综述从数据来源、调优策略和评测协议梳理大语言模型指令微调的对齐逻辑。

title: Towards Data Contamination Detection for Modern Large Language Models: Limitations, Inconsistencies, and Oracle Challenges

one_line_summary.en: Five prompt-, likelihood-, completion-, and order-based probes are compared on public benchmark slices; none consistently tracks known added fine-tuning exposure, and cross-method agreement is weak.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究把五种污染检测器作为不同的审计接口，在八个基准与一个受控 LLaMA-2 指令微调 oracle 上比较；五种指标都未能稳定追踪已知新增暴露比例，方法间一致性也很弱。

title: Towards Large Reasoning Models: A Survey of Reinforced Reasoning with Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A 2025 survey of reinforced reasoning that brings automated trajectory construction, learning-to-reason, and test-time scaling into one account.
one_line_summary.zh: 将强化推理、自动数据构建与推理期扩展纳入同一概念图的综述。

title: Towards Medical Complex Reasoning with LLMs through Medical Verifiable Problems

one_line_summary.en: HuatuoGPT-o1 filters medical exams into 40K verifiable problems, distills complex traces for half, and uses the remaining half for answer-reward RL.
one_line_summary.zh: HuatuoGPT-o1 把医学考试题筛成 4 万道可验证问题，其中一半带复杂推理用于微调，另一半用于强化学习。

title: Towards Thinking-Optimal Scaling of Test-Time Compute for LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: TOPS selects shortest correct effort-conditioned reasoning traces to train task-dependent test-time thinking length.
one_line_summary.zh: TOPS 从不同推理努力下的候选中选择最短正确回答，训练模型按题目选择合适的测试时思考长度。

title: Training Long-Context, Multi-Turn Software Engineering Agents with Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: The paper filters 21,336 SWE-rebench tasks to 7,249, keeps 6,548 test-passing self-generated episodes for RFT, then applies synchronous DAPO to 65k/131k repository interactions, but does not release the trajectories, training code, or checkpoint.
one_line_summary.zh: 论文从 21,336 个 SWE-rebench 任务筛出 7,249 个任务，以测试通过的 6,548 条自生成 episode 做 RFT，再以终局测试奖励训练长上下文 DAPO agent；其训练轨迹、代码与模型均未发布。

title: Training Software Engineering Agents and Verifiers with SWE-Gym

one_line_summary.en: SWE-Gym releases 2,438 unit-test-validated Python repository tasks plus OpenHands and Moatless trajectories, policies, and outcome verifiers built through rejection sampling and Best@k selection.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-Gym 发布 2,438 个带仓库快照、容器环境和单元测试的 Python 工程任务，并把 491 条成功轨迹、5,564 条失败轨迹和 1,318/1,318 平衡 verifier 数据分开封装；但 Lite 数量、镜像 digest、轨迹谱系和各工件许可仍不一致。

title: Training Vision-Language Process Reward Models for Test-Time Scaling in Multimodal Reasoning: Key Insights and Lessons Learned

one_line_summary.en: VL-PRM300K provides roughly 300K multimodal reasoning traces with visual-versus-reasoning error locations for training process reward models.
one_line_summary.zh: VL-PRM300K 提供约 30 万条多模态推理轨迹，并标明视觉或推理错误位置，用于训练过程奖励模型。

title: TreeRL: LLM Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Tree Search

one_line_summary.en: TreeRL uses entropy-guided on-policy search trees to turn terminal correctness into reweighted step-level rewards; the public repository releases input prompts and code, not a verified corpus of the resulting runtime trees.
one_line_summary.zh: TreeRL 将熵引导的 on-policy 搜索树中叶节点的终点正确性转化为重加权逐步奖励；公开仓库发布了输入提示与代码，但未核验发布运行时树语料。

title: TritonBench: Benchmarking Large Language Model Capabilities for Generating Triton Operators

one_line_summary.en: TritonBench evaluates generated Triton operators through 184 real-world kernels plus GPU correctness and efficiency profiling.
one_line_summary.zh: TritonBench 覆盖 184 个真实 Triton 算子，并用 GPU 执行正确性与性能剖析共同评测生成代码。

title: UI-Genie: A Self-Improving Approach for Iteratively Boosting MLLM-based Mobile GUI Agents

one_line_summary.en: Builds mobile-GUI reward data from rule checks, controlled corruptions, and mined hard negatives, then uses a learned verifier to collect step-level agent SFT data over three rounds.
one_line_summary.zh: 以规则核验、受控破坏和困难负例构造移动 GUI 奖励数据，再用学习到的验证器在三轮探索中筛选步级 agent SFT 数据。

title: UI-TARS-2 Technical Report: Advancing GUI Agent with Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: UI-TARS-2 discloses a continual-pre-training/SFT/PPO flywheel over stateful GUI episodes and three outcome-feedback paths, while leaving the training corpus, reward records, model weights, and replayable environments unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: UI-TARS-2 披露数据飞轮、多轮 RL 与大规模 rollout 沙箱，但未披露训练记录和奖励账本。

title: Understanding Software Engineering Agents: A Study of Thought-Action-Result Trajectories

one_line_summary.en: Releases and analyzes 120 RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover, and OpenHands episodes as 2,822 thought-action-result iterations with action and semantic-relation labels, while replay metadata and an immutable release remain incomplete.
one_line_summary.zh: 该研究把 3 个软件工程 agent 的 120 条成功/失败运行统一为 2,822 次 thought-action-result 迭代，并加入动作与语义关系标注；它适合评测与审计，但缺少可重放环境和不可变发布。

title: Understanding the Thinking Process of Reasoning Models: A Perspective from Schoenfeld's Episode Theory

one_line_summary.en: This benchmark applies Schoenfeld’s cognitive episodes to human-annotated DeepSeek-R1 math traces at paragraph and sentence levels.
one_line_summary.zh: 该基准以 Schoenfeld 认知情节标注 DeepSeek-R1 数学轨迹，覆盖段落和句子两个层级。

title: Unified Reward Model for Multimodal Understanding and Generation

one_line_summary.en: This paper releases or uses a preference or reward-feedback artifact for alignment research.
one_line_summary.zh: UnifiedReward 联合图像和视频的理解与生成偏好，统一支持成对排序与单点评分，并用于自动构造 DPO 数据。

title: UnitCoder: Scalable Code Synthesis from Pre-training Corpora

one_line_summary.en: UnitCoder mines functions and unit tests from pre-training corpora, using test execution to filter scalable code-synthesis training data.
one_line_summary.zh: UnitCoder 从预训练语料中挖掘函数与单元测试，借助测试执行筛出可用于代码合成训练的大规模样本。

title: Unlocking Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning via Process Reward Model

one_line_summary.en: URSA releases multimodal CoT and embedded-label process tables and trains a PRM for Best-of-N and PS-GRPO; the release lacks full image, trajectory, and reward-lineage records needed to audit the reported construction pipeline.
one_line_summary.zh: URSA 将多模态 CoT、BEL/MIE 过程标签和 PRM 分数下降信号接入 PS-GRPO；公开表格未保留完整图像、rollout 与奖励血缘。

title: Unlocking Post-hoc Dataset Inference with Synthetic Data

one_line_summary.en: Shared-prefix synthetic suffixes and calibrated paired tests enable post-hoc set-level training-data inference without a pre-existing matched holdout.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作通过同前缀合成后缀与校准配对检验，在缺少天然匹配留出集时进行事后集合级训练数据推断，但不能给出记录级或法律层面的证明。

title: Unveiling Chain of Step Reasoning for Vision-Language Models with Fine-grained Rewards

one_line_summary.en: CoS-Dataset releases fine-grained reward supervision for vision-language reasoning steps, supporting VLM process rewards, reranking, and reinforcement learning.
one_line_summary.zh: CoS-Dataset 提供视觉推理步骤与细粒度奖励，可直接用于视觉语言模型的过程奖励、重排序和强化学习。

title: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2

one_line_summary.en: GPT-5.2 repeats GPT-5's coarse source/reasoning-RL disclosure but adds explicit overlap boundaries, production and agent evaluation contracts, and a dated CoT-monitorability audit without releasing training records or rewards.
one_line_summary.zh: GPT-5.2 相对 GPT-5 没有增加训练来源或 reasoning RL 的可复现细节，但新增明确的 train/eval overlap、窄范围 non-overlap/held-out 声明、生产与 agent 评测契约及带日期的 CoT monitorability 审计。

title: UserBench: An Interactive Gym Environment for User-Centric Agents
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Scaling Environments for Agents

one_line_summary.en: UserBench releases 3,122 unique travel-planning tasks and a mixed GPT-4o/rule Gym environment for preference elicitation, but not the paper's rollout trajectories, and its counts, judge labels, randomness, and best-option ties require a pinned audit.
one_line_summary.zh: UserBench 发布 3,122 个唯一旅行规划任务及 GPT-4o/规则混合验证的 Gym 交互环境，用于评测偏好澄清、搜索与推荐；论文运行轨迹未发布，计数、judge 编号、随机性与 best_id 并列标签仍需固定版本审计。

title: Value-Guided Search for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: VGS releases 2.5M math roll-in/roll-out pairs with correct, incorrect, and incomplete outcome labels, trains a 1.5B token-level value model, and uses it to guide 4,096-token beam-search blocks plus weighted voting.
one_line_summary.zh: VGS 公开 250 万条带正确、错误与未完成结果标签的数学 roll-in/roll-out 对，并用其训练 1.5B token-level value model 引导分块搜索；完整拒绝清单、历史搜索树及代码和模型许可证仍未公开。

title: VaPR: Vision-language Preference Alignment for Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: VaPR releases 30,000 vision-language preference pairs whose edited hard negatives control for style and length while targeting reasoning errors.
one_line_summary.zh: VaPR-30K 发布超过 3 万视觉推理 chosen/rejected 对，并以困难负例强化细粒度视觉—语言推理偏好学习。

title: VeriCoder: Enhancing LLM-Based RTL Code Generation through Functional Correctness Validation

one_line_summary.en: VeriCoder turns natural-language RTL seeds into 125,777 simulation-passing specification–RTL–test triplets through teacher-guided test-and-repair loops.
one_line_summary.zh: VeriCoder 通过教师生成测试、仿真反馈和迭代修复，把 RTL 种子扩展为 125,777 条功能验证的规格—实现—测试三元组。

title: VeriContaminated: Assessing LLM-Driven Verilog Coding for Data Contamination

one_line_summary.en: Official repository releases the Verilog contamination-assessment implementation.
one_line_summary.zh: 以双检测器审计 Verilog 评测污染，并量化缓解污染与代码质量的取舍。

title: VerIF: Verification Engineering for Reinforcement Learning in Instruction Following

one_line_summary.en: VerIF engineers hard and soft instruction verifiers into reward signals for reinforcement learning on instruction following.
one_line_summary.zh: VerIF 将硬约束和软约束指令验证器工程化为奖励信号，用于指令遵循的强化学习。

title: VeriFact: Enhancing Long-Form Factuality Evaluation with Refined Fact Extraction and Reference Facts

one_line_summary.en: VeriFact refines fact extraction and introduces FactRBench to evaluate both precision and recall of long-form factuality.
one_line_summary.zh: VeriFact 用精炼事实抽取和参考事实集 FactRBench，同时评估长回答事实的精确率与召回率。

title: Verifiable Format Control for Large Language Model Generations

one_line_summary.en: VFF builds automatically checkable format-control tasks that train and evaluate strict adherence to output constraints.
one_line_summary.zh: VFF 构造可自动判定的格式控制任务，以严格语法约束评估并训练模型遵循输出格式。

title: VerifierQ: Enhancing LLM Test Time Compute with Q-Learning-based Verifiers

one_line_summary.en: VerifierQ trains an utterance-level Q-value verifier offline, aiming to select stronger multistep mathematical solutions under a test-time compute budget.
one_line_summary.zh: VerifierQ 用离线 Q-learning 训练步骤级验证器，在增加推理候选时更有效地评估和选择数学解答。

title: VeriThoughts: Enabling Automated Verilog Code Generation using Reasoning and Formal Verification

one_line_summary.en: VeriThoughts filters Verilog reasoning-and-code traces with formal-verification feedback for synthesizable RTL generation.
one_line_summary.zh: VeriThoughts 用形式验证反馈筛选 Verilog 推理与代码轨迹，面向可综合 RTL 生成。

title: VerlTool: Towards Holistic Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Tool Use

one_line_summary.en: VerlTool turns task prompts into on-policy, multi-turn action-observation episodes behind a stateful Tool Server, but releases no paper-pinned six-domain trajectory corpus or replay manifest.
one_line_summary.zh: VerlTool 以状态化 Tool Server 将六类异构任务转换为在线多轮 action-observation episode，并用领域标量奖励训练智能体；其价值在统一构造与反馈接口，但未发布论文版本固定的六域轨迹语料或 replay manifest。

title: VersaPRM: Multi-Domain Process Reward Model via Synthetic Reasoning Data

one_line_summary.en: VersaPRM creates and releases multi-domain step-labeled reasoning traces, then trains a process reward model that improves test-time selection beyond mathematics.
one_line_summary.zh: VersaPRM 构造并发布多领域、带步骤标签的推理轨迹，再训练过程奖励模型，使测试时选择能力扩展到数学以外的领域。

title: Vibe Code Bench v1.1: Evaluating AI Models on End-to-End Web Application Development

one_line_summary.en: Vibe Code Bench evaluates whether models can build functioning web applications in a full development environment, scored through point-and-click functional tests and review criteria.
one_line_summary.zh: Vibe Code Bench 评测模型在完整开发环境中生成可用网页应用的能力，核心反馈来自交互式功能测试和工程审核准则。

title: VideoRewardBench: Comprehensive Evaluation of Multimodal Reward Models for Video Understanding

one_line_summary.en: VideoRewardBench exposes whether a reward model can rank answers to real videos across perception, knowledge, reasoning, and safety.
one_line_summary.zh: 1,563 个视频偏好样本、1,482 段视频，按感知、知识、推理、安全给出 chosen/rejected 回答，适合视频推理反馈。

title: ViLBench: A Suite for Vision-Language Process Reward Modeling

one_line_summary.en: A multimodal PRM benchmark and a released 73,560-row MCTS-derived process/value dataset, where terminal GPT-4o judgments are propagated into continuous partial-solution scores.
one_line_summary.zh: ViLBench 同时提供面向过程奖励的多模态评测集与公开的 ViLReward-73K：后者把图像条件下 MCTS 的部分推理过程及其连续价值写成 73,560 行数据。

title: VISCO: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Critique and Correction Towards Self-Improvement in Visual Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: VISCO measures fine-grained critique and critique-conditioned correction for visual reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: 针对视觉推理答案同时评估细粒度批评与基于批评的修正能力。

title: Vision-Language Models Can Self-Improve Reasoning via Reflection

one_line_summary.en: R3V repeatedly samples answer-labelled multimodal CoT, trains on a latest positive, a negative-to-positive refinement, and three-candidate answer selection, then reuses the selector for test-time compute.
one_line_summary.zh: R3V 反复采样按最终答案标注的多模态 CoT，以最新正例、负例条件下的正例模仿和三候选答案选择进行训练，并在测试时复用选择能力。

title: VisualPRM: An Effective Process Reward Model for Multimodal Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: VisualPRM400K converts 16-continuation prefix success rates into binary multimodal step labels for an 8B PRM, but the original release omits the continuation and decision ledger behind those labels.
one_line_summary.zh: VisualPRM400K 把 16 次续写的前缀成功率转成二元多模态步骤标签用于训练 8B 过程奖励模型，但原始发布未包含这些标签背后的续写记录与判定台账。

title: VisualWebInstruct: Scaling up Multimodal Instruction Data through Web Search

one_line_summary.en: VisualWebInstruct turns image-guided web search into 906,160 multimodal and text QA demonstrations through extraction, consistency filtering, and source-answer alignment.
one_line_summary.zh: VisualWebInstruct 通过图像引导的网页搜索、答案一致性筛选与网页答案对齐，构造了 906,160 条多模态和纯文本问答示范。

title: VL-RewardBench: A Challenging Benchmark for Vision-Language Generative Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: VL-RewardBench is a 1,250-example human-verified benchmark that stress-tests vision-language generative reward models on perception, hallucination, and reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: 1,250 个经人工核验的图文偏好样本覆盖感知、幻觉与数学推理，是多模态生成奖励模型的核心评测数据。

title: VLRMBench: A Comprehensive and Challenging Benchmark for Vision-Language Reward Models

one_line_summary.en: VLRMBench provides 12,634 vision-language reward-model questions spanning process understanding, outcome judgment, and critique.
one_line_summary.zh: VLRMBench 含 12,634 个视觉语言问题，覆盖过程理解、结果判断与批评生成，可系统评测视觉奖励模型。

title: WASP: Benchmarking Web Agent Security Against Prompt Injection Attacks

one_line_summary.en: WASP operationalizes realistic web-agent hijacking as 84 runtime-instantiated tasks with a GPT-4o any-compromised-action judge and task-specific environment or action-log predicates, exposing both security-by-incompetence and verifier-contract drift.
one_line_summary.zh: WASP以84个运行时生成的GitLab/Postmill prompt-injection任务审计web agent，并分离GPT-4o逐动作劫持判定与任务特定的端到端成功，但未发布canonical rollout且固定commit的exfil evaluator只检查action text中的URL片段。

title: Weaver: Shrinking the Generation-Verification Gap by Scaling Compute for Verification

one_line_summary.en: Weaver converts reward-model and LM-judge outputs over repeated candidates into posterior correctness scores for response selection, then distills those ensemble scores into compact verifiers.
one_line_summary.zh: Weaver 汇聚多个弱验证器的输出，用估计准确度的归一化分数筛选重复采样候选。

title: Web-Shepherd: Advancing PRMs for Reinforcing Web Agents

one_line_summary.en: Web-Shepherd releases step-level web-agent preference pairs and checklists to train process reward models that guide trajectory selection.
one_line_summary.zh: Web-Shepherd 发布网页智能体的步骤级偏好对与检查清单，用于训练引导轨迹选择的过程奖励模型。

title: WebAgent-R1: Training Web Agents via End-to-End Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: WebAgent-R1 combines a 9,460-trajectory behavior-cloning warm-up with asynchronous current-policy WebArena rollouts, M-GRPO, and binary terminal rewards, while the online trajectories and checkpoints remain unreleased.
one_line_summary.zh: WebAgent-R1 用 9,460 条轨迹做行为克隆预热，配合异步的当前策略 WebArena 采样、M-GRPO 与二元终止奖励；在线轨迹与检查点均未发布。

title: WebChoreArena: Evaluating Web Browsing Agents on Realistic Tedious Web Tasks

one_line_summary.en: WebChoreArena releases 532 author-curated WebArena tasks with answer-, URL-, and DOM-based terminal evaluators, but not paper-run trajectories or a fully pinned environment snapshot.
one_line_summary.zh: WebChoreArena 发布 532 个作者策划的 WebArena 任务及答案、URL、DOM 终端评测器，但未发布论文实验的完整轨迹、结果包或完全固定的环境镜像。

title: WebDancer: Towards Autonomous Information Seeking Agency

one_line_summary.en: WebDancer turns 100,000 synthetic web QA pairs into filtered ReAct SFT trajectories and LLM-judged on-policy agent rollouts, but publicly releases only 200 QA and 200 trajectory examples rather than the complete corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: WebDancer 将 10 万条合成 web QA 转化为过滤后的 ReAct SFT 轨迹和由 LLM judge 评分的 on-policy rollout，但仅公开 200 条 QA 与 200 条冷启动轨迹样例。

title: WebEvolver: Enhancing Web Agent Self-Improvement with Co-evolving World Model

one_line_summary.en: WebEvolver co-trains Llama-3.3-70B policy and world models, releases policy and world-model SFT message data, and uses synthetic rollouts plus world-model look-ahead; raw trajectories and replay metadata are not released.
one_line_summary.zh: WebEvolver 联合训练 Llama-3.3-70B 的策略模型与世界模型，发布了两者的监督微调消息数据，并使用合成采样与世界模型前瞻；原始轨迹与回放元数据未发布。

title: WebExplorer: Explore and Evolve for Training Long-Horizon Web Agents

one_line_summary.en: WebExplorer synthesizes about 40K evolved web-search QA pairs and trains Qwen3-8B with correct ReAct trajectories plus judge-rewarded online episodes, but releases only 100 QA rows rather than the paper-scale trajectories or training pipeline.
one_line_summary.zh: WebExplorer 先合成约 40K 条演化式网页搜索 QA，再用约 13K 条仅保留正确答案的 ReAct 轨迹做 SFT、用约 12K 条 QA 做 format 与 DeepSeek-V3 混合奖励的在线 RL；当前公开物只有 100 条 QA，没有论文规模轨迹或训练代码。

title: WebGen-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Generating Interactive and Functional Websites from Scratch

one_line_summary.en: WebGen-Bench exposes website generation with browser-executed functional tests as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: WebGen-Bench 将网站生成与浏览器执行的功能测试做成可审计的评测面。

title: WebRL: Training LLM Web Agents via Self-Evolving Online Curriculum Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: WebRL trains browser agents over 8 curriculum phases using failure-derived GPT-4o tasks, binary ORM-labeled rollouts, KL-constrained updates, and confidence-filtered successful replay, while releasing only a partial data corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: WebRL 从 1,186 条 WebArena-Lite 种子示范出发，以失败驱动课程、学习型 ORM 和成功轨迹回放训练浏览器智能体；方法证据充分，但完整在线语料与复用许可仍未发布。

title: WebSailor-V2: Bridging the Chasm to Proprietary Agents via Synthetic Data and Scalable Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: WebSailor-V2 reports 30K-plus synthetic instruction pairs, rejection-sampled ReAct SFT, and on-policy RL across offline-Wikipedia and managed live-web environments, but releases no V2 data, code, verifier, or complete trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: WebSailor-V2 报告了 3 万余条合成 instruction pair、经 rejection sampling 获得的 ReAct SFT 轨迹，以及跨离线 Wikipedia 与受管真实网络环境的 on-policy RL，但没有公开 V2 数据、代码、verifier 或完整成败轨迹。

title: WebSailor: Navigating Super-human Reasoning for Web Agent

one_line_summary.en: WebSailor trains web-search agents with just over 2,000 successful reconstructed ReAct trajectories and DUPO's mixed format/answer reward, but officially releases only 20 QA examples—not the complete successful or failed trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: WebSailor 用 2,000 余条成功的重构 ReAct 轨迹和 DUPO 的混合格式/答案奖励训练网页搜索 agent，但官方目前只发布了 20 条 QA 示例，并未发布完整成功或失败轨迹。

title: WEBSERV: A Full-Stack and RL-Ready Web Environment for Training Web Agents at Scale
venue: arXiv preprint (expanded v2); earlier version presented at MTI-LLM @ NeurIPS 2025

one_line_summary.en: WebServ releases 726 success-filtered Claude browser traces and the code for resettable Incus-backed GRPO training, but not failed traces, record-level outcomes, Qwen RL rollouts, checkpoints, or a pinned environment bundle.
one_line_summary.zh: WebServ 公开了 726 条经成功筛选的 Claude 浏览器轨迹及 Incus 隔离式 GRPO 训练代码，但未公开失败轨迹、逐条结果标签、Qwen 在线 RL rollout、模型检查点或可固定复现的环境镜像。

title: When Data is the Algorithm: A Systematic Study and Curation of Preference Optimization Datasets

one_line_summary.en: When Data is the Algorithm: A Systematic Study and Curation of Preference Optimization Datasets addresses curation and systematic study of preference-optimization data.
one_line_summary.zh: 该工作分析开放 DPO 语料，并利用逐样本任务、输入质量和奖励标注构建 UltraMix。

title: When To Solve, When To Verify: Compute-Optimal Problem Solving and Generative Verification for LLM Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: The paper shows when solution sampling beats generative verification and fits scaling laws for allocating compute between them.
one_line_summary.zh: 论文说明何时应扩大解答采样、何时应扩大生成式验证，并拟合二者的计算分配标度律。

title: Where LLM Agents Fail and How They can Learn From Failures

one_line_summary.en: AgentErrorBench releases 200 annotated failed ALFWorld, WebShop, and GAIA episodes with a 17-type taxonomy, minimal root causes, and feedback, while annotation agreement and replay metadata remain material audit limits.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentErrorBench 发布 200 条带标注的 ALFWorld、WebShop 与 GAIA 失败轨迹，含 17 类错误分类、最小根因与纠正反馈；标注一致性与回放元数据仍是主要审计缺口。

title: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?

one_line_summary.en: MAST-Data scales a human-derived 14-mode failure taxonomy to more than 1,600 multi-agent execution traces for structured diagnosis and judge evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: MAST-Data 将人工归纳的 14 类多智能体失效分类扩展到逾 1,600 条执行轨迹，支持协作过程诊断与 judge 评测。

title: Wider or Deeper? Scaling LLM Inference-Time Compute with Adaptive Branching Tree Search

one_line_summary.en: AB-MCTS allocates a fixed inference budget between fresh response branches and feedback-conditioned revisions, producing scored answer trees that released code can persist even though the paper's realized trees are not public.
one_line_summary.zh: AB-MCTS 在固定推理预算下，自适应选择生成新回答分支或沿既有回答进行反馈驱动修订，形成带外部评分的响应—修订树；公开代码可保存完整本地树和逐调用日志，但论文实验的原始树、全部回答、未选分支与 API 日志并未发布。

title: WildBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Challenging Tasks from Real Users in the Wild

one_line_summary.en: WildBench curates hard real-user tasks and applies task-specific checklists for automatic, interpretable model comparison.
one_line_summary.zh: WildBench 从真实用户对话筛选高难任务，并用任务专属核对表进行自动、可解释的模型比较。

title: WOMD-Reasoning: A Large-Scale Dataset for Interaction Reasoning in Driving

one_line_summary.en: WOMD-Reasoning converts 63,000 WOMD scenes into 2.94 million GPT-4 Turbo Q&As, including 409,000 interaction and intention records that may depend on future trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: WOMD-Reasoning 将 6.3 万个 Waymo 运动场景转成 294 万条规则支撑与 LLM 撰写的问答，但生成式交互叙述和未来感知标签必须分别进行因果与质量审计。

title: xVerify: Efficient Answer Verifier for Reasoning Model Evaluations

one_line_summary.en: xVerify trains lightweight answer-equivalence verifiers on VAR, a roughly 56K-record collection of long reasoning answers with correctness labels.
one_line_summary.zh: 约5.6万问答验证样本以参考答案给出对错标签，适用于训练轻量验证器与推理结果评测。

title: YESciEval: Robust LLM-as-a-Judge for Scientific Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: A rubric-based evaluation framework for scientific question answering that audits judge robustness under adversarial data.
one_line_summary.zh: 以 9 项 rubric、对抗变体和开源 judge 审计科学问答回答的可靠性。

title: Z1: Efficient Test-time Scaling with Code

one_line_summary.en: Z1 releases 107,173 Code Evol-Instruct-derived prompts with QwQ-32B-Preview response trajectories and pairs their SFT use with a token-capped Shifted Thinking Window for efficient inference.
one_line_summary.zh: Z1 发布 107,173 条 Code Evol-Instruct 派生问题与 QwQ-32B-Preview 完整响应轨迹，并用 Shifted Thinking Window 约束推理预算；但数据没有正确性 verifier、长短标签、许可证或去污染记录。

title: Zebra-CoT: A Dataset for Interleaved Vision-Language Reasoning
domains: geometry, physics, algorithms, 2D and 3D reasoning, embodied planning, logic, games, and visual search

one_line_summary.en: Zebra-CoT serializes both textual thoughts and intermediate images so a model can learn to generate visual aids during multi-step reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: Zebra-CoT 把文字思考与中间图像交错保存为 18.2 万条视觉推理轨迹，覆盖 18 个领域。

title: Zero-Overhead Introspection for Adaptive Test-Time Compute

one_line_summary.en: ZIP-RC reuses reserved logits to predict reward and remaining length without an extra inference pass, then allocates prefix-tree search by utility.
one_line_summary.zh: ZIP-RC 在同一次前向中预测奖励与剩余长度，并据此分配测试时搜索。

title: A Survey of Confidence Estimation and Calibration in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A NAACL 2024 survey of estimating and calibrating how reliable an LLM's answer is likely to be.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理大语言模型的置信度估计与校准：如何让自信程度更接近实际正确率。

title: A Survey on Evaluation of Large Language Models
venue: ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology

one_line_summary.en: A high-impact survey that turns “evaluate an LLM” into concrete choices about target, dataset, protocol, and metric.
one_line_summary.zh: 把大模型评测拆成评什么、在哪里评、怎样评的高影响力综述。

title: A Survey on Model Compression for Large Language Models
venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics

one_line_summary.en: A TACL survey of quantization, pruning, and distillation for practical LLM deployment.
one_line_summary.zh: 综述量化、剪枝和知识蒸馏等压缩方法，以及相应的评测指标。

title: AGENT BANK: Towards Generalized LLM Agents via Fine-Tuning on 50000+ Interaction Trajectories

one_line_summary.en: AGENT BANK releases 51,287 paper-reported rationale-action-observation trajectories across 16 tasks for masked-loss trajectory tuning.
one_line_summary.zh: AGENT BANK 发布论文所报 51,287 条跨十六任务的理由、动作与观察轨迹，用于掩码式轨迹微调。
