title: Agent-FLAN: Designing Data and Methods of Effective Agent Tuning for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Agent-FLAN releases 24,703 redesigned agent conversations that separate reasoning, retrieval, arguments, format following, and tool-use negatives for SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: Agent-FLAN 把代理轨迹改写为按能力配比的自然对话，并加入不应调用工具的负例，共公开 24,703 条 SFT 记录。

title: AGENTBANK: Towards Generalized LLM Agents via Fine-Tuning on 50000+ Interaction Trajectories

one_line_summary.en: AGENTBANK releases 50K+ cross-task interaction trajectories with chain-of-thought rationale for every action.
one_line_summary.zh: AGENTBANK 汇集 16 项任务、五类智能体技能的五万余条交互轨迹，并为每个动作提供链式推理标注。

title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents

one_line_summary.en: AgentBoard contributes a tool-use or agent-environment surface with an explicit evaluation or verification contract.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentBoard 提供带明确评测契约的智能体环境评测面，除任务成功率外还用进度指标刻画多轮交互中的逐步推进。

title: AgentTuning: Enabling Generalized Agent Abilities for LLMs

one_line_summary.en: AgentInstruct releases 1,866 reward-filtered, multi-turn ReAct demonstrations across six agent tasks for hybrid instruction tuning.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentInstruct 将六类代理环境整理成 1,866 条按奖励筛选的多轮 ReAct 示范，用于与通用对话混合微调。

title: Aider's Polyglot Coding Benchmark

one_line_summary.en: Aider Polyglot evaluates coding-edit ability across C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust using selected Exercism problems and repository-level test feedback.
one_line_summary.zh: Aider Polyglot 使用筛选后的 Exercism 题目，评测模型在 C++、Go、Java、JavaScript、Python 和 Rust 中完成代码编辑并通过测试的能力。

title: AIME Benchmark for Mathematical Reasoning
venue: Mathematical Association of America exam source / benchmark subset

one_line_summary.en: AIME 是高难度竞赛数学评测源，题量不大但区分度高，常用来观察 frontier reasoning 的上限。
one_line_summary.zh: AIME 是高难度竞赛数学评测源，题量不大但区分度高，常用来观察 frontier reasoning 的上限。

title: AlignBench: Benchmarking Chinese Alignment of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: AlignBench combines real Chinese user scenarios, human-verified references, and rule-calibrated judging to assess multidimensional alignment.
one_line_summary.zh: AlignBench 结合真实中文用户场景、人工核验参考答案与规则校准评判，衡量多维对齐能力。

title: AlphaMath Almost Zero: Process Supervision without Process

one_line_summary.en: AlphaMath converts answer-labeled GSM8K and MATH prompts into selected positive and negative MCTS paths with backed-up step-value targets.
one_line_summary.zh: AlphaMath 将带最终答案的 GSM8K 与 MATH 题目转化为经筛选的正负 MCTS 路径和回传步骤价值目标。

title: Aya Dataset: An Open-Access Collection for Multilingual Instruction Tuning

one_line_summary.en: Aya publishes 204,114 human-authored instruction-response pairs across 65 languages with task provenance.
one_line_summary.zh: Aya 发布 20.4114 万条覆盖 65 种语言、带任务来源的人写指令回答对。

title: BABILong: Testing the Limits of LLMs with Long Context Reasoning-in-a-Haystack

one_line_summary.en: BABILong exposes reasoning-in-a-haystack up to very long contexts as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: BABILong 把超长上下文下的大海捞针式推理做成可审计的评测面。

title: Beyond Human Data: Scaling Self-Training for Problem-Solving with Language Models

one_line_summary.en: ReST-EM samples math solutions or programs from the current policy, keeps only outputs that pass binary checks, and repeats SFT to turn verified self-generation into training data.
one_line_summary.zh: ReST-EM 从当前 policy 采样数学解答或程序，只保留通过二元检查的输出，再重复 SFT，把经验证的自生成结果变成训练数据。

title: ChartAssistant: A Universal Chart Multimodal Language Model via Chart-to-Table Pre-training and Multitask Instruction Tuning

one_line_summary.en: ChartAssistant couples chart-to-table alignment with a released multitask ChartSFT conversation corpus.
one_line_summary.zh: ChartAssistant 将图表到表格对齐与公开的多任务 ChartSFT 对话语料结合。

title: CharXiv: Charting Gaps in Realistic Chart Understanding in Multimodal LLMs

one_line_summary.en: CharXiv exposes chart understanding from arXiv papers as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: CharXiv 把取自 arXiv 论文的图表理解做成可审计的评测面。

title: CriticBench: Benchmarking LLMs for Critique-Correct Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: CriticBench exposes generation-critique-correction reasoning across domains as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: CriticBench 把跨领域的生成、批判与纠正推理做成可审计的评测面。

title: CriticEval: Evaluating Large-scale Language Model as Critic

one_line_summary.en: CriticEval evaluates scalar and textual critique across four critique dimensions and nine task settings using annotated reference critiques.
one_line_summary.zh: CriticEval 通过带标注参考批评的四类批评维度和九类任务，同时评测标量与文本批评。

title: CRITIQUELLM: Towards an Informative Critique Generation Model for Evaluation of Large Language Model Generation

one_line_summary.en: CritiqueLLM trains an informative critique generator for scalable evaluation and generation improvement.
one_line_summary.zh: 训练能给出具体、可操作理由的批评模型，并把批评作为可扩展的生成改进反馈。

title: CRUXEval: A Benchmark for Code Reasoning, Understanding and Execution

one_line_summary.en: CRUXEval exposes code input/output reasoning checked by execution as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: CRUXEval 把由执行结果核验的代码输入输出推理做成可审计的评测面。

title: Cybench: A Framework for Evaluating Cybersecurity Capabilities and Risks of Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Cybench exposes CTF/cyber tasks with flags, subtasks, and command execution as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: Cybench 把带 flag、子任务与命令执行的夺旗与网络安全任务做成可审计的评测面。

title: DART-Math: Difficulty-Aware Rejection Tuning for Mathematical Problem-Solving

one_line_summary.en: DART-Math converts MATH and corrected GSM8K training prompts into answer-verified CoT pairs by allocating more DeepSeekMath-7B-RL trials to queries with lower pass rates.
one_line_summary.zh: DART-Math 按 DeepSeekMath-7B-RL 的低通过率向 MATH 与修正版 GSM8K 难题分配更多采样，再用正则与 SymPy 终局答案检查筛成 CoT SFT 对；该 verifier 不验证中间推理。

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: DeepSeek-V3 discloses aggregate pretraining scale and a high-level SFT/RL post-training sequence, but not the data lineage or feedback contract needed to audit the recipe.
one_line_summary.zh: DeepSeek-V3 披露了聚合预训练规模与高层 SFT/RL 后训练顺序，但未披露审计该配方所需的数据谱系和反馈合约。

title: DSBench: How Far Are Data Science Agents from Becoming Data Science Experts?

one_line_summary.en: DSBench exposes data analysis and modeling tasks over realistic files as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: DSBench 把基于真实文件的数据分析与建模任务做成可审计的评测面。

title: DynaMath: A Dynamic Visual Benchmark for Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning Robustness of Vision Language Models

one_line_summary.en: DynaMath exposes programmatically generated visual math variants as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: DynaMath 把程序化生成的视觉数学变体题做成可审计的评测面。

title: Evaluating LLMs at Detecting Errors in LLM Responses

one_line_summary.en: ReaLMistake evaluates whether LLMs can detect realistic, objectively checkable errors in LLM responses.
one_line_summary.zh: 构造真实且客观的 LLM 回答错误，揭示强模型检测错误的低召回与提示敏感性。

title: Executable Code Actions Elicit Better LLM Agents

one_line_summary.en: CodeActInstruct turns five task suites into 7,139 filtered multi-turn demonstrations of executable Python actions, observations, and self-corrections for SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: CodeActInstruct 将五类任务改造成 7,139 条可执行 Python action、环境反馈与自我纠错的多轮示范，用于智能体监督微调。

title: Factuality of Large Language Models: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: An EMNLP 2024 survey of why LLM answers can be factually wrong and how factuality is evaluated and improved.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理大语言模型事实性错误的成因、改进方法与开放式生成的评测难点。

title: Ferret: Refer and Ground Anything Anywhere at Any Granularity

one_line_summary.en: Ferret's GRIT corpus serializes points, boxes, and free-form regions into about 1.1M grounded conversations.
one_line_summary.zh: Ferret 的 GRIT 语料把点、框和自由形状区域序列化为约 110 万条定位对话。

title: FOLIO: Natural Language Reasoning with First-Order Logic

one_line_summary.en: FOLIO exposes first-order logic reasoning in natural language as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: FOLIO 把自然语言形式的一阶逻辑推理做成可审计的评测面。

title: Free Process Rewards without Process Labels

one_line_summary.en: Free Process Rewards without Process Labels exposes process or trace supervision data.
one_line_summary.zh: 提出隐式 PRM：仅用廉价的回答级标签训练 outcome reward model，即可从策略与参考模型的似然比导出过程奖励。

title: From Crowdsourced Data to High-Quality Benchmarks: Arena-Hard and BenchBuilder Pipeline

one_line_summary.en: Arena-Hard-Auto exposes automatic pairwise judge set from hard arena prompts as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: Arena-Hard-Auto 把源自竞技场高难提示的自动成对评审集做成可审计的评测面。

title: FrontierMath: A Benchmark for Evaluating Advanced Mathematical Reasoning in AI

one_line_summary.en: FrontierMath tests frontier models on original expert-written advanced mathematics problems with controlled release and automated verification.
one_line_summary.zh: FrontierMath 用专家原创、低污染的高等数学题和自动验证来测试 frontier model 的真实数学推理边界。

title: Fundamental Capabilities of Large Language Models and their Applications in Domain Scenarios: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: An ACL survey linking fundamental LLM capabilities to their roles in domain applications.
one_line_summary.zh: 综述大语言模型的基础能力及其在不同领域应用中的作用。

title: Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs

one_line_summary.en: Gorilla / APIBench evaluates API-calling LLMs with documentation-grounded instructions and AST-based tool-call matching.
one_line_summary.zh: Gorilla / APIBench 用文档驱动指令和 AST 匹配评测 LLM 的 API 调用能力。

title: Groma: Localized Visual Tokenization for Grounding Multimodal Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Groma releases about 30K GPT-4V conversations that bind dialogue turns to localized visual tokens and boxes.
one_line_summary.zh: Groma 发布约 3 万条 GPT-4V 定位对话，把会话中的指代绑定到局部视觉 token 与边界框。

title: HalluciDoctor: Mitigating Hallucinatory Toxicity in Visual Instruction Data

one_line_summary.en: HalluciDoctor diagnoses and rewrites roughly 50K visual conversations whose answers contain unsupported image claims.
one_line_summary.zh: HalluciDoctor 诊断并改写约 5 万条含有图像无依据陈述的视觉对话。

title: HelpSteer 2: Open-source dataset for training top-performing reward models

one_line_summary.en: HelpSteer2 is a CC-BY-4.0 preference dataset of about 10,000 response pairs for efficient reward-model training.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 HelpSteer2 开源人类偏好数据，以可解释的多维质量属性和偏好对训练高性能通用奖励模型。

title: JudgeBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-based Judges

one_line_summary.en: JudgeBench exposes objective response-pair judging for knowledge/reasoning/math/code as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: JudgeBench 把知识、推理、数学与代码领域的客观答案对评判做成可审计的评测面。

title: Knowledge Conflicts for LLMs: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: An EMNLP 2024 survey of conflicts between contextual and parametric knowledge in LLMs.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理大语言模型中上下文知识与参数知识发生冲突的情形。

title: KTO: Model Alignment as Prospect Theoretic Optimization

one_line_summary.en: KTO directly aligns a policy from desirable and undesirable response labels using a prospect-theoretic objective.
one_line_summary.zh: KTO 将逐条回答的好/坏二元反馈直接转化为基于前景理论的对齐目标，避免要求同一提示下的成对偏好。

title: Length-Controlled AlpacaEval: A Simple Way to Debias Automatic Evaluators

one_line_summary.en: Length-Controlled AlpacaEval debiases AlpacaEval-style automatic preference scores by estimating win rate at equal output length.
one_line_summary.zh: Length-Controlled AlpacaEval 通过在同等输出长度条件下估计胜率，降低 AlpacaEval 自动偏好评测对长回答的偏置。

title: LESS: Selecting Influential Data for Targeted Instruction Tuning

one_line_summary.en: LESS releases gradient influence scores and task-specific instruction subsets selected from larger public pools.
one_line_summary.zh: LESS 公开梯度影响分数与面向具体任务筛选的指令子集。

title: LiveCodeBench: Holistic and Contamination Free Evaluation of Large Language Models for Code

one_line_summary.en: LiveCodeBench exposes recent contest problems with execution, repair, and output prediction as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: LiveCodeBench 把近期竞赛题的执行、修复与输出预测做成可审计的评测面。

title: LLMs Assist NLP Researchers: Critique Paper (Meta-)Reviewing

one_line_summary.en: ReviewCritique compares human and LLM paper reviews with expert-labeled deficient segments.
one_line_summary.zh: 以专家标注的缺陷片段比较人类与 LLM 论文评审，并检验模型能否识别低质量评论。

title: LongAlign: A Recipe for Long Context Alignment of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: LongAlign-10k packages long documents, instructions, and answers with length-aware training metadata.
one_line_summary.zh: LongAlign-10k 将长文档、指令与回答连同长度感知训练元数据一起发布。

title: LongVideoBench: A Benchmark for Long-context Interleaved Video-Language Understanding

one_line_summary.en: LongVideoBench exposes long video-language QA with referred-context reasoning as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: LongVideoBench 把需要指代上下文推理的长视频语言问答做成可审计的评测面。

title: MAmmoTH: Building Math Generalist Models through Hybrid Instruction Tuning

one_line_summary.en: MAmmoTH releases MathInstruct, a 260k-record hybrid CoT/PoT math SFT mixture with newly generated and execution-filtered rationales.
one_line_summary.zh: MAmmoTH 公开 MathInstruct，把 13 个来源的 26 万条自然语言 CoT 与可执行 PoT 示范用于混合数学 SFT。

title: Math-LLaVA: Bootstrapping Mathematical Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Math-LLaVA turns 40k selected images into an open 360k-record multimodal mathematics instruction set and measures the contribution of selection and four synthesis operations.
one_line_summary.zh: Math-LLaVA 将四万张筛选图像扩展为开放的三十六万条多模态数学问答，并用消融实验区分图像选择与四类合成操作的贡献。

title: Math-Shepherd: Verify and Reinforce LLMs Step-by-step without Human Annotations

one_line_summary.en: Math-Shepherd: Verify and Reinforce LLMs Step-by-step without Human Annotations exposes process or trace supervision data.
one_line_summary.zh: 提出 Math-Shepherd，用自动构造的步骤级监督训练数学过程验证器，并把逐步奖励用于候选重排和 PPO。

title: MathCoder: Seamless Code Integration in LLMs for Enhanced Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: MathCoder turns math problems into open trajectories that alternate reasoning, executable Python, execution feedback, and continued reasoning, then trains models to consume that contract.
one_line_summary.zh: MathCoder 将数学题转成开放轨迹，让自然语言推理、可执行 Python、执行反馈和后续推理交替出现，并用这一契约训练模型。

title: MathGenie: Generating Synthetic Data with Question Back-translation for Enhancing Mathematical Reasoning of LLMs

one_line_summary.en: MathGenieData combines 81K code-integrated solutions, 30K verification rationales, and 170K back-translated math pairs in typed execution-aware records.
one_line_summary.zh: MathGenieData 汇集 81K 代码解答、30K 验证推理和 170K 解答回译题目，并保留文本、代码与执行结果。

title: Measuring short-form factuality in large language models

one_line_summary.en: SimpleQA evaluates short factual answers with a public 4,326-row dataset and a three-way factuality/abstention grader.
one_line_summary.zh: SimpleQA 用 4,326 条短事实问答和三分类评分器评估模型的正确回答、错误回答与不作答行为。

title: MetaMath: Bootstrap Your Own Mathematical Questions for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: MetaMathQA bootstraps both math questions and their worked solutions into a 395k-record public SFT dataset.
one_line_summary.zh: MetaMathQA 把 GSM8K 与 MATH 种子题扩展成 39.5 万条答案增强、改写与正反向推理的公开 SFT 记录。

title: MLLM-as-a-Judge: Assessing Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge with Vision-Language Benchmark

one_line_summary.en: MLLM-as-a-Judge benchmarks multimodal judges on scoring, pairwise comparison, and batch ranking.
one_line_summary.zh: 以打分、成对比较和批量排序三类任务全面检验多模态模型担任裁判的能力。

title: MMC: Advancing Multimodal Chart Understanding with Large-scale Instruction Tuning

one_line_summary.en: MMC packages more than 409K chart QA records and 250K alignment examples from scientific and non-scientific charts.
one_line_summary.zh: MMC 汇集超过 40.9 万条图表问答记录与 25 万条对齐样本，覆盖科学图表和非科学图表。

title: MMLU-Pro: A More Robust and Challenging Multi-Task Language Understanding Benchmark
venue: NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks Spotlight / arXiv

one_line_summary.en: MMLU-Pro exposes harder cleaned MMLU-style questions with 10 answer choices as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: MMLU-Pro 把经清洗、含十个选项的更高难度 MMLU 风格题目做成可审计的评测面。

title: MMMU-Pro: A More Robust Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding Benchmark

one_line_summary.en: MMMU-Pro exposes adversarial multimodal academic QA with vision-only setting as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: MMMU-Pro 把含纯视觉设定的对抗性多模态学科问答做成可审计的评测面。

title: Mol-Instructions: A Large-Scale Biomolecular Instruction Dataset for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Mol-Instructions unifies more than two million molecule, protein, and biomedical-text targets under one instruction schema.
one_line_summary.zh: Mol-Instructions 用统一指令结构组织超过 200 万条分子、蛋白质和生物医学文本目标。

title: mPLUG-DocOwl 1.5: Unified Structure Learning for OCR-free Document Understanding

one_line_summary.en: DocOwl 1.5 combines four million structure records with 25K answer-filtered document explanations.
one_line_summary.zh: DocOwl 1.5 把约 400 万条结构记录与 2.5 万条按答案过滤的文档解释结合起来。

title: MuMath-Code: Combining Tool-Use Large Language Models with Multi-perspective Data Augmentation for Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: MuMath-Code releases 600K tool-integrated math demonstrations after a 751K natural-language stage, using answer or pseudo-answer checks to retain traces.
one_line_summary.zh: MuMath-Code 先用 751K 条自然语言数学数据训练，再公开 600K 条含推理、Python 执行与纠错过程的工具示范。

title: MuMath: Multi-perspective Data Augmentation for Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: MuMath turns GSM8K and MATH into multi-perspective natural-language SFT data, with a 304K main recipe and a distinct approximately 751K scaled release.
one_line_summary.zh: MuMath 以四类多视角增强把 GSM8K 和 MATH 转成自然语言训练示范，并区分 304K 主实验与约 751K 扩展发布。

title: Navigate through Enigmatic Labyrinth A Survey of Chain of Thought Reasoning: Advances, Frontiers and Future

one_line_summary.en: An ACL 2024 survey that organizes chain-of-thought reasoning methods, current frontiers, and open questions.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理思维链推理的方法、研究前沿、挑战与开放问题。

title: OffsetBias: Leveraging Debiased Data for Tuning Evaluators

one_line_summary.en: OffsetBias releases instruction prompts, two candidate responses, and deliberately balanced evaluator labels for response comparison for bounded preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and audit.
one_line_summary.zh: OffsetBias 发布围绕其任务场景组织的候选回答比较与反馈记录，可用于有边界的偏好学习、奖励建模、评测和审计。

title: OlympiadBench: A Challenging Benchmark for Promoting AGI with Olympiad-Level Bilingual Multimodal Scientific Problems

one_line_summary.en: OlympiadBench exposes bilingual olympiad-level math and physics, including multimodal cases as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: OlympiadBench 把双语奥赛级数学与物理题（含多模态题目）做成可审计的评测面。

title: Omni-MATH: A Universal Olympiad Level Mathematic Benchmark for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Omni-MATH exposes olympiad-level math with subdomain and difficulty labels as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: Omni-MATH 把带子领域与难度标注的奥赛级数学题做成可审计的评测面。

title: On the Effects of Data Scale on UI Control Agents

one_line_summary.en: AndroidControl releases 15,283 human Android demonstrations with paired high-/low-level instructions and uses offline next-action matching to show that in-domain SFT scales much faster than out-of-domain high-level control.
one_line_summary.zh: AndroidControl 发布 15,283 条带高层目标与逐动作指令的人类 Android 示范，并以离线下一动作匹配研究数据规模；其分数不等同于在线任务成功，复用仍受许可证冲突与不可回放环境限制。

title: OpenCodeInterpreter: Integrating Code Generation with Execution and Refinement

one_line_summary.en: OpenCodeInterpreter releases 68K multi-turn code conversations and 192K turns that combine explanations, execution feedback, simulated user guidance, and revisions for SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenCodeInterpreter 公开 68K 条多轮代码对话和 192K 个 turn，把解释、执行反馈、模拟用户指导与修订组合成可用于 SFT 的静态记录。

title: OpenMathInstruct-1: A 1.8 Million Math Instruction Tuning Dataset

one_line_summary.en: OpenMathInstruct-1 releases 1.8M verified GSM8K/MATH code-interpreter demonstrations plus 6.6M incorrect traces under a commercially permissive license.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenMathInstruct-1 以开放 Mixtral teacher 生成并公开 1.8M 条经答案校验的 GSM8K/MATH 代码解释器示范，同时保留 6.6M 条错误轨迹。

title: Optimization-based Prompt Injection Attack to LLM-as-a-Judge

one_line_summary.en: JudgeDeceiver optimizes a prompt-injection suffix that makes an LLM judge select an attacker-controlled response across response positions.
one_line_summary.zh: 用优化得到的注入后缀劫持 LLM 裁判的候选选择，并审计换位与常见检测防御。

title: ORPO: Monolithic Preference Optimization without Reference Model

one_line_summary.en: ORPO unifies supervised fine-tuning and pairwise preference optimization through an odds-ratio penalty without a reference model.
one_line_summary.zh: ORPO 在监督微调中加入优选/拒选回答的赔率比惩罚，统一完成指令学习和偏好优化而不使用参考模型。

title: Osprey: Pixel Understanding with Visual Instruction Tuning

one_line_summary.en: Osprey releases 724K conversations whose targets are conditioned on arbitrary pixel masks rather than coarse boxes.
one_line_summary.zh: Osprey 发布 72.4 万条以任意像素掩码而非粗框为条件的视觉对话。

title: Phi-4 Technical Report

one_line_summary.en: Phi-4 releases MIT model weights and reports a 9.8T-token synthetic-heavy pipeline, 8B-token SFT, 250,297 token-local DPO examples, and about 850K judge-guided pairs, but no training corpus or stage-to-record lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Phi-4 报告了以合成数据为主的预训练与后训练：约 50 类数据集、约 400B 合成 token、8B SFT token，以及由任务 oracle 辅助的 DPO；但未发布数据、完整血缘或 verifier 细节。

title: ProcessBench: Identifying Process Errors in Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: ProcessBench exposes earliest erroneous step identification as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: ProcessBench 把数学推理中最早出错步骤的定位做成可审计的评测面。

title: Prometheus 2: An open source language model specialized in evaluating other language models

one_line_summary.en: Releases Prometheus 2, an open judge model that accepts custom rubrics and supports both absolute scoring and pairwise comparison.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 Prometheus 2 开放裁判模型：接收用户自定义量规，同时输出绝对评分与成对比较，替代不透明的闭源评判器。

title: Prometheus-Vision: Vision-Language Model as a Judge for Fine-Grained Evaluation

one_line_summary.en: Prometheus-Vision trains an open vision-language judge on 15K user-facing rubrics for image-grounded, fine-grained evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: Prometheus-Vision 用 1.5 万条面向用户的量规训练开源视觉语言评判模型，进行图像依据的细粒度评测。

title: Prometheus: Inducing Fine-Grained Evaluation Capability in Language Models

one_line_summary.en: Prometheus trains an open evaluator on GPT-4 feedback, custom rubrics, and reference answers for fine-grained scoring and critique.
one_line_summary.zh: Prometheus 利用 GPT-4 反馈、自定义量规和参考答案训练开源评判模型，进行细粒度评分与批评。

title: Puzzle Solving using Reasoning of Large Language Models: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: An EMNLP 2024 survey of language-model puzzle solving, organized around rule-based and rule-less puzzles.
one_line_summary.zh: 以规则型与非规则型谜题为主线，梳理语言模型解题的方法、数据集、基准与困难。

title: Quilt-LLaVA: Visual Instruction Tuning by Extracting Localized Narratives from Open-Source Histopathology Videos

one_line_summary.en: Quilt-LLaVA converts localized narration from open pathology videos into 107K image-question-explanation records.
one_line_summary.zh: Quilt-LLaVA 把开放病理视频中的局部专家讲解转换成 10.7 万条图像、问题与解释记录。

title: RAGTruth: A Hallucination Corpus for Developing Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Language Models

one_line_summary.en: RAGTruth is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
one_line_summary.zh: 对近 18K RAG 生成回答作实例级、词级和幻觉强度人工标注，直接对应检索证据约束下的生成事实性与细粒度错误定位。

title: ReST-MCTS*: LLM Self-Training via Process Reward Guided Tree Search

one_line_summary.en: ReST-MCTS* uses value-guided tree search and terminal-answer verification to create positive policy trajectories and scalar partial-solution targets for mutual self-training.
one_line_summary.zh: ReST-MCTS* 用价值引导树搜索与终点答案核验生成正向策略轨迹和部分解标量目标，以联合迭代训练策略模型与过程价值模型。

title: RLAIF vs. RLHF: Scaling Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback with AI Feedback

one_line_summary.en: RLAIF trains alignment systems from LLM-generated feedback and compares reward-model and direct-reward variants with human-feedback RL.
one_line_summary.zh: RLAIF 用现成语言模型生成偏好反馈，并比较经奖励模型训练与直接获取 AI 奖励的两条强化学习路径。

title: RLHF-V: Towards Trustworthy MLLMs via Behavior Alignment from Fine-grained Correctional Human Feedback

one_line_summary.en: RLHF-V: Towards Trustworthy MLLMs via Behavior Alignment from Fine-grained Correctional Human Feedback releases image-text responses with segment-level human corrections for hallucinated content and dense preference supervision for preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and feedback audit.
one_line_summary.zh: 以人工标出的视觉幻觉片段构造纠错式偏好监督，可用于密集多模态偏好优化。

title: SciInstruct: a Self-Reflective Instruction Annotated Dataset for Training Scientific Language Models

one_line_summary.en: SciInstruct turns answer-only science questions into open worked-solution records through staged generation, self-reflection, outcome checking, and learned quality filtering.
one_line_summary.zh: SciInstruct 通过分阶段生成、自我反思、结果核验和质量分类，把仅有答案的科学问题转成开放的分步解答记录。

title: SedarEval: Automated Evaluation using Self-Adaptive Rubrics

one_line_summary.en: SedarEval creates per-question adaptive rubrics with positive and penalty points and trains judges that better match human scoring.
one_line_summary.zh: SedarEval 为每道题生成带加分与扣分项的自适应量表，并用其训练更贴近人工评分的裁判。

title: Self-Alignment with Instruction Backtranslation

one_line_summary.en: Instruction backtranslation generates and curates instructions for web documents, then uses the resulting pairs for iterative instruction tuning.
one_line_summary.zh: 指令回译为网页文本生成并筛选相应指令，再将保留的指令—文本对用于迭代式指令微调。

title: Self-Explore: Enhancing Mathematical Reasoning in Language Models with Fine-grained Rewards

one_line_summary.en: Self-Explore converts rejected math rationales into prompt/chosen/pit-step preferences by searching for the first prefix with no correct recovery among four samples; code is open, but paper-run generated pairs are not.
one_line_summary.zh: Self-Explore 从被拒数学推理中搜索首个四次续写均无法恢复正确答案的步骤，并构造 prompt/chosen/错误步骤偏好对；代码已开放，但论文运行生成的数据对未发布。

title: Self-Play Fine-Tuning Converts Weak Language Models to Strong Language Models

one_line_summary.en: SPIN releases base dialogues and iteration 0-3 policy responses that support repeated self-play fine-tuning.
one_line_summary.zh: SPIN 公开基础对话及第 0 至第 3 轮策略回答，用于反复自博弈微调。

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection

one_line_summary.en: Self-RAG releases 150K instruction outputs augmented with passages and reflection tokens for adaptive retrieval-and-critique SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: Self-RAG 公开约 15 万条插入检索、相关性、支持度与效用 token 的指令输出，用于检索感知的自我批判式 SFT。

title: Self-Rewarding Language Models

one_line_summary.en: A language model generates and judges its own candidate answers, then improves through iterative DPO on the resulting preference pairs.
one_line_summary.zh: 自奖励语言模型让同一模型生成候选回答并充当评审器，再用这些自生成的偏好对迭代进行 DPO 训练。

title: ShareGPT4V: Improving Large Multi-Modal Models with Better Captions

one_line_summary.en: ShareGPT4V distills 100K GPT-4V captions into a captioner that expands dense visual supervision to 1.2M images.
one_line_summary.zh: ShareGPT4V 先收集 10 万条 GPT-4V 详尽描述，再训练描述器把高密度视觉监督扩展到 120 万张图像。

title: ShareGPT4Video: Improving Video Understanding and Generation with Better Captions

one_line_summary.en: ShareGPT4Video releases 40K long temporal captions and a captioner for scaling video-language supervision.
one_line_summary.zh: ShareGPT4Video 发布 4 万条长时序描述，并提供可扩展视频语言监督的描述器。

title: SimPO: Simple Preference Optimization with a Reference-Free Reward

one_line_summary.en: SimPO trains chosen/rejected preference pairs with a length-normalized implicit reward and no reference model.
one_line_summary.zh: SimPO 以长度归一化的平均对数概率充当隐式奖励，并用目标间隔直接训练偏好对，无需参考模型。

title: Skywork-Reward: Bag of Tricks for Reward Modeling in LLMs

one_line_summary.en: Skywork-Reward: Bag of Tricks for Reward Modeling in LLMs addresses practical reward-modeling methods.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 Skywork-Reward-Preference-80K，并总结数据选择、去噪和过滤等奖励模型训练配方。

title: SpreadsheetBench: Towards Challenging Real World Spreadsheet Manipulation
venue: NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks Track Spotlight / arXiv

one_line_summary.en: SpreadsheetBench evaluates agents on challenging real-world spreadsheet manipulation.
one_line_summary.zh: SpreadsheetBench 用真实 Excel 操作任务和文件状态比较评测智能体。

title: Step-DPO: Step-wise Preference Optimization for Long-chain Reasoning of LLMs

one_line_summary.en: Introduces Step-DPO, an algorithm that applies preference optimization to individual reasoning steps rather than only final answers.
one_line_summary.zh: 提出 Step-DPO 步骤级偏好优化算法：把长数学推理的 DPO 监督从整题答案下沉到单个推理步骤。

title: Superfiltering: Weak-to-Strong Data Filtering for Fast Instruction-Tuning

one_line_summary.en: Superfiltering releases scored Alpaca-family records and tiny subsets selected by GPT-2 instruction-following difficulty.
one_line_summary.zh: Superfiltering 发布带 GPT-2 指令跟随难度分数的 Alpaca 系列记录及其小比例筛选子集。

title: SWE-bench Multimodal: Do AI Systems Generalize to Visual Software Domains?

one_line_summary.en: SWE-bench Multimodal extends repository repair tasks to visual software domains.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-bench Multimodal 将仓库修复任务扩展到视觉软件领域。

title: SWT-Bench: Testing and Validating Real-World Bug-Fixes with Code Agents

one_line_summary.en: SWT-Bench tests whether code agents can generate and validate tests for real-world bug fixes.
one_line_summary.zh: SWT-Bench 检验代码智能体能否为真实 bug fix 生成并验证测试。

title: tau-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains

one_line_summary.en: Tau-Bench exposes retail/airline user-agent-tool conversations with database-state grading as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: Tau-Bench 把零售与航空场景下的用户、智能体与工具对话及数据库状态判分做成可审计的评测面。

title: The Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL): From Tool Use to Agentic Evaluation of Large Language Models
venue: Official leaderboard BibTeX lists ICML 2025; no standalone paper page verified

one_line_summary.en: BFCL / Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard exposes function/API call generation with AST/execution checks as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: BFCL 把带抽象语法树与执行检查的函数及 API 调用生成做成可审计的评测面。

title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models

one_line_summary.en: Llama 3.1 discloses a 15.6T-token 50/25/17/8 pretraining mix and six rounds of reward modeling, best-of-10–30 rejection sampling, SFT, and DPO, while releasing weights and guards but not corpora, preferences, reward models, candidates, or item lineage.
one_line_summary.zh: Llama 3.1 披露 15.6T token、50/25/17/8 预训练配比，以及六轮 reward model、best-of-10–30 rejection sampling、SFT 与 DPO；它开放权重、推理工具和 Llama Guard 3，但不开放语料、偏好、RM、候选或 item-level lineage。

title: The PRISM Alignment Dataset: What Participatory, Representative and Individualised Human Feedback Reveals About the Subjective and Multicultural Alignment of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: PRISM links 1,500 participants’ stated preferences and profiles to fine-grained ratings in 8,011 live conversations with 21 LLMs.
one_line_summary.zh: PRISM 将 1,500 名参与者的调查、社会人口信息与 21 个 LLM 的实时对话评分相连，揭示多文化对齐的主观差异。

title: TheAgentCompany: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Consequential Real World Tasks

one_line_summary.en: TheAgentCompany pairs 175 simulated-company tasks with mixed checkpoint evaluators and releases model-generated results, screenshots, and full evaluation trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: TheAgentCompany 将 175 个模拟公司任务、混合 checkpoint evaluator 与模型生成的结果、截图和完整评测轨迹连接起来，但轨迹日志许可、不可变环境版本、split、去污染、逐条 lineage、judge 校准和隐私同意仍未确认。

title: TinyChart: Efficient Chart Understanding with Visual Token Merging and Program-of-Thoughts Learning

one_line_summary.en: TinyChartData exposes chart questions with Python program-of-thought targets and final answers for compact chart SFT.
one_line_summary.zh: TinyChartData 公开图表问题、Python 思维程序与最终答案，用于紧凑图表模型的指令微调。

title: Training Language Models to Self-Correct via Reinforcement Learning

one_line_summary.en: SCoRe trains on the learner's own two-turn correction episodes, using a KL-constrained initialization followed by progress-shaped multi-turn RL with programmatic outcome rewards.
one_line_summary.zh: SCoRe 在学习者自身的两轮纠正轨迹上训练，先做 KL 约束的初始化，再用进度整形的多轮强化学习配合程序化结果奖励。

title: UltraFeedback: Boosting Language Models with Scaled AI Feedback

one_line_summary.en: UltraFeedback combines diverse instructions, multi-model answers, and GPT-4 critiques and scores into a large-scale alignment resource.
one_line_summary.zh: UltraFeedback 将多源指令、17 个模型回答与按四个维度给出的 GPT-4 反馈组织为大规模对齐资源。

title: V-STaR: Training Verifiers for Self-Taught Reasoners

one_line_summary.en: V-STaR keeps correct self-generated solutions for iterative generator SFT and converts correct-versus-incorrect outcomes into DPO verifier pairs for Best-of-k ranking.
one_line_summary.zh: V-STaR 将正确的自生成解用于迭代式 generator SFT，并把同题正确—错误结果转换为 DPO verifier pairs，以支持 Best-of-k 排序。

title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks

one_line_summary.en: VisualWebArena turns visually grounded website tasks into an auditable browser-agent evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: VisualWebArena 将视觉网页任务变成可审计的浏览器智能体评测表面。

title: VLFeedback: A Large-Scale AI Feedback Dataset for Large Vision-Language Models Alignment

one_line_summary.en: VLFeedback releases GPT-4V-scored multimodal responses across helpfulness, visual faithfulness, and ethical considerations for VLM preference training.
one_line_summary.zh: VLFeedback 用 GPT-4V 按有帮助性、视觉忠实性和伦理考量为多模态回答打分并生成理由，支持 VLM 偏好训练。

title: WebLINX: Real-World Website Navigation with Multi-Turn Dialogue

one_line_summary.en: WebLINX packages multi-turn dialogue web navigation demonstrations for agent training and evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: WebLINX 将多轮对话式网页导航示范整理为 Web 智能体数据。

title: WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models

one_line_summary.en: WebVoyager evaluates multimodal agents on live website browsing tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: WebVoyager 在真实网页浏览任务上评测多模态智能体。

title: WildGuard: Open One-Stop Moderation Tools for Safety Risks, Jailbreaks, and Refusals of LLMs

one_line_summary.en: WildGuard: Open One-Stop Moderation Tools for Safety Risks, Jailbreaks, and Refusals of LLMs addresses open moderation tools for safety risks and jailbreaks.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 WildGuardMix 安全审核数据和 WildGuard 模型，用统一标签识别有害意图、回答风险、拒答与越狱攻击。

title: WizardLM: Empowering large pre-trained language models to follow complex instructions

one_line_summary.en: WizardLM turns 52K seed instructions into a 250K candidate pool through explicit depth and breadth operations before teacher answering.
one_line_summary.zh: WizardLM 用显式深度和广度操作把 52K 条种子指令扩展成 250K 候选，再生成教师回答。

title: WorkArena++: Towards Compositional Planning and Reasoning-based Common Knowledge Work Tasks
venue: arXiv; official WorkArena GitHub labels NeurIPS 2024

one_line_summary.en: WorkArena++ extends enterprise web-agent evaluation toward compositional planning trajectories.
one_line_summary.zh: WorkArena++ 将企业 Web 智能体评测推进到组合规划轨迹。

title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?

one_line_summary.en: WorkArena evaluates web agents on stateful enterprise knowledge-work tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: WorkArena 用有状态企业知识工作任务评测 Web 智能体。

title: ∞Bench: Extending Long Context Evaluation Beyond 100K Tokens

one_line_summary.en: InfiniteBench exposes 100K+ token tasks across retrieval, code, math, novels, dialogue as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: InfiniteBench 把检索、代码、数学、小说与对话上超过十万词元的长上下文任务做成可审计的评测面。

title: A Survey of Deep Learning for Mathematical Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: An ACL 2023 survey of mathematical-reasoning tasks, datasets, methods, benchmarks, and future directions.
one_line_summary.zh: 梳理数学推理的任务、数据集、方法、基准与未来问题。

title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents

one_line_summary.en: AgentBench contributes a tool-use or agent-environment surface with an explicit evaluation or verification contract.
one_line_summary.zh: AgentBench 提供带明确评测契约的工具使用与智能体环境评测面，用各环境特有的成功与失败信号量化推理、决策和指令遵循行为。

title: Aligning Large Multimodal Models with Factually Augmented RLHF

one_line_summary.en: Aligning Large Multimodal Models with Factually Augmented RLHF releases image-text conversations with human preferences over answers and factually augmented reward-learning context for preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and feedback audit.
one_line_summary.zh: 图文问答的人类偏好比较结合图像事实信息，可用于降低多模态奖励模型的幻觉。

title: ARES: An Automated Evaluation Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

one_line_summary.en: ARES exposes automated RAG evaluation with synthetic training and PPI as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: ARES 把带合成训练数据与预测驱动推断的自动化检索增强生成评测做成可审计的评测面。

title: C-Eval: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models

one_line_summary.en: C-Eval exposes Chinese multi-level/multi-subject exam QA as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: C-Eval 将 Chinese multi-level/multi-subject exam QA 做成可审计的评测面。

title: Camels in a Changing Climate: Enhancing LM Adaptation with Tulu 2

one_line_summary.en: Tulu 2 connects a 326K instruction mixture, scalable DPO, open checkpoints, and common evaluation in one reproducible adaptation suite.
one_line_summary.zh: Tulu 2 把 32.6 万条指令混合数据、可扩展 DPO、开放 checkpoint 和统一评测连接成可复现的适配套件。

title: Can LLM Already Serve as A Database Interface? A BIg Bench for Large-Scale Database Grounded Text-to-SQLs

one_line_summary.en: BIRD expands text-to-SQL toward larger databases, external knowledge, and more realistic database-grounded reasoning.
one_line_summary.zh: BIRD 用 12,751 个 text-to-SQL pairs、95 个大数据库和约 33.4GB 内容扩展 database-grounded 评测。

title: CMMLU: Measuring massive multitask language understanding in Chinese

one_line_summary.en: CMMLU exposes Chinese multitask language understanding questions as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: CMMLU 把中文多任务语言理解题做成可审计的评测面。

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model

one_line_summary.en: DPO directly optimizes a policy from chosen/rejected preference pairs using a reference-policy likelihood ratio.
one_line_summary.zh: DPO 用参考策略的似然比直接从优选/拒选回答对优化模型，无需单独训练奖励模型。

title: Enhancing Chat Language Models by Scaling High-quality Instructional Conversations

one_line_summary.en: UltraChat generates both sides of 1.47M topic-steered conversations, turning explicit user-demand sectors into multi-turn SFT data.
one_line_summary.zh: UltraChat 同时生成 147 万段主题引导对话的双方发言，把明确的用户需求类别转成多轮 SFT 数据。

title: Evaluating the Performance of Large Language Models on GAOKAO Benchmark

one_line_summary.en: GAOKAO-Bench evaluates LLMs on Chinese Gaokao objective and subjective exam questions with converted exam scores.
one_line_summary.zh: GAOKAO-Bench 用中国高考主客观题评测 LLM，并把人类考试总分与主观题评分一致性纳入审计。

title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation

one_line_summary.en: FActScore exposes atomic fact decomposition and retrieval-grounded factual precision as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: FActScore 将长回答拆成 atomic facts，并用知识源支持标签评估 factual precision。

title: FELM: Benchmarking Factuality Evaluation of Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: FELM benchmarks factuality evaluators with segment-level error labels, error types, and external evidence.
one_line_summary.zh: 以带证据链接和错误类型的片段级标注，评测事实性裁判能否定位开放回答中的局部错误。

title: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants

one_line_summary.en: GAIA evaluates general assistants with 466 hidden-answer real-world questions requiring reasoning, tools, browsing, files, and multimodal handling.
one_line_summary.zh: GAIA 用 466 个现实 assistant 问题评测工具使用、多模态、网页浏览和推理的组合能力。

title: GPQA: A Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A Benchmark

one_line_summary.en: GPQA provides 448 expert-written Google-proof science multiple-choice questions for scalable oversight and hard-domain reasoning evaluation.
one_line_summary.zh: GPQA 提供 448 道专家编写的 Google-proof 科学选择题，用于困难领域推理和 scalable oversight 评测。

title: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: IFEval 用规则可检查的指令约束评测模型是否真的遵循格式、长度、关键词、语言等要求。
one_line_summary.zh: IFEval 用规则可检查的指令约束评测模型是否真的遵循格式、长度、关键词、语言等要求。

title: Is Your Code Generated by LLM Really Correct? Rigorous Evaluation of Large Language Models for Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: EvalPlus exposes strengthened HumanEval+ and MBPP+ test suites as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: EvalPlus 将 strengthened HumanEval+ and MBPP+ test suites 做成可审计的评测面。

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena

one_line_summary.en: MT-Bench / Chatbot Arena exposes GPT-4 pairwise/multi-turn judging and human arena votes as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: MT-Bench 与 Chatbot Arena 把 GPT-4 的成对及多轮评判和人类竞技场投票做成可审计的评测面。

title: Large Language Models Meet NL2Code: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: An ACL 2023 survey of LLMs for converting natural-language descriptions into code.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理大语言模型如何把自然语言需求转换为代码，并比较模型、基准与指标。

title: LeanDojo: Theorem Proving with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models

one_line_summary.en: LeanDojo Benchmark exposes Lean theorem proving with retrieval/tracing environment as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: LeanDojo Benchmark 把带检索与追踪环境的 Lean 定理证明做成可审计的评测面。

title: LegalBench: A Collaboratively Built Benchmark for Measuring Legal Reasoning in Large Language Models

one_line_summary.en: LegalBench exposes legal reasoning task suite as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: LegalBench 将 legal reasoning task suite 做成可审计的评测面。

title: Let's Verify Step by Step

one_line_summary.en: Let's Verify Step by Step exposes process or trace supervision data.
one_line_summary.zh: 发布 PRM800K：为 MATH 解题轨迹提供 80 万条人工步骤反馈标签，并实证过程监督优于只监督最终答案。

title: Let's Verify Step by Step (MATH-500 Evaluation Subset)

one_line_summary.en: MATH-500 是 verifier、PRM 和推理模型报告里常用的固定评测子集，用来降低整套 MATH 评测成本。
one_line_summary.zh: MATH-500 是 verifier、PRM 和推理模型报告里常用的固定评测子集，用来降低整套 MATH 评测成本。

title: LIMA: Less Is More for Alignment

one_line_summary.en: LIMA uses 1,000 curated instruction-response pairs to test whether a capable base model needs data quality more than data volume to learn an assistant style.
one_line_summary.zh: LIMA 用 1,000 条精选指令—回答记录检验：能力较强的基础模型学习助手风格时，数据质量是否比数据规模更关键。

title: LongBench: A Bilingual, Multitask Benchmark for Long Context Understanding

one_line_summary.en: LongBench exposes bilingual long-document QA, summarization, few-shot, and code tasks as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: LongBench 把中英双语的长文档问答、摘要、少样本与代码任务做成可审计的评测面。

title: MathVista: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning of Foundation Models in Visual Contexts

one_line_summary.en: MathVista exposes visual mathematical reasoning over diagrams, charts, and figures as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: MathVista 把基于示意图、图表与插图的视觉数学推理做成可审计的评测面。

title: MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI

one_line_summary.en: MMMU exposes college-level multimodal subject questions as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: MMMU 把大学水平的多模态学科题目做成可审计的评测面。

title: OpenAssistant Conversations - Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment

one_line_summary.en: OpenAssistant Conversations - Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment addresses open conversational alignment data.
one_line_summary.zh: OpenAssistant Conversations 构建并公开了 OASST1，包含约 16.1 万条消息、35 种语言、46.1 万个质量评分和一万余棵完整对话树，可用于指令微调、奖励模型训练和人类偏好对齐。

title: Orca 2: Teaching Small Language Models How to Reason

one_line_summary.en: Orca 2 elicits task-specific reasoning strategies from GPT-4 and erases the strategy prompt during SFT so a smaller model learns both how and when to reason.
one_line_summary.zh: Orca 2 让 GPT-4 按任务生成不同策略的推理回答，并在 SFT 时擦除策略提示，使小模型同时学习怎样推理和何时采用哪种策略。

title: RAFT: Reward rAnked FineTuning for Generative Foundation Model Alignment

one_line_summary.en: RAFT samples candidates, selects the reward-best response, and fine-tunes the policy on it.
one_line_summary.zh: RAFT 从多个策略候选中保留奖励最高的回答，并用该回答迭代监督微调模型。

title: Reasoning with Language Model Prompting: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: An ACL 2023 survey of prompting methods used to elicit and study reasoning in language models.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统梳理如何用提示激发语言模型推理，并提供方法比较与学习资源。

title: RRHF: Rank Responses to Align Language Models with Human Feedback

one_line_summary.en: RRHF trains a policy to rank sampled responses in the same order as feedback, using a lightweight ranking loss.
one_line_summary.zh: RRHF 让模型对多来源候选回答的概率排序与反馈排序一致，无需 PPO 或单独奖励模型。

title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions

one_line_summary.en: Self-Instruct repeatedly asks GPT-3 to invent, filter, and answer new tasks, expanding 175 human seeds into 82,439 synthetic SFT instances.
one_line_summary.zh: Self-Instruct 反复让 GPT-3 发明、过滤并回答新任务，把 175 条人写种子扩展为 82,439 条合成 SFT 实例。

title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?

one_line_summary.en: SWE-bench turns real GitHub issues into executable repository repair tasks.
one_line_summary.zh: SWE-bench 将真实 GitHub issue 转化为可执行仓库修复任务。

title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs

one_line_summary.en: ToolLLM introduces ToolBench, a large tool-use dataset over 16,464 real-world APIs, plus ToolEval and ToolLLaMA for training and evaluating API-using models.
one_line_summary.zh: ToolLLM 提出 ToolBench：覆盖 16,464 个真实 API 的工具使用数据集，并配套 ToolEval 与 ToolLLaMA 用于训练和评测。

title: Towards Reasoning in Large Language Models: A Survey

one_line_summary.en: This survey separates supervised reasoning, inference-time elicitation, self-improvement, evaluation, and interpretation into distinct claim types.
one_line_summary.zh: 这篇综述把监督推理、推理时诱导、自改进、评测和解释拆成不同主张类型。

title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
venue: Published as ICLR 2024 in arXiv PDF; WebArena-x index also labels WebArena as NeurIPS 2024 Oral

one_line_summary.en: WebArena exposes browser tasks on self-hosted realistic websites with functional checks as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: WebArena 把自建真实网站上带功能性检查的浏览器任务做成可审计的评测面。

title: Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models
venue: Transactions on Machine Learning Research / arXiv

one_line_summary.en: BIG-bench exposes collaborative suite of diverse language-model tasks as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: BIG-bench 把社区协作构建的多样化语言模型任务集做成可审计的评测面。

title: DS-1000: A Natural and Reliable Benchmark for Data Science Code Generation

one_line_summary.en: DS-1000 exposes data-science code completion with executable tests and API constraints as an auditable evaluation surface.
one_line_summary.zh: DS-1000 把带可执行测试与 API 约束的数据科学代码补全做成可审计的评测面。

title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
venue: Transactions on Machine Learning Research / arXiv

one_line_summary.en: HELM 把语言模型评测组织成“场景 × 指标”的矩阵，不只看准确率，也看校准、鲁棒性、公平性、毒性、效率等维度。
one_line_summary.zh: HELM 把语言模型评测组织成“场景 × 指标”的矩阵，不只看准确率，也看校准、鲁棒性、公平性、毒性、效率等维度。

title: Large Language Models are Zero-Shot Reasoners

one_line_summary.en: Zero-shot-CoT uses a generic cue and a second answer-extraction call to elicit test-time rationales without demonstrations.
one_line_summary.zh: Zero-shot-CoT 用通用提示和第二次答案抽取，在没有示例时诱导可见的测试时理由。

title: Pre-train, Prompt, and Predict: A Systematic Survey of Prompting Methods in Natural Language Processing

one_line_summary.en: A high-impact systematic survey of the prompt designs that later reasoning prompting builds on.
one_line_summary.zh: 系统整理提示构造、预训练模型与微调策略的高引综述。

title: STaR: Bootstrapping Reasoning With Reasoning

one_line_summary.en: STaR repeatedly turns answer-correct model rationales into new SFT data, bootstrapping reasoning from few demonstrations.
one_line_summary.zh: STaR 反复把答案正确的模型 rationale 转成新一轮 SFT 数据，用少量示范自举推理能力。

title: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

one_line_summary.en: HH-RLHF releases dialogue contexts, paired assistant responses, and helpfulness or harmlessness preferences including red-team interactions for bounded preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and audit.
one_line_summary.zh: HH-RLHF 发布围绕其任务场景组织的候选回答比较与反馈记录，可用于有边界的偏好学习、奖励建模、评测和审计。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code

one_line_summary.en: HumanEval 用小而精的函数合成任务和单元测试定义代码生成能力，是代码 benchmark 的基础坐标。
one_line_summary.zh: HumanEval 用小而精的函数合成任务和单元测试定义代码生成能力，是代码 benchmark 的基础坐标。

title: Measuring Coding Challenge Competence With APPS

one_line_summary.en: APPS 把代码评测推进到竞赛编程和复杂输入输出题，能暴露长程算法推理与实现能力。
one_line_summary.zh: APPS 把代码评测推进到竞赛编程和复杂输入输出题，能暴露长程算法推理与实现能力。

title: Measuring Mathematical Problem Solving With the MATH Dataset

one_line_summary.en: MATH 将竞赛级数学题系统化，覆盖代数、几何、数论、组合等方向，是硬数学评测的根节点之一。
one_line_summary.zh: MATH 将竞赛级数学题系统化，覆盖代数、几何、数论、组合等方向，是硬数学评测的根节点之一。

title: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems

one_line_summary.en: GSM8K provides 8,792 grade-school math word problems and uses final numeric answer checking while studying verifier models.
one_line_summary.zh: GSM8K 提供 8,792 道小学数学应用题，用最终数值答案检查，并研究 verifier models。

title: TruthfulQA: Measuring How Models Mimic Human Falsehoods

one_line_summary.en: TruthfulQA 检查模型是否复述常见误解和虚假信念，而不是给出真实回答。
one_line_summary.zh: TruthfulQA 检查模型是否复述常见误解和虚假信念，而不是给出真实回答。

title: Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding

one_line_summary.en: MMLU 建立了覆盖 57 个学科的大规模多选题评测面，用来衡量模型在预训练知识、专业考试和跨学科推理上的基本能力。
one_line_summary.zh: MMLU 建立了覆盖 57 个学科的大规模多选题评测面，用来衡量模型在预训练知识、专业考试和跨学科推理上的基本能力。

title: What Disease Does This Patient Have? A Large-scale Open Domain Question Answering Dataset from Medical Exams

one_line_summary.en: MedQA-USMLE provides 12,723 English medical licensing-exam questions, with the full MedQA release spanning 61,097 multilingual questions.
one_line_summary.zh: MedQA-USMLE 常用英文子集有 12,723 道医学执照考试选择题；完整 MedQA 多语 release 约 61,097 题。

title: HellaSwag: Can a Machine Really Finish Your Sentence?

one_line_summary.en: HellaSwag tests grounded commonsense continuation by adversarially filtering easy artifacts from video-caption and activity data.
one_line_summary.zh: HellaSwag 用约 70K 个 adversarially filtered 续写选择题测试 grounded commonsense。

title: PubMedQA: A Dataset for Biomedical Research Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: PubMedQA evaluates biomedical yes/no/maybe reasoning with 1,000 expert-labeled examples plus larger unlabeled and artificial subsets.
one_line_summary.zh: PubMedQA 用 PubMed 摘要评测生物医学 yes/no/maybe 推理，核心评测集是 1,000 个 expert-labeled PQA-L 样本。

title: WinoGrande: An Adversarial Winograd Schema Challenge at Scale

one_line_summary.en: WinoGrande scales Winograd-style commonsense pronoun resolution with adversarial filtering to reduce superficial cues.
one_line_summary.zh: WinoGrande 将 Winograd-style 常识消歧扩展到约 44K 题，并用 adversarial filtering 降低浅层线索。

title: FEVER: a Large-scale Dataset for Fact Extraction and VERification

one_line_summary.en: FEVER links 185,445 factual claims to Wikipedia evidence and labels, making fact verification an evidence-grounded evaluation task.
one_line_summary.zh: FEVER 把 185,445 条 factual claims 绑定到 Wikipedia 证据句和三分类标签，是证据约束 fact verification 的经典 benchmark。

title: GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Natural Language Understanding

one_line_summary.en: GLUE is an ICLR 2019 multi-task NLU benchmark with nine English sentence and sentence-pair tasks plus a diagnostic set.
one_line_summary.zh: GLUE 是 ICLR 2019 的多任务 NLU benchmark，包含 9 个英文句子/句对任务和 diagnostic set。

title: HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering

one_line_summary.en: HotpotQA makes multi-hop QA auditable by pairing answers with supporting Wikipedia facts.
one_line_summary.zh: HotpotQA 含约 113k 个 Wikipedia 多跳问答样本，并给出 supporting facts，使答案与证据链能一起被评测。

title: Spider: A Large-Scale Human-Labeled Dataset for Complex and Cross-Domain Semantic Parsing and Text-to-SQL Task

one_line_summary.en: Spider made cross-domain text-to-SQL evaluation difficult by separating database schemas across train and test.
one_line_summary.zh: Spider 用 10,181 个问题、200 个数据库和跨 domain split 建立了经典 text-to-SQL 难题。
